posts.title: Ability to follow an author
posts.description: And get notifications when they publish a new book.

posts.title: Series Tracker
posts.description: See all started series and where I'm at.

posts.title: Add (private) notes to books
posts.description: It would be interesting to have a short notes field in the To-Read Pile in order to keep track of who recommended that book, or a quote/review that brought it to your attention, that sort of thing.

posts.title: Book status of Paused
posts.description: I would like to request that the status option of Paused be added to "Read," "Currently reading," "Did not finish," etc. I find this need especially with hefty short story collections. I now only have the option of "Did not finish" [DNF] or removing. The DNF gives the impression I disliked the book and removes it from any association with my list. This Paused would be a less 'binary' option (using the term loosely) and would assist me in tracking my reading. I'd not be compelled to know how far I'd gotten (page count) or when started/stopped -- if that helps database interaction. Thanks for considering.

posts.title: Upcoming Releases
posts.description: It would be cool to find upcoming releases that may interest you. Maybe an added filter on the Your Recommendations page to filter by release year?

posts.title: Author pages
posts.description: It would be great to have a way to navigate an author's backlist by series/published dates.

posts.title: Ability to follow a series
posts.description: And get notifications when a new book is added to the series. I'm not always interested in everything an author writes, so the ability to limit the notifications to a series would be nice.

posts.title: Add books privately
posts.description: Have a way to add add books to track status and stats without sharing those titles with friends and followers

posts.title: Phone Widget
posts.description: To see your currently reading book(s) and progress, and easily update your progress

posts.title: Batch/Bulk Edit Books (Tags, TBR, Removal, etc.)
posts.description: Would love to be able to pull up one of my lists and add a tag to a bunch of selected books at once. Update from Nadia (27th Jan 2024): Repurposing this post to be a general "bulk add/edit" one.

posts.title: Quotes
posts.description: Give users a chance to share their favorite quotes from a given book they have read.

posts.title: different rating for each read
posts.description: I'd love to be able to change my rating when re-reading but still have the old rating saved somewhere. That way I could easily see how I changed my mind over time and also the stats for previous years wouldn't be affected

posts.title: Ability to Filter/Sort Author Results
posts.description: I often want to look at other books written by an author after I have finished a book. Currently it seems that the results that come up for an author are pretty random? Maybe most recently added? But that doesn’t really help find books by that author.. perhaps adding the ability to sort by number of times it was shelved? Maybe year published? Even just consolidating the editions of the same book in these results would make this feature much more functional

posts.title: Heat/Smut/Steam/Spice level for Romance and Erotica books
posts.description: I was thinking... I really miss something that'd let me see what is the level of explicit sexual content when I'm trying to choose a Romance. Sometimes you're in the mood to read something more spicy, and sometimes something clean and sweet. It's really hard to find out what's the heat level of a Romance (and sometimes even Erotica) book without going through tons of reviews that might give you a bunch of spoilers. I'd greatly appreciate it if all books categorized as 'Romance' or 'Erotica' had some sort of box/option for readers to classify the amount/intensity of heat/smut/explicit scenes after reading.

posts.title: Filter reviews
posts.description: I would love to be able to filter user reviews by star rating, key word, etc. When I finish a book I love to read contrasting reviews and then reviews who are on par with my star rating, but it can be hard to find these just by scrolling the reviews especially when there are thousands for a book and I am only seeing the ones that happen to come first with no way to sort them.

posts.title: Mark authors/books as "will not read"
posts.description: There are certain authors who might fit my usual genres/styles which I enjoy but which I am purposefully not reading for various reasons. I'd like to be able to preemptively exclude them so they won't be recommended to me. If possible, having them show up in searches but have a flag that on the book listing to indicate they're on my do-not-read list would be nice. Right now I'm making due with using a tag, but it means that I have tagged some books I don't want to ever read.

posts.title: Finished Button for Currently Reading
posts.description: Currently, there is no I'm finished button when currently reading a book so it would be great if there was instead of just flipping it back to Read.

posts.title: Ability to create ordered lists
posts.description: A feature that I really miss from GR is the ability to create an ordered list. For example, I have been a part of a book club for the past few years, and I have a list (I suppose technically it's a tag) that I maintain of all of the books that we have read in the order that we read them. There does not seem to be a comparable way to do something like this on SG. Another example is that I tried to curate a list of 30 books that I wanted to read in the second half of this year. I used a Challenge to get around this, but it was rather clunky and ends up requiring a lot of scrolling to see what is next due to the bulk of Challenge entries (which make sense when they are being used as designed, but less sense when they are literally just a container for a title of a book).

posts.title: Make it easier to add books to reading challenges
posts.description: As of now, one has to go to the specific book they want to add to a challenge. instead, it would be much easier for a challenge we have already joined to be able to add directly a book to the prompt we want. otherwise it is very tiring. also, it would be good to be able to add a book on multiple challenges in an easier way than having to select each challenge individually.

posts.title: Rating for audiobook narrator
posts.description: I would like to be able to rate a narrator in addition to the book itself when I listen to an audiobook. Currently I am listening to an interesting novel, but the narration just isnt that great and I would like to differentiate between the two when rating the book.

posts.title: Sort Books by Storygraph Rating
posts.description: I’d love to be able to sort my books by the average rating they have on storygraph.

posts.title: Favorite books section
posts.description: I'd love to be able to mark books as favorites, and then have them show up in the stats section for the year's reading.

posts.title: Offline mode on mobile app
posts.description: Currently, if you're not connected to a network, the app just loads endlessly. I would love to be able to use it in a limited way offline - for example, view my Currently Reading list, or perhaps even To-Read and Read as well.

posts.title: The StoryGraph's "End of Year Review" Page
posts.description: We've always wanted to have one! A special, easily-shareable page/infographic style thing that shows a selection of information, stats, diagrams, charts, etc. of your reading during that year. What would you like to see on such a page? Share all of your ideas: big or small! The great thing about a feature like this is that we can adapt and improve it to surprise and delight y'all every single year! :-D Perhaps we'll have one ready for 2021, but no promises!

posts.title: Display rating as well as "You've read another edition of this book"
posts.description: If a friend starts reading a book and I click through, or if they link me to a book page on TSG, "You've read another edition of this book" is not the most important information I'd like to see there — it would be nice to have my rating displayed on all editions, in addition to the link to my edition. Perhaps "You've read another edition of this book (4 ⭐)"?

posts.title: See Books In Common on Friends Profile
posts.description: When I go to a friend's profile, it would be nice to see which books we've both read or want to read along with any associated ratings and reviews. Ideally would work across editions

posts.title: A section for ‘favorite authors’.
posts.description: We have a section/bookshelf for our favourite books already and I LOVE it. I’d really like to see an option to catalog favorite authors; and potentially even follow their work as they release new books.

posts.title: Timeline of books read
posts.description: I'd love to see something like a timeline showing how book read dates overlap. Less to do with pages read per day, but just showing start and end date on a timeline for each book*, possibly to scroll on. This is the only thing I've seen on another site (LibraryThing), but it doesn't have to be like this: http://simile.mit.edu/timeline/ * (ETA: all books on a timeline, but each one has its own start & end date)

posts.title: New Book Notifications
posts.description: (Email?) Notifications for new books by authors you've subscribed to. Possibly with the ability to subscribe to specific series by the author.

posts.title: Publication Day Notifications
posts.description: i personally tend to forget the release date of upcoming books that i added to my tbr, so a reminder when the book finally comes out would be amazing **ADMIN NOTE**: _Merged the posts in the wrong direction!_ This is from the original post from @cajengirl from Sep 2021: "A notification or email when books I have on my To-Read list are published. So if I put something on my TR that is coming out next month... a notification that says "hey, this book on your TR list is out today!" so that I remember I want to request it at my library or pick up a copy at the bookstore."

posts.title: Display Ratings Distribution
posts.description: We know that the mean of a distribution does not tell the whole story. It would be great to be able to visualize the distribution of ratings for a given book. Is it all 4.5s? Or is it some combination of mostly 5s and 1s?

posts.title: Default edition format in search results
posts.description: I understand search results right now use the default book type (with the exception of those we've already read, as per the recent update). I would find it helpful to be able to automatically have the search results show only digital editions, or only audio. Reason being, I don't go into editions when I add to my TBR, and then I frequently have to go back in bulk and check what editions were listed for books I've read recently.

posts.title: Filter TBR/Owned/Read by Format
posts.description: I.e. Paperback/Hardback, Audio, Ebook. I currently use tags to do this.

posts.title: Filter reading challenges
posts.description: Sometimes I'm in the mood for a reading challenge that's just a week or a month long, it would be nice to have a filter to find challenges like that. Perhaps combined with a "starting soon" option to filter out the ones that are already coming to an end.

posts.title: Privacy settings for books
posts.description: I really like being able to have friends following me here, but sometimes I read books about somewhat personal topics that I’d rather not blast out to all my friends. But simultaneously, I want them to count towards my stats/goals. It’d be really nice if there was a way to set some books I’m reading as “private” so my reading history wouldn’t be visible to anyone else on my profile and my review would show up on the book’s page as “anonymous”.

posts.title: Exclude outliers in Publication Year vs Read Date graph
posts.description: Since reading a Greek play written in 431 BCE, my Publication Year graph is a lot less useful since all other books are bunched together. I'd love to exclude that one book from this graph, or toggle it to the publication year for that edition instead of the original publication year.

posts.title: Status across multiple editions not shown
posts.description: This shows up in 3 ways (feel free to separate out into multiple posts if the implementation is very different): 1) if you open an edition that you haven't read, it says "you've read another edition of this book." but if you've read *two* editions, they don't cross-link to each other. 2) re-reads aren't tracked across editions (if you've read edition A and edition B, it doesn't list either under re-reads). 3) tags and "owned" don't surface at all, so I've found myself accidentally buying an e-book for a book I already owned a physical copy of because I didn't manually check all the editions.

posts.title: Increase Up Next Queue Limit to 10
posts.description: I would love to see this expanded to 10. Reason...library holds, mood, need for a shorter book, or time for a longer book...a top 10 just provides more options but keeps it manageable (never more than 10 would be needed).

posts.title: Pagination for book lists: paged view instead of infinite scroll
posts.description: I'd love it if the shelves/book lists had actual pagination and not just infinite scroll. Update from Nadia: Original title used to be "Pagination for book lists". I've edited it now to make it easier for people to find. (2024/03/08)

posts.title: Sort to-read pile by average rating
posts.description: This was my favorite feature of Goodreads . Would love to see it here as an option to help me select next books from pile. I know "personalized recommendations" are hot, but I'd like to be able to bypass the algorithm.

posts.title: See your followers
posts.description: Hello! A friend said they started following me on The StoryGraph, but I can't see them anywhere. That leads me to believe that random people could follow me and I'd have absolutely no idea and no means of blocking them. Is there a way to see who is following me? If not, I think that would be a really helpful community safety tool.

posts.title: Libby/Storygraph
posts.description: Is there a way to connect storygraph to the Overdrive app, Libby? I just downloaded Libby and would like an easy way to find out which of my to-read books on storygraph are available for checkout. Thank you!

posts.title: Filter Reading Challenge Prompts
posts.description: It'd be really nice to be able to filter the prompt book lists on reading challenges. Often when I go to a challenges page I click on one of the prompts to filter it by things like Owned Books, On To-Read Pile, Not Part Of A Series, Page Length, Mood, etc only to remember that you can't. It'd just be a lot easier and quicker for me to find books for that specific prompt that I'm in the mood for and can easily get my hands on if there was an option to filter them :)

posts.title: Library Label
posts.description: A label for books read similar to the “Mark as owned” label already available that we can select to remind ourselves/ users that the title is available or was borrowed from the library.

posts.title: See how many times a book has been marked DNF
posts.description: When on the reviews page showing community stats like average star rating, show how many times a book has been DNF'd

posts.title: Sort without The/A/An
posts.description: I like to update my "to-read" every so often to match up with my updated bookshelves at home. I sort all my books by title, but I disregard "The" "A/An." Could we have an option to sort our storygraph shelves this way? With 1,500 books it's tough to match up the shelves while zooming back and forth to the A's and T's

posts.title: Specific Date added for TBR books
posts.description: I generally try to work through my TBR from oldest to newest, so I'm very often sorting it by the Date Added option. Sometimes I find myself feeling like I just added a book but I guess it's been a year or so. I can kind of contextualize it based on the books before and after, but if possible I think it could be cool to show a date for when exactly I added the book to my list. Even if it's just listed in the reading journal. I kind of like to see the time it took me from being interested in it to when actually started reading it. (Although I know this can make some people feel guilty/bad about how long they take...it doesn't have to be in an obvious spot but it would be nice if it were available!)

posts.title: The StoryGraph Yearly Most Acclaimed [awards]
posts.description: It would be nice to have a fun community centered feature similar to the GoodReads Choice Awards (but that tries to be better). The nominees could be based on data from TSG itself, such as “most marked as read” and “most highly rated” for the year. On December, users would be able to vote on each category/genre, but only if at least one nominated book from each category has been tagged as read by them (this should prevent users from voting randomly without being too strict about who can really vote - in fact one could still mark a book as read and vote anyway). And the winners of the year could be displayed on the home page during the following month as a suggestion tbr list for the January Reading Challenge (the streak one).

posts.title: Allow reporting of spoiler reviews
posts.description: Some reviews contain spoilers. It would be nice to hide these, or report them for hiding.

posts.title: Filter read books by rating
posts.description: it would be very helpful to be able to filter books I've read by how I rated them. This would make it easier to recommend books to others as well as make top books of the year lists, etc

posts.title: Narrator & Illustrator Stats
posts.description: I would love to see how many audiobooks I listen to by the same narrator and graphic novels/story books illustrated by the same illustrators, just like we can see stats for our most read authors.

posts.title: Make it easier to find my Read Books and Reviews
posts.description: I know this is ridiculous but each time I log in - not that often - I forget how to find the books I've read and my reviews. Help please. And I promise to write the steps down so I don't forget again!

posts.title: Filter options for series
posts.description: It would be really cool if there could be a filter option for just books in a series. So sort of the opposite of "only show me books that aren't part of a series." It would also be great if there was an additional option for "show me books in a completed series," for when you don't want to have to worry about starting a series that hasn't been finished yet and catching up to a cliffhanger. Or alternatively, an option for if you want books in an ongoing series.

posts.title: Save/Follow Public Tags/Lists
posts.description: It would be great if there were a way to save and/or follow other people's public tags! I have public booklists that I share with others and they want to be able to save them to their TSG profile.

posts.title: Tag Groups
posts.description: Ability to create groups / bundles in the tag list. I use tags for several different purposes eg tags for whether it's in a particular library, whether I borrowed or purchased the book, content tags etc. I'd love to separate these out for easier browsing and sorting. Currently I use prefixes eg "library-sydney-city", "source-purchased", "diversity-asian-author", with the first word indicating the purpose of the tag, then sort alphabetically, but built in tag groups would help a lot!

posts.title: Tag statistics unread/read chart
posts.description: i would love it if we could have an additional statistic for our tags that shows what books are on our read/to read/dnf shelves

posts.title: Immersive Reading (Multiple Formats With Overlap)
posts.description: I’ve been getting into immersive reading more and listening to the audiobook while following along with the physical/digital text. However, when it comes to tracking my progress I usually have to choose either the print or the audio format, and I don’t want it categorized as a re-read or as two books added to my monthly/yearly total. It would be cool to be able to mark that I’m reading the print and audio formats for the same book in such a way that I can have them both added to my pages read/minutes listened and formats stats - but only count it as one book towards my goal.

posts.title: Send book recommendations to friends
posts.description: It would be great to send friends my recommendations for them (and to receive recommendations from them)! Maybe by way of a button on each book page to recommend to another user, or else a bar in the community page to recommend things to friends.

posts.title: Most Read Authors
posts.description: having a section in the stats page showing a user's top 10 (or top 5 or top whatever) most read authors, and maybe the average rating for each book by that author you've read

posts.title: Easier way to edit tags on mobile
posts.description: I will admit, I probably overuse the tag system, but I love it. It is extremely difficult to edit tags on mobile, especially in a list instead of viewing one book. The pencil icon is SO tiny, and it’s so challenging to actually hit it. 80% of the time I accidentally click on an existing tag and then I lose my spot in my TBR. I just wish adding tags was a button that was more accessible and separate from the existing list of tags.

posts.title: Title should be removed from To Read once I read it (edition agnostic)
posts.description: Sometimes I add a book to my TBR but end up reading it in another edition. Unfortunately, then the book keeps showing up on my TBR unless I go in and manually click "remove book" -- but the popup is so scary that I always worry I'm going to erase my journal entries! I would like if: 1. A book gets removed from my To Read list if I read any edition of the book 2. The "remove book" warning specifies that it will remove the information on only that edition -- I think this is the actual behavior, but the current wording makes me nervous. Thank you! I <3 TSG.

posts.title: Add to Up Next from anywhere
posts.description: Currently the only way I know how to add a book to up next is to go in from my the list. I’d like the ability to do it from any page where the book is pulled up. If I find a great book I immediately want to read next, it would be great to not to have to add it to ‘to read’ then go into that list to add to my up next list. Thanks!

posts.title: Mass Tags
posts.description: As a reader who is trying to diversify their own reading and make it easier for others It would be awesome if: - I could take all of the books from a challenge prompt and mass tag them with an applicable tag. - I could have a setting to make my tags public by default. Or some other easier way than individually opening each separate tag and choosing that option. or if on https://app.thestorygraph.com/your-tags we could have a way to select all or even have checkboxes for what to choose which are public/private So that I can make it easier to share books that have representation with others For example, in this image, I'd like the ability to give them all a `disability-rep` tag without multiple steps

posts.title: RE: Delete tags from book when removing it
posts.description: I’m posting this in response to this recently shipped change: [Delete tags from book when removing it](https://roadmap.thestorygraph.com/requests-ideas/posts/delete-book-from-tags). Tags have been my favorite feature on TSG precisely because they are (or were) independent from other lists, i.e., adding/removing tags and adding/removing books are separate actions. I don’t have to add a book to tag it, so I don’t think removing a book should affect the tags (at least not automatically). I’m a prolific tagger; I have nearly 500 tags and over 4k tagged books. I use my tagged books list like an extended TBR. I frequently add/remove books from my to-read pile as their availability or my interest changes. That’s how I keep my to-read pile more manageable. Sometimes when I remove a book I also want to remove all the tags, but the majority of the time I want to keep the tags. Each of my tagged books has around 10+ tags. Now with this change, I’ll have to manually add all those tags back after removing a book. Adding tags is more inconvenient than removing tags. Especially because when there are a lot of tags, I’ll have to screencap them or write them down before they’re deleted so I don’t forget any that need to be added back. So this change is going to have a significant negative impact on my use of TSG. It seems the pain point here is having to take the extra step to manually delete each individual tag when removing a book. To address that, I have a couple of suggestions: 1. Add a question to the ‘remove book’ pop up screen asking the user if they want to remove the book *and* tags or just the book, so the deletion of tags is optional rather than automatic. 2. Add a ‘delete all’/🗑️ option to the tag edit box, which could be used regardless of whether the book is being removed. This would be my preference, so that adding/removing tags remains independent from adding/removing books.

posts.title: Add Country Option in Preferences and Pre-Select It In Giveaways Filter Menu
posts.description: If I want to filter the give-aways based on whether they are available in my country, I have to scroll all the way down to my country every time. It would be nice if this could be something you set one time so I don't have to scroll everytime I'm going through the give-aways

posts.title: Ability to filter by language
posts.description: it would be good to be able to filter for language options as well since now it is very english language centric

posts.title: Tag and Filter AI books
posts.description: We are starting to see books being written, graphic novels being illustrated, and audio books being narrated by generative AI. I believe that the best way for us combat generative AI is by not supporting authors who admit to using generative AI for covers, story or audio books. This could be hard to do because authors who use generative AI aren't upfront about it. I propose that librarians can add tags to books that authors admit to using generative AI for. Having authors admit to this is the only reliable way to tell unfortunately, otherwise, this becomes a witch hunt.

posts.title: Middle Grade, YA, etc. not Genres: "Age range"/"Audience" Category
posts.description: What are people's thoughts regarding YA, Middle Grade, Children's, (maybe more such as Graphic Novel) not necessarily being a genre but rather a type of book? I'm probably overthinking it, but a genre to me would be the KIND of book. For example, YA is the kind of book and the genre is fantasy and mystery. I'd prefer to have the KIND of book be separated in it's own chart, much like how fiction and nonfiction are their own things. If clicked on, maybe it could correspond with the genres of books read within each grade level. Love to hear people's thoughts about this. Cheers!

posts.title: Able to Customize Homepage
posts.description: I would like to see my to-read pile before my recommendations. Some flexibility in home view would be great

posts.title: Ratings More Prominent
posts.description: Moving the aggregate user rating on a book from the very bottom (on mobile) to a more prominent location on screen would be helpful. Thank you.

posts.title: Recommendations should have an "not interested" button per book to remove them from your recommendations
Searchable public book tags
posts.description: I often create trope tags for books I read or want to read, to make browsing the list easier, e.g. "magic school" or "necromancy" or "happy ending" or, I don't know, "swan shifters". I'm sure I'm not the only one and it would be great to look for books with similar tags. I would love to be be able to search all the tags on SG, not just created by yourself, and pick your next book from them. Or, if not that, to see a tag system where (optionally, so to avoid spoilers) each book page would also display a number of most used tags for the book (I guess, similar to the trigger warnings).

posts.title: show tropes on book description page
posts.description: Since it's optional to add the tropes and themes of the book in the reviews, it would be nice if those were shown on the main book-description page (similar to moods and pace)

posts.title: Immersive Reading (Multiple Formats/No Overlap)
posts.description: My apologies if this has been posed before. I often read a digital version of a book alongside the audio book version. But there doesn’t seem to be a way for me to track that immersive reading process.

posts.title: Move To-Read Books to the top of all added books on Reading Challenge prompt pages
posts.description: I think it would be great if within reading challenges, any books I've tagged with "To Read" are at the top of "All Books Added".

posts.title: Prioritise reviews of similar readers
posts.description: Ratings and reviews are so varied, and often depend on if someone likes that type of book. Once you've got the feature for finding users that are similar to us, could you extend that to prioritise their reviews (and maybe even ratings?) at the top of the review list? I could trust a review/rating from someone who likes the same type of books as I do, more than the "general populous".

posts.title: "Do Not Count" towards reading goal
posts.description: Could we have a button or box to check to keep a book from being counted towards the reading goals? For example sometimes authors will put out a really short story about a character they have. I'm talking like 4 pages short. I like to mark them as read, but I don't want them to count toward my book goal. (I don't mind them counting toward my page goal, but that might be too involved to have one but not the other.)

posts.title: Add 100 pgs or less to pg # pie chart
posts.description: I read a lot of children's books, manga and novellas. It would be great to have this distinction.

posts.title: Giveaway entry status on main page
posts.description: I really love the giveaway functionality. I think the only improvement I’d suggest is if you could see if you already entered a giveaway from the main page. Or alternatively, could filter out giveaways you already entered. Thanks!

posts.title: External links/Bio in profile
posts.description: I'm pretty sure I've heard that there is thought about adding external links to our profile page, like rather than having social capabilities on tSG, we can link to twitter, instagram, a blog or even email for others to contact us if they choose and if we feel comfortable. I just didn't see it on the roadmap and wanted to put my vote for it. I like this limited customization because then we can still connect, but tSG doesn't have to moderate activity, and the site doesn't become cluttered.

posts.title: Consolidate book versions
posts.description: allow toggling through different versions of the same book under one umbrella book, as opposed to multiple separate unique books. Including audio books

posts.title: Custom charts - compare tag vs no tag
posts.description: Would it be possible, in a custom chart, to be able to track a certain tag vs no tag? For example, books with the an LGBTQIA tag vs books that don't have the LGBTQIA tag? That way we could see how many books with the tag we read vs without.

posts.title: Dark Mode For Wrap-Ups
posts.description: I would love to have the option for my wrap up graphics to also be dark mode, or customizable beyond just white! I love to share them and alternate colors would make them better to post on blogs/accounts that stick to a specific aesthetic.

posts.title: See who else is currently reading the book(s) you're currently reading
posts.description: I thought this was a fun idea from someone writing in! A good way to find similar users, especially when we eventually have other social links in our Profiles, so you can connect over the book you're both currently reading. :-)

posts.title: Translated Works/Original Language
posts.description: Would like to see original language versus translated languages. And be able to filter by translated languages.

posts.title: Show active readalongs on book pages
posts.description: It would be good to see if there is an active readalong going of a book when you're going to mark it as currently reading.

posts.title: TBR Weeding
posts.description: I have an out-of-control, always growing TBR. I would love if there were ways to get help from the app at cutting the TBR down. I would love ways to filter that would help me narrow down what I may want to remove. Examples: - show me the books on my TBR I am LEAST likely to like (based on my average ratings per mood, genre, etc. - show me the books on my TBR with average star ratings under X. Then I can review and choose to remove.

posts.title: Find Books by Tropes/Topic/Theme
posts.description: Maybe like reviewing a mood on a book, there could a section to review a trope (like tick a box of it features enemies to lovers, or morally grey characters). And then someday be able to search by trope, kind of like how you can search by mood now. Update by Nadia (28/07/24): Updated title slightly to match what others are requesting!

posts.title: Point-of-View for novels (single, multiple, 1st person, omniscient, etc.)
posts.description: I'd love to see a point-of-view section in the community reviews for fiction books. First person, third person, third person omniscient, as well as if a book is told from one, two, or 3+ perspectives. And then add search capability with this, just like with moods for example.

posts.title: Stats for book series
posts.description: Since I start and finish so many series, I would like to have the oportunity to see stats for these. Such as "How many did I start finish in a month/year", "In which book of a series am I" (maybe based on what book is on the TBR?) These are just ideas and maybe you find something you want to implement. :)

posts.title: Change LGBTQ from being a genre to being a stat tracked about representation
posts.description: I know that genres are controlled by publishers, but it feels discriminatory to me to have a genre as LGBTQ+. I know as a black woman, I'd had to have a book categorised as black or female or both. Can we remove this genre from books and rather have a way of tracking diversity in authors and characters that looks at demographics such as: 1. Gender 2. Ethnicity 3. Country 4. Disability representation 5. LGBTQ+ representation etc.

posts.title: Add "Due Date" Option for Currently Reading
posts.description: For books that are checked out from the library, I like the idea of having the option to enter a "due date". That way, you could easily see on your home page/dashboard when you need to return a certain book without needing to cross reference emails or receipts or another app like Libby. It could also be fun to tie this into the reading goals calculation. For example, if I need to return a 400 page book in 20 days, it could recommend how many pages I'd need to read per day to finish before the due date. (Also optional most likely? Since I know some folks prefer not to see the progress bar)

posts.title: Sort Read Books By Rating
posts.description: Can we sort our read books by our own star ratings?

posts.title: Stats on authors
posts.description: Would love a feature to see stats on authors read. Male/female/non-binary/etc. BIPOC authors.

posts.title: Show how many days of the year you've read in annual wrap-up
posts.description: During next year's annual wrap up it would be cool to see how many days of the year you've read and maybe even set a goal for that at the beginning of the year (ie 300/365 days or something like that). Building off of the January challenge.

posts.title: Add the question, "Do you recommend this book?", to review page
posts.description: The 1-5 rating system has a lot of issues. For books with few ratings, a few bad or good ratings can skew that number in one direction or the other. People also have very different interpretations of what each of these numbers mean. I'd propose keeping the 1-5 rating and adding an additional question to the review page, "Do you Recommend this book?" with only a Yes or a No as an option. Maybe an optional text box to explain your selection. On the book page, display a graph breaking this down or just show a percentage of users that recommend or do not recommend the book. This would be very helpful in situations where a book has a 3 star rating and I'm wondering whether to read it. If most people recommend it then it may be worth my time. Long term you could even add a feature that shows books that "similar readers recommend". Or include something on the book page that tells me if similar users recommend it or not.

posts.title: Add Content Warnings while book is marked as "Currently Reading"
posts.description: It would be super helpful if I could add CW's while I'm still reading a book. I suppose I could probably add them as notes under the track progress notes, but then I would need to collate them myself at the end.

posts.title: Ratings for Series
posts.description: The ability to rate a finished series as a whole, as well as rating the individual books.

posts.title: DNF included in stats
posts.description: It would be nice to see DNF’d books in the stats, maybe in the bar chart that shows number of books per star rating. Then you can see that you did read in that time period, just didn’t finish as many.

posts.title: Mark books as lent/borrowed
posts.description: It's nice to have a list of owned books. I would also like to be able to mark which of them I've currently lent out and to whom.

posts.title: Sort challenges you've joined
posts.description: It would be great to be able to sort your challenges in different ways -- I've completed a bunch but have one still going, but the one that's still going I have to click "show more" a number of times to get to it, so sorting uncompleted before completed, for example.

posts.title: Book Clubs V2
posts.description: Let's hear it! :-D

posts.title: Shareable Graphics
posts.description: With the launch of easily-shareable graphics for the whole wrap-up, the wrap-up mood map, and the wrap-up cover collage, we now have the infrastructure to offer this in more places. Already in our plans/requested on the roadmap are: * Monthly wrap-up * Book review with star rating * 5-star cover collage from the wrap-up Any other ideas?

posts.title: New Stat: Book length vs time taken to read
posts.description: Would be so interesting on the stats page. A scattergraph of books read in this year, book length (pages/minutes) vs time taken to finish reading (Days/months) It might seem less necessary for audiobooks, but it would still be interesting to see over how many days/months it took you to finish.

posts.title: Filter reading stats by my ratings to see moods/genres etc I've been enjoying or not enjoying
posts.description: I would find it so helpful to be able to filter the stats by how I rated the books (for all time, but by month might be fun to compare as well). We can see our average rating for the genre/mood across all books I've read but I think it'd be really interesting to see, for instance, if it was showing only my 5-star ratings, what proportion of those were magical realism vs. fantasy, or dark vs. lighthearted books. It would give me an idea of my preferred reading tastes and what I'm actually enjoying rather than just what I've been reading mostly.

posts.title: A graph of first reads vs rereads
posts.description: Id like to compare how many books i reread vs how many new books i read in a year

posts.title: Plus Streak Stats
posts.description: As we transition Plus to be an Advanced Stats Package, we'd love to add in a couple of extra stats for y'all on your streak page. What would y'all like to see?

posts.title: Widget Embed for Website
posts.description: I'd love to be able to add a Storygraph widget showing my current reads on my website. That would be the final push I need to leave G**dr**ds behind for good.

posts.title: Pin Challenges
posts.description: I'd like to be able to pin a few challenges to the top so I don't have to scroll all the way down to find them. I'm thinking like my top 3-5 challenges that I'm keeping track of would be really nice.

posts.title: Planning Calendar for To Read List
posts.description: It would be nice to be able to have planning calendar for reads. This would help plan out when you want to read specific books. It would be helpful for spreading out reading challenge books and books you want to read during a particular season (like fall, winter, specific holidays, etc.).

posts.title: Filter Reading Challenges to show incomplete prompts
posts.description: With some of the longer challenges it can be difficult to tell at a glance which prompts have been completed and which haven't, especially if you've already added books to the prompt. It would be nice if the prompts were sorted by incomplete/complete either automatically or as an option. Especially with challenges with 100+ prompts, it's a lot of scrolling and if you're 90% done, it can be difficult to spot the incomplete prompts. Even just having the entire box change colors or something like that would be a big help when trying to spot which prompts you're missing.

posts.title: Graphs for books marked "owned"
posts.description: I love the graphs and stats for books I've read. Would it be possible to have similar views for books marked as "owned" and/or TBR? I tend to gravitate to the same genres, I think. And the visibility would help remind me to diversify!

posts.title: Ability to choose widgets on my Your Storygraph page
posts.description: Ability to choose which widgets (a widget being a Graph or a Stat or one of the current options like TBR or Currently Reading) show on my Your Storygraph page. Also the ability to choose the order they appear in. Even if we started off with one stat/graph, I think that would be fun. I would pick the pages/books read graph.

posts.title: Achievements/Badges
posts.description: I am a sucker for external validation and I would love some fun little badges like "You've read 100 total books" or "You've read 50 non-fiction books." It would be a fun addition to profiles and to cheer people on.

posts.title: New Read's vs Re-reads Stat
posts.description: I would love a new stat for how many books are new reads (something never read before) vs re-reads. I re-read a LOT of old favorites. There are some books I read EVERY year, and some I read every few years. I would love a stat that compares how many books a month (or year) are new and how many are re-reads.

posts.title: Translation Stats
posts.description: I'd love to have my stats include how many of the books I read were translated editions. If you're willing to take it a few steps further, it would even be awesome to have a pie chart showing original languages.

posts.title: Mobile Push Notifications
posts.description: Now that the app has a Notifications area, I would really like for mobile push notifications to be implemented in the app. Otherwise I may miss a notification if I don't check that area of the app often.

posts.title: Days Read Calendar
posts.description: It would be helpful to see how my reading habits change throughout the month with a calendar that has the days I updated tracking on books.

posts.title: Unfinished Series
posts.description: Filter books by series you've started, but not completed

posts.title: Reading timer
posts.description: I would love to be able to track reading sessions with a timer - could be a fun thing to add to streaks?

posts.title: Folders/groups in TBR
posts.description: Could we have the ability to create named folders/groups/shelves in our to-read piles? I know there's the tags option but I think having like a visual grouping option in the tbr would be useful to a lot of people! thanks!! :)

posts.title: Author Information
posts.description: I love how clicking on an author's name brings up a list of their books, but it would also be awesome if it brought up a picture and short biography of them! A lot of times, I need that information for reading challenges, so this would be super helpful!

posts.title: Randomize TBR Pile sort
posts.description: Adding 'Random' option for sorting the TBR pile page, that way I'm not seeing the same books at the top of the pile every time since my tbr is very full and there's ones that get caught in the middle with the newest/oldest/name etc options. Randomize also offers a fun way to choose the next read.

posts.title: Easier to review a book with just a star rating
posts.description: Would love to be able to review a book with just a star rating instead of viewing and scrolling all the way down to the bottom of the detailed review section.

posts.title: Saved filters
posts.description: I'd really like saved filters in the to-read pile. This is great for if you have a mood you're commonly in and would save you from having to check all the boxes/type in tag names every times.

posts.title: Indicate existence of review text on community page reviews
posts.description: When browsing my friends' reviews on the community page, I would like to see if they only rated a book or also wrote a review text, because I only want to look closer on reviews with text. I find myself clicking on 'see full review' to find out, just to turn back when there is no text for me to read.

posts.title: Search for/filter by publishers
posts.description: I think it'd be cool to have a way to search for books published by the same publisher. It'd be another way to find similar-ish books, and could help boost visibility for smaller presses.

posts.title: DNFs in book challenges
posts.description: make it an option for DNF books to count towards a challenge: this would be helpful for challenges like "read all books by *specific author*"

posts.title: Reading challenge: copy and edit existing challenge
posts.description: **- Copy and edit an existing challenge to save as new** Being able to copy or duplicate a challenge would be excellent so all the ones that repeat yearly, monthly, etc don't have to be manually done over and over. The a-z challenge as an example is 26 prompts to write out every time!! I envison this as: For an existing challenge, there's a "create a copy" button that then opens the "create new challenge" edit page with the info from the copied challenge pre-populated. Then you can edit it and save as a new one. I don't know that there'd be any reason not to allow people to copy a challenge they didn't make, but I guess that could be an option if needed.

posts.title: Add ‘books that are part of series’ filter option
Monthly book wrap up graphics
posts.description: A lot of people like to do monthly book wrap up posts. It would be really neat to have an easy way to see what you read in a month. So like the stats page (or on the stats page) just a list of the titles you read. Or even better the covers of what you read that month UPDATE by Nadia (23/06/24): Updated the title to fit what's being delivered! UPDATE by Nadia (1/07/24): There'll be three varieties: 1. A cover collage (with and without ratings) 2. A summary view, similar to our annual wrap-up, in (IG Story and IG post/square format), with two pages/sections: overall summary view and stats charts view 3. A calendar/Gantt chart view

posts.title: Reread Stat
posts.description: When looking at all time stats it would be nice to see what books I have read the most (number of rereads and/or different editions).

posts.title: Filter books that count towards reading goals
posts.description: I would love to be able to filter what contributes to my annual books/pages goal. I read a fair amount of graphic novels and manga, but personally I set my annual reading goals to challenge myself to read more text-heavy books (I could easily rack up books/pages read by reading graphic novels but I'm not sure I'd feel like I'd achieved my goal at the end of the year). Therefore, it'd be great to be able to uncheck graphic novels and manga from the genres that contribute to my goals. I guess it may also help people to be able to exclude books by tags rather than just genre. For example, it might help people who are tracking their school/uni reading but only want books read for fun to count towards their reading goal.

posts.title: Series - Standalone?
posts.description: Passing this along from a friend - "You should ask TSG to add a feature where it says if a book in a series can be read as a standalone or if it needs to be read in order. Maybe a yes/no/maybe option."

posts.title: Ability to sort and filter search results
posts.description: It seems odd that this doesn't exist.... maybe this is a bug with my instance? Also I've not been able to find an advanced search. Both would be lovely.

posts.title: In TBR, the ability to have a “maybe” pile
posts.description: It would be great to have a section of books that when I’m unsure about whether I want to read it or feel tepidly towards it but may be interested in it at a later time, to have an option to add it it’s own section

posts.title: Add More Moods
posts.description: I think there's more to add overall, but specifically as a romance reader I would love to see additions like "romantic" or "steamy." I often struggle to review my romance picks accurately based on the current moods.

posts.title: Average rating by people like me
posts.description: If there was a kind of “average rating by people like me” filter / field, that would be SO incredibly helpful. In the absence of this, the signals I have historically used to figure out how to weight the average weighting (in Goodreads): * if 90% of the reviews are by men I am skeptical * if 90% of the reviews are by women I am skeptical * if there is a huge split between positive and negative, I check to see how intelligent the comments are. Articulate, thoughtful, effusive POSITIVE reviews paired with inarticulate / short “I didn’t get it” negative reviews is a strong POSITIVE signal for me. And the inverse is a strong negative

posts.title: Future releases in TBR pile
posts.description: I often add coming books when they are announced to by TBR to keep track of them. I would love to somehow be able to hide/fade/toggle these from the total TBR until they are actually officially released.

posts.title: Icon for owned books
posts.description: Would love some sort of button, icon, or visual cue to indicate if a book is marked owned. Think like a blue check on some social media. Could tell at a glance if a book/edition was owned and then not buy it again in store 😅😅

posts.title: Author Tags
posts.description: I know that the issue of Author Stats is complicated (https://roadmap.thestorygraph.com/features/posts/author-stats). What if there were user-created author tags, in addition to the book tags that users can already create? I'm currently trying to add these sorts of tags manually to every book in my list, both to my "Read" list and my "To Read" list, but there are some pretty cumbersome aspects of this workflow. If I have read multiple editions of the same book (e.g. one audiobook, one ebook), there may be some tags that I only want to apply to one of those editions, but these "author stats" tags I definitely want to apply to both. It also feels tedious to apply the tags over and over if I have read multiple books by the same author. I may not remember which tags I applied to the first book, so I have to either research the author again or remember which book of theirs I have already tagged. My two use cases for these tags are: 1) The tag stats graph. I think it’s really interesting when I’m comparing YOY stats to be able to see whether there are changes in the diversity of books that I’m reading. 2) Filtering my TBR. My book club focuses e.g. on women and lgbt authors, and being able to quickly suggest books from my TBR would be really helpful. I don’t know if this would mitigate some of the very reasonable privacy concerns mentioned in that umbrella app, but it doesn’t seem like it would be much more invasive than the existing tags that get associated with books. Maybe these tags would be private-only? I don’t know. But having an author-level tag that would get pushed onto any book of theirs that I add to my queue would be really helpful!

posts.title: Yearly stats for all Storygraph
posts.description: A yearly stats (even monthly?) Showing total stats for all of Storygraph such as - Most read book Most DNFd book How many pages read by all users How much time listened to by all users Most read genre Most read mood Proportion of pages the logged books have Etc etc. Basically much the same as individual stats page but for all of Storygraph

posts.title: Parent tags
posts.description: I like to (overly) tag my books so I can find recommendations for people looking for something obscure or particular. Would it be possible to add parent tags? You could have the option to tag only the parent tag or have it be automatically tagged when you choose one of its sub-tags. For example: - A parent tag of 'science fiction' but have sub-tags of 'dystopia', 'space opera' and 'zombies' - A parent tag of 'Romance tropes' and sub-tags of 'enemies-to-lovers' and 'friends-to-lovers' - A parent tag of 'Set in Asia' and a sub-tag of 'Japan', 'China' and 'Malaysia' - A parent tag of '1800s' and sub-tags of '1810s,' '1820s', etc. Something like that?

posts.title: Alternative Covers
posts.description: Add an option to switch between covers. Frequently authors have alternative or updated covers for existing books. This would be different from adding editions since the release date and publishing information does not change.

posts.title: Original language stat
posts.description: I'd really like to be able to easily tell what the original language of a book is and get stats on that. I'm always trying to read more broadly and learn about other people's experiences. I only read books in English. But some of the books I read are translated from a different language. For example, Fredrick Backman's books were originally Swedish. The Hen Who Dreamed She Could Fly was originally Korean. Manga is originally Japanese. Etc. I think it would be really cool to easily see what the original language was without having to Google it. Then I could see all the stats on that.

posts.title: Information about book tropes
posts.description: I would love a feature to know about which tropes are present in a book, especially regarding romance novels (Fake Dating, Slow Burn, enemies to lovers, etc.). Maybe it could be a seperate description, like genre and mood already are, with its own stats :)

posts.title: Make it easier to rearrange reading challenge prompts when creating/editing a challenge
posts.description: When adding new books to reading challenges, it would be great to have an easier way of rearranging the books if you'd like to add one further up in the list.

posts.title: Country of Origin chart
posts.description: It would be great to be able to track what countries you are reading from. Similar to tracking the language

posts.title: Library Stats
posts.description: It would be lovely to have stats on how many books I read were from the library.

posts.title: End of year stats - Stroygraph's overall stats (not users')
posts.description: It would be interesting to see stats of all users in an email newsletter or sorts. Some stats could include: * Most reviewed / highest rated books of the year * Most DNFed books of the year * Most read genres and average ratings * Total pages read / hours listened * Total number of active / new users * Most popular challenges / book clubs * Most read / highest rated authors

posts.title: Personal average author rating
posts.description: I would love to see a average author rating if I've read more than 1 book by an author, to find out who I've rated the highest

posts.title: Best Book of the Year (Personal Bracket)
posts.description: I think it would be fun to have a built in feature where you can select the best book you read for each month of the year, and they would bracket down to the best of the year by the end. You could put notes about why it was the best read that month, or what made it stand out. It would be fun to see the progression throughout the year as well. This is something I do on paper, but I would really like a digital option in the app

posts.title: TBR reading time calculation
posts.description: Hello, to start, I have no idea how "do-able" this would even be. And it's a very "gimmicky" thing. But I just like such calculations/numbers. Could information on the time it would take to read one's to read list be included in the header of said list when you open it (based on how many books a user reads per year on average)? Something like this: To Read 123 books Estimated reading time: 2 years, 3 months and 8 days

posts.title: World map stat showing number of books from each country
posts.description: I've mentioned this previously on a thread but I'll leave it here as well for voting, I think having a 2D or 3D world map plot where the dots would be the number of books read from each country (based on the respective author's nationality) would be really interesting. Something like the image attached. I know some readers are really invested in reading books from all sorts of cultures. Having it as a map they would slowly fill in could be so much fun. Not to mention a great way to promote an "around the world" challenge on social media such as booktube, which would increase visibility for StoryGraph.

posts.title: customize colors
posts.description: not super necessary but I think it'd be cool to be able to customize the colors used in the charts in my stats. or maybe choose from different color palettes/themes

posts.title: Counting collections/anthologies volumes as more than one book
posts.description: Option to count large books that are a collection of series as multiple books towards the yearly reading challenge. For example, Douglas Adam’s ‘Hitchhiker’s Guide - A Trilogy in Five Parts’ could be counted as 5 books instead of 1 Update by Nadia (7th Sep 24): Updated title to make the ask clearer

posts.title: New rating/review for reread
posts.description: I'd love to be able to provide a fresh rating/review each time I read a book, even if it is the same edition.

posts.title: Reviewing entire series
posts.description: As someone who reads a lot of books within series', I'd love the ability to review a series as a whole rather than the books independently. For an example, instead of reviewing every book in the Percy Jackson and the Olympians series, I'd be able to just rate the series overall.

posts.title: Forecast/pace for books/pages goals
posts.description: Add a forecast to the reading goals: "you are on pace to read xx books this year"

posts.title: Actively look up and mark Authors/Book as 'Not Interested'.
posts.description: Hello. One of the features that I love the most about TheStorygraph is the ability to click on that little 'x' next to Author Names and Book Names when they show up on my Recommendations, so that I can forever ban authors/books I don't like from wasting my time going through their stuff again, in case I forget I don't like them. I would like to have even more control over that, and have the ability to actively look up some authors and books and click on that 'x' on the search page too, which, for now, is not possible. It would also be great if we had access to some sort of List page containing all the authors and books we've ever marked as 'Not Interested' before, so that we would have the chance to 'unban' them in case we change our minds.

posts.title: Multiple “up next” queues/lists
posts.description: I love the (limited to 5 items) up next queue - in fact it’s the feature I searched for that made me switch from Goodreads to StoryGraph. Would be very interested in multiple up next queues though because at any given time, I like to be reading one non-fiction, one fiction, and one audiobook. Ideally I would have queues for each such that when I finish, for instance, the novel I’m reading I just check out the fiction “up next” queue for my next read. I see others sharing in this community that their patterns are the same and suspect if they could have an up next “comics” list and “manga” list and “Children’s book” list and “mystery” list etc, it would scratch a big itch. Btw for me this is a classic example of where Goodreads failed and where you guys can differentiate - this is a feature that ties directly to dedicated book reader behavior (I find it so crazy that after 15 years there is still no way to manually sort Goodreads lists in their apps! What else does a dedicated reader really want than a way to keep track of what they hope to read NEXT?)

posts.title: Exclude tags in To-Read Pile filters
posts.description: Right now you can filter your To-Read Pile by what tags a book has, but not what tags it *doesn't* have. I'm trying to tag all the books in my TBR pile with which local libraries they're available at, but there's no way for me to filter the pile by what's tagged and what isn't. I tried the normal boolean operators but that doesn't function with the way the tags are designed.

posts.title: Compare my Rating to Average Rating
posts.description: Would be fun to have an easy way to compare all the books I have rated to what their average rating is. I was talking with a friend about whether I would give a low-average-rated book a chance. It would be fun to see how my ratings line up with the general consensus

posts.title: Tag Sorting (Read, To Read, Currently Reading)
posts.description: I would love to see the 'Read' books automatically drop to the bottom of a tag. Currently, the 'Read' books are mixed in with the 'To Read' and 'Currently Reading' books making it hard to see which books are what. Dropping the 'Read' to the bottom and keeping the 'Currently Reading' at the top with all the 'To Read' in the middle of the Tag List would be a great kindness. Additionally, having a color in the box where it says 'Currently Reading' 'Read' 'To Read' would be also be appreciated because it makes the list pop. At the moment, all three book statuses are white.

posts.title: Recommendations for books in languages other than English
posts.description: The title basically. Even though I have more non-English books on my shelves than English books, I only get English recommendations (and yes, I have written Dutch in my reading preferences). Would be nice if the algorithm can be changed so it will be less biased to English books.

posts.title: Confetti/Celebration after hitting goal milestones
posts.description: I would like to get confetti or balloons or a pile of excited puppies playing or something fun when I reach reading goal milestones or when I beat my previous record. Who doesn't like rewards? Obviously not critical, but fun.

posts.title: Differentiate between zero-stars average rating and no ratings
posts.description: I recently posted the first and only review for a book. I didn't want to give a star rating so I intentionally left that field blank. On the review page, no rating is displayed, which is good. However, on the book page it says the average rating is 0.0⭐. So now it appears as if the book is poorly rated, rather than unrated, which is not what I intended when I chose not to leave a star rating. Can the way the average rating is displayed be changed to better differentiate between an actual average rating of 0-stars vs no ratings?

posts.title: Calendar Tab
posts.description: I love planning out my reading and buying and I think it would be really nice to have a calendar feature or "upcoming" feature that shows you when books on your TBR/list are being published. I'd also love to opt-in on notifications like "a book you added is published today!"

posts.title: Compare Stats: Year to date, quarterly and other time slices
posts.description: I think one of the key stats missing, it would be a way to compare year to date... For example I would love to see how the first 100 days of 2023 fare against the same period of previous years. I would also add a couple of additional time frames such as quarters and halves. If possible even select specific windows such as Feb to Jul or March 14th to Sep 17th. I would think this could be part of the advanced statistics. Finally, and this is probably just a pet peeve of mine, I would like to point to the way the comparison is presented. When I compare two periods is automatically selected previous year as option 1 and current as option 2. Usually, and this is just me coming from business intelligence so there could be bias, the current or most recent time frame is presented first and then the comparison is second.

posts.title: On the buddy read search bar, friends/following should come up first
posts.description: When I go to the page where I can put in several users and see what books are suggested as a buddy read for all of us (https://app.thestorygraph.com/buddy_reads/get_suggestions), the suggestions when I start typing should bring up friends/following first. I don't have that many people I'm connected with on The StoryGraph, but I still have to type in basically the entire username I want before they pop up as a suggestion, even though they're one of my friends.

posts.title: Search and sort by average rating.
posts.description: Would like ability to filter by average rating and sort any list by average rating.

posts.title: Filter Tags by Haven't Read Status
posts.description: Currently, tags can be filtered by the criteria **"not in my To-Read Pile"**, but I would also love to be able to filter tags to show books **"I haven't read"**. I can filter Books I Own by the criteria **"I haven't read"** and would love this functionality for tag filtering as well. This would be helpful because sometimes I search my tags for books that I have tagged but not marked To-Read, and it can get clogged up by books I have already read (since books marked Read are technically "not in my To-Read Pile").

posts.title: Books Not Reviewed
posts.description: Ability to sort books from the 'read' category to view only the books you have not written a review for. This is helpful because I like to go back and write several reviews at once and if I have a list of books I've read but not reviewed, it's much easier than sorting through my whole 'read' list.

posts.title: Don’t show me books I’ve read in recommendations
posts.description: I see books I’ve already marked as read in my recs a lot, which does show how good recs are but also means I’m not seeing as many new books as I’d like. Would like to filter read books out, like you can with “to read” and owned.

posts.title: Target end date
posts.description: I would love to add a target end date for a book I’m currently reading and have storygraph tell me how many pages a dayI should read to reach that goal

posts.title: Next book in series
posts.description: I've been reading a long series straight through, and the infinite scroll format of the book list has grown increasingly painful the further in I get. Instead of having to click from the book I just finished, into the series as a whole, locate the next one in the list, and click through to that, it'd be really awesome to be able to just have a "next book in series" button (maybe also a "previous book in series" button?) when on the page of a book that's part of a series, in order to quickly & easily navigate; I think this might help slightly on the server end too as it's pulling less data each time someone's trying to get from one book in a series to the next.

posts.title: Representation Tags
posts.description: I know there has been a big conversation about author stats to track diversity and there is a lot of nuance to that conversation. I think we could talk about the representation in the actual book without putting authors in a bad position. I would love to see what types of representation are included in a book through user-generated tags similar to the current content warning tags. Example(anxiety rep, sapphic rep, trans rep etc.). This would allow the users to call out the representation they feel was included in the book without adding the author to the conversation. I think this would prevent a situation with an author feeling pressure to come out while still allowing a conversation about trans characters

posts.title: Count Anthologies as Multiple Books
posts.description: If you are reading an edition with multiple books included, there should be a feature where it counts for the number of books in the anthology.

posts.title: Favorite authors
posts.description: Add a feature where we can add favorite authors to our profile or are preferences, so those authors show up more in our recommendations

posts.title: Multiple Series
posts.description: Mostly a tool for Librarians to be able to add a book to several series. This as long running series tend to brach out in different “prongs” that are difficult to order relative to each other and makes reading order impossible to understand. Also makes it possible to have both publication order and reading order for those authors that jumps around in their own timeline.

posts.title: Reread Field in review
posts.description: In the review form, I would like to be asked "Would you re-read this book?" with the ability toggle yes/no/maybe with a comment box.

posts.title: Please let users select their gender in the profile settings
posts.description: I know some people like being referred to as "they", but personally I don't. Would it be possible to let users choose their gender/pronoun in the settings?

posts.title: Character/Plot graph
posts.description: Find out easily if you prefer character or plot driven books instead of clicking on each individual book

posts.title: Decline Up Next Suggestion
posts.description: I have the same few books popping up in my up next suggestions that I’ve already decided against. I’d like to have a way to decline them so I don’t have to see them and can get new suggestions.

posts.title: Don't show your own updates in community tab
posts.description: Ability to turn off your own updates in the community tab - so that you won't see them, while other people will - I'm the most active reader among my friends and usually when I go to the community tab all I see are updates on my own reading, and if I want to see my friends' I need to scroll waaaaay down, which I find kind of annoying.

posts.title: Number of Times Added On Reading Challenge
posts.description: Sometimes you have to rely on other people’s honesty when choosing books for a challenge, such as prompts like “a book featuring a love that defies social boundaries” for the 2026 PopSugar challenge. When I click to view all of the books added to a challenge prompt, I would love to see how many people added that book. I’d be more likely to add a book 11 other people are reading for that prompt vs. just one person adding it.

posts.title: This Day In Reading
posts.description: I would suggest a this day in reading. The ability to see what you were reading on today’s date in year’s past, how many books/pages you read by this point last year, by this point in the month last year, etc.

posts.title: Author Search- filter
posts.description: When I look at a book by an author, I often click on their name to see what other books by them I might also be interested in. However, this often leads to a TON of results that are not the author's books, or are huge compilation books. This is often not at all what I am looking for; I want books written by that person, period. I understand that other people might love to look at all the books the author has touched, but I am uninterested in collab books with 15 authors contributing to it. Also, sometimes inexplicably, something very much not by the author (in this case, Villette by Charlotte Bronte) will show up under the author search. I'd also like to be able to filter out articles the author has written that show up as 11 page user-added books. Solutions welcomed! One thought is that collaboration books are somehow able to be separated out from "normal" (for lack of a better adjective) novels, and that there's potentially a filter available when looking at these search results. I use this feature alllll the time and this is constantly a little thorn in using it.

posts.title: Custom order for custom chart segments
posts.description: I would like the option to order my data points in my custom chart manually (as opposed to alphanumerically or by frequency), similar to how I can order the prompts in reading challenges.

posts.title: Removing "Recommendations" and "Giveaways" from frontpage
posts.description: I don't use the recommendations and Giveaways and find they take up quite a lot of space on my front page. Would love the option to remove them if you don't use them.

posts.title: Sharing year wrap up to instagram
posts.description: I love seeing my yearly wrap up on StoryGraph, but would love for it to have a share function direct to instagram stories, not just a link in private message.

posts.title: Search by narrator
posts.description: I saw the post that a lot of books are missing narrator data but for those that have the data I would love to be able to search for books with a certain narrator. Thanks!

posts.title: Book wishlist
posts.description: It'd be great to be able to identify the books, publicly, that I don't own - and would like to. Some would be books I have already read, but don't yet own, others would be ones I've not read, but know they're ones I want to own. I've trained my family over the years ;) to look at my TBR and see what's tagged as owned or not, but it'd be nice to be able to differentiate the books I'd actively like to receive/purchase.

posts.title: Ability to see if book series is complete
posts.description: Before I start a book series, I often like to know if the series is finished or not. Usually, I go google it to find out, but it would be nice to just see that information in StoryGraph! If the series is not finished, I would like to know if each book is considered its own stand alone novel and not necessarily in order.

posts.title: Lists for Awards
posts.description: it would be awesome to be able to create/cultivate lists for yearly awards for literature. Goodreads has their own nomination system which would also be really neat but I feel like it would be cool to have a way to look ag what was nominated for certain categories (or even won) so we can pick and choose the best of the best. When it comes to these lists and pre-existing challenges it would be really awesome if there was a quick add option for the books to the “to read” pile. Example: the nominees for the 2021 world fantasy awards were just released… So if I’m looking at the 2021 World Fantasy Awards, I can see the nominees, categories, and eventual winners. & add them to my “to-read” pile from that list. Also adding this feature to challenges with specific books would be really great. This feature would also allow challenges that refer to certain categories to be cultivated from lists that pertain to that category. Not all books are obvious based on genre/author/etc. so if I want to do a Buzzfeed challenge that asks me to read a book based on circuses, having a list that has a bunch of books pertaining to circuses that I can quickly add to my tbr shelf would be really great!

posts.title: Show read dates on ‘read books’ page
posts.description: When I click to see all my books read recently it would be great to show the reading dates on that page. Right now I have to click into the book and then click again to see both the start and finish date. Or if this isn’t possible to be able to see the full reading date history on the main book page and not have to click into the reading history.

posts.title: Random Generator For Owned Books
posts.description: Randomize and pick from the owned category.

posts.title: Ability to archive tags
posts.description: I'd love to be able to archive tags that aren't being used anymore without deleting them entirely. For example, I have a lot of tags that involve a year (e.g. 2023-challenges or 2025-non-xmen). I will not be actively adding those tags to books anymore, since the relevant year is over. I don't want to delete the tag permanently, because I still want to be able to look at the list and stats associated. But I would love for my tag list to be just a little less long when I'm applying NEW tags to books. I've got tbr-add-2025 *and* tbr-add-2025-01 through 12 for different purposes and it's going to get crowded once I started adding this year's list.

posts.title: Editions Page Improvement: Prioritize Read and Owned Editions
posts.description: Hi! 👋 When looking at the Editions section of a book, it would be super helpful if the editions I’ve interacted with (read, reading, paused, DNFed, or owned) appeared at the top of the list - above the rest of the editions. Right now, the edition I opened is at the top, then the filter, and then all other editions. If I’ve read or own multiple editions, it’s hard to find them quickly. Two possible improvements: • Sort editions so that read / owned / reading / paused / DNFed ones always show first. or • Add a filter option to show only read or owned editions. This would make it much easier to track and manage books with several editions - especially for people who collect, reread, or compare them. Thank you! 💛

posts.title: Re read section
posts.description: Make a re-read section within the read books, or maybe an independent button to see them, something to make it easier to access the list of books we have read multiple times.

posts.title: Ability to make bingo boards for reading challenges
posts.description: There are a lot of reading challenges that are in bingo format rather than a list of prompts you need to complete. It would be so nice to have a challenge that would mark a challenge as complete when a bingo (straight across, down or diagonal) is completed + shows how many bingos you achieved by the end of the challenge if you still managed to continue.

posts.title: Links to prequel/sequel/companion series on series page
posts.description: I think it would be really cool if on a page for a series, there could be a link to a different series that is connected to it in some way. So for example, Mistborn Era 1 and Era 2 could be different series pages, and on the Era 1 page you'd have a "For the sequel series, see Mistborn Era 2" with a link embedded in it, and vice versa. Right now they're smushed into one page, which I think makes it feel more like they'd follow the same characters all the way through. As another example, see the Kushiel's Legacy: Phedre's Trilogy series page, which suggests based on the title that there are other series but you would have to go searching for those somewhere else, and without using other tools it would probably be difficult to tell which series comes next. I have no idea how complicated this would be to implement (maybe it's something users could designate to take some of the load off of you all?) but I think it would be really cool!

posts.title: Up Next list to show up under Currently Reading on the homepage
posts.description: Could the up next list show up under currently reading block?
