posts.title: Trends in your all-time stats
posts.description: A feature that looks at your all time data and discusses changes and shifts in your reading over time. For example over the last year or so I've really gotten into general fantasy and away from young adult. So there might be a line under my genre stats that says "Since 2020 you've picked up more fantasy and less young adult" recognizing the change in my taste and notating this.

posts.title: Buddy reads: Open invitations where people can opt in
posts.description: I'd like to be able to create buddy reads where I don't invite specific people, so those who are interested can opt in. I'd like a list of all open buddy reads, with some intelligent filtering so it's easy to find books I'm interested in. Why I'd like this: - It's intimidating to invite strangers who I've had no interaction with to a read-along. - With the current method for finding people to invite, I think many invitations will be sent to people who aren't interested in a read-along right now, or in reading that specific book right now. (From my limited experience of trying buddy read once, two of the people invited haven't answered the invite.) The ability to create open buddy reads could be a Plus feature, but everybody should be able to join them.

posts.title: Have a "To-Read" List of Authors
posts.description: I would love a way to have a list of authors I'd like to read on Storygraph. Especially useful for authors with a large catalog of books, instead of adding all their books, I'd love to just add an author to a list of TBR authors to refer back to.

posts.title: Reading Goals - Stretch Goals
posts.description: I think it would be nice to have the option for stretch reading goals - like I want to read a minimum of one book a week (or 52 books) this year but I'd also like to push myself and get to 75, 100, etc total as like secondary goals.

posts.title: Filter by Books I've Added to Challenges
posts.description: Currently, when filtering books in my TBR/Owned/Tags, etc. there is an option to filter for "Books Added to My Reading Challenges" but it brings up any book that anyone has added to my reading challenges. This feels a bit cluttered and unhelpful because I want to filter for books that only I have added. If I want to see what books other people have added to challenges I will go straight to the actual prompt pages. Currently, I've joined quite a few challenges and have to go through a lot of clicking to see what books I've added. I could make a tag for this but it became a bit tiresome. So, what I'm looking for is a way to see all books I have added to any of my challenges all in one place. This could be a filter option or it could even be its own separate thing under the Reading Challenges (like a place to click to view all books I've added to my reading challenges, either in a normal list or cover view would be even cooler!). That way I could browse and pick my next read from this selection!

posts.title: Mark Interest in Buddy Read for a Book
posts.description: It's hard to know if other users are interested in buddy reads for specific books, and I wish I could mark that I'm interested in buddy reading certain titles. This could be useful to help provide user suggestions for buddy reads. It would really be helpful if there was a way to display publicly or to friends the books you'd like to buddy read (maybe in your profile? and/or it could show up on the book's page where you find reviews/TBR status of people you follow?)

posts.title: Users can decide what's shown on their profiles
posts.description: e.g. options to toggle on certain tags to be shown, owned books, hide five-stars etc.

posts.title: Own voices reviews
posts.description: When looking at other reviews being able to filter by 'own voices' reviews. My example is: a book set in Korea, being able to find reviewers who are Korean/ or AAPI (I would imagine that the reviewers could self certify as own voices review when filling in their boxes) Thank you!

posts.title: Filter books added to challenge prompts
posts.description: When I'm doing a reading challenge I like to look at the books other users have added to the prompt for ideas of what to read. But when there are tons of books, it's hard to look through. It would be nice to be able to sort it and filter it to find books I would want to read

posts.title: Opening links to StoryGraph should open in the mobile app
posts.description: Opening links in your mobile browser should prompt you to open the page in the mobile app or it should open the mobile app automatically.

posts.title: Tags at the book level, not edition level
posts.description: I feel like I might have made this suggestion before but I couldn't find it 😅 Apologies if this is a duplicate, I wish the roadmap tool let you look up a history of your own posts! The next custom chart I'm working on is a "Date I Added It To My TBR" chart. I exported my data to get that info 🎉 and I'm going through all the books on my Read list and my TBR to add "tbr-add-XXXX" tags to every one. I just realized though that for books where I've read multiple editions, I have to remember to go into every single edition to add the same tag to them so that they will all show up correctly in the charts, since I read the different editions in different years. I wish there were a way that I could say "I added Gideon The Ninth, the book, to my TBR in 2020" and have any edition of it that I read know about that tag in my charts.

posts.title: Monthly reading goal
posts.description: I'd love to be able to set a monthly reading goal rather than just a yearly one!

posts.title: Toggle hiding completed prompts in Reading Challenge
posts.description: For reading challenges that are quite long, it can be hard to see which prompts are still left to go. For this challenge (https://app.thestorygraph.com/reading_challenges/862c3ed0-ea8f-41f2-92d4-979215d30c16), I have 75% of the prompts completed. With books added to every prompt, you can only see ~2 prompts per screen (a little bit more on my laptop, definitely maxed at two on mobile), and scrolling through to find which ones are not yet done is difficult. I would love to have a toggle up at the top with options to "show all" or "show incomplete".

posts.title: Reviews display dates (optionally)
posts.description: I would love the site to list the date when a review was written. It can often situate the context around a particular review. Also, when people state that 'this book hasn't been updated' etc, then it would be nice to know when their review was written since sometimes subsequent editions were published.

posts.title: Option for "Mainly reads..." to be based on most recent books read
posts.description: As I have moved my Goodreads data across to Storygraph, I have a record of all the books I've read since I was about 15/16. I really had quite a strong preference for YA fantasy as a teenager, meaning my "Mainly reads..." and "Typically chooses..." information is heavily influenced by these books. As an example, it currently says that I typically choose fast paced books despite the fact that I have read more medium paced books over the the past couple of years. I'd really like to keep the record of the books I read when I was younger, but they are significantly skewing my stats and the "Mainly reads" information doesn't actually reflect what I mainly read at the moment. I'd like to suggest the option for this information to be based on either an amount of time (eg. the last 12 months) or a set amount of books (eg. the last 100 books) because it would make the information more useful and relevant. Thank you :)

posts.title: Ratings should (mostly) follow the book, not the edition
posts.description: I suspect this was debated internally by the product team, but having individual ratings track to an edition as opposed to the *book* is confusing. There are some books I have read, for instance, that have 60 or 70 editions, where most of the editions are simply new printings of the same book (“20th anniversary edition“ etc.) or different formats (kindle vs. hardback vs. paperback vs. large format) I understand that there may be cases where a new edition fundamentally changes the book, but those cases are probably mostly restricted to translations (where the translator really matters) and audiobooks (where the voice actor / narrator really matters). So my suggestion would be to represent ratings at the level of the book rather than the edition, except in cases where the edition is in a different language than the original or is an audiobook. For an example of where this is most confusing - when I scroll through the “popular this week” section, I see a ton of books I have read. Most of them, however, say “you read a different edition of this book” and so don’t have my rating next to them. This makes it a bit hard for me to remember what I thought of the book, which is a useful data point in trying to select my next book (eg, if I see one I rated a 5 in the list, I might click through and use the “similar books” function). EDIT: I can see how much attention/care has gone into trying to grapple with this edition challenge and how much work it will be to revise it. What I’m trying to convey, gently, is that SO many other things about this app are working brilliantly, but this is one area that isn’t.

posts.title: Disability genre
posts.description: Hi there! Disabled/chronically I’ll reader here. I’d love to be able to keep track of my reads with disability rep in the same ways StoryGraph lets you track LGBTQIA+, etc. would you consider adding it as a genre?

posts.title: Ability to complete missing info when importing via ISBN
posts.description: When a user imports a new book via ISBN - and all the data is loaded... having an opportunity to review / update any "missing" fields before saving it? For ex, today I imported a digital version of a book using ISBN, it imported fine but it was missing page info. It would have been nice to add that myself without having to create a ticket. Basically - what ever fields may be missing on import that you would normally let a user add when adding manually would be great!

posts.title: Search engine autocompletion/suggestions
posts.description: Add autocompletion and suggestions with book cover images to the search engine.

posts.title: Add reading journal entries from the reading journal page
posts.description: It would be nice/more convenient to be able to add entries to a specific book's reading journal instead of having to go back to the "currently reading" page or book's profile to add a new entry. I can add screenshots if needed!

posts.title: Favourite tags as checkboxes
posts.description: I would love to have at least some of my tags available as checkboxes, so I don't always have to write them, then choose from the list, then click on update. Instead I have - for example - 5 tags of my choosing be available with a checkbox and I just go, check, check, check and am done with the tags.

posts.title: Additional sort options
posts.description: It would be nice to be able to sort lists alphabetically or by publication date.

posts.title: TBR stats and summaries
posts.description: I would love a few more stats around TBRs to help be more intentional about what I am adding and reading. Some thoughts: - annual summaries could include a chart which captures how many books added/read/removed to TBR - monthly/annual summaries show which books you read from TBR - chart on TBR stats page showing how many added per year

posts.title: Option to hide tags from stats page
posts.description: I created some tags purely for the custom charts available in Plus but they also now appear in the regular tag stats chart and the chart is getting overwhelmed. I would like to be able to hide some tags from the stats page but not remove them from my books.

posts.title: Monthly calendar - custom colors?
posts.description: I'm pretty obsessed with my monthly calendars, I have been generating a new one sometimes multiple times a day to see the new bars and covers get added as I add journal entries. I can't wait to share my August one once the month is over! I know that a ton of work went into the color picking algorithm but with the number of books that I read concurrently, it can be hard to distinguish which book is which. The first calendar I generated after this launched (July, see first pic), I had read a lot of books that had covers with similar color schemes, so it ended up looking like all the progress bars were very similar shades of grays/dark teal/khaki. I jokingly said to myself that I better read more vibrantly colored books in the future. But, I was just looking at one of my older month calendars and was surprised that some of the covers that I thought would have been a bright color also seemed to be more muted than I would have expected (February, see second pic, I circled the ones that surprised me. Sorrowland is in there even though it's a bright green because I would have expected that color to be bright purple since the green is a much smaller section of the cover). I don't know how possible this would be in a V2 or V3 since it's a generated image rather than an interactive chart, but I would love the ability to customize the colors associated with each book. I'd love for Bunny in the Feb calendar to be that neon pink, but for July with all of the mostly gray Wicked + Divine covers to be able to just pick a few random colors so that they are easily distinguishable in the image. Still extremely happy with the chart in the meantime though, all of the wrapup graphics in general have eliminated nearly all of the screenshotting that I used to do every month when I share my reading round-ups!! (The only remaining screenshots are just if my custom charts have anything interesting to say 😄)

posts.title: Use other Storygraph data points for custom charts
posts.description: Hi! I LOVE the custom charts. I do wish I could include other non-tag data points WITH tags. For example, I have one custom chart with the source of the book (library, Everand, borrowed from a friend, etc). I wish I could add my “owned” books to this chart. I use the native “owned” feature, and I don’t really want to go through it and add an “owned” tag too that I’ll have to maintain. I think this could also be fixed by potential smart tags…every time I mark a book as owned, add an “owned” tag, etc!

posts.title: Block other users
posts.description: a feature to block other users from seeing our activity and reviews.

posts.title: Change the "owned" button to be more visually distinctive
posts.description: It would be really helpful if when I mark a book "owned" it could invert colors or turn the same colors as the "to read" button is before it's selected, something like that - something to visually distinguish it as different if I own the book, beyond just having to verbally process reading "mark as owned" vs "owned." Basically I would like a way to be able to more quickly tell at a glance when I'm out and about and pull up the book's page whether I own the book or not.

posts.title: Streak Reminder
posts.description: I'd really like the ability to enable a push notification to remind me to extend my streak because I am forgetful af and will definitely forget whether I've read anything or not. (I literally just turned my light out and then had to turn it back on again cuz I realised I hadn't read anything yet today!)

posts.title: Include publishers in the stats
posts.description: I would love to see most read publishers included in the all time stats below most read authors. It would also be helpful if it’s possible to find other authors from the same publisher.

posts.title: Expand/Extend Most Read Authors Chart
posts.description: I’d love to be able to expand the “Most Read Authors” graph to show how all authors stack up in a specific time frame or for all time Update by Nadia (30th Jul 2024): Edited title to make it clearer what this post is asking for!

posts.title: Compare stats with other users
posts.description: Would love to be able to see the stats page of all users combined and/or have a button to compare you stats to compare your stats with another users

posts.title: Sort DNFs
posts.description: I hope I'm not asking a dumb question that's already been answered. I read a lot and DNF a lot too. So I was curious how many books I DNFd this month (because I can't remember) and my list shows ALL DNFs in history. I don't know what I DNFd this month. Can we sort by date?

posts.title: Show your edition as search result
posts.description: Hi there! This is probably also way more complicated than it seems, haha, but could you make it so that the edition I last read/marked as to read etc. shows up in the search results when I search a book on the storygraph? I think this would be particularly helpful for people who read other languages

posts.title: Book award lists and medals
posts.description: The idea is that there'd be lists of winners/nominees of certain writing awards (National Book Award, Nobel, Booker, Pulitzer, Hugo, Nebula, Women's Prize, etc) and when you view a book's page it would have maybe a medal icon and state what awards it was nominated for or won.

posts.title: Option to exclude certain books from Stats page
posts.description: Add a checkbox to a book's page that would exclude that book from your stats page and the annual book/page challenge. This would be helpful if you don't want to track certain books (such as reference books) but still want to be able to mark them read/review them.

posts.title: Search results should prioritize books we've already added
posts.description: I know that we can go to our TBR pile/read books/etc. and search through those lists, but it would be nice if we could skip that step and have our top results in the general search bar prioritize books already in our library. OR have ONE list for our entire library, containing books on our TBR, read books, DNFs, etc.

posts.title: Mark as favourite inside the review form
posts.description: Hi! The new favourite shelf has been an immediate favourite (eheh!) for many users, even if the feature is still at its very first version. I just wanted to leave a suggestion for the future: I would love if just under the rating question in the review page there could be a simple “do you want to add this book to your favourites shelf?” checkbox. I can’t wait for all the new additions (and possibly stats? 👀) we are gonna get for this feature!

posts.title: Filter books by star ratings
posts.description: I add anything that sounds mildly interesting to my tbr so I like to clean it up occasionally and being able to filter on average star ratings would help me to decide if a book is worth it or how to prioritise my tbr.

posts.title: Be able to suggest a book for a reading challenge but not count it against your progress
posts.description: Sorry if this was posted somewhere already, but it would be nice if we could add books to reading challenges so others can see them, but not count them for specific prompts. For instance, in a book bingo challenge I'm doing - I have books that count for multiple prompts, but the card doesn't allow for repeats. I like adding books for people to find them in each prompt, but I'd like to be able to select which prompt I'm actually using the book for. In the screenshot, The Tainted Cup counts for both Published in 2024 and Character with a Disability, but I only want to use it for the character with a disability square - my published in 2024 prompt is actually not complete since it's a repeat book of another prompt.

posts.title: Add finished goal date
posts.description: Would be awesome to have an optional field when marking a book as currently reading or up next to assign a "goal finish date" especially with book clubs there's usually a time frame by which you aim to finish the book so If I could plug in a date and then it could Tell me how many pages I need to read a day to finish the book by the date

posts.title: Show the date when a book was marked as owned
posts.description: It would be great to see the date/month a book was marked as owned, on the book listing and in the stats. To see which months I purchase books, the amount, compared to how many of those I have read.

posts.title: Filter/Sort/Bookmark/Pin Timed vs Ongoing Reading Challenges
posts.description: Would love to be able to filter/sort Reading Challenges, not only while browsing new challenges, but also on my own profile or while looking at challenges I’ve already joined. As an example, having the option to sort by challenge soonest to end would be super helpful! And having the start/finish date displayed somewhere on the thumbnail(?) like the number of prompts completed would also be nice. Also, I join ongoing/perpetual challenges whenever they seem even a little interesting because I don’t want to lose track of them, though I don’t always want to start them immediately. Would be nice to have a bookmark (haha) option to revisit interesting challenges on a separate page so challenges I’m not actively trying to complete don't overtake my profile or the Reading Challenges page. Also had the thought that pinning challenges so they appear at the top of the list could be useful! Like if someone is prioritizing a challenge because it's part of a book club, a social media thing, or just because it's the one they're focusing on right now!

posts.title: Move 'completed' prompts to bottom of list - challenges
posts.description: It would be great if the prompt list on challenges was sortable or if the completed promps would automatically drop to the bottom of the list.

posts.title: Filter Other People's To-Read Pile by What I've Read and Want to Read
posts.description: When looking at other people's To-Read Piles (and Read books) it would be nice to be able to filter books I've read and books I want to read. This could go under the "Only show me books.." section of the filter options

posts.title: Add nicknames to friends
posts.description: A way to add a nickname to friends would be great. I would like to add it next to their site name to make them easier to find. Thank you!

posts.title: add a book to series on Series page
posts.description: the future I think we should add to the story graph is the ability the ability to add a book to the series from the series page

posts.title: Notification when Challenge Completed
posts.description: I like the celebration emojis, but I think it would be nice to also get a notification when I’ve completed a reading challenge. (Just something automated.)

posts.title: Audiobook Speed Setting
posts.description: I typically listen to audiobooks at 1.2x speed. It would be great to have a way to mark what speed you listen at so that the stats would reflect actual time spent listening instead of the listed time.

posts.title: Release *date* rather than just year
posts.description: This seems pretty basic, but we really need the release date rather than just the year on the main list view. If I'm waiting for a new book it's really confusing as to whether a book is out yet. Ideally, that would then also allow your TBR to be filtered by whether a book is out yet, and/or get reminders when a new book is due out (or perhaps is due out this month, so you could get one reminder for all of your TBR new releases.

posts.title: New Filter Option in Tags to exclude books that have been read
posts.description: When filtering a list, a filter option to only show books that haven't been marked as 'read' would be nice. This would be similar to the 'Only show me books... not in my To-Read Pile' filter. I have a tag for eBooks and would like to see only ones that haven't been read yet because I add the tag to both 'read' and 'to-read' books.

posts.title: Community Read Challenges
posts.description: When clicking on a reading challenge on a friend's profile, it directs to the overall reading challenge or my page of it. Would be nice to be able to see what books they have chosen for the prompts when clicking to it from their Profile.

posts.title: "switch edition"
posts.description: At the moment, in order to switch editions (after adding a new edition for example) you need to go to the main page for an edition you don't want or 'you are reading another edition', click 'see alternate editions' and then can click 'switch edition.' I think it might be useful to be able to click 'switch edition' from the main page, or at least from any version of the 'browse editions' page. The above is badly phrased, but maybe there could be a 'switch edition' button on the top edition of a book as well as the ones below the 'jump/filter'? Thanks!

posts.title: Complexity rating
posts.description: How hard is this book to read? Are there a lot of characters to keep track of? Difficult concepts to grasp?

posts.title: Rearrange/redesign book pages
posts.description: The left-hand side is getting quite cluttered, while the right-hand side is rather empty, especially if a description is missing. Maybe "People you follow" could go the the right, that way we don't have to scroll down so far to see the moods, CWs etc.

posts.title: Specific pub date
posts.description: Include the actual date of publication for each, not just the year.

posts.title: Update pages read challenge when progress is tracked
posts.description: Currently the ‘pages read’ challenge only updates when a book is marked as finished (and soon when marked as DNF) If the book being read is particularly long this means that for several days the challenge will tell you you’re behind, but that may not be the case if the progress through the book is taken into account. Current behaviour: 50% of the way through a 1000 page book = 0 pages in reading challenge Desired behaviour: 50% of the way through a 1000 page book = 500 pages in reading challenge

posts.title: better search engine
posts.description: the search engine does not work super well at the moment. even if i type the title of the book i know exists , i still have to scroll down to find it among other titles who are not nearly as relevant.

posts.title: Option to hide "no rating" in ratings graph
posts.description: I don't rate every book I read (such as nonfiction, comic collections, or books I read a long time ago). With every "no rating" book appearing in the star rating graph, the graph has become incredibly difficult to read, like how the graph for publication vs read date used to look before being able to filter out dates. Personally I would like to go back to these not appearing in the graph, or to at least having the option to hide them.

posts.title: Buy Year vs Read Year Plot
posts.description: It would really interesting to have a plot for date or year a book was bought vs the year it was read. To have an idea of how long it took to read it. This would be particularly interesting for people who tend to buy a lot but not read as much, having a visual evidence of how much they are buying each year vs how much they are reading each year would be really cool. Obviously this would require a "buy day" field that readers would have to fill in, but I don't think that's too hard to add.

posts.title: Ability to exclude books from wrap ups
posts.description: I love the wrap ups but have recently had various books I would have excluded from the wrap up - re-read and bonus chapters that I logged. It would be great if there were some option to exclude things from wrap ups.

posts.title: "Finished" graphic
posts.description: I would love an option to get a cute "Yay, you finished this book" graphic to share. I love it on apps I've used in the past.

posts.title: Not Yet Published Flag/ Notification
posts.description: Okay so I hate to copy something from that other app not to be named but I kinda LOVE THE “Not yet Published; Expected…. DATE” feature…. Would love to see something like that one here.

posts.title: Custom Charts - Include multiple tags for a segment
posts.description: So I just decided to play around with some the Custom Reports and created one I’ve had in mind for awhile, which was a book source chart where I have tags showing I got it from the library, new purchase, used purchase, kindle purchase, free, gift etc. It worked great and did exactly what I wanted. Then I had the idea of creating a chart that shows whether I paid for the book or didn’t. I thought I could just add all the free categories (library, gift, free) to one segment and then include the purchased categories in the second. Unfortunately, this wasn’t possible unless I went through and added another tag to all my books. It would be great if I could either add multiple tags to a segment or maybe have the ability to create tag categories and add tags under that. Then I could create segments by tag categories.

posts.title: Ability for challenge participants to leave comments on books they read for challenge participants to see
Only show content warning symbol if it is verified or percentage
posts.description: I propose that the caution symbol should only show up if the content warning is verified, if a certain percentage of reviewers who left warnings mention it (like 50%), or if it's on the main page instead of needing to click see all. I read a lot of horror and nearly all of them have warnings for SA and it's wrong for more than half of them.

posts.title: Exclude non-books from recommendations
posts.description: I would like to add in my preferences for recommendations that I only want to see books, since I'm not interested in fan fiction etc.

posts.title: "if you liked this book, you'd also like"
posts.description: It would be awesome to include similar books when leaving a review of a book. For example, when you finish one book you could list 3 other books it reminded you of. That would make it easier to find books with similar styles!

posts.title: see friends' reading challenge books
posts.description: I'd love to be able to see what books my friends have added to their reading challenges when clicking on the challenge from their page rather than it bringing me to my own challenge (like if you open the challenge from their profile it shows you their progress vs your own progress when you open it on your profile/from reading challenges).

posts.title: Reorder Joined Reading Challenges
posts.description: It would be great to be able to sort or reorder the reading challenges instead of them showing up as most recently joined! I've joined so many challenges that sometimes I have to scroll a while to find the one i want when adding books, so being able to rearrange what order they are listed in would be great!

posts.title: Tinder Style Buddy Reads
posts.description: This one is weird but thought I'd throw it out since my friend and I were having trouble picking a book. It would be lovely if we could both "swipe right" or "swipe left" on a series of books (potentially from the list of recommended books we already get for buddy reads). And the system could tell us which book(s) we both swiped right on. This would be even more helpful with larger groups.

posts.title: Ability to filter/prefer series or standalone
posts.description: I think it would be helpful in the recommendations section/ reading preferences to be able to filter for or reflect in reading preferences interest in series versus stand alone. When asked “what are you in the mood for?”, it would be great to be able to note whether you want to begin investing in a series or not.

posts.title: Include first books in the series
posts.description: When filtering to read being able to exclude sequels to books, but include the first book. Also being able to only show series would be amazing.

posts.title: Email signature/blog banner - Currently Reading
posts.description: I would love a function to be able to display the book I'm currently reading in an external banner - specifically, if possible, in an email signature, and/or on socials, blogs etc. It's the one thing that keeps me using 'that other site' in tandem with this one, because it's such a neat little feature.

posts.title: Pages in TBR
posts.description: This is a smol feature request, but I would love to know the total number of pages in my TBR! I thought that when I went to the All Time Stats view, which compares All Time with the TBR, that it would show me this info, but alas it does not. I want to know, based on my reading rate in the past year, how many years of books I have in there 😅 if I read at roughly the same rate.

posts.title: Duplicate Titles
posts.description: It would be great if there was a button like GR that shows you what books you have duplicate editions on. Right now I’m going one by one when I’m making sure my tags are the same as they were on GR.

posts.title: Up Next Tab
posts.description: I would love to see the Up Next screen / Pile To Read be its own tab. Using the Up Next feature is currently difficult to get to because we have to click 'Profile' tab then click Pile to Read option. Having its own dedicated tab would be amazing. Perhaps consider removing the home tab as we can already get to home screen by using The StoryGraph icon on PC or hitting the back button on mobile (or just having five tabs). Love the Up Next feature! Would like to have it more accessible. Thank you!

posts.title: Date Range For Stats
posts.description: It would be great to be able to select a date range to view my stats so I don’t have to go into every month and compile them when I want to do a quarterly or mid-year report.

posts.title: Public option for reading journal
posts.description: One of my favorite things in reading apps is to see my friends update their reading progress and what they're thinking about the book so far.

posts.title: Anonymous review thanks
posts.description: As someone who LOVES the absence of social noise on TSG and considers it "one of my favourite things" (UNLIKE "The Sound of Music"), I still sometimes wish I could silently thank a user for their review. If it were possible to "thank" someone with no visible indication on the review page that this had been done, the temptation/tendency to 'game the system' by writing for points would still be avoided. If the only result was the user receiving a notification that some unspecified user had thanked them, that would avoid any sense of intrusion, while at the same time letting them know that their contribution was appreciated.

posts.title: Book recommendations including reading challenges
posts.description: In my filters, I'd love to have an option "Show books that have been added to your reading challenges by other people", so that I get personalized recommendations, but they also work towards my reading challenge goals.

posts.title: Add a possibility to suggest merging two book records, as sometimes there are multiples for one book
posts.description: Example: https://app.thestorygraph.com/books/02126472-5a21-4f93-adc7-8f5b4ead52e6 and https://app.thestorygraph.com/books/169bc3c0-61b7-4e71-95d6-0a18e870da98

posts.title: Draft review while reading
posts.description: I would like to be able write my review while a am reading the book. The review should off cause be a draft version and not be able to be published before the book is finished (or DNF'ed). I always have a lot of thoughts and ideas for my review while reading the book, but once I'm done I have forgotten most of the thoughts I had in the beginning (which are the most important for a spoiler free review), and then a couple of days go by and I've read another book in the meantime and I end up writing a really short generic review because I've moved on and are not that invested anymore. Now I know what you are thinking: Use the reading journal. I have tried, but is doesn't work for me - I will still have to put all the different entries together which feels like double work, and I mostly forget to even look in the journal. Maybe the journal would work better if it was easily accessible form the review page, but as it is now it feels very cumbersome to use for this purpose. I know that there are also people that don't update their progress, so the reading journal is no good for them either.

posts.title: Book statistics
posts.description: i didn't find any similar thread it would be nice for each book to see something similar to the book statistics in goodreads, seing something like: - average rating - how many people read it - how many people have it in TBR - how many people DNF and a chart with the evolution overt time of these metrics it could be nice also a graph with when a new editions is published over time, to see how many times and how often it gets published again 1984 book statistics on good read: https://www.goodreads.com/book/stats?id=61439040

posts.title: Add "Owned" checkbox to Filter editions
posts.description: For books that have many editions, I am often looking for the one that I own to add to my TBR, so that I select the right edition when I start it. My TBR section is only for my immediate TBR (i.e. within the next few weeks) and as such, I use Owned heavily for inventory. A tickbox for Owned in the filter editions tab would greatly improve finding the right edition, especially on mobile.

posts.title: Streak Freeze
posts.description: I'd really like a streak freeze option like Duolingo has, so if you have a really busy day you can skip a days reading without losing your streak. Maybe it could be something you earn by reading so many pages in a time period? And you could customise it for your own personal habits? Thanks!

posts.title: Pencil on Currently Reading with no pages logged yet
posts.description: I love that we can enter where we are in books on the currently reading tab, but I wish there was a 0% with a pencil on books we are starting. That way we don't have to go all the way into the book itself to log the first progress entry.

posts.title: year published pie chart
posts.description: I just think it would be neat to have a pie chart with decade slices. i could do this with tagging in custom charts but since they year is already attached to the book, it seems like there should be an easy way to summon up that sort of data

posts.title: Show read date on review
posts.description: I would like to see when my friend read the book .. seems on the review page would be the easiest, but??

posts.title: Make owned books easier to spot on a list
posts.description: To mark books as owned, the button has two simple status where just the text changes between them. So, the button says "mark as owned" and when clicked the copy changes to "owned". It works fine but when looking at a list of books is not easy to distinguish between both and I've found myself mistakingly clicking the button because I click faster than I read. I'd love for the owned books to be easier to spot. Maybe the button could change color when clicked or a check mark could be added inside the button when the book is marked as owned?

posts.title: See Books I've Read on Virtual Bookshelves
posts.description: The biggest thing I miss about reading physical books is the ability to amass a personal library, where I can see all of my owned books on bookshelves. For many (like myself), we don't have room in our homes for so many books. I would love to see all the books I've read/owned on a virtual bookshelf. It could even be personalized, and users could see our personal library space (like a reading room). I haven't found any platforms that offer this, and would love to see it created here.

posts.title: Sharable graphics for challenges!
posts.description: I went to Instagram today to get the templates for the 2023 Challenges to belatedly share and realized that they had already been replaced by the new ones. It made me think that it would be really cool if, for the TSG hosted ones, it was part of the Wrapup/shareable graphics to have the template all filled in for you with the covers! I imagine it would be much more difficult to autogenerate something like that for challenges set up by other users, but it might be a neat new addition for next year 😄

posts.title: Adding “Mythology” genre
posts.description: Hi! I’m a big-time fan of mythology and myths retellings- any chance of adding a mythology genre category?

posts.title: Condensed List View
posts.description: To be fair, my to-read pile is excessive at over 1400 titles. I have problems with scrolling through all the options. (The page eventually crashes or stops responding). I generally like the way books appear on the tbr pile, but when I'm hunting for a book to fill a challenge prompt, it's frustrating that I can only view 3 books at a time on my screen. I wish there was a way to toggle between the standard view and an alternative (maybe condensed, more list like view). Filtering is great, but sometimes I can't filter for the type of book I'm looking for (e.g., a book with a purple cover, or when I want to see which authors have 3+ books on my TBR pile)

posts.title: "Last Night" Button
posts.description: Add a check box/button when updating the pages read for last night/yesterday so you don't have to go to the reading journal to change the date when you update your bedtime book in the morning.

posts.title: Access to "never show me this" list
posts.description: The ability to exclude books and authors from recommendations is really helpful, but (unless I just haven't found it) there's no way to access that list of excluded titles and authors. Mis-clicks happen, tastes change, and it would be helpful to be able to see that list and no longer hide something previously put on the exclusion list.

posts.title: Filter option to remove unpublished/not yet published books
posts.description: It would be great to have an option to filter to remove the currently unpublished books from the TBR list!

posts.title: Add calendar to daily streak
posts.description: Add calendar view in addition to the line graph to the daily streak. Show numbers of pages/minutes on calendar.(Similar to the January calendar template).

posts.title: Upvoting books added to challenge prompts
posts.description: I often try to use challenges to diversify my reading. If I come across a prompt and can't think of a book to fulfil it, I'll browse the books other users have added for some inspiration. My problem is that sometimes I find that many of the books don't actually fit the prompt (ie. the prompt may ask for a contemporary novel from a female author, but the books added include classics, or novels translated from Arabic could include novels that were originally written and published in English). Obviously no one has the time to go through and check the relevance of all books to their prompts, and I understand that not everyone will care so much that the books they're adding to challenges fit the prompts perfectly, but I think some sort of upvoting could help people who are browsing (like a thumbs up if you think a book is a good match for the prompt). Or maybe ordering the books by the number of people who've added it to that prompt.

posts.title: Up Next Book Suggestions "Owned" toggle
posts.description: (I'm sure someone has thought of this already but I couldn't find a post, so I'm sorry if this is repetitive!) I love the up next suggestions but it would be nice if there was an option for it to only show books you've marked owned (on/off type of a toggle). Often when I'm stuck with my next read I refer to that page and really helpful, but often most, if not all, books are ones I don't easily have access to. So it would be nice to have the option! :)

posts.title: See Stats by Challenge
posts.description: I would love the option to see my stats for a specific reading challenge too - not just time periods.

posts.title: Make large buddy reads easier to navigate
posts.description: I'm participating in a buddy read with 5 people and our comment section is quickly filling up and as it's taking longer and longer to scroll through I thought something like what's in my attached pic would be a good idea to make it easier to see everything! Maybe like unread/new comments can be maximized and when you've read it the next time you come back to the app they're minimized and only new comments are maximized and then you have the option to maximize previous comments?

posts.title: 'Don't show me this series again' option
posts.description: It would be nice to be able to exclude series from your searches the same way you can remove individual authors and books, with a cross. This would be good for series' with lots of different authors (like comics or TV book adaptations) that users might not be interested in.

posts.title: Exclude certain genres from stats
posts.description: I read comics sometimes, but because they're so short they really skew some of my stats (especially most read authors). I would love the ability to filter my stats by genre so that I could see the breakdown of books I've read excluding comics.

posts.title: To-Read pile of just author names
posts.description: Would be cool to have a to-read list of just authors, as opposed to individual books, like a list where we could add authors and be able to then click on each one to see their books. This could be a way to keep track of favorite authors or authors that have been recommended to you but that you don't yet know what books by them you want to read.

posts.title: Books listed by series
posts.description: I was wondering if it would be possible when clicking on an author's page to have parts of a series consolidated into one link/another page, with standalone books staying on the books page (or under a standalone page). It gets really overwhelming when searching for a specific book and an author has many series or many volumes, such as the case with comics & manga.

posts.title: Search/filter *for*/to exclude certain content warnings
posts.description: Sometimes I'm in a horror mood and want books with body horror, or character death, etc In addition to the idea to exclude books with certain content warnings, can there be an option to filter for them as well?

posts.title: show covers in currently reading on homepage
posts.description: Show covers in currently reading on homepage.

posts.title: Add display name for user profile
posts.description: It would be great for our feed to display the real name of people rather than r3adalotofbooks or emily879. It makes the community feed more personable and I can be Emily on my profile rather than un1que_us3r_name.

posts.title: Add track progress button on homepage for book that doesn't have any progress updates yet
posts.description: If you have marked a book as 'Currently Reading' but haven't created any updates for it yet, you have to click 'View All' in order to track progress for it. It would be nice to have a 'Track Proress' button on the homepage where the other books have the 'Edit' button. See the first book in the screenshot.

posts.title: Show the edition marked by a user as the default one
posts.description: In the search result, on author pages and on series pages it would be nice to see the edition you have marked as read/to-read by default, instead of seeing the 'You have read another edition of this book' link everywhere. This would be nice for read books even more so than for to-read books, because then you can see your review right away. For example (see picture): When I'm on a series page and want to get a quick overview of how I've liked each book then I often get this view.

posts.title: Recommend Books I Own
posts.description: Currently in the Your Recommendations section, there's an option to only recommend books I don't own, or books not in my TBR, but would it be possible to add an option to only show books I own? I would love to browse the recommendations section knowing I can go pick up any of the books I see recommended based on the StoryGraph algorithm

posts.title: Add mythology as a genre option
posts.description: Mythology doesn't neatly fit into any of the current genres. It isn't really fantasy, historical fiction or magical realism. It is such a popular genre right now so it should be represented

posts.title: Average Pages Stat
posts.description: I would love to be able to see my average number of pages read for a period of time (for me, the one I’d care about most was per day). I currently just click on each point on the streak chart, but it obviously takes a little time to do. Personally, I would find the stat most interesting on the streak page, and have it be an average over the past 28 days, and just be the average of the graphed data. I also think it would be cool to have on the stats page, under/near the “average time to finish” stat. It would be cool to see what my averages were in 2024 vs 2025, and so on.

posts.title: Monthly Calendar Line Colours
posts.description: I think the colours of the lines showing each day you updated progress for a book are generated by the average cover color, resulting in a lot of indistinguishable browns. I'd love if the line colour was just the most dominant colour of the cover so it's easy to tell which book it's for at a glance. If 2 are the same, so be it, that's a less likely scenario though.

posts.title: Filter To Read Pile with Books that are in a series
posts.description: Right now, we can choose to show books not in a series but I would like to see only books that are in a filter

posts.title: Filter for 1st book in series
posts.description: Would be nice to have the ability to filter results by only the 1st volume in a book series (i.e. filter out for sequels).

posts.title: Showing Up-Next on Home Page
posts.description: I'd love to see my up-next on my home page, without having to click on "to-read" to get there. I like being reminded often of what I am trying to read next! It would also be nice if we could change up what lists we see on that front page, and swap out the "recommended" or "popular this week" for the "up next" list.

posts.title: Most Read Day add to wrapup
posts.description: A fun feature for the wrapup could be to show the day on which you read the most (pages + listening)! It's great to look back at the year, but the specific day might likely have a nice memory of relaxation attached to it. It would be fun to include in the wrap-ups for next year 2025/6)

posts.title: Notifications for when we get likes on our statuses
posts.description: I would like notifications for when my friends like a book I'm reading, a review I posted, or a book I DNF'd

posts.title: Time left prediction
posts.description: A feature that when you track your pages/percentages for that day it predicts when you will finish i.e "5 days left" or a date (or option to pick which way its displayed). This can change depending how fast or slow you read.

posts.title: Average Daily pages to catch up
posts.description: Loving the pages and minutes goals for the year but I have one suggestion that I didn't see if someone already made. It would be great to not just see "117 min until your caught up" but average that for the days left in the year. Realistically I'm not going to listen two hours in one day to catch up but if it said "listen to atleast 25 min every week to catch up" that would be motivating and more realistic

posts.title: Average author rating
posts.description: On the stats page, I would love to have a breakdown of authors by average personal rating, similar to the moods and genres.

posts.title: If you like this book then you might like this
posts.description: To recommend similar books can be tough doing it through a computer system, so I thought it would be great if I as a reader had the option to suggest people books that are similar to each other. It could be an extra part on the book page where people recommend books that are similar and maybe they would have a little bubble with a comment of the person that shared the book. For example “I think you would also like this book because it’s a single parent + nanny romance and has the grumpy/shunshine trope as well” English is not my native language so I hope you get what I wanted to describe.

posts.title: Streak counter should update when you update a book's progress without needing a page refresh
posts.description: When you enter in progress for a book on the main homepage, the progress bar and percentage updates but the streak icon and number doesn't. You have to refresh the page which is confusing because the progress bar does update when saving.

posts.title: Shared tags with other users
posts.description: I've got a tag called "audiobook-together-tbr" that are books that are contenders for my partner and I to listen to together. He is also a StoryGraph user and I wish I could share that tag with him so that he could add to it or delete from it or easily view it from within the app. I now know that you can make a tag public and share it, which is definitely useful, but that requires for him to hold context on a URL rather than being able to easily access it in his own tag list.

posts.title: Make 'editions' link bold/easier to see on book page
posts.description: On the new book page, can you make editions easier to see? Right now it gets lost in relation to the rest of the page. Maybe make it bold like it was before?

posts.title: Search tbr pile by keyword
posts.description: It would be great to be able to search books on my tbr pile by keyword (ex, ‘ecology’) or content (ex, ‘enemies to lovers’). I often want to read something on a particular topic and know I have a bunch saved, but if the topic isn’t in the title I won’t be able to find it!

posts.title: Record ‘recommended by’ note against books
posts.description: I get a lot of book recommendations from #BookTube. I would like to record a note with the book so I know who inspired me to haul the book. I like to go back to them and thank them for their recommendation when I get around to reading the book, rather than relying on memory. I’ve taken to using custom tags, but it potentially means creating huge numbers of tags - recommended-by-storygraph, readalong-storygraph - when I want to select a tag and apply a bit of meta-data along with it (tag: recommended; data: storygraph). If I just use a single ‘storygraph’ tag then it loses a bit of meaning (am I doing a readalong with StoryGraph or did they recommend this to me in the first place?). I might even want to link a twitter or YT URL to the book so I know where to reference later on. Acknowledging the source of something is important to me, so I want to add this information somewhere in my book data.

posts.title: Search by tags
posts.description: It could be useful to be able to search for books based on if they have certain tags. Everyone has their own way of tagging books but if I want to find a time travel romance, I’d probably be more likely to find ones if I can use the romance genre and search for books that have a time travel tag.

posts.title: Mark Interest in Reading Challenges
posts.description: Sometimes I find reading challenges that I want to join at some point, but not right now. I don't want to join them because then they'll show up at the top of my reading challenges list, and I'm not planning on getting to them for maybe several months. I want some kind of "interested in" or TBR equivalent for challenges so that I can remember to join them later.

posts.title: Sort by popularity
posts.description: Specifically/especially in the Browse all books page. It would be really nice to filter for what I want to read and then find things my library is actually likely to have

posts.title: Ratings of reviews
posts.description: Would be great to have the ability to thumbs up or down ratings based on how helpful they are. Then being able to sort by the highest ratings (as many people put a tremendous amount of time into their ratings but I still need to scroll to find them)

posts.title: Enable 2FA to increase account security
posts.description: Two factor authentication (2FA) is an important security feature. It would be good to see it enabled for The StoryGraph. Specifically the use of OTP codes and not using SMS.

posts.title: Add Cozy Mystery as a genre
posts.description: Cozy Mysteries are a genre all their own, but they're frequently lumped in with mystery/suspense/thrillers. Please add Cozy Mystery as a genre and as a keyword (for making reading challenges)

posts.title: Owned Books in Recommendations
posts.description: I'd like to be able to filter recommendations to only show books I own. Right now I only see the option to exclude those books. I don't need any more reasons to buy more books! 😆

posts.title: Ability to Like/Heart Comments in Buddy Reads
posts.description: It would be great if there was an option to like/heart comments in buddy reads, similar to hearts in the Community feed. I don't always feel the need to reply to some comments/quotes but want to show that I read it!

posts.title: Additional filters
posts.description: +1 for the recommendation of having the ability to sort by books that *are* in a series, but taking that one step further, it'd be great to filter on series I've started but haven't completed, and have the remaining TBR books in those WIP series easier to surface.

posts.title: Filter out books I've read
posts.description: When browsing, there's an option to filter out books from my **to-read** pile. But what would be even more useful is to filter out books I've **already read** (and that should automatically include ones where I've read another version/edition).

posts.title: Libby Import
posts.description: The Libby app allows users to export activity history in json or csv formats, it would be great to be able to import the history directly into storygraph

posts.title: Make a Bookshelf View
posts.description: Make one of the views (for example, the Reading Challenge Prompt View) a bookshelf.

posts.title: community chat/follow
posts.description: would like to be able to ccontact friends and see who they follow to broaden the people I follow. Right now I don't see a lot of community members.

posts.title: Larger Book Cover View in App
posts.description: In the app, enable clicking a book cover from the book's main page to get a larger view of the cover. Would be helpful for screenshots!

posts.title: Filter to find your untagged books
posts.description: Currently you can use the exclude tags function to filter out specific tags, but sometimes I forget to tag a book when I finish reading it, and it'd be nice to be able to filter my read books to show only books that have no tags on them so I can work through them to add tags. But my tag list is too long to add them all to the excluded list manually... Maybe an 'all tags' option in the drop down for exclusion?

posts.title: Make “pen” icon next to tags more easily tappable
posts.description: On the book page: When I try to edit the tags on a book, I often “miss-tap” an select a certain tag instead, bringing me to the list of all books with that tag instead. Could you make the edit tags symbol bigger and place it in a more easily accessible location with the next UI Update of the book page?

posts.title: Compare mood map in wrap-up to previous years
posts.description: On reddit I just saw a thread where people compared their 2025 mood maps and I saw that some had a second graph to see their mood map compared to that of their friends. I don't use the friend feature so I hadn't seen that yet, but it got me thinking that it would be interesting to see how my graph for 2025 compared to 2024. Of course, I can look at the 2024 wrap-up, but it would be convenient to see it right in the current wrap-up similar to the way it is to the friends mood map. Edit: fixed some typos

posts.title: Suggested reading goals
posts.description: This feels like a big ask, but dreaming big here! It would be neat to see suggested reading goals based on the previous years’ data. For instance on 1/1 when I go to set up my reading goals for the year, it might show something like “you average X books/pages a year and last year you read more books than usual. For a challenging goal, you might aim for X books/pages this year.”

posts.title: Default Pause Date to Last Progress Update Date
posts.description: Want to start by saying I absolutely love the new Pause status feature!! I have a small request/idea to default the Pause date to the last day that you updated the progress for a book. I say this because when I just set a bunch of books to Pause, I went into the journal entry and retroactively set them to the last day I read them.. I don't always know that I am "pausing" a book until days or weeks after I haven't picked it up again, and I would like for it to default to the last time I read it, and not the day I decide to mark it as Paused.

posts.title: Pre-ordered indicator
posts.description: For books that are yet to be released, it would be awesome to have the option to mark them as pre-ordered and have it flip to owned come the release date.

posts.title: More Customization on Custom Charts (Star Rating & Time Segments)
posts.description: Hi! I LOVE Storygraph and I love the new(ish) custom charts feature. That said, I really wish we could make additional customization of the graphs, as most of the graphs I want to make currently are impossible. My "wish list" is below along with my own personal use case examples! I know it's a big list so this is roughly in the order of impact to my use of Custom Charts. I would like to see star rating as additional option for an axis when making tag-based graphs. Specifically, I would like to be able to compare my average star rating across different tags I use. For example, I'd like to see my average star rating across each of my book subscriptions, which I am currently using tags to track. It would be AMAZING if I could automatically compare the average star rating for books tagged "Illumicrate" v. "FairyLoot YA" v. "FairyLoot Adult." It would be so helpful when deciding what subs to keep to easily be able to see, for example, if my average rating for Fairyloot Adult is <3.0 stars and to compare to my other subs. I also think star ratings would be helpful folks that track tropes and other writing elements like POV to easily be able to identify if they tend to rate "Fated Mates" really poorly but tend to rate "Enemies to Lovers" really highly, for example, when deciding what books to add to their TBR and Storygraph preferences! Also, I wish we could have time segments as an option on the X axis. For example, I have a tag for books on my priority TBR, and I'd love to track how many books I read off that list per month. So, ideally, I could select the time period as a full year, and then choose "months" for the X axis and see how many "Priority TBR" books I read per month (similar to the books/pages graph in the standard stats but only for books meeting the tag requirement). Lastly, I would love to be able to have an "exclude" feature for tag segments. Again, using my priority TBR tag as an example, I'd love to use a pie chart to track the percent of books that I read off of my Priority TBR v. other sources. I think this could be accomplished with "exclude" functionality on the tags. So one segment would include "Priority TBR" and the other would exclude "Priority TBR." As you can tell, I am a big data need (which is why I love Storygraph so much!!) so I totally understand that these requests might not have general appeal as it would probably take some tech-savviness to configure charts with this many options. But for my own use, these features would be absolute game changers in getting me to use the custom charts practically vs. just admiring the data. 😃

posts.title: Total Owned TBR Line Chart Over Time
posts.description: I would love to see the progress of my Owned TBR over time (maybe split into months?). For example, if in April I read 8 books, and acquired 6 books, I would see that my total owned TBR number when down by 2 that month. I think this could help motivate me to read more of what I own, and think twice before buying a new book! Additionally, it would be cool to be able to sort the graph by format, as I love to focus on my physical tbr more than ebooks/audiobooks

posts.title: TBR/To-Read Book Has An Active Readalong
posts.description: I would love to see a notification that tells me that a book on my TBR has an active or soon to be active readalong. Perhaps even a link to ask “ do you want to join “insert book name” to join this readalong?”

posts.title: TBR Add Date vs First Read Date chart
posts.description: One of the things I'm loosely trying to tag in my data this year is when I added a book to my TBR vs when I'm actually reading it. There's some guesswork involved here since it isn't visible in the UI. But it made me think that a chart similar to the all-time publication vs year read chart might be cool. Plotting "date added to TBR" against "date of first read" would be a neat way of visualizing how long books stay on your TBR or how much you favor new-to-you books.

posts.title: "Verified" flag for books that match challenge prompts
posts.description: I know that ideally reading challenge owners should go through each prompt page and check regularly whether new additions match the prompt's criteria. But in practice, it can be hard to remember which books you have and haven't checked. I can imagine this is particularly discouraging for people with several ongoing challenges. The current interface does not make this task easier, so here's a suggestion. What if there were a "verified" flag available to challenge owners? Like so: 1) The "verified" flag would automatically apply to owner-added books. 2) Verified books would show up at the top of each prompt's list for all challenge participants — not the most recently-added books, which are in fact more likely to have issues. 3) Challenge owners could filter out all verified books under each prompt to go through the non-verified ones, which can then be either verified or removed.

posts.title: Have an "All Books/My Books" page
posts.description: I was wondering if it would be possible to have a feature where you can swap between your read, currently reading, and to read shelves whilst we're in one, without having to leave and go to a different section of the website just to access each individual shelf. I hope I worded that right.

posts.title: Audiobook Progress by Time Remaining
posts.description: Many audiobook platforms show your progress through an audiobook not by how much time you've listened but by how much time is left in the audiobook. StoryGraph asks for how many hours and minutes you have listened so far. This difference makes it difficult to quickly update audiobook progress in StoryGraph without having to do a bunch of math. Could we have the option to track progress through an audiobook by time remaining?

posts.title: Stats for Challenge Creators
posts.description: It would be great to see some feedback after you create a reading challenge as people join--for example, a graph that shows the number of participants who have completed 0, 25, 50, 75, and 100% of a challenge. It also would be great to see the percentage of participants who completed each particular prompt so we could learn if one is way too difficult, one is popular, etc.

posts.title: Not sharing up next to community
posts.description: I'd love to have a setting where I can turn of sharing of my up next list. I don't always want anyone seeing what and when I put titles in my queue.

posts.title: Adding photos/images to journal entries
posts.description: I wonder if it would be possible to make it so that users can add images to book journal entries? I like to record favourite quotes but sometimes they're quite lengthy so quickly adding a photo of the quote/passage would be ideal! (I also appreciate this would likely be the lowest of priorities (if even possible) and probably not even something most people would even care about but I figured it can't hurt to ask!)

posts.title: Option to Report Reivews
posts.description: I've noticed a few books I'm reading have gotten "review bombed" by people who very clearly haven't read the book. I'm all for making sure authors are treating sensitive subjects with respect, but when the "reviews" are entirely wrong about the contents of the book and are very clearly from people who haven't read it, there's an issue. It would be great to be able to report reviews as spam or even a "review bomb" type option. This might create too much work for the team, but it's something to think about for the future.

posts.title: Immediate Review Section After Marking Book As Read
posts.description: As soon as you mark a book as read, a pop-up or a new page should open so you can immediately give your rating, review, and read dates.

posts.title: Explore more books from authors you've read
posts.description: I would love to be able to see a complete list of unread books from authors that I already know. Often when I read a new author I want to remember to read more by them, but if they have numerous books, I'm unlikely to add all of those to my TBR at once. And then, I can't remember whether the author has books I haven't read or not.

posts.title: Collage visualization for favorite books
posts.description: I’d love to have a feature where I can tag or mark books as a favorite of the month and then generate a collage at the end of the year to show my top picks that I can share on social media. Right now, I screen shot the app on my phone and stitch it together

posts.title: Library integration
posts.description: I love the Firefox extension that lets me see if a book is available at my local library, and would love to see a native feature of this for storygraph. Anywhere we integrate a "buy here" link, could we also include a "borrow here" option?

posts.title: Batch Edit Reviews
posts.description: Would love to be able to adjust star ratings all from one page.

posts.title: Track how long it takes to read a book (hours)
posts.description: it would be nice to be able to add in number of minutes/hours when updating your progress on a book. It could lead to cool stats and help predict how long future books will take to read.

posts.title: Choose books for wrap-up graphics
posts.description: When generating monthly or custom wrap-ups, there are 3 books that are seen with covers (highest rated or 5-star reads). It would be nice to choose which books show up if there are more than 3 that “qualify”. I noticed that in case there would be more than 3 books with the same ratings, the app chooses the books read last. I would love to be able to choose which 3 book covers are seen if I had more than 3 5-star reads for example. Thank you for this amazing app!!🤍

posts.title: Recurring Challenge
posts.description: At the moment a Challenge either has an open date range (and goes forever) or has a fixed date range. Many challenges are really _recurring_ challenges, such as a yearly challenge or a monthly challenge. This suggestion is that the date option allows for turning the challenge into a recurring challenge. The simplest form would be allowing an extra set of radiobuttons next to the date range (which can't be open) to not recur (default, as now), recur monthly or recur annually. The challenge title would then be suffixed. Eg. I create a Christmas Challenge to read 2 books (Number Challenge) and for the date range I might put Dec 15 -> Dec 31, and I select the radio button option of Recur Annually. This creates a Christmas Challenge (2026) for this year. Next year it would auto create a new one called Christmas Challenge (2027).

posts.title: Please add an "are you sure you want to leave" check to app pages that have text boxes
posts.description: There have been several times that I am writing a review or a progress comment in the app and either I accidentally tap a button or scroll too much and refresh the page, losing everything I have written. A simple "do you really want to discard your progress" popup would fix a lot of frustration.

posts.title: times book has been shelved this year/all time
posts.description: I really like the most/least shelved feature in the yearly wrapup, but would love even more if on a book's page you could see how many people have read it this calendar year and since publication. It would be really cool to see what else is more obscure or popular than I think it is!

posts.title: Custom TBR Order
posts.description: I would love to be able to categorize and/or sort my TBR! I know there is an “up next” option but that limits me to only 5 books and sometimes I don’t want my TBR sorting to be on the community feed.

posts.title: Enjoyment rating option
posts.description: We all rate books on a 0-5 star rating scale, but it leaves out how much we enjoyed the book. Sometimes a 2 star book is a 5 star enjoyment read.

posts.title: Exclude Bonus Content from Series Page
posts.description: When looking at a series page, I would like to see only the primary books in the series (0, 1, 2, 3, etc). Currently, there is already a separate page for collections (1-3, etc), and it would be great if we could get a similar page for bonus/novella content (0.5, 3.1, etc). This would make series pages far more useable to me. Thanks!

posts.title: Reading Streak Milestones
posts.description: Since the streak counts up by days, I think it would be cool if we could get a notification or maybe it shows next to the days when hit year milestones. Similar to “you have read every day for 1 year!” Or if it’s next to the fire symbol it could say “365 - 1 year”.

posts.title: Mark review as spoiler-free or not
posts.description: I know spoiler text is an option in reviews, but I have almost never actually seen it be used. I think having a checkbox (or something similar) when you post a review that allows you to mark whether your review contains spoilers or not could be useful. Then if you're looking at reviews of a book you haven't read (e.g. to gauge whether or not you want to read it), you could filter to only see reviews without spoilers.

posts.title: Personalized previews that don't always tell me I'll love every book
posts.description: I find the personalized previews feature to have a lot of potential, but as it is right now, I've stopped reading them, because they tend to all be fairly similar. They seem to think I will always like every book, and recommend I read them. I've tried to explicitly find books that don't sound interesting to me, and it will say "As a fan of X, Y, & Z, you likely be drawn to this..." where those three books seem utterly unrelated. It even does this in books I've read and given a 1.0 because I did not like them at all, and yet the preview tells me all the reasons I will like it. It would be good to have some sort of configurability to how these are generated, or for them to be a bit more critical. I actually really want it to point out when a book likely isn't up my alley, rather than basically telling me why I'd like every book ever written.

posts.title: Label tbr by priority
posts.description: I wish we can label book in our want to read based on priority level. I would love to filter my tbr based on this too

posts.title: Show date range for read books instead of just "date finished"
posts.description: I found that when I'm looking at books I've read it only shows the date I finished a book and not when I started it. When I want to use this information for my library log I have to click the pencil to find out what date I started a book and click cancel which is too many steps. I feel like it would be cool to have a "read from Jan 1 - Jan 3" caption instead of "finished on Jan 3"

posts.title: Custom time Wrap-Up
posts.description: I love the new monthly Wrap-Up feature. It's really nice to periodically see what I've been reading and get some insights. However, usually my 'reading periods' are not related to months. I have a 6 week vacation right now, so I'm reading a lot. I would love to be able to get a Wrap-Up for that periode. So my idea is to add an option to generate Wrap-Ups for custom time frames.

posts.title: Popular This Week In My Country
posts.description: I love the 'popular this week' section, but I'd love if we could see what's trending in our own countries (and others) as well as globally.

posts.title: average year of publication
posts.description: It'd be really cool if it was possible to see on either the yearly wrap-up or stats tab the avg publication year for the books read

posts.title: Export charts as images
posts.description: Right now, when you hover over the charts, only the "Number of books and pages" can be copied as an image. It would be great if any of the charts could be copied or exported as an image (maybe with a download button in the corner to preserve the interactivity of the charts).

posts.title: Streak - display start date
posts.description: It would be nice to see which date the current streak began.

posts.title: Stats for challenges
posts.description: I'm not sure whether this feature request is "stats for challenges" or "a quick way to add a tag to all books in a challenge", but, I would love a way to get stat insights for challenges that I participate in. I manually made this tag (https://app.thestorygraph.com/tags/9d7e824e-e4d8-40b1-8fef-6d6b5a6a44ba) for this challenge (https://app.thestorygraph.com/reading_challenges/8d93938e-bc96-45bf-ab9a-f4bdadcbb59f) and it's been really neat to compare the stats for the books in the challenge with my overall reading, but doing that by hand for the many challenges that I am in would be arduous. I feel like it would be cool not just for challenges like that one, which is a specific list of books, but also for ones with categories like Book Riot or StoryGraph's Genre Challenge.

posts.title: Buddy Read Notification when you haven't read the book in a while
posts.description: Right now, if the buddy/buddies you're reading with have read past you, there's no notifications to remind you of the buddy read. Would be nice to have a setting to be reminded to get back to the book (for those of us that read a lot of books at a time). Even nicer would be to have a certain percentage difference to have it prompt. For example, "your buddy Jane is 10% ahead of you in Pride and Prejudice, better get back to reading!" And the 10% would be able to be customized to any percentage.

posts.title: 're-read' option???
posts.description: I know I can create a tag (but I don't want my list to get too long) - would people like to see an added built in tag: 'to read', 'currently reading', 'RE-READ', 'did not finish', 'remove book'.

posts.title: Plus 1 to "to read" books
posts.description: Often I read a review of a book or hear about it from a friend and go to add it to storygraph as 'to read' only to discover that I've already added it! It would be cool to have a "plus one" marker, and then a way to sort by "to-read" quantity of +1s.

posts.title: Buddy read GIF inclusion
posts.description: Not sure if this is possible but could GIFs be added to the buddy read comments for uncultured swine such as myself who convey must of their feelings through the medium of gif rather than using actual words? Thank you kindly

posts.title: Owned/Not Owned when looking at Tag Stats
posts.description: Could it be possible to have stats for read/unread and owned/not owned when looking at books that you have tagged?

posts.title: Librarian dashboard "User-Added Books" ordered by number of interactions to prioritise correction of most read books
posts.description: I think it could make sense on the Librarian Dashboard to have a filter on the "User-Added Books" list to sort by number of interactions.
