Meaning that the user-added books which have the largest number of reads/reviews/etc would show up first, and therefore we could confirm/correct user-added books which are the most used first, thus having the largest impact on the database and user satisfaction. Given that it's a huge list, I think it could make sense to have some kind of prioritisation of this kind.

posts.title: Show me when I last made progress on books I'm currently reading
posts.description: I'd really like to see when I last made progress on books I'm currently reading. I usually have 3 or 4 books in progress. I don't always read every book every day so it would be nice to see when I last made progress. It would also help me notice when I didn't update my progress for the day. Just a small message under the progress bar that says something like "Last read yesterday" or "Last read 2 days ago" Screenshot attached to better explain what I'm thinking.

posts.title: Jump from pages chart to date in reading journal
posts.description: It would be very handy if we can go to the Pages and minutes read in... and then click on the dot for that day, which brings you to your reading journal and what you tracked that day. Sometimes I have days I read a ton and want to know afterwards what I read. Scrolling through my Reading Journal is not the fastest way Edit by Nadia (July 2nd 2024): Updated title based on merged in post to make this one easier to find.

posts.title: Reviewer similarity to my profile
posts.description: When I read reviews, the intention is usually to judge if I'd have the same experience with the book. It would be nice to see a similarity score next to each reviewer so, I can quickly guage if this reader & my tastes match & how seriously should I take a particular review. Thanks!

posts.title: Narrator as default "expected" field for audiobooks
posts.description: It would be great if all books with format:audio were "expected" to have at least one contributor of the "narrator" type. What I mean by that is: a way for non-librarian users to add a narrator if a book has none, the same way they can add missing page counts, hours, etc. We have a lot of audiobooks missing narrators and this could encourage people to help improve that metadata.

posts.title: Private written reviews
posts.description: The option to check a box that keeps the written portion of your review private. I would love the ability to write reviews for myself, rather than having to write them publicly in an attempt to provide a useful review for others.

posts.title: Easily Distinguish Anthologies
posts.description: It would be great if there was some way to make anthologies more distinct from "traditional" books. Maybe it could be one of the general descriptor tags listed at the top of the book listing, like "fiction." Maybe on the author profile page or search results anthologies could be a separate section. Just different tactics like this to help differentiate between say the author's novels and short story collections vs contributions to anthologies.

posts.title: Edit own comments in buddy reads
posts.description: I'd love to be able to edit my comments in buddy reads. Sometimes I realize I had a spelling error or something and would like to be able to correct it. :)

posts.title: Book Word Count
posts.description: Historically, pages has been the way to measure the length of book but varying editions with their page size, font size, font choice, et cetera makes this measurement more vague than precise. Having an additional mention of a book’s word count will help people keep truer to their TBR commitments and pledges to buddy reads.

posts.title: Ability to hide "you're behind by..." for yearly challenges
posts.description: Last year I accidentally set my book and page challenges comically low, underestimating just how much I would read in 2021. By the time I migrated from GR to The StoryGraph, I had already met both goals (lol). This is the first year that I'm starting the year on TSG, and I'm finding the "Nothing to worry about but..you are behind by 89 pages." messaging a little bit stressful! I finished the year by trying to read as much as possible to see just how high my counts could be, and I'm trying to relax this year, so seeing those nudges is making me feel like I need to rush or hurry or treat reading like a chore just to meet a goal. I would love the ability to hide those messages on the Challenges page (which I visit constantly, since I'm use those to set up queues for my TBR), and perhaps reveal them with a click or a hover so that I don't feel edgy about being behind my goal four days in to the year.

posts.title: Own voices author?
posts.description: Is it currently possible to tell whether authors of books are own voices? Thanks!

posts.title: Comics and Manga as genres
posts.description: I don't think comics and manga should be consided genres, after all, they can be about anything - even non-fiction. They are their own medium, but I'm not sure how best to handle this without (I assume) a lot of re-coding. Ideally, I'd want them separate from regular books somehow.

posts.title: Ability to Filter Community Feed
posts.description: I searched through other posts and didn't see this specifically, so I thought I would add it! I would love the ability to choose what I see when I go to community feed (regardless of whether I am looking at entire community, people I follow, similar readers, etc). So I could say "show me books added to TBR and books reviewed or Books reviewed with text review". That would clean up the feed and make it easier to navigate through.

posts.title: ARC Tickbox
posts.description: Probably a little niche for now, but it could be real handy to have a box which makes it clear if someone's reviewing a free copy of the book for full transparency :)

posts.title: recommendations by tag
posts.description: it would be nice if the recommendations can be generated only for the contents of a specific tag

posts.title: Easier Tag Navigation
posts.description: Be able to select a few tags and/or have a few of your biggest tags show up on the homepage, so you can easily jump to the ones you use the most.

posts.title: Book Club Reading Challenge designation
posts.description: I've created a small book club with a friend this year and we've both picked books to read together using a custom reading challenge. I wish I could see which prompts she's finished, too. I get that you wouldn't want most reading challenges to be so public, but it would be nice if there was a "book club" option in the reading challenges so you could see which prompts others have completed as well as your own.

posts.title: Reorganize order of joined challenges
posts.description: it would be great to be able to reorder the tiles on the reading challenges joined landing page so

posts.title: Days Read (if you don't use the streak feature)
posts.description: I would like to be able to see how many days out of the month, year, or custom date range I have read. I could go back and manually count for every month on the chart in stats, but it would be nice if it could calculate that for you. My streak has reset this year, but at the end of the year, I would like to be able to say that I read 312 out of 365 days or something like that.

posts.title: TBR List in Challenges?
posts.description: I tend to do reading challenges that the goal is to pick books from your TBR for the prompt. It would be great if there’s an option to see your TBR right from the challenge page instead of having to flip between the challenge page and my profile page. I know we can add books from our TBR to a challenge but I’d like to stay on the challenge page so I can look at other books people have added.

posts.title: Easier tag selection when building charts
posts.description: I'd love a way to select each of the tags I want to include in a chart by selecting them all from the drop down list in one go (like you can when adding them to a book), instead of having to add a new segment then select the tag for each one, sometimes I end up selecting the same tag multiple times. Even just having the options already added to the chart greyed out so you know you've already added them would be helpful!!

posts.title: DNFing a Paused book should default to last updated date for DNF date
posts.description: I was trying to clean up my Paused books and marked one of them as DNF because I realized it's been Paused for months and I'm never going to pick it back up. It set today as the DNF date, which I guess maybe makes sense since today is the day I made the decision, but I expected it to set the DNF date to the date I paused it. More oddly though, it added a Resumed entry and a DNF entry into the journal log, which didn't seem right. Not entirely sure what all the right behavior should be here but it seemed strange so I just wanted to log it.

posts.title: Private and friends-only reviews
posts.description: Being able to set granular private/friends-only/public visibility permissions on ratings and reviews would be amazing. I don't want to have my reviews publicly available, but I would like for my friends to be able to see them instead of hiding them away in private notes.

posts.title: Show 1000+ streak on profile
posts.description: Hello! I recently hit 1000 days on my StoryGraph streak and I'm pretty proud of it, but I noticed that on my profile, it shows as "1k" instead of displaying the number. This bums me out a little because it's now going to be another 980+ days before it looks any different. I know there has to be some kind of truncating limit on a number like that, but I'm wondering if maybe the font could just get a little smaller for four digit numbers so that the limit could be TEN thousand instead of one? I feel like if I manage to track my reading for another 25 years in StoryGraph, I'll be okay with it showing "10k" 😂

posts.title: Mark re-reads on wrap ups
posts.description: Would love if the cover/ratings collages on the wrap ups had some sort of indicator on a book if it was a re-read.

posts.title: Ability to filter books by specific page number range
posts.description: I would love to find books that are between a certain number of pages (perhaps I can set a specific range).

posts.title: Line chart for Average time to finish
posts.description: I would like to see a chart that would show the average time to finish for each month in a selected year, similar to the number of pages and books read in the yearly stats. And maybe have similar chart for years as well. So, when you switch to All time stats, the chart would show years instead of months and the average time to finish per year.

posts.title: Author ID when clicking on author
posts.description: Adding the author ID would be helpful maybe on the author page when selecting them on a book. When adding a new book, it is not clear which author to select so I wish we could distinguish properly, the ID we CAN see doesn't help distinguish between another

posts.title: Custom Charts on Wrap Up
posts.description: Could we have an option to put our custom charts into the monthly wrap up graphics? For example I know everything I read in a month is fiction so the fiction/nonfiction chart isn't useful. It would be great to replace that chart with a custom chart.

posts.title: "Your Friend owns an edition of this book"
posts.description: To encourage sharing books with your friends, it would be cool to see a notice on a book's landing page that alerts Users if a Friend owns an edition of that book. This would look similar to the "You're currently reading another edition" alert. Furthermore, if Users click/tap on that notice, it would take them to a "Request to Borrow" page. This would of course work best with email or push notifications.

posts.title: Don't Recommend Books Already on TBR
posts.description: I would love a way to have the recommendations not show me books that I already have on my TBR list. I've seen a lot of the books recommended over and over again and I've already added them to my list.

posts.title: Ability to Thumbs Down (and Thumbs Up) Authors
posts.description: See (very rough) mockups attached. There are authors who I don't like, but there's no easy way to see when I find a book that I read some of her books 10 years ago and didn't like them. A simple 👍/👎 for every author would be awesome. I see many other people voted for "favorite authors"... but adding a "don't like" would also be super helpful. You can also make this easier by providing stats about author on title detail pages (see other mockup). Ultimately, if we had the thumbs up/thumbs down it would be great if search lowered the weight of authors that you give a thumbs down to.

posts.title: Show What Books Inspired What Suggestion
posts.description: The suggestions are awesome. Sometimes I wish I could see what books directly inspired some suggestions like "Need more of what you just read?" And either in suggestions or after you finish a suggestion a chance to say whether or not this matched the suggestion category.

posts.title: Group tags in custom chart segments
posts.description: This might be similar feature to this: [https://roadmap.thestorygraph.com/de/requests-ideas/posts/tag-groups](https://roadmap.thestorygraph.com/de/requests-ideas/posts/tag-groups) I feel I've seen this request before, but I couldn't find it. I would like to group several tags into one data point in my custom chart, e.g. having only one bar in my bar chart representing the tags "1860", "1870", "1880" and "1890" as "1800s". The book count should be summed up, but books with several of those tags should only be counted once.

posts.title: Be able to link books to other books when necessary
posts.description: Have a way to link or mark that a book is part of another book. For example, lot of authors include Novella’s either at the end, or in the beginning of the audiobook for the previous or next book. In order to save time and resources. It would be so much easier users could search through the StoryGraph database, and say that this Novella or short story is included in another book in the database. Basically have a way of showing the name of the novella and then have a link like a series to the book that it is included in. This would be especially helpful since these types of Nove valleys do not have any ISBN number or ASINnumber. If you are able to link books together, then users could easily find, and use the identification number to find where the Novella or short story could be found Essentially users have way to indicate a book or audiobook is included/apart another book and easily link them to identify and find the books easier in the storyGraph database? Here’s these example of about Nevada that is included in The audiobook for the next book in the series: https://app.thestorygraph.com/books/e0ff3566-832b-4690-bb1d-59b529d68db1

posts.title: Tell me if any of my friends are reading a book
posts.description: On the book page the "People you follow" box shows me reviews from friends and those with it on their TBR, but most useful to me would be those who are currently reading. I'd like the "People you follow" section to include people who are currently reading the book.

posts.title: Option to include DNF in star rating chart with finished books
posts.description: I'm currently using the DNF functionality for two purposes; firstly, for marking a book I disliked enough to not want to finish, and secondly to mark a book I was unable to finish for some reason and want to reshelve and revisit later (I already upvoted the Pause status request 🧡). In the case of the former, I would like to be able to mark the books both as DNF'd and give a star rating. I feel my spread of ratings skews higher than it ought to because it isn't counting books I disliked and would've rated 1 star had I actually made it to the end.

posts.title: Tropes Graph
posts.description: Adding to the graphs, it would be a nice to see the specific tropes broke down.

posts.title: Add "Read" list to homepage
posts.description: Instead of just "currently reading", have "recently read" on the homepage as well.

posts.title: Additional TBR list
posts.description: I'd would love to be able to sort my TBR into personalised lists or some other similar way. So like a list for TikTok Recommended or Holiday List

posts.title: Allow DNFs to count for reading challenges
posts.description: It'd be great to have a way of seeing books you've DNFd on your reading challenge stats, especially for prize list challenges where I've tried all the books but didn't enjoy them all to finish.

posts.title: publication year vs read date: clickability
posts.description: This is so minor but I would love to be able to click the points on the scatter plot and see what the book is and maybe even like zoom into the scatter plot itself? My dates range from -720 to 2160 so the view is very zoomed out and the last century is very compact/difficult to distinguish anything. :)

posts.title: Share Owned Books with friends
posts.description: Hi! I am a big believer in sharing books, so it would be cool if we could share our Owned Books on the Storygraph. That way our friends could see we have them and ask to loan them. It could even go so far as seeing that a book is in a friend's library on the book page :) Finally, as someone pointed out I think, it would be a way to see what books are still "missing" from someone's library to be able to gift them :) Of course, as everything on the Storygraph (love you for that), this would be a opt-in feature. Thanks for considering!

posts.title: Adding a book to a reading challenge adds it to your to-read pile
posts.description: I want all books I add to my challenges to be added to my to-read pile.

posts.title: Reader Match Rating
posts.description: When looking at a book page on the app, I’d like to see some kind of indication of how similar the book is to other things I’ve liked (or disliked) before. It could be done with images/icons to show whether the book is a safe pick, worth trying out, or probably something the reader should pass on. Or it could be done with words, numeric coding, whatever. I look up books and try to read through reviews and tags, and that’s great. But if there was an easy at-a-glance indicator of how probable it is that I’ll like the book, it would save time on reading all the other information for books that are just not likely to land well for me.

posts.title: A genre covering mythology and fairy tales
posts.description: I have had difficulty assigning a proper genre for collection of norse Myths or collection of fairy tales… fantasy doesnt seem like the right fit Would be possible to get a genre that fits stuff like Greek myth and fairy tales… or maybe there need to be two. One for myths and one for fairytales… could maybe combine it as folklore?!

posts.title: Suggested books to read Before or After a certain book
posts.description: Sometimes, certain books could be better appreciated had the reader read a few other works before them. It'd be nice if we as users could suggest books to read before (and even after) a certain book. The top 5 or 10 suggestion could maybe show up on the book page somewhere? Just another idea I had the other day. :))

posts.title: Reading Notes Shown on Review Composition Page
posts.description: Could we please have it so that our notes taken while reading a book show up on the review composition page for it? I like to use my notes to inform my review, and it would be much easier to do so if they appeared automatically (of if there were a link one could click like "Show my Notes" that would then load them) instead of having to open two instances of The StoryGraph and keep switching back and forth between my reading journal notes and the review I'm crafting. Thank you for your consideration!

posts.title: quicker way to reading journal
posts.description: i'd love if we could access our reading journal from the drop down menu at the top instead of having to click on our profile and then reading journal

posts.title: Export for Reading Journal
posts.description: I would love the ability to export a book's reading journal page. Printing to PDF technically works, but it doesn't look nearly as pretty as the page itself.

posts.title: Specify list of dislikes as well as likes (Reading Preferences)
posts.description: In the reading preferences for recommendations, it would be useful to be able to list what tropes/book elements I'm not interested in reading. For example, while I like historical fiction I'm not into war-time settings. Or, someone might not want to read books focused on family relationships, or have a romance trope they dislike.

posts.title: Suggestions from Tags
posts.description: Hi! I would love if there was a way that I could get suggestions from a tagged list. I keep a list of my owned Kindle books and I would love to narrow down suggestions to that format when I'm choosing from there. Sorry if this is already a feature!

posts.title: Filter out challenge books that don't actually meet the prompt
posts.description: I had a hard time when I was choosing books for both the Genre Challenge and the Translation Challenge because many books that other people had added to prompts did not actually fit those prompts at all. For the Translation Challenge this was particularly egregious; many of the books in "A book written by a Black woman in translation" were in fact written in English. This feature request is explicitly not meant to punish people who incorrectly associate a book (although I suppose you could make it function that way if you want haha 😈) but is more to keep the lists clean for other users of the challenge to make it easier for people to find books within the intended categories. I am not entirely sure who should be the keeper of going through these flags; perhaps the owner of the challenge? But it was something I thought of today while starting to read Indigenous People's History of the United States and saw that folks had added it to "A memoir or autobiography by an Indigenous author" in the Genre Challenge, which it very distinctly is not.

posts.title: Upcoming books in challenges
posts.description: I'm not sure if this has already been suggested but I would love to see a few suggestions or "upcoming" books that I've put into active challenges that I haven't read/finished yet on the homepage/profile pages. This would make it easier for me to remember which books to get to in order to complete a challenge or prompt!

posts.title: Add to Reading Journal After Finished with Book
posts.description: I went back to try to add some quotes to a book after I'd already marked the book as "read" and was not able to. Without a specific "quotes" section, this would be nice to be able to do.

posts.title: re-participate in a challenge
posts.description: Especially with challenges without start/end dates I would love to be able to do that challenge again without deleting the books I read previously. So maybe a "participate again" button after a challenge is marked as finished would be nice.

posts.title: Change segment splits in page number pie chart
posts.description: for the page number graph, would it be possible to split <300 into <100 and 100-299? This would help differentiate between shorter books and short stories. Like, if I read Tell Tale Heart, I would like that to fall in the under 100 section so it doesn’t look like I read more substantial books.

posts.title: DNF eplanations in reviews
posts.description: Would it be possible for DNF explanations to be included in the reviews of books? I'm currently wading through a book that is so astonshingly bad, I'm only finishing it as a selfless public service so that I can give it a 0.25 rating and detailed review to balance the only review it currently has, a 5-star "AWESOME". If DNF explanations were visible, they could add more balanced persective to books for prospective readers, perhaps?

posts.title: Progress status for Reading Challenges
posts.description: It would be really neat if there was a progress bar for the reading challenges that have a time frame set to them. So you get those nice "you're a book ahead!" or "don't panic, but you're two books behind" messages.

posts.title: Lists AKA Playlists but for books
posts.description: Allow useres to create custom lists (i.e. "science fiction by women of color") that they can share publicly and/or privately (both across social media platforms and internally). The idea is taking from Podchaser's ability for users to create playlists of podcasts with explanatory notes about why they includes each item in the list. (Ex. https://www.podchaser.com/lists/audio-drama-podcasts-with-lgbtq-main-characters-107ZztL9Zk)

posts.title: google chrome extension
posts.description: An extension that takes the ISBN from waterstones, amazon, goodreads, barnes and noble, etc., to make adding books to your storygraph easier.

posts.title: Pages Read Per Month even when a Book isn't finished
posts.description: I know you've added the yearly pages goal but I wanted to suggest a pages read per month graph. And to fill in some other stats during a month. Ideally, as you read and update your progress (% or Page#) it audio updates the pages you've read. For example, this past month (February) I've been reading three books, but I got hit by a bunch of work. So I didn't finish any of them. I'll finish this March, but now my graphs for book achievement flatlines. So although I've read almost a thousand pages, I see a flat line and subconsciously am discouraged. I use your tool to find books and inspire me to read and it'd be great if I could glance at the pages, moods, etc. of what I'm reading, especially when I flatline for a month because of work ;-)

posts.title: Expanded custom tags stats
posts.description: It's cool to be able to compared two custom tags, but I'd like to be able to compare multiple and filter by year, shelf or other criteria. As an example case, I like to try and keep track of where the authors are from for each book I read and see what country produced the most books I read at the end of the year. The current custom tags make it a bit tedious to see this tag info, and have no way of filtering it by when I read a given book, for example.

posts.title: Sync Audiobook Progress with Libro.fm
posts.description: Manually updating my progress in audiobooks is quickly becoming a pain point. This is particularly noticeable during a buddy read, when comments don’t unlock until book progress is updated, despite leaving comments that indicate how far I’ve read.

posts.title: Recommend books based on what taste-matched readers loved, not just mood/genre
posts.description: The current recommendation engine is based on mood, pace, and genre preferences, which is a great starting point. But those categories are really broad. I've read 45 books tagged "fae" and rated them everywhere from 1.75 to 4.75. Telling me I like fae books doesn't help me find my next great read — the tag doesn't predict quality for me. What actually predicts whether I'll love a book is whether readers who rate the same books I do also loved it. That's collaborative filtering, and StoryGraph already has the building blocks: - You already have Similar Users matching - You already have everyone's ratings data - You already know which books users have in common **What I'd love to see:** Take the users who are my strongest taste matches (based on actual rating alignment on shared books, not mood/genre profiles) and surface the books they rated 4+ stars that I haven't read yet. Something like: > "3 readers with 80%+ taste match rated this book 4.5 or higher" Or even just a recommendation category called **"Loved by readers like you"** that pulls from taste-matched users' top-rated books. This would be a massive leap in recommendation quality because it doesn't rely on broad categories that don't predict individual taste. It relies on the most reliable signal there is: people who agree with me about specific books tend to agree about other books too. Tags, genres, and moods describe what a book is. Taste-matched readers tell you whether a book is *good for you specifically*. That's the difference.

posts.title: Keep "DNF" status after switching book to "To Read"
posts.description: Hi! I frequently find myself in a situation where I start reading an audiobook, I find the audiobook's narrator to have an extremely painful voice (thanks, ASD), I DNF the book, I leave a "see explanation" review explaining why I DNF'd the book, I plan to try again re-reading the book as an ebook or physical book instead, and then I mark the book back as "To Read". When I do this, the DNF "see explanation" review I left gets replaced by a standard-style review, prompting me to leave a star rating and more. Also, the book then gets removed from my DNF shelf on my profile. Is there a way you can improve how this is managed? I wish books could exist both on my DNF shelf and on my To Read shelf in cases like these, because I want to remember that I DNF'd them, while still planning on reading them in a different format next time. Thanks in advance!

posts.title: stat: average time to finish on book's page?
posts.description: Some books take forever to finish, some you breeze through. Maybe it would be interesting to see the average length of time it took people to finish a book (in days) as a piece of info on the book's page? Could be a gateway stat for a summary stat showing which ones were super slow going for you compared to the average as well?

posts.title: End of year stat idea: most above/below average rating
posts.description: It might be a nice end of year stat that Storygraph could generate: - The book you rated the most above the average - The book you rated the most below the average eg, a book that's averaging 2.8 stars and you gave it a 4.5. A book that was 4.1 stars that you gave 1.5 stars. Don't know if you need to tweak that one though because books with only one or two ratings might swing wildly and be less interesting than even books with just 50 ratings, or enough to even out a bit.

posts.title: Bookclub suggestions
posts.description: I'd love to see an option for bookclub members to add recommendations to a list within the bookclub feature. Ideally, it would also allow us to nominate one for the monthly read or to randomly select one that hasn't been read yet.

posts.title: Days to read estimate in personalised summary
posts.description: I would really like to see estimates for how long it may take me to read something based on previously read books in my personalised summary for books. E.g. This lighhearted romance is 300 pages, similar to others you have read in the past. If you maintain the same reading pace, you may be able to finish this book in 4 days.

posts.title: AI Opt-Out
posts.description: Is it possible to include a toggle to opt out of the AI features? Thanks.

posts.title: "Try again" feature for DNF Books
posts.description: Sometimes I'll try to read a book, throw it on pause (love that feature) and come back a month later to clear out my paused book and some time after THAT decide.... I should finish that book. I'd love a feature to resurect or, try again with a DNF book, where it starts tracker where you left off, rather than beginning the tracker at 0, and adding all the pages between to your read count. The other issue I have with the current system is that it counts a DNF'd book as completed. If you go back and finish the book it counts THAT as completed as well, so you have 2 completions for the same book. There could be an option when you finish the book for Why you DNF'd and Why you returned.

posts.title: Showing challenges on user profiles
posts.description: I noticed with the recent profile redesign updates that have started rolling out that only annual reading goals are shown on a user's profile page. All other public challenges a user has joined or hosted are no longer visible on their profile. I looked at the [mobile](https://www.figma.com/proto/bxUVtA0mz5RlBuRZfGg1Rr/Community-Design-Sneak-Peeks-?page-id=0%3A1&node-id=2-192&viewport=273%2C101%2C0.42&t=3gT3A15Pnupu22Kg-8&scaling=min-zoom&content-scaling=fixed&starting-point-node-id=2%3A192&hide-ui=1) and [desktop](https://www.figma.com/proto/bxUVtA0mz5RlBuRZfGg1Rr/Community-Design-Sneak-Peeks-?page-id=0%3A1&node-id=2-414&viewport=273%2C101%2C0.42&t=3gT3A15Pnupu22Kg-8&scaling=min-zoom&content-scaling=fixed&starting-point-node-id=2%3A414&hide-ui=1) profile design sneak peeks and it appears this is a permanent change. If so, I will miss being able to see a user's joined or hosted challenges. I've found lots of interesting challenges on users' profiles that I wouldn't have thought to search for in the challenge directory. I also found it motivating that my challenges and progress were visible to others. Are there any plans to eventually incorporate challenges back into profile pages? Like a link to view more challenges under the reading goals section? Or giving the user the option to choose what challenges are visible on their profile?

posts.title: Make "Reading Lists"
posts.description: Ablity to make a specific "to-reads" list (like if tracking books by one author, or books for a class, etc.) or tag books into a group to make a sub-group. (EX: I could tag 10 out of my 1200 TBR books into a mini-list.)

posts.title: Html colour codes on custom graphs
posts.description: HEX/HTML colour codes on custom graphs so that it is easier to get the shades you're looking for and set nicer colour palettes

posts.title: Place for Paused Books on Profile Page
posts.description: When I don’t have any books marked as currently reading like this, would love for the Current Reads section on my profile page to show that I have books marked as paused with a link to access them like it does on the Home page! When I do have books marked as currently reading, both places have the View All button that takes me to current and paused reads so it’s only when I don’t have current reads that I don’t have a place to access paused reads from my profile page. (Soooo excited to finally have the Paused feature 😍)

posts.title: Filter to-read, Reading Challenge books by challenge end date
posts.description: I *love* the ability to filter my to-read recommendations to select the books I've added to Reading Challenges. An additional option I'd love is to filter to-read recommendations for books that are in time-bound Reading Challenges (e.g. this year, as opposed to completing whenever). That would let me prioritize my reading by not missing completing reading challenges I'm already underway on.

posts.title: TBR Randomizer
posts.description: It would be amazing if there was a feature where Storygraph chooses a book from your TBR for you to read next. Like a wheel spin of all the books on you have put on your to be read lists.

posts.title: Allow profiles to be public but not findable via email
posts.description: Hi! I like the idea of keeping my profile visible and public, yet anonymous. I noticed that by making my profile public, people can find my account by entering my email, but I'd prefer there be an option when my profile is public, but not findable via my email address. I like interacting with people on here, but I'd prefer to do that anonymously, Reddit-style. Thank you!

posts.title: Mood/Pace/Page Number etc Year over Year stats
posts.description: I would love to be able to see the change in some of my stats year over year. I can compare two years which is great but like the books/page/minutes line graph when you select all time I want to see the ups and downs of like which years I got more into a certain mood or more books over 500 pages or more fiction or non-fiction over a longer period of time. I really enjoy seeing how my reading changes over a few years.

posts.title: Turn off Didn't Win Giveaway notification
posts.description: I would love a way to turn off the "You didn't win the giveaway" notifications. I get excited when I see I have a notification but then it's just those and I don't need them.

posts.title: StoryGraph Preview powered by AI
posts.description: Didn’t know where to put this! I am not necessarily a fan of AI implementation when it comes to book descriptions cause it can start easily infringing on copyrighted material. But setting that aside, the Storygraph Preview you see online is partially broken but I think also going to turn people off of the app. (See link). https://bsky.app/profile/shaneblackheart.com/post/3kt4lqzqfiq23 Creatives by and large don’t like AI in this generative way and I am not sure that it really adds to the StoryGraph experience, because it clouds out what people do want to see which are actual reviews and and the actual book description.

posts.title: Be able to default "Only show reviews with written explanations" to On
posts.description: At the moment I do that extra click to "only see written reviews" every time I browse reviews. It would be great if I could have it ticked On by default -- as then I'd only need to toggle it off if there weren't any written reviews (so I could at least see ratings instead.) Maybe a new profile setting?

posts.title: Option for "all colors the same" in custom charts
posts.description: When the custom charts were first launched, all of the segments had the same color. I really liked the very quick change to make each segment have a unique color, because the first few charts I made were pies... but as I'm adding more charts, there are some where I *do* actually want them all to have the same color. These tend to be bar charts that have LOTS of tags associated with them, which is exactly why I don't want to have unique colors for each one. If there could be a toggle at the top similar to the "display by frequency vs alpha-numeric" that could be "uniform color vs unique colors" where I could pick the color once, that would be so awesome!!

posts.title: Show which books you completed for a challenge
posts.description: It would be great if there was a way to show which book you completed for a reading challenge prompt. Perhaps if the cover was outlined in yellow like the "prompt complete."

posts.title: TBR Stats/Charts on how it changes over time
posts.description: Someone suggested this in IG DMs and I think it's a great idea: "Is there a way of seeing my TBR over time? Like how many books have been on it at certain times? One of my goals is to reduce my TBR this year, so thought it would be cool to see." Maybe just a line chart that gets a data point on the first of each month? Might be a fun Jan 1st 2025 release?

posts.title: Sticky Tags
posts.description: A Goodreads feature that I would like to see on StoryGraph is the ability to make tags "sticky"; that is, when choosing your tags for a book, those that you label as sticky will be first on the drop-down list. Currently, tags are default alpha sorted and there is no way to change that.

posts.title: Add a forum to reading challenges
posts.description: Someone suggested this in their Google Play Store review and...I kinda love it! I've always wanted to add ways for at leasts hosts to be able to communicate with challenge participants (though I think we'll still have a way for hosts to send out a broadcast), and this is a great way to make the challenge itself feel alive!

posts.title: Reusable yearly challenges
posts.description: I created a yearly challenge for 2023. If I, or anybody else, want to repeat it in 2024, 25 etc., we would have to create a copy of that challenge. This means manually copying everything, and we would loose the books already added. Instead, I would like to add another timeframe to an existing challenge, that matches the original timeframe. That way I could do a yearly challenge several times, others could do it in a year that suits them and we could still see all the books that have been added in previous years.

posts.title: One-click Author Reading Challenge
posts.description: There are some authors on my "I'll read anything you'll ever write" list, and I'd love a way to create a reading challenge (or any way to track progress on reading through an author's entire collection). Bonus points if it auto adds new releases.

posts.title: More Notifications
posts.description: We have a nice notification system, but it seems to mainly (only?) be used for giveaway results so far. I think it would be cool to get notifications about a reading challenge you've joined ending soon/being halfway over or a reminder to update your streak if you haven't by 9:00 pm or something like that. Of course, with more notifications probably also comes more needs for notification settings so people can turn them off.

posts.title: Ability to "pin" books for personalized book recommendations
posts.description: So this is similar to the plus feature, "Browse Personalized Similar books". I really like this feature and if I'm ever really enjoying a book, I always use it to maybe find some similar books I'd enjoy. However, rather than looking the book up and then clicking on this option I'd just like to be able to "pin" up to say 3 books to the main recommendation page. Then Storygraph can look at those 3 books and find any common themes or tropes and make recommendations or just create a list. Even allowing us to just pin one book would be an improvement and I think this might help bring more attention to one of the best plus features at the moment. I know you can add tropes and stuff to the recommendation survey, but I never really know what to put there. So it would be nice for Storygraph to just find that information for based on books I've enjoyed and would like to read books similar to it.

posts.title: Highlight specified content warnings in "see all " view
posts.description: Have selected content warnings highlighted or bolded so we can easily see where they fall in severity and frequency when "see all" is chosen.

posts.title: See friends' public tags while browsing their books
posts.description: When browsing a friend's read books, 5 star-books, tbr etc., I'd love to see the public tags they've used for those books. Maybe a friend read an interesting book on "duck grooming in 18th century Europe", and I want more recommendations on that topic from that person. If they used a tag, it would be easy for me to see the other books they've read or want to read. Or maybe a friend has created a tag for books they want to buy and I can surprise them with one of those as a gift.

posts.title: Multiple personalized reading goals
posts.description: In addition to my 'Read x number of books this year' goal I'd like to be able to set up more specific annual reading goals by tag, genre, etc. For instance, I want to read 30 nonfiction books this year. The only way I could figure out to track this was as a reading challenge, which was so painful to set up. I guess another way to solve this would be to allow bulk creation of prompts in a reading challenge.

posts.title: Reading Goal for New Reads only
posts.description: I would like to be able to set a reading goal that only counts books I haven't read before, so I can work on trying new things (and cutting down the enormous TBR pile!) instead of re-reading old favourites again. Either as a separate goal, or by being able to filter which books count toward the goal.

posts.title: Year-over-year monthly stats!
posts.description: I'm beginning the third full year that I'm tracking reading stats daily on The StoryGraph 🎉 and at the end of January, when I went to do my January wrap-up, I wanted to make some statements about Januarys in general. It's usually a really great month for reading for me, with that New Year energy, and I wanted to see what might be similar or different across all three of the Januarys that I have daily data for. But I could only compare 2023 with 2022, and 2023 with 2021. It would be really cool to have a way of looking at ALL Januarys (or any month in particular). Just a couple of ideas:

posts.title: Option to hide "buy" button
posts.description: Give users the option to hide the buy this book/buy button. This would declutter the UI especially for users who have to rely on other retailers for various reasons.

posts.title: Allow multiple hosts for a reading challenge
posts.description: This could be helpful with maintaining long challenge lists or lists for book clubs, etc.

posts.title: View Tags as List/Edit
posts.description: It would be great to be see all my tags in a list in a location I could easily edit the names and combine them. B/c tags are an organic system I've made some different tags that I'd like to combine or just reorganize, e.g. so some of my tags for who recommened a book are name first, and then I thought it would be better to start each with "rec-name" and some have 2 tags with the same info! or i tag locations the book is placed in but now I want to bulk them together "location-texas" "location-italy" so I can see the breadth of places books I read are placed.

posts.title: Keep track of book source
posts.description: I like to keep track of if I own/buy a book, or if I get it from the library. It would be neat to be able to compare bought books vs library books, like what genres I read or page numbers.

posts.title: Sub-Catergories for Genres
posts.description: Being able to add sub-genre tags to books would make searching for books and recommendations much easier. For example; fantasy and sci-fi are quite broad terms and most people will have a preference over which of those sub-genres they like to read. Maybe base it off the percentage of users that select that sub-genre tag.

posts.title: Ability to click on genre tags on book pane
posts.description: I wish we could click on the green tags and search all the books within that tag for new books to read. I tried searching my recommended titles with the two genres I was looking for but couldn't find anything even though I know there are books in the database that fit the criteria.

posts.title: Private Tags/Shelves that nobody can see but me
posts.description: I have some books/genres that I like to read, but I don't want others judging me because of them when they see my profile. It would be amazing to be able to set some Tags/Shelves as "Private", in a way that books included in them don't ever show (to others, of course; I still would like to see them myself) on my "Read Recently"/"To be Read" piles, and also don't show on the stats/Ratings pages. I'm sure it'd be a better option than to have to have separate accounts for those books we want to read just for ourselves. It'd save a lot of pain :)) Thanks

posts.title: Filter Read books out of Popular This Week
posts.description: The Popular This Week sectiom has the option to remove books on your TBR already from the list, but it still shows books that you have already read. It would be good to have either a filter for this so you can take read books from the results, or for them to count under a tbr and read filter?

posts.title: Summary statistics by author
posts.description: It would be nice to be able to search for a specific author and view their book statistics as well as those provided during reviews so as to give a reader a summary an overview of the author's style and how readers see their stories (e.g. primarily fast paced, strong character development, etc ). The stats section available for each user could largely be replicated but to show for a specific author.

posts.title: filter reading journal
posts.description: I'd really like to be able to filter my reading journal, particularly for a time period, so that I can then go back and look at the commonalities in the notes I was making.

posts.title: Review breakdown
posts.description: I'd love to be able to see a breakdown of how many reviews for a book have each of the star ratings please. Knowing what the average rating of a book is can only go so far to tell you what people think of it, whereas being able to see at a glance how many of a books reviewers gave it 5*s, 4*s and so on would make a massive difference I think!

posts.title: Add "visible" comments to buddy reads
posts.description: I'm reading a book with friends right now using Buddy Reads. The percentage of my friend's edition is pretty significantly different than mine, so when she left a comment at 40% and I was at 44%, I thought it was safe to unlock. Fortunately nothing she said was really a spoiler, but she was at the beginning of chapter 7 when I still hadn't finished chapter 6. Would you consider adding two fields to buddy reads comments, one that would be visible where someone could put something like "beginning of chapter 7" and then the locked section? In another buddy read, I started doing things like putting "END OF CHAPTER FIVE" in capital letters at the top of my comment in case my friend unlocked it and didn't want spoilers. I know this wouldn't really help for mid-chapter discussion, but it would be very helpful for the way that I've been using Buddy Reads so far!

posts.title: Ability to hide journal entries that don't contain notes
posts.description: Not sure if this has already been suggested but I often like to scroll through my journal entries to look back on my thoughts and opinions and how they developed as I read it. It would be cool if I could hide the entries with no notes so I can just see the ones that contain my thoughts.

posts.title: Create groups of owned books
posts.description: Categorize your owned books in groups, for example "Discworld series" or "Serie X/Y/Z"

posts.title: Reading progress viewable to friends
posts.description: My friends and I would love to be able to share our reading progress with each other. It would be more motivating to see how we are all doing with books that we are reading. Kind of like buddy reads but not specific to one book.

posts.title: track comics/webtoons
posts.description: Create some sort of formatting to better track episodic material or those that come in single issues, such as physical and digital comic books, webtoons, etc. I realize this is a significant undertaking since some of those series can be 100s of issues/episodes. The League of Comic Geeks has one model for doing this, but it would be awesome to have all reading tracked on one platform.

posts.title: View for Reviews
posts.description: I find it difficult to tell whether I have written a review on an individual book. Maybe there is a view on the site that I am missing? I have been trying to write better reviews this year, since I have been reading considerably more than in past years. I also found a list of books I read in 2010 with ⭐️ ratings and no notes, and for many of them I have no recollection of even reading the books let alone why I rated them the way I did. In order to get the info I want, right now I have to go to this year's stats and open the list of all books I read. Then, I find myself opening every single book's "Add a review" or "See review" link in a new tab, because there is no way for me to tell whether I just left a ⭐ review and no text on the "See review" ones, and I have read too many to remember where I left off the last time I tried to make sure every book had a written review. Basically, on a page like this (https://app.thestorygraph.com/books-read/jaina8851?year=2021), what would be really helpful in the filters would be "show me books with no reviews" AND "show me books with no written reviews" the way you can filter the community review page for an individual book.

posts.title: Buddy Reads
posts.description: Based on user feedback, instead of groups we're going to start with everyone being able to run buddy/group reads, and then longer-running book clubs will be a Plus feature. For buddy reads — where you read a book alongside at least one other person and then discuss it/or discuss it as you go — what would you like to see? How would one get kicked off? What's the discussion format like? How do invitations to join one work? Share any ideas below!

posts.title: Moods
posts.description: Is it possible to add more moods to choose from when reviewing a book? (e.g. the question "This book would be for someone who is in the mood for something:")

posts.title: Decline Recommendations
posts.description: I would love the ability to decline a book recommendation if it doesn't sound like something I'd like so that it stops appearing in the list! :-)

posts.title: Sort for “currently reading”
posts.description: I’d like a sort function for currently reading, maybe by “percentage read” or “start date”.

posts.title: Private Books V2
posts.description: I know one thing y'all want is a way to filter/list/see all of your private books in one place. Anything else?

posts.title: Aliases for authors
posts.description: Some authors go by multiple names. I've also had an issue with an author being listed by their first and last name on some books but first, middle, and last on others, which makes the system read those as two different names. Could there be some way to identify to the system that these are indeed the same author? Thanks!

posts.title: Duplicate Custom Graphs
posts.description: It would be great to be able to duplicate a custom graph that you have already made, then edit it from there. It would save a lot of time when creating similar custom graphs

posts.title: Romance Rating System
posts.description: I feel that it would be valuable to have the ability to rate and see a rating for how big of a component romance is of a book and if there is any sexually explicit content included. This would allow both adult romance readers to see books that may appeal to them, as well allowing young readers, romance/sex repulsed readers, and those simply not looking to read heavy romance in that moment to make a clear informed decision without doing extensive research that often does not answer the question of how big of a component romance is to the story.

posts.title: Filter others user's reviews to only show books I've also read
posts.description: When I'm looking to add a book to my TBR or pick a book from my TBR to read next, I spend time looking at reviews. If I see a review from FakeUserReadsBooks that's 5 stars, I'll often click FakeUserReadsBooks profile and see what else they've read and reviewed. Then I'll scroll for books we've both read to see if our ratings align. If we match in our liked and disliked books, there's a decent chance I'll agree with their take on this new book I'm considering. I want to be able to go to FakeUserReadsBooks read books and filter to only show reviews for books I've also read.

posts.title: DNFs Cover Collage
posts.description: As a cover collage with % read, like the monthly ratings collage I think what I DNFed in a year is just as interesting a part of my reading journey as what moods I read

posts.title: Convert tag to challenge
posts.description: It would be great if it was possible to have a button or simple process to turn a tag into a book-specific challenge. I have a tag that I use to track which books I'd like to put on my list for the next year. When the book-specific challenges came out I started making it a challenge - which has been great! - but it's a bit of work to set up and since I already have the tag, I'd love an easy way to just turn the tag into a challenge.

posts.title: Export your stats into CSV/Excel
posts.description: CSV Export for Stats and Reading Journal I would like to request the ability to export my StoryGraph stats and Reading Journal data in a CSV format that can be used in Excel. Requested Functionality: • Export all core reading stats in CSV, including genres, moods, pacing, formats, page counts, and other categories StoryGraph already tracks. • Export Reading Journal entries: pages read, reading duration, and reading dates. • Allow users to select a custom date range for the export. • Allow users to choose which data categories to include in the file. Why This Matters: StoryGraph provides monthly charts, but the visuals are limited and not customizable. Being able to export this data would let users create their own charts, graphics, and reading reports in Excel. Since StoryGraph already logs all of this information, users should be able to export their own data in a flexible format for personal analysis and documentation.

posts.title: Have a separate section for completed challenges instead of archive
Author Programme to allow authors to maintain their book details
posts.description: It would be brilliant if there was a way to identify yourself in StoryGraph as an author, and then have your books shown on your profile. With this, it would then be brilliant if the author could update their book details/covers/etc, as and when needed.

posts.title: Number of books over time chart for plus stats
posts.description: I'd love to be able view the "Number of books, pages, and minutes" chart within the Plus stats sections (e.g. for moods, genres, star ratings, tags). This would be a great way to understand my changes in reading habits over time.

posts.title: “Suggested by Others” or “Spotted in the Wild” Counter for TBR Books
posts.description: Hi StoryGraph team, Thanks so much for building such a helpful and beautiful platform—I truly enjoy using it! I wanted to suggest a feature that would help with prioritizing books on my TBR: A way to track how many times a book has been recommended to me or mentioned in the wild (e.g., by friends, online, or in media). Right now, when I add a book to my TBR, I often forget how or why it got there, and I’d love a way to “upvote” it each time I hear about it again. Ideally, this would be a simple counter I can click to say, “This came up again,” or maybe something automated based on tagging or community suggestions. This would help me surface the most buzzed-about or personally relevant books when deciding what to read next. Thank you for considering this idea!

posts.title: Monthly wrap_up - option to include/exclude
posts.description: For the monthly stats and graphs it will be nice to have an option to check off or uncheck books you would like included in that graph or stats. For instance in my current monthly graph it included all of the books that I put on pause.

posts.title: Emojis in Tags
posts.description: I'd love the option to use emojis in my tags. For me, it's super helpful to have that visual image in addition to a written description. Thank you!

posts.title: Easier switch between book versions/formats
posts.description: I struggle to find audiobook versions of the books I’m reading, which throws off my charts. I’d like an easy way to accomplish this. Maybe there’s already a way to do this that just isn’t obvious to me, and in that case, I think it should be made more obvious.

posts.title: Bookly stats
posts.description: I would absolutely love it if you could add some stats like they have on bookly. You can track your reading sessions and it calculates how many pages you’re reading per hour, how long it’ll take you to finish the book, how much you would need to read per day to finish on your desired date, etc. If this was added, I wouldn’t need to use any other reading apps!

posts.title: Custom Reading Challenge Badges
posts.description: A really nice feature would be if when you create a challenge you can also create / upload a badge so that when someone completes a challenge the badge shows on their profile page.

posts.title: Please make drop-down for reading status bigger on mobile!
posts.description: I keep hitting the wrong button on that drop-down in ways that are difficult to undo 😭 I just marked a book as DNF when I meant to mark it as Paused, and I know I've recently marked things as Read when I meant to mark a paused book as Currently Reading. The fact that I can't easily get the book back into the desired state is really frustrating 😞

posts.title: DNF challenge
posts.description: This is perhaps a bit niche and feel free to remove/merge with other posts... Each year I tell myself: you gotta stop reading books that don't make you happy and each year there's a few books that I am plodding though only because I feel I *have* to. I'd love to set myself a challenge to "DNF X number of books" for the year, and of course be able to track that using SG... Don't know how difficult this would be to implement and how widely this would be used so may not get a lot of return on time invested, but just throwing it out there :)

posts.title: Make a discord server for storygraph!
posts.description: A lot of game developers make discords to announce new features as well as a way to connect with the users. I feel like storygraph would benefit a lot from this. 1. A way to announce new updates 2. Reporting bugs 3. Sharing advice/ tips 4. Connecting with people 5. Host readalongs/ buddy reads and other events

posts.title: Re-read formatting
posts.description: I would love a better way of seeing info for books I have read more than once. For example, currently it shows "you have read this book 2 times" and automatically shows the most recent read dates in the edit dates part. It would be nice if it had a line under "you have read this book 2" saying the date finished and rating for each separate read. With an easier button to take straight to the journal view. This would be nice as I have reread books and more often than not, ratings change over time. I dont want my original rating to be changed. I think this should also change the review format to show original rating and review text, with a line and a section below with the new rating and any additional review text to add. I hope I have explained everything clearly enough, thank you.

posts.title: Owned books page more accessible
posts.description: I'd really like to have the owned books page more accessible. Right now you have to first navigate to your profile, then scroll down to find your Owned book page. I'd like to see it more visible, maybe on the home page somewhere as another section? I buy and sell a lot of books and use that page quite often.

posts.title: Ability to pin tags
posts.description: I would love to have the ability to pin my favorite tags in the tag menu since there are a lot of tags I like to refer to often.

posts.title: Remove red/green from stats comparison
posts.description: The monthly stats are awesome, but I really hate the "down =red" "up =green" of the "compared to last month" stats. It sends a very clear signal that reading less (or, fewer books, for the pedants) is bad, reading more is good. Offering at least the option to simply have the comparison offered neutrally, without the current traffic light judgment system would be an improvement.

posts.title: Thumbs Up/Thumbs Down Option
posts.description: I don't always have the time or executive functioning to review a book or even give it a star rating when I finish (since I tend to think hard about how many stars I think the book should have). I would love to have the option for a quick thumbs up/thumbs down for the book. This could be an additional rating system "on top of" the stars system, or a quick "review" that will get replaced by the real review if and when I get around to giving a star rating.

posts.title: Cover collages for tags!
posts.description: I have a few different tags that I've used throughout the year to track certain categories of books (e.g. books from my subscription with my local book store, books that I wrapped in paper and pulled numbers out of a cup to pick my up next). I tagged all of those books with particular tags, and I would love a quick way to report out about all of them. It made me think how nice it would be to be able to generate a cover collage with ratings like I can for monthly wrap-ups, but since I read them over the course of the year, they won't show up in one month's wrap-up, and even if I wait until the end of the year, they will be mixed in with all the rest of the books I read. Could be a neat option to add to the Tag Stats page!

posts.title: Reading Challenges: Multiple specific books required for one prompt
posts.description: I searched through the existing posts and didn't see one for this particular usecase, but apologies if this is a duplicate! I would like a challenge type where I could have one prompt with multiple specific books that all must be completed before the prompt is checked off as done. I've been doing a lot of back-to-back reads of classics and modern retellings, and I would like to make a reading challenge where one prompt is "David Copperfield / Demon Copperhead", and another is "Huck Finn / James", et al, and both books are associated with each prompt. Only once both books are complete does it get checked off as green. I'm sure there would be other use cases where people would find this useful too :)

posts.title: Alt text for wrap ups
posts.description: The new monthly wrap-ups are AWESOME, truly magnificent. A suggestion for making them more share-friendly on social media: Add a text download option for use as alt text for the images. To add alt text to my wrap up graphics for August 2024, I downloaded my entire TSG data and sorted the CSV by "Date last read to get the 19 books I read and their ratings, then copied tem as text, as shown in the screenshot from my Mastodon account. I realise there is far too much graphical information in the wrap ups for "complete" alt text, but might it be possible to generate a text summary of key data like title, author, rating and the stats summary?

posts.title: Additionally series functionality
posts.description: Currently we can filter out books in series when looking at our TBR. I think some useful related series functions would include: - Filtering only books in series - Filtering “up next” books in series in our TBR, potentially with a breakdown of if they are new series (book one counting as the next book) or series in progress - Maybe adding series to the stats page, both in terms of in series vs standalone as a stat, as well as maybe allowing users to see stats for a series, similar to how we can for our tags.

posts.title: "All Books" stats view
posts.description: I'd love a view in my stats that includes ALL the books I've tracked (Read + To Read + DNF). I've made a custom chart for "year added to TBR" and I really wish I could set a filter for "all books, all time" and get a sum of how many books total I added to my TBR for each year rather than having it split across multiple views.

posts.title: Move Readalong and Buddy Read links to a more prominent place
posts.description: It'd be easier to know about and go to the Readalongs page from the Community page if it's above the Following and Similar Users lists. (same for Buddy Reads)

posts.title: Ability to filter DNF stats by year
posts.description: It would be nice if you could sort DNF books by year when looking at the stats. Same way you can compare read books in different years. Currently you can only see all DNF books from all time.

posts.title: Read Date - set to yesterday button
posts.description: I love the set to today button, but adding a "set to yesterday" button would be so handy!

posts.title: Add "partially read" option
posts.description: I love storygraph but I feel like its impacted my reading habits in that I feel like I HAVE to finish a book cover to cover. I'd love to have an option for partially read (as opposed to DNF) where it's a book that I've read excerpts from, say in a class where we read a chapter of it, and while I want to read the whole thing I want to recognize that I've read part of it (but did not abandon it like a DNF). I have added my own tag of this but I think it would be a cool feature.

posts.title: Add multiple languages for one edition
posts.description: I recently came across several books who contain multiple languages within the same edition. There are books which do this for artistic purposes and such which are used in schools who have both the original version and the translated text next to one another. It would be nice if we could add multiple languages for these editions and still keep them searchable.

posts.title: Seeing reading journal when reviewing a book
posts.description: I would like the option to access my reading journal entries for a book when I'm writing its review, so I can see past thoughts and maybe copy-paste some pieces from my journal. Right now the journal is quite hard to access.

posts.title: Show last progress update for audiobooks
posts.description: I sometimes forget if I have logged my reading or not when I have multiple books in progress. For a book with pages, it is easy to see the last page number update that I made right from the home screen. For books with HH:MM, the box is blank when I open it on the home screen, and even if I go all the way into the journal entries for that book, it has been converted to total minutes so I have to do a bunch of clicking and then math to figure out if I logged or not. It would be extremely helpful if I could see this info at a glance the way I can for the other books I read. I have screenshots for what I mean if this isn't clear but they aren't uploading on mobile got some reason.

posts.title: Exclude "Upcoming Books" when browsing books or recommendations.
posts.description: Sometimes, when I'm looking for stuff to read, a bunch of titles that pop up are books that aren't even out yet. It would be nice to filter these out, maybe next to the "Only show me books..." bar in the filter options?

posts.title: No recs from specific authors
posts.description: In the same vain of genres we don't like / never want to read it would also be nice to have authors we don't like. That way people can not get recommendations by authors whose writing they don't like or if they don't like an author because they find them problematic etc...

posts.title: Add plot/character/a mix driven stats to yearly/monthly stats and/or rating stats
Links to other books in review
posts.description: I often mention other books when I review a book, similar books, books that informed my reading of this book etc. It would be cool to be able to put a link to those other books in the review leading to the page of the mentioned book so someone reading the review can put it on their tbr if they want.

posts.title: What Book Should I Read Next quizzes
posts.description: Like a "20 Questions" game that finds you the perfect next book! It's fine to say I want something adventurous, but what if that led to a "do you want your adventure to involve a body of water?" And then maybe "how many main characters are you interested in following?" I understand this would take a lot of research, but readers can add information like that to their reviews. Or maybe they can opt to take a quiz when they've finished reading, providing loads of information to provide to the database. I think that feature would add a huge perk for subscribers!

posts.title: Searching for book series
posts.description: A lot of time I am searching for recommendations of books in a series. It would be great if we could filter results buy standalone books or series. In the to-read pile filter you can select "that aren't a part of a series" but I would love to do the opposite.

posts.title: Buddy Read Spot on Homepage
posts.description: I would like to see a dedicated buddy read spot on the homepage, even for books which I haven't marked as "currently reading" yet. I have joined three buddy reads, and in all instances, the buddy read does not pop up on my homepage until after I manually search for the book and mark it as "currently reading." I think a buddy read should automatically appear on the homepage after I have joined it, even if I have not begun the book yet.

posts.title: Rereads and DNF toggle button when searching to-read pile
posts.description: When I search my to-read pile for the next book to read I often want to consider rereads and DNFs too. Would it be possible to add an "Include rereads" button that would add the entire "read" category too? Same for DNFs ("Include DNFs" or something like it).

posts.title: User Compatibility
posts.description: It would be cool to see some kind of compatibility info when looking at/for similar users' profiles! Something like LastFM where it shows you how compatible you are and what authors/genres you have in common.

posts.title: Number of Participants That Have Completed Challenge
posts.description: I'm always curious and think it would be a fun feature on challenge pages to show how many participants have completed the challenge. (Maybe somewhere near where it shows number of participants/books added?)

posts.title: ability to change journal entry order
posts.description: it would be great if we could have the option to view journal entries in reverse chronological order. i'd really like to view them with newest at the top and oldest at the bottom so i dont have to scroll so far if i've made a lot of entries and want to see the more recent ones

posts.title: Notes/comments on reading challenge books
posts.description: I would like to be able to add notes or comments on books I or others have added to reading challenges. That way all participants could note if a book doesn't fit a prompt, or explain how it does. A challenge host could opt to get notifications on comments so they could more easily keep the challenge prompt 'clean' of books that don’t fit.

posts.title: Letting users add similar books
posts.description: Similar to the LibraryThing feature - have a section on a book's page where users can add their own recommendations for similar books, with an explanation. (LibraryThing has limits on how many times you can recommend the same book, so a similar limit might be good here too, to prevent spamming.)

posts.title: Will I like this book?/Recommendation Score
posts.description: This is probably a huge feature idea, but I would love to use the power of StoryGraph's algorithms to get a better sense of whether I would like a book before adding it to my TBR. The recommended books on my home page are really useful, but if I see a book that a friend has read, or that a friend has added to their TBR, or is on a list of "you must read these books!", I would love to punch that in to StoryGraph and on the book's page have some sort of indicator of "this is really similar to books you've read, you would probably love it!" Basically just a different way of presenting the recommendations... instead of seeing a bunch of books in a list, having an indicator on an individual book of how likely it is to *appear* in the list of recommendations.

posts.title: Reading Preferences Divided For Fiction and Nonfiction
posts.description: Hello! A suggestion I have is to divide the "the kind of books you like to read" section into one text box for fiction and one for nonfiction. There are some subjects that I'm only interested in in fiction (like "political intrigue" and "dreams"), and I think it would be nice to give the StoryGraph recommendation AI a way to know that.

posts.title: More social aspects
posts.description: I love story graph already as it is but I also like comparing and seeing all my friends books BUT they won't switch over from GR because they like the social aspect more, I think it would be awesome to have story graph be the biggest and best out there so I'm hoping for more social aspects so everyone will also be enticed to switch over. Specific things like recommendations to each together, having a full bio/profile, being able to make book related posts that aren't just the books you're reading, etc) also please feel free to delete this if it's already been said im mostly just requested on behalf of my friends :3

posts.title: See "owned" and/or tags for people I follow
posts.description: .I follow several family and friends and would love to buy them books on their TBR that they don't own. I would love to be able to see their owned books so I would know what they already have. Or even their tags(?) (I tag books as "to-buy" and I know some others do too). I buy books as gifts often and this would help ensuring I'm getting them something they don't already have. I follow several family and friends and would love to buy them books on their TBR that they don't own. I would love to be able to see their owned books so I would know what they already have. Or even their tags(?) (I tag books as "to-buy" and I know some others do too). I buy books as gifts often and this would help ensuring I'm getting them something they don't already have.

posts.title: Add additonal "buy this book" links for different countries
posts.description: Bookshop.org is a FANTASTIC place to start (especially because it also redirects to MyMustReads and Libro.fm), but it seems like if you're not in the US or UK you can't use it to full effect. Perhaps users from other countries can add below what sites would be most helpful for them?

posts.title: Adapt Reading Challenges
posts.description: Add a button for copying a reading challenge from someone else and and being able to change it as your own reading challenge. This would allow for things like changing the dates, or deleting prompts without having to create a challenge from scratch.

posts.title: Examples of themes, topics, tropes
posts.description: When reviewing a book, I would find it exceptionally helpful to have a list of potential themes, topics, and tropes that might have been present. I want to help users find similar books, but my mind goes completely blank on what to put in this section. Having a list I could refer to or select from would help me get more descriptive and better contribute to the community!

posts.title: Time periods in the stats comparison
posts.description: I'd love to be able to compare individual time periods, in addition to single months and years. For example comparing the first half of 2020 to the second half of the year. Or 2021 versus all the other years before that.

posts.title: Enhanced book recommendations
posts.description: Give more potential answers for the "what are you in the mood for?" question, to include topics like "time-travel"/"vampires"/ "ghosts"/"pirates" etc

posts.title: Option to have my current streak info on monthly/yearly wrap ups
Hide others reviews when buddy reading/within book club until I’ve also finished the book
posts.description: Sometimes I don’t want other peoples star reviews to influence how I feel about the book before I’ve submitted mine

posts.title: Traffic Light for Content Warning Triangle
posts.description: TLDR: colour code the warning triangle for content warnings, to easily differentiate graphic from mild at a glance. For those of us who have some content warnings set to notify, the yellow triangle that comes up against potentially problematic books is a godsend. However, some content warning items feature at a mild level very frequently, which means seeing that yellow triangle a lot. Whilst the CWs are all available in detail further down the page, it would be really handy if the triangle colour coded to reflect severity/frequency of mentions. Probably red for graphic, orange for moderate and yellow for mild (on the basis that green would suggest none). But it could also be brights for frequently flagged and pastels for fewer flags. I am very grateful that the feature exists, but I’d like to be able to utilise it without having to think about /check for my triggers as much.

posts.title: Ranked Choice Voting in Book Club Polls
posts.description: Add an option for ranked choice voting on book club polls! Too many votes are ending as ties.

posts.title: Stat: pages per day per book
