It would be nice to be able to create different "reading preferences" profiles, all inside my single account, and be able to shift between them depending on my mood, without having to save lists of keywords and genre combinations in external, separate files. For instance, sometimes I'm more in the mood to read Literary, Magical Realism, and Historical; those, of course, go with completely different keywords as reading preferences compared to when I'm in the mood to read some Romance, Erotica, or even Non-Fiction.

posts.title: Filter Quotes on Reading Journals
posts.description: There is a way to look at your entire reading journal for all of the books you've read and tracked progress on. Would it be possible to add a filter so that you can see all the note or quotes you wrote down while reading? Filter out all the updates to the tracker that just progresses you through the book and only shows notes for all books at once.

posts.title: easy way to add an aditional book cover for a given edition or mark as incorrect
posts.description: I've stumbled across a few editions of books that show a different cover than the book I have (same ISBN). It would satisfy my aesthetic-focussed brain to be able to add a second cover to a specific edition of a book

posts.title: Goal for Time Read
posts.description: I would love to set up a goal for how long I read in a year. I love having pages instead of books, as I DNF a lot of books. However, some of my reading is educational articles which are hard to track, and I'd love to log them as time read (e.g. 25 minutes read today)

posts.title: Add notes/tags to user profiles
posts.description: It would be nice to have a note section for each friend/person I'm following. eg IRL friends have storygraph usernames that don't match what I know them as, I'd like to note their IRL name so I can better keep track. I'd also like to note why I followed someone, whether they're an IRL friend, instagram friend, storygraph similar user etc. Note from Nadia (July 4th 2024): Edited title slightly, changing "friends list" to "user profiles", inspired by patlo's post.

posts.title: Home Menu Layout
posts.description: Place 'To-Read Pile' above 'Recommendations'. While I like having recommendations on the home page, I have a long TBR list and use 'Search and Filter' countlessly more times than 'Explore'. Expand 'Popular This Week' into cover image format and use that side bar menu for 'All Tags'. This would especially be helpful for mobile because every time I want to look at specific tag--whether it be for buddy reads, monthly TBR list, or something more specific, the click chain to get to 'All Tags' is way too many clicks to be useful. Having instant access to my tags would greatly improve the accessibility of the app for me.

posts.title: Add photographer as a contributor role
posts.description: There are plenty of books that will have photographers credited, but no role beyond a generic "Contributor" or inaccurately tagging them as illustrators.

posts.title: Reading challenges' dates
posts.description: It would be great to be able to see when a reading challenge ends on the box with the name and number of prompts on the page before clicking on the actual reading challenge link. Like, if it has no end date, then nothing but if it does have an end date it could placed under the progress bar and the bonus prompts percentage

posts.title: Sort star ratings pages
posts.description: The star ratings pages (e.g. 4 star books in 2021) don't appear to list books in any order that I can identify. It would be nice to be able to sort them by date read or alphabetically.

posts.title: Input books by ASIN
posts.description: Right now users can input new editions by looking up the ISBN. I know this may be complicated, but is it possible to adapt the search engine so that it can find editions using ASIN? This would be especially useful when importing audiobooks given it’s extremely difficult to find the ISBN

posts.title: Expanding Language Options (Language team???)
posts.description: Hi Nadia, Love The Storygraph. I was mentioning it on a forum, and someone complained that it was only for English speakers. I'm wondering if there is some way to make this more accessible to the rest of the world? A language option, perhaps? You've mentioned in other posts you and your team only speak English, but perhaps people are willing to volunteer (Similar to your librarian volunteer system - I think that's what you called it) and help translate parts? This might be a considerable undertaking, so I'm just tossing it out there as a thought. It'd be great to welcome others into the system regardless of language. ;-)

posts.title: Connect NetGalley account
posts.description: Hi! I just joined NetGalley and noticed you could connect that profile with a few other sites including Goodreads. I use this site more for my reviews though. It would be awesome if I could connect this profile to it somehow! Right now I just put a link to my StoryGraph profile.

posts.title: Make the reading journal easier to access
posts.description: The reading journal is really difficult to get to. It would be much more user-friendly if there were a button or access on our profile to see all of the notes we write about books. This is one of the most important features for me, as I write a lot of notes about the books I'm reading and I need that information to be accessible to me quickly.

posts.title: Recommend more books like this
posts.description: I think it would be great if after you finish a book there was a toggle to “reccomend more books like this”. That way your recs can always be refreshed and it’s easier to reflect new tastes.

posts.title: Suggest Book To A Follower Within Site
posts.description: On a book's page under "People You Follow" can you consider adding a "Suggest this book to a Follower" so we can recommend books to one other within the site? Apologies if this already exists.

posts.title: Challenges
posts.description: I like that you can see which books are part of a reading challenge with the logo under them. Would be nice to click on that and go to the challenge and prompt or prompts it is attached to.

posts.title: Add Flexibility in Search Bar
posts.description: When I enter a book title and "by author name" it brings me to the Import a book page. This often happens when I copy a title and author from a web search to bookmark it in SG. Fine tuning this search function would be helpful.

posts.title: Save user's progress updates on read history of a book
posts.description: You should save a user's progress updates on the read history of a book. The update should show the date and page/percent of the update. You could use this data for new graphs based on reading speed.

posts.title: Tag books from authors I don't want to read again
posts.description: When reading a book by an author that I either have indicated I don't want recommendations from OR I've read books for them before but recorded them below 3 stars, show a warning like the 'this book contains topics you said you want to avoid' but for the author.

posts.title: Filter for books within a Challenge
posts.description: **Suggestion:** On the "Filter List" menu, there's already a checkbox to filter for books that are part of (any) challenge. Add an option to select a specific challenge or challenges. (It would be cool if it's similar to the genres or tags search, where instead of a checkbox there are include/exclude boxes to search the names of your active challenges.) **Goal:** Find a book that fits your current reading vibes that's part of a specific open challenge that you're participating in. **Example:** I created and joined a number-type challenge to work through a specific TBR pile of 111 books that can be read in any order and are all different kinds of genres and moods. I want the next book I choose to be one of the books that's part of that specific challenge, but also to fit what I'm in the mood for at the time without having to read through every title in the list. https://app.thestorygraph.com/reading_challenges/fb7834ee-9633-4e53-8aae-166e2d0d3b4e ----- ORIGINAL SUGGESTION Idea #1: Add a filter to challenge pages so you can filter within the list of books you've (or anyone has?) added to that specific challenge. This is especially helpful for number type challenges, where there can be a big pile of books without a prompt associated. Idea #2: Add a "challenges" option to the filter settings on your To Read list that lets you select challenges you've joined. It can then search for books that meet your other criteria AND are in a specific challenge. Or something else that someone else comes up with to reach the stated outcome?

posts.title: Monthly TBR
posts.description: Hi, is there any chance for a montly TBR feature?

posts.title: Time as X-axis custom charts
posts.description: I'd love to have a custom chart feature where I see a tag vs time (so for a few months scale, vs month, for a few year scale, vs year). I'm thinking specific genre vs time or custom tag vs time could be really interesting to track how reading preferences change over time.

posts.title: Carousel through Favorites
posts.description: I would love the option to have my favorites exist as a list someone can scroll through. So the options could be: * random generation (with all of them viewable with a horizontal scroll) * pin certain ones

posts.title: Easier to backdate reading stats
posts.description: I find that I often need to fill in my reading stats from the last couple of days. I usually start in ”current reads” and then update where I am and what book I read what date (usually ”today, yesterday and the day before”). But I find that it’s not very easy to do this, I wish the date was adjustable in the ”current reads view” and that the digits were wheel instead of typing. (Love the app, just also love to improve)

posts.title: Publish Buddy Read Updates in Reading Journal
posts.description: I am not sure if anyone else has suggested something like this but I would love for updates (original posts) that I make on a buddy read to also appear in my reading journal. Currently I have to cross-post my ideas and I wish at least the unique, new posts I make on a buddy read would also be viewable as part of my reading journal.

posts.title: Friends Favorite Book on Books' Page
posts.description: I love that I can see which of my friends read/reviewed/dnf'd a book etc, on the book's page. I would love if it is also said "So and So title is on this_user's Favorites Shelf" too!

posts.title: System to discern series/authors with identical names when manually adding books/data
posts.description: I regularly find myself manually adding data to existing titles or completely adding new books onto Storygraph. I really enjoy doing this and contributing to the community. However, it's difficult when there are multiple authors/series with the same name already logged into the system, and I don't know which one of these identical names/series to select. There's a 4-digit code attached to the names, but no clear information on what it means. I've noticed that this has clearly been an issue for other people before, too, as I've seen some book series with books from completely different series that just happen to share the same name grouped together. I'm unsure how to report this either, as 'the series isn't called x, it's called x' doesn't seem particularly helpful! I'd love for this to be remedied :)

posts.title: Challenge book sorting
posts.description: At the moment when you view a Challenge you have joined, the books appear to be sorted in the order they were added. Add a sorting option. - Added order - I assume this is the current default ordering, and would represent the order they were added to the Challenge - Read order - eg grouped Reading, Read, Unread [per user] - Unread order - eg grouped Unread, Reading, Read [ per user] - Priority order - this would be if you allowed the user to drag and reorder the book entries, but obv would require more infrastructure than simply supporting the grouping options above Rationale: If there are dozens of books in the Challenge and I've read some number and maybe have a couple others in the middle of Currently Reading, it's fiddly to either easily see the ones I've done, or to see which ones are still to be read. It's possible this suggestion is mostly of use for a Challenge which is to Read a Number of books from a selection.

posts.title: Enable toggle for seeing yourself in the news feed
posts.description: I love scrolling the news feed and seeing what others have been up to but I’m not super interested in seeing my own reading there as events. I keep thinking that someone I know is reading the same book as me. I’d love to be able to toggle myself off there :)

posts.title: Share owned book library
posts.description: My husband and i each have the app! I would like if he could see or is we could share the owned books section. thanks!

posts.title: Clarify translator position when adding book
posts.description: When adding a book it says add the 'main' author, and then you can add 'contributors'. It is not clear to me whether for translated works, is the translator a main author or a contributor. I think a clarifying point in the author text would help, which currently begins: "Author(s) This field is for the main authors of the book. Other contributors can be listed separately below. "

posts.title: Search Review Text
posts.description: It would be really helpful if we were able to search keywords or text in reviews

posts.title: Related to pausing: slow reads
posts.description: I’d love a feature that allows me to read a book over the full year without that affecting all of my stats—showing me reading much more slowly than I really do. An example: I’m about to start reading Diana Henry’s Around the Table, which is 52 essays. I want to read one each week—but it’ll wreak havoc with my stats. And I want to do the same with Nature’s Calendar and The Hidden Year.

posts.title: Gift a book to a user based on their read and/or to-read list
posts.description: Use a local model to create a feature on public user's pages to create gift recommendations for someone visiting their page. For example, if I am a user and I visit YOUR profile, there should be a "Gift me a book" section (maybe integrated with Bookshop and/or Libro.fm?) with recommendations driven by your read and/or to-read lists.

posts.title: Ability to filter moods/genres by required and optional
posts.description: When I'm filtering by moods or genres, I'd really love it if there was a way to say that one filter is required while others are optional. For example, making adventurous required, while making lighthearted and mysterious optional would bring up books that were adventurous and mysterious, adventurous and lighthearted, or all three, but no books that were just mysterious or lighthearted. Or for genres, being able to select romance as required, but historical or fantasy as optional to bring up historical or fantasy romance, but not contemporary romance or non-romance fantasy.

posts.title: Display edition format on book page
posts.description: I've really loved the switch in most places to having the edition format (paperback, hardback, digital, audio) included in information list, but for some reason it hasn't been done on the book page. I saw the preview of the new format for the book page and noticed it's not there either, so I thought I'd put in a request!

posts.title: Option to filter Similar Users by recent activity
posts.description: As is the nature with the web, sometimes people create accounts and use a site for a bit and then forget about it for a stretch of time or get caught up with something else. It'd be nice to be able to filter the Similar Users section by users with recent activity (something like, "has reviewed a book in the last 3 months"). This way, you're more likely to see people who are active on the platform currently.

posts.title: Extra Reading Goals set using Tags
posts.description: I use tags to delineate "format types" novels, novellas, manga, etc. and would love to be able to set a reading goal by tag! Have a goal of 24 novels or like my tag for translated works. A goal to read 24 books in translation.

posts.title: Custom data: average rating per author, tags, mood, etc
posts.description: It would be really helpful in a plus account to be able to build custom charts that could track the average rating per category of book, especially author, tags, moods, and genre. This would be more helpful than just being able to see the number read in each category.

posts.title: Switching accounts
posts.description: I have an account for myself and one for my child, when I want to change profiles I have to log out and back in each time. It would be great if I could log in to both accounts on the app and then just switch between them.

posts.title: Distinguish journal entries for different reads
posts.description: I started rereading a lot of books. And in the journal entries page for each book, if I'm reading the same edition, it would be nice to be able to filter which journal entries are for which reads. This would be especially helpful for long books where one might have dozens, if not hundreds, of entries.

posts.title: Rating book covers from 1-5.
posts.description: I'd love the possibility to rate book covers. Doesn't need to be anything complicated or elaborate, just a 1-5 checkbox rating system, like on the book rating page. 🙂

posts.title: Charts based on your OWN review, not collective
posts.description: Allow charts based on one’s own review only and not the collective tags on that book. For example, if in my review of a book, I check the Mood “dark” but that’s not a commonly-used Mood in the books’ collective reviews, I may still want to see that selection in my charts. This would apply to Mood and Pace mainly.

posts.title: Custom stats page to default to this year rather than all time, like the standard stats page does
Sort currently reading
posts.description: I’d love some sort options for currently reading, particularly “sort by progress” and “sort by add date”. That way I can properly prioritize what to read next. Or if the list could be moveable similar to “up next”

posts.title: Exclude rereads from yearly wrap up cover collage
posts.description: In the yearly wrap up, it would be nice to have an option to exclude rereads from the summary graphic with all the covers (related: adding a "reread" option in the list with read paused dnf et al) i find myself rereading several books a year (usually my favorite audiobooks as i'll just throw one on when i'm unable to decide what book to read next or doing something that keeps me too distracted to be fully present for a new read) and this year, since i reread a couple of long series, a lot of my graphic ended up being rereads. so i had mixed feelings looking at it because while it's nice seeing all the books i read, i found myself trying to like ignore the covers of books i've already read to just see the picture of new books. and then i realized there was no way to filter rereads out of my graphic. thanks so much for all your hard work and this incredible app!

posts.title: More Book Club Forum Push Notifications
posts.description: I run a book club but when people add comments in the book clubs forums or readalong forums I don't get a notification. It would be really great to have an option to receive notifications perhaps with a follow forum toggle feature at the top of each forum? Or a notifications on/off toggle which members of the readalong or book club could choose to turn on or off also. I feel this would really improve participation in book club forums.

posts.title: Content warning clarity
posts.description: When a book is flagged with a '⚠️' and it says that it may contain content types that you have previously indicated you don't want to read about, would there be any way to know what types of content were flagged for this specific book? So that you could know whether to proceed or not. A warning is amazing, but if I knew specifics could mean I was able to shelve the book for another time, not avoid completely.

posts.title: Book Lists or Playlists
posts.description: I would love to have an option to create different playlist for books that people can follow, comment and suggest books under. Maybe even upvote books. I know we have tags but I would like to have something different that would not count in stats and would be more of a public facing thing. You can have them public or unlisted like buddy reads and this is something I'd love to see in the homepage. An example of this is "Anticipated 2025 releases by BIPOC authors"

posts.title: “Owned” descriptor
posts.description: Please add ability to mark where along with “owned”… ie, available in Libby, hoopla, owned on kindle, physical copy…

posts.title: Book club readalongs in the book club menu tab
posts.description: I would really love to see a 'readalong' tab in book clubs. Currently from a book club page you can only see what live and upcoming readalongs a club has from via a meeting, or at least I haven't found another route. Ps... I love what you are building!

posts.title: Seeing my friends custom charts
posts.description: I would love to be able to see the custom charts that my friends have made

posts.title: Custom Chart to look at a tag over time
posts.description: I would love to be able to set up a custom chart that displays a tag based on when the tagged book was marked "read." For example, I have a tag for new releases and I'd love to be able to look at how many new releases I read per month over the year without having to manually check each month. So I'd need to be able to filter the chart to the tag "new releases", then only include books marked as "read" and use the date marked as read to fill the month bins. I know this would be pretty complicated behind the scenes, but it would be a nice addition for v2!

posts.title: Default Sort Order for Owned Books
posts.description: I'd love to be able to choose a sort order for my Owned Books list, and have the list remember that for the next time I go to the page, rather than always defaulting to Latest Added.

posts.title: Crafts & Hobbies Genre
posts.description: A Craft and Hobbies genre would be amazing. A significant number of the books I borrow would fit perfectly within this category; they don't quite align with any of the existing genre selections.

posts.title: Edit icon on app is too small hit tap; make it bigger
posts.description: On the android app the thing you have to click to add a tag is very very small and hard to hit. I often end up clicking the tag next to it instead. Would it be possible to make the little edit symbol a bit bigger so it's easier to hit with your fingers on the screen

posts.title: Multi-book reading challenge prompts
posts.description: I don't know if this has been added before but I couldn't find it if it has. I would love an option to set the number of books that needs to be read for a certain prompt before it is marked as "complete". At the moment you can add multiple books but you only have to read 1 for it to be marked complete. I would love to be able to set up challenges that have prompts like "read 5 classics" or "read 2 fantasy books" but the only way to do this at the moment would be (as far as I'm aware) set up a different reading challenge for each prompt or insert multiple of the same prompt into the reading challenge. I envision this as an extra button that says "How many books to be complete?" maybe when setting up the prompt (near where the current "bonus book" option is perhaps).

posts.title: Compare Stats - Pages/books read Line Graphs
posts.description: Hi - love all the stats features. In particular I track my pages daily for fun and look at pages read line graphs over time quite often. However I don't see the ability to see similar views in the compare feature. Is this something that could be considered in the future? Thanks!

posts.title: Q&A Feature
posts.description: I would love to be able to ask specific questions about a given book. Sometimes googling and reading all the reviews just doesn't cut it! I'd also be more than happy to answer questions as well--sometimes I'm quick with my reviews and it occurs to me later that someone might want to know more specifics about a particular content consideration. Maybe an opt-in setting to receive notifications when a new question is asked about books I own? LOVE this app, by the way. Thanks for all your hard work!

posts.title: Tie tags to a specific reading
posts.description: When I re-read a book, I'd love to be able to tie tags specifically to that time reading it. For example, I like to tag where I sourced a book. Maybe the first time I got it from the library, but then I bought a copy before reading it a second time. I think it would be great to be able to have the tags be accurate to each time I read the book.

posts.title: Tags with colour attribute used in custom stats
posts.description: In the custom stat graphs each segment can be assigned its own colour. Would it be possible to assign colours to my tags, such that when I include coloured tags in custom graph segments their colour is used by the segment? This way I can have consistent tag colours across stat graphs when the tags are re-used in different circumstances, without having to re-select the ‘correct’ colour in each segment the tags are used in.

posts.title: WordMap from reviews
posts.description: Not sure how possible it is, but it would be cool to see WordMaps made from your own reviews or journal entries on Storygraph in the Stats section. For those that don't know a WordMap is kind of a word collage usually created from words that are used very often. The more often a word is used the larger it would be on the collage. Hopefully it would exclude words like "the", "and", "a", etc. it would be cool to see words we personally commonly use to describe books and see the themes!

posts.title: Indicator for Tag already added to custom chart
posts.description: I love the new custom stats for pro users. My idea is at an individual chart level to either disable or add an indicator to the tags already added to that chart. For example I have a publisher chart and I don't need "Tor Publishing" twice but I can't tell if I already added it unless I scroll up and down my list. Thank you so much for the amazing Storygraph!

posts.title: Ability to mention (or '@') books, authors, users
posts.description: Idk if this is already on here (couldn't find it) but it would be awesome (though pretty unnecessary) to be able to 'mention' or '@' books or authors in our reviews. For instance, if I want to post a link to another book in my review i have to go get the link to that book's page, type in the title, then hyperlink it. But it would be cool to be able to type an @, type the first few letters of the book, select it from an autocomplete list (like the reading challenges), and then have it link automatically. It would also be really cool to be able to do this with author pages as well. Small suggestion, just an idea to think about for any UI overhauls :)

posts.title: Journal ratings
posts.description: It could be cool to have a rating option on the reading journal updates (where you can add notes) so you can see what you thought of the book at different points and whether the ending etc changed your impression - could then produce a final rating by averaging out the reviews instead of rating the book as a whole

posts.title: Search to-read by alphabet
posts.description: I have a thousand books in my to-read list, and it'd be so helpful if we can view only the books that start with A or B or C etc. so that we won't have to scroll all the way down if we want to view the books that start with P or something.

posts.title: Hide books with specified tags from lists
posts.description: I would really like the ability to hide some books from other users on Storygraph There are certain books I'd rather not show up for some people in my life. Yet, I want to include them on Storygraph because I still want to track my reading and I want recommendations based on them. So my solution has been to just not tell people I'm on Storygraph or recommend it to them, which is unfortunate. In addition to the current permissions on the To Read, Owned, Read, and Currently reading lists, I'd like to be able to hide certain books from other users based on an assigned tag in these lists . That said there are some people that I'm fine seeing an unrestricted view of my reading. So I'd like the option to mark them as a "Close Friend" so that the tag rule doesn't apply to them.

posts.title: Option to only avoid books with graphic content with "Content to avoid"
posts.description: The "Content to avoid" is an elegant way to stay clear of certain content without getting spoiled and I already love it a lot. I'm aware it's still in Beta, so maybe something like this is already planned, but I would love to have an option to avoid only graphic descriptions of something. Often, the little warning triangle shows up next to a book, and when I check the user-submitted content warnings, I see that the content is either moderate/minor or submitted by so few users that it could be a mistake. An option to only exclude graphic descriptions of that content in the preferences would be very helpful in some of those cases. Alternatively, it would already really help to see the severity of the content on the book page without having to open all content warnings and getting potentially spoiled.

posts.title: Books Grid View
posts.description: Allow for choosing a grid view instead of the current lazy loading list view for books lists.

posts.title: Hide star ratings
posts.description: I am just not interested in the completely subjectif star rating of the books I read, but I am very interested in written reviews. I'd love an option to hide star ratings when I read the reviews with written texts.

posts.title: Recommendations to include the book rating
posts.description: Include option, when requesting recommendation to include books or filter books based on their rating. The book market is producing masses of books nowadays but only fraction of them is good / worthwhile. I think giving this as an option to the users would allow us to get more meaningful recommendation.

posts.title: Audiobook length stats further broken down
posts.description: For the audiobook stats it would be great if we could have them broken down further on the pie chart. For example 8 to 16 hours is a really long range. It would be better to have that broken into 4 hour increments.

posts.title: Content warning request
posts.description: Could grooming be added to the list of content warnings please?

posts.title: Active buddy reads easier to access
posts.description: I would love having buddy reads show up on my front page. I find I forget about buddy reads I've joined by it not being visible and easy to access and there fore I don't end up reading the books.

posts.title: Voice Options for Notes/Reading Journal
posts.description: Adding a function to record audio when adding to your reading journal so that you can have audio to come back and listen to.

posts.title: Group prompts in a challenge
posts.description: For longer challenges, it would be be great to be able to group prompts. For example: I'm probably going to create one to keep track of my readings for the Hugos this summer. It would be great to create a group for best novel, a group for prozine, etc.

posts.title: Make owned a drop down menu with other choices
posts.description: I know we can make labels/tags, but can you make owned a drop-down menu that also includes Libby, library, kindle unlimited, or a custom option.

posts.title: ASIN/Independent Publisher
posts.description: I saw one post about this a couple of years ago; but I wanted to suggest this again. It would be nice to be able to add the ASIN for independently published books since those have risen in popularity lately. It can be a bit frustrating trying to add or select the right edition when it's published in e-book and paperback as well as various languages. Also maybe have a specific checkbox for "independent publisher" rather than have it as a search option. I appreciate all the changes y'all have made! The dark mode looks incredible.

posts.title: Display/rate anthology stories separately on a dedicated page
posts.description: I can imagine this would be quite complex, and it would require a lot of additional metadata, but: It would be lovely if anthologies and collections were a distinct kind of book with a chapter index displayed on TSG—ideally one where you can (optionally) input ratings for each part separately. The current choice to display a long list of authors works well enough, but being able to see which stories each author contributed in each volume would be next-level!

posts.title: ActivityPub support
posts.description: It would be really nice if you could add support for the ActivityPub protocol: https://www.w3.org/TR/activitypub/ This would make it possible for friends on, for instance, Mastodon to follow along. So from a personal perspective that’s interesting. I think from a business perspective it would be interesting as well: by allowing people on an existing network to follow activity here in The StoryGraph, many more people will get to know it and might start to use it.

posts.title: Recommended Debut Books/authors
posts.description: So apparently Barnes & Noble is no longer going to be stocking debut hardcovers. This is not great for new authors, but also it makes it harder to discover new authors. Some more detail here: https://bookriot.com/barnes-noble-hardcover-stock-change/ I'd really like to see a recommendation list that only includes debut books from the last 3-4 weeks. From that list generate recommendations I might like based on my reading. A Debut book/author would be defined as one where it is the authors first book or perhaps their first book in a specified genre. I would also like to be able to include or not include indies in the results and make use of the other filters available.

posts.title: Clearer indicator of NYP/pub date
posts.description: It would be great to have a clearer visual indication of titles that are NYP when looking at a list. I tend to add titles to my TBR before they are available. Later when I'm reviewing to pick a new book, seeing "first published in 2022" doesn't tell me whether it is now available or whether it has a pub date of later in the year. It would be great to have a visual marker for NYP titles and/or include a month with the year.

posts.title: In-app notification for closed book tickets
posts.description: I would like to be notified in-app when a book ticket I submitted is dealt with. As of now, we can only be notified by e-mail, or we are not notified at all. I receive a lot of mails every day, so I would love to receive a notification in the app or website rather than by e-mail.

posts.title: Different editions for rereads
posts.description: I often reread books using a different edition the second time. For example, first read was digital but second read is audio. As it is now, when you switch editions, the edition changes for all reads. Would love to be able to distinguish them. Thanks! 💖

posts.title: Add rating categories
posts.description: I find it difficult to assign a number value to very different books. For example, I may thoroughly enjoy a light hearted fiction read but not think it’s the highest quality I’ve ever read. So it may be a 5 for enjoyment, but a 3 for quality. Likewise, I may read a mentally demanding nonfiction. It may be a 5 for importance, and a 5 for research and effort, but it may have also been too long and dense and maybe I struggled to get through it for various reasons. It would be awesome to add it a bunch more categories for rating on the 0-5 at .25 scale to more accurately rate a novel. I think this would help me better connect with new books, too.

posts.title: Add "pages read" to Reading Journal that are not part of a book
posts.description: I've been eagerly awaiting the "not a book" features that just shipped, since I've been reading a lot of fanfiction and not a lot of novels. While the new feature will be really great for longer form fanfiction, I would love a way to track shorter items without having to go through the whole process of adding it to my library, having it be reviewed by librarians, etc. It feels a bit heavy handed for reading work that is less than 10000 words, but which I would really love to be tracking so that it doesn't look like I've been reading nothing at all for the last month 😅 My ideal way to track these things would be something like: - navigate to Reading Journal - have a button that says "track reading" - perhaps an affordance to ask me whether I'm tracking one of my In Progress books instead - then it basically takes me to a page like this, where it would have a field for Title, Date, Pages Read, and Summary

posts.title: recommendation carousal includes the star rating and possibly the genre/themes visible
posts.description: without having to click on the book to see what it’s rated and what it’s about. Or a quick view where you can hover over it to see those things

posts.title: Pages DNF
posts.description: It would be nice if pages from a book that you DNF was added to your page total

posts.title: Add More Review Questions and Randomization
posts.description: Adding more review questions may help in approving the recommendation AI. In order to prevent survey fatigue though, keep the same number of questions but randomization which ones users take. With hundreds or thousands of reviews on one book, the data for additional questions would be robust.

posts.title: Up Next from a certain tag
posts.description: I would love if I could set my up-next suggestions to read exclusively from a certain tag. For example: I regularly take part in a writing class and the book recommendations that come out of it are amazing. I tag each of them and I would love it if I could force my up-next suggestions to only read from that tag for a little while. Short term, it would be nice to have some extra info on the up-next suggestion panels to show tags, potential associated reading challenges etc...

posts.title: Reading Challenge Icon
posts.description: There used to be an icon on a book panel showing if the book had been added to a reading challenge I was participating in, but it was removed a while ago. I miss it! I'd love to see its triumphant return one day.

posts.title: Curated book recommendations
posts.description: I would love to see book recommendations curated by humans in addition to the recommendations and currently popular books. Either in a way where every user can curate "bookshelves" on a specific topic which can then be searched, or to include new or popular reading challenges, or recommendations of authors or librarians.

posts.title: Ratings floor for recommendations filter
posts.description: I may need to recalibrate based on how StoryGraph does things, but historically, an average rating of less than 3.4 or so is an almost always hard pass for me, so having a bunch of books in recommendations section less than 3.4 is not very helpful.

posts.title: User-Generated Page Total for Tracking
posts.description: Especially now that page tracking has become more common in the app, it would be helpful if there were a way for users to input the total pages in books they are currently reading. For example, once a user marks a book Currently Reading, there could be a place to enter the total pages in their copy of the book and this would be used to calculate their reading progress instead of the main page number from the publisher. So, say if a book officially had 400 pages but the story really ends on page 367, the user can put this number in so that once they reach that point it will show 100% instead of 92% and not add the remaining 33 pages to their pages chart once the book is marked Read. I am imagining this could go somewhere in the page tracking feature area. This would not change the publicly displayed page count but rather be an optional data input from users that would only affect their personal tracking. That way users can customize their page tracking experience to more accurately reflect their progress by simply entering the total pages once at the beginning without having to manually edit journal entries or do the math every single time they track pages. Might also help cut down on book tickets haha.

posts.title: Ability to log ad hoc reading
posts.description: I'd love to be able to add reading without it being connected to a particular book. This would be super useful for me in situations where I'm re-reading old comics I have from the early 2000s, where I don't want to enter every individual comic (both because that would be a ton of work and would ruin my stats for the year), but I'd still like to have a record of the reading I did. Or maybe as an alternative, having the ability to make a custom me-specific book that I could title "Amazing Spider-Man" or something and use it as a catch-all to track any time I read any of those comics (using journal entries maybe to track the specific issues I read at various times). I suppose I could technically do this now, but I wouldn't want to create a book that doesn't actually exist and clutter the database for everyone else!

posts.title: Compare TBR stats to stats for a certain time period
posts.description: I would love to be able to compare TBR stats to the stats for read books in a certain time period. At the moment you can compare TBR and all read books, but I'd love to be able to combine say only 2022 read books and TBR.

posts.title: Add a special badge to profiles that complete the January pages challenge
posts.description: I think it would be a fun idea to have a special badge on your profile if you complete the pages challenges. That way people can earn something even if they don't win one of the prizes.

posts.title: Filter for "Added to My Reading Challenges" Showing Books I Did Not Add
posts.description: When I use the "added to my reading challenges" filter on my TBR, tags, etc. a lot of books are showing up that I have not added to any of my challenge prompts. I'm not sure why all these extra books are popping up. So, especially when I'm trying to filter for books on my TBR to find my next read that will complete one or more prompts for my reading challenges, it's just cluttering things up.

posts.title: Invite people to challenges
posts.description: It would be great to be able to invite friends/people to challenges that you are hosting or think that others would like. Many of my friends are having trouble finding and joining challenges I host and sending an invite to their notifications would be much easier.

posts.title: Weighted averages
posts.description: I love the Plus stats with averages by genre, mood etc. What would make them even better is if they were weighted to account for the number of books involved. For example, in my all-time list, the number 1 genre is ONE book (Scott Pilgrim), and the 2nd and 3rd genres are both the same ONE book (Born a Crime). If the averages were derived from a given minimum number of books read, perhaps that might give a more accurate depiction, as the books in questions are outliers, notable exceptions as can be seen by the fact that they're the only books I've read in the given genres

posts.title: Hide Review in Timeline
posts.description: I would like to choose which reviews show up on my timeline for friends to see. Sometimes, I just want to review a book for myself, or get embarrassed that I read a certain book but still want the stats.

posts.title: New Adult
posts.description: I would love to see new adult added to genres, to help differentiate between books that aren't young adult and adult. The majority of the new adult books just don't have an audience label.

posts.title: Pages and Minutes Read chart
posts.description: The new “pages read” chart is awesome! Some days, I don’t get a chance to read a physical book, but do listen to an audiobook. It would be cool if we could add “minutes read” to the same chart. I imagine it could be similar to the “books and pages” read chart, but with 2 lines.

posts.title: Separate romance genre from romantic subplots
posts.description: I would like to have the option for romantic as a mood and have romance in the genre list be kept for romance genre books. Right now, when I select romance as a genre, I get a lot of books that maybe have a romance subplot, but are not romance books. In particular, a lot of fantasy series with a romance subplot show up (for example, Forged in Blood (https://app.thestorygraph.com/books/30b2ccde-73b4-4637-b4fd-aad9bbea069a) and The Wonder Engine (https://app.thestorygraph.com/books/6eff85ed-bf8a-402a-b9c9-bc9d3d2985a5)) when I'm looking for romance novels.

posts.title: Add Book Publisher Details Please!
posts.description: Can you please import the publisher name to each book's page? It would be nice to track over time whether I read more of a specific publisher's releases.

posts.title: Ways to consolidate repeat/very similar Reading Challenges
posts.description: I'm thinking particularly of the half a dozen or so "Read a book from every country" challenge. I don't necessarily mean that there could only be one challenge of a particular type, but it seems like we're losing a bit of the point of a public challenge like that when people are split across multiple challenges and you don't get all of the benefits of having a bunch of people recommending books for a prompt. Like there's 10 people doing one challenge, and 200 doing another, then those 10 people are going to have a lot harder of a time benefiting from other people adding books to prompts, even if both groups are doing the same prompts. Maybe something when people are creating a challenge there's a pop up that says "Here is a challenge that already exists, is this what you're trying to create?" or a way to import all of the books from a prompt in a different challenge to the same prompt in a challenge you're working on. Maybe just a way to sort the challenges by number of people or number of books added.

posts.title: Hosts can see challenge progress
posts.description: I would like it if I could see the progress of participants on challenges I'm hosting. Maybe visible to all participants when we click on the participant page?

posts.title: Functional Page Counts as Well as Total
posts.description: It would be nice to have the functional number of pages, as well as the total. For example, a book I'm currently reading has an index and a bibliography, so when I enter the number of pages read, the percent completed is depressed. I realize I can do the math myself, and enter a percentage, but if the StoryGraph tracked both, and used the functional one to calculate the percentage, that would be great.

posts.title: Recommendations Page: Add New Option to "I'm In The Mood For..."
posts.description: Add a recommendation to the "I'm in the mood for" filter that says, "Show me something outside my comfort zone" so we can discover new authors, genres, we would otherwise not have found under the main algorithm.

posts.title: Reading challenge lists
posts.description: The new reading challenge page with the filters and category options is great, but it's made it a little less easy to find new challenges - you now need to have a specific idea of what you're looking for to search/filter by, whereas before you could see a full list of all the challenges. Would it be possible to have the full list again, alongside the categories and filter?

posts.title: turn off community feed updates for my activity
posts.description: I don't want every review I post and every book I start, finish and dnf to show up on the community feed. It'd be great to have a setting where they are visible if a friend looks at your profile, but don't pop up on the community tab itself. Maybe smth similar to the checkbox goodreads has to add the review to updates before posting.

posts.title: On search, prefer results I have in my library
posts.description: When I search a book/author, I’d like to see a preferential list of results the shows me the matches for books /author I already have in my library. Example: if I have a book on to-read list already and search for a title match, show me that match first. For books with multiple matches, this saves a lot of time.

posts.title: Add Satire as a Genre
posts.description: I quite enjoy satire books, and it would be helpful to be able to search books by this genre

posts.title: Not for me status
posts.description: I'd love to have either a dropdown in the read status or a checkbox somewhere where I can mark that a book doesn't sound like it's for me (at least not now). I look at a lot of books and don't always remember the title/cover so then need to essentially keep reading info about them and then deciding it's not for me. I'm using a tag now but I'd like better options for this

posts.title: Challenge “Fit”
posts.description: I understand that the book lists shown in a challenge prompt only reflect the books that others have added. It would be helpful if we could add a count of how many people have added the book to give an idea of how likely it is that the book actually fits the prompt. Another option would be an AI-generated confidence score.

posts.title: Librarians to see list of tickets/actions they have completed
posts.description: There is a list of every completed tickets that every libraian can see, however there is not a private list that only the librarian who completed the ticket can see. It would be nice to see everything you have changed.

posts.title: Separate Reading List/Stats for Manga/Graphic Novels/Comics
posts.description: I've been quite hesitant to track my manga/comic/graphic novel reading on SG since I don't want to drown out my goals for reading traditional novels by sheer volume (it's very easy to read multiple volumes of those three formats in a single day in comparison to a fully text novel) so it'd be nice if they could, possibly (if doable), have their own separate reading list, annual goals/streak, and/or stats page. Or barring that if we could link a secondary account to our main account to view the stats of.

posts.title: Add reviews without reloading page
posts.description: This add review link leads to a new page but it makes leaving reviews and ratings more difficult/inefficient. Would be nice if it kept you on this page like marking read or owned is.

posts.title: Multiple Streaks
posts.description: I would like the ability to have separate streaks similar to how we can choose to set up the annual book challenge by [#] of pages, [#] of books, and [#] of hours listened. So in theory it could be I want to read this [#] of pages over [insert interval here] **AND** additionally listen to this [#] of minutes over [insert interval here] but while still having each of them be a separate streak instead of a combined one like it currently is.

posts.title: Show total books read on profile
posts.description: I recently passed 1,000 total books read, which was an exciting milestone! However, I was sad that my total number of books is now perpetually sitting at "1k" on my profile. It took 5+ years to reach this amount and I'd hate to have to go that long without seeing my progress along the way.

posts.title: Rate translator
posts.description: I didn't find a post that covered this, so maybe I'm the only person who would benefit from this, but it would be great to be able to rate the quality of a translation! A bad translation can influence the experience so much. My local library doesn't always have the physical versions of the original language, so I often find myself struggling to decide whether I will read the e-book in the original language or the translated physical book. And also, when I don't speak the original language, it can be hard to choose a translation without anything but my personal list of translators to avoid to go by. A star rating on Storygraph (either on the book page or the translator page) would be greatly appreciated! Thank you very much for all the great work you do and I apologize if this has already been mentioned somewhere and I just didn't find it!

posts.title: Limited Reading Challenge host messaging
posts.description: An opt-in for a limited communication to a challenge host, for a member to: * flag a book for attention * flag there is a missing entry This limited form means Hosts can get some communication about Challenge issues, whilst also limiting the potential for excessive random messaging. Use cases: - Book Challenge is the set of books from an award, and a new award has been given and so the new book should be added to the challenge - Book Challenges where the book is part of a set (such as an international award) but the wrong book has been selected - Book Challenges where there was more than one entry for a year but only one entry for the year was included in the Challenge In the absence of this, people just end up creating near identical challenges

posts.title: Sort by shelvedness
posts.description: I love the up next suggestions telling me the most and least shelved books on my TBR, is there a way to expose the entire sort order?

posts.title: Personal Physical Library Cataloging
posts.description: I think it would be really cool if the team used the existing robust metadata database and infrastructure to support LMS features comparable to something like Libib. Libib is a physical library cataloging application that allows you to scan your books in and keep track of them digitally. There are a lot of cool features that branch from this, like tracking who you lend books to. I know that currently you can already mark books as owned, so I think that leaning more into this LMS featureset would be really awesome.

posts.title: Custom charts when comparing stats
posts.description: When comparing stats (for plus users), I can only see SG's stats. I'd love to also be able to compare my custom charts.

posts.title: Edition date in year only
posts.description: When adding a new book manually, the system asks for a full edition publication date (year, month, day). Other sources never cite the full date, just the year, so I end up entering random months and days. Request: allow entering edition date by year only.

posts.title: Addiing "Editor" to list of contributors.
posts.description: "Editor" in both fiction and non-fiction is probably the most commonly used contributor in book data after author. When entering a new book manually it would be *incredibly* helpful to be able to tag a contributor as "Editor." I manually add a lot of academic non-fiction books.

posts.title: ISBN Formatter/Converter when searching/adding an ISBN
posts.description: When searching for or adding a new edition the ISBN has to be given without any separators/blank space. It would be great to be able to copy/paste the ISBN as it is from, for example, the publisher page and when pressing a button "Cleanup ISBN" or something like that, all "-" or empty spaces are removed. Or convert it automatically on "submit" into to searchable form. Otherwise I have to do this myself every time because in most cases an ISBN is shown in "human readable" (978-1-123-12345-0) form not as a simple string without separators.

posts.title: Make 'Pace' graph show your pace rating
posts.description: Right now, looking at the pace graph, I see that it's broken down by the pace rating of the book itself, not what I gave it. Would be great to have an option to switch that to look at my pace rating instead!

posts.title: Custom Chart for Personal Review Elements
posts.description: Can there be a chart that shows personal review elements for a book, versus the Storygraph review elements? By review elements, I mean the review of what moods, pace, genre, etc. I would like to see my stats using my own reviews, and then comparisons of the review elements that Storygraph uses. There is a couple of charts featured in the Pro version on the prior year wrap, but it would be awesome to have this all the time.

posts.title: Warrant Canary?
posts.description: Does The StoryGraph have warrant canary and if not would you be willing to set one up as a protection to account holders and a signal to media/journalists? Given the current political environment federally and in many states, I'd hate for The StoryGraph to be served a subpoena for account records and also be barred from publicly acknowledging it. I know it's an old school tool, but I'm hoping businesses and service providers might revive the practice. Thanks for considering! https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Warrant_canary

posts.title: Have the option to select which time a day ends
posts.description: I read past midnight a lot and I know I can just date back my reading to the previous day — I just find it quite tedious. I wish we had an option to select what time a day ends so my reading can be accurate without having to manually change the dates or set myself on another time zone. Personally, I would classify a new day as when the sun rises so I would put my time as 5 am.

posts.title: Search by Plot/Character Driven
posts.description: I have been wanting to read more character driven books lately, but my TBR list is over 2k books and there's no easy way to filter by plot type. I can search by pace, mood, genre, but even though there is a question of whether a book is plot or character driven (or a mix) this is the only statistic that doesn't appear to be searchable. Maybe could be coded as a conditional query since it's only applicable to fiction? Like if a user is searching and selects fiction the question of plot style pops-up? If that's too difficult to code (since there is not other functionality like that) it could just be always available like the other questions but is grayed out if the user selects nonfiction?

posts.title: Mark a book as Started or Finished on Apple Watch
posts.description: I'd love to be able to tap my watch and indicate that I'd finished a book and started the next. Anything to keep me from putting down a book and picking up my phone, please!

posts.title: Graph for pacing throughout book
posts.description: I would prefer to know how parts of the book are paced instead of the general pacing. Also when reviewing, if e.g. the start and middle was slow but the last third super fast paced, I'm not sure what pace to rate it as. I would like to have an option to rate the individual parts e.g. in a graph format with moving dots or at least 3 different parts - start, middle, end.

posts.title: Continuous Barcode Scanning
posts.description: I love the new cover-scanning feature, but it’s quite slow when cataloging hundreds of books. A dedicated ISBN barcode scanner mode for rapid, continuous scanning would be a fantastic addition! Being able to scan and add 50 books by barcode first, then review the editions on the shelf afterward, would be much faster than selecting and checking each book individually and reopening the camera each time.

posts.title: Automatic Number Challenges
posts.description: I like the Number challenge type. I think it would be really cool if the number is counting something that StoryGraph tracks, it could automatically add books. For example, I have a challenge to read 30 Non-Fiction books this year. When I set up the challenge, it would be really cool if I had the option to associate the challenge with the Non-Fiction genre. Then when I read something of that genre, it would automatically add it. That way, I wouldn't have to go in and add each individual Non-Fiction book one by one. There could still be the option to add everything manually for number challenges that don't correspond with something StoryGraph doesn't track.

posts.title: Custom charts - alphabetize tags in setup view
posts.description: I created two charts when the custom charts feature first launched for Author Nationality and Book Setting. These involved fairly long lists of tags, and when I first set up the charts, they were in alphabetical order. In the years since, if I read a book that is set in a new country or by an author in a new country, I have to remember as soon as I add the tag to ALSO go and add that tag to the chart. Sometimes I don't have the time to do this when I'm doing other things. This means that right now, I know that there are countries in my tag list that are not represented in the chart, but I have no easy way of finding out which ones because there is no way of reordering them. I'd love the ability to at least be able to reorder them in the setup view to be alphabetical so I can compare my tag list with the tags that are already associated with the chart.

posts.title: Color-coded Quotes
posts.description: I know we will have a quote feature coming, so I would like to add my two cents! I think being able to color code the quotes would be awesome cause then I would know why I'm highlighting that quote for

posts.title: Clicking on the Current Reads header on Homepage should take you to your current reads
posts.description: The other headers on the homepage (To-Read Pile, Recommendations, etc.) are all links to go to those pages. It would be nice if "Current Reads" worked the same way so you didn't have to scroll to the bottom on desktop to hit "view all".

posts.title: Share challenges with Storygraph friends
posts.description: It would be great to share the challenge I created with my friends on Storygraph (or also for any challenges that I am participating in). It seems hard to get new challenges even seen so this would help.

posts.title: Hide or collapse public ratings
posts.description: Now that SG has shipped the more prominent ratings that nearly everyone wants, it would be great for the minority of us to be able to hide or collapse those ratings. I much prefer NOT to see ratings before I read a book. We can avoid seeing them in the phone app, but not on desktop or a large tablet. Ideally, it would be nice to be able to collapse the whole review area for those of us that think of our SG experience as personal and private.

posts.title: Sort Read Book List by Rating
posts.description: I would love if under any/all of the Read Books lists (i.e. I choose to look at the list of fantasy genre only from the stats page or the entire list for the year or the adventurous books) can be sorted by rating. A filter by rating could also work instead, whichever is easier. I'd just love to be able to see my 5 stars as a secondary filter. Right now, if you use the rating graph to pull up just 5 stars, there are no sorting or filtering options available. That is also a solution that would work for me, adding filtering/sorting to the individual ratings page.

posts.title: Generate custom collage
posts.description: Looking at my wrapped, I discovered I am extremely stingy with my actual 5 stars, even though I have lots of 4.25, 4.5, and 4.75. I wish I could share those too as my favorite reads. This leads me to wonder if it’ll ever be possible to create custom cover collages for purposes like this one!

posts.title: Owned - switch to this edition
posts.description: Currently, if you’ve marked an edition as owned And you have all the other tags, and status attached to it, When you decide to switch to a different edition, it switches even the “owned” status, Which in my opinion, it shouldn’t Example, I own 2 editions, a hardback and the audible edition I’ve tagged and marked as TBR the hardback, when it came to reading the book, I’ve decided to listen to it instead and thus, change my tags and everything to the audible edition with the “switch to this edition” feature, But it switched the ownership too, I’d like to move from book to book, switching editions, without having the owned status changed, As I marked owned specific editions that I already own, Sometimes owning more than 1-2 editions, Thank you <3

posts.title: Toggle "not a book" from book count
posts.description: I would like to be able to choose to remove "not a book" entries from my yearly book count.

posts.title: Successful star rating personalization
posts.description: I would like to be able to customize my definition of a successful book. I don’t want the app to base my recommendations on 3 star reads which, personally, were pretty disappointing books. I’d like to be able to set the bar at 4 stars. Someone else might set it lower or higher.

posts.title: < 100 Pages
posts.description: I am a preschool teacher, and I read(and track for future reference!) a LOT of 100 page or less books. This feels like a pretty different category from 100-300 page books, but right not they are all lumped together. I’d love a different stats segment for this.

posts.title: A way to filter recommendations for audio format
posts.description: A way to filter when searching for book recommendations if a book has an audiobook format listed

posts.title: Withhold reviews on books published in the future
posts.description: Since this is not just a problem on Goodreads but it starts to happen here on TheStoryGraph I would like to share my wish to withhold reviews of a book before they are even published. I know that ARCs (Advanced Reader Copies) are given to readers in exchange for an early review and that in this case one would have to think about a way for this to still be possible while reducing the amount of reviews given just because someone is excited for a book. These reviews in particular make a rating for a book untrustworthy. I would like to add this video because I think it shows a nice way of maybe solving this problem: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=2R0oe2kxACs

posts.title: Option to mark certain charts as required tag
posts.description: I have some charts that I really want to make sure I have all the books tagged under: for example if the book is a series or a standalone. I would like to know the books I haven't marked so I can go back and tag them under this chart.

posts.title: Set no goal for the year
posts.description: I don't want to set a reading goal for the new year. Last year I did not set one, but I kept having the Set a reading goal button on my stats page which was annoying. This year I did set a goal. Wanted to do 0 but couldn't, so did 1. Hilarious for the percentages but not something I actually want. Could this maybe be changed for the new year?

posts.title: Reminder to Review
posts.description: In the options, or when finishing a book, it would be nice if you don't review right away to be given a reminder. So often I need a bit to formulate my thoughts on a book, I rarely write a review the second I finish a book.

posts.title: Option to exclude moods
posts.description: I'm trying to create a list of books that I can read before bed, and it would be much easier if I could exclude certain moods like "challenging", "dark", "tense", etc.

posts.title: See who owns a book on a book page
posts.description: When I look at a book page, and I see that one of my friends has read the book, I would also like to see if that friend owns the book, so I can potentially ask them to borrow it. Maybe as a small icon or text in the "see all activity" view.

posts.title: Tooltip on tag list
posts.description: Smol request, would it be possible to have either a tooltip or a way to expand the column width on the tag list? My tag list is lonnnnng and the individual names are also long, and there's currently no way to see the whole name without opening it in a new tab.

posts.title: Voice notes option for buddy reads
posts.description: I love using voice memos when doing bubby reads and would love an option to add them with the percentage complete

posts.title: Chart on number of reviews your books have
posts.description: Similar to the number of pages graph in stats analysis, it would be cool to have a pie graph that shows the number of reviews for each book, binned into categories (1-999 reviews, 1k-5k, 5k-10k, etc.). It could be a quick way to see if you are reading rare or popular books!

posts.title: Read books summary gallery
posts.description: I would love to see a visual spread of the books I've read over the course of the year or month, kind of like the yearly wrap up!

posts.title: Track Progress on Challenges
posts.description: Just like the way it tracks progress for yearly challenges (1 book ahead, 72 books behind) it would be nice to track the books ahead/behind for challenges that have a time frame - for instance the Storygraph Reads the World.

posts.title: Ability to include/exclude tags based on prefix
posts.description: I'd like to be able to go into my Read books or TBR and look at all books that I haven't tagged with a tag beginning with e.g. "author-nationality-" or "set-in-" or "on-tbr-". I can manually pick all of the tags that start with that prefix, but it can get unwieldy with a lot of tags in a particular category, and I have to repeat that manual action any time I want to look at this filter again. In other apps, this often gets accomplished by being able to type in "on-tbr-*" into a filter box, and that would exclude ALL of the tags that start with that without me having to manually select the tags. Having this ability would greatly speed up a lot of the "let me tag all of the books with this new type of categorization scheme" tasks I've been doing lately so I can quickly see how many I have left to tag for a particular tag-set 😄

posts.title: Secondary LGBTQ tag for Representation
posts.description: The current LGBTQ+ tag is too broad and could be off-putting for those people who absolutely encourage representation but wouldn't necessarily care to read a book with that as the main focus. It means that the entire tag has to be excluded when only a narrow section is actually problematic for those users. Would it be possible to roll out an "LGBTQ+ representation" tag that can go together with the existing one, to allow users to better refine what they're interested or willing to read and have recommended to them.

posts.title: View custom tags stats pages filtered by "read" time period
posts.description: Custom reports and new tag stats are amazing! I tag all the books I read for myself with a tag with my name. Then I tag all the books I read aloud to my child with a their name in the tag. But I've been using this tag for years. So now, when I try to view pro stats for the tag, it filters all the lifetime tag data. I would LOVE to be able to filter that view so I see only what I've read in this calendar year or this month. Like So, in other words, that filter logic would be: Tag = "Name" AND status = "Read" AND date is "2024"

posts.title: Author "Buddy read-style"/Behind-the-scenes notes/annotations
posts.description: [@yhurwitz](https://instagram.com/yhurwitz) just sent me this via IG DM: *"...do you have plans to make the buddy read feature available for an author to annotate/give thoughts/more background/behind the scenes that readers can then unlock through the buddy read feature as they get there?!"* I'd already thought of having a way for authors to add "annotations/notes" to their books but didn't think about them being hidden buddy-read style. I don't think it should be part of a buddy read per-se but the concept of locked notes by the author, which you unlock as you get there I think could be super fun! And could also tie in well with actually buddy reads, readalongs, and book clubs.

posts.title: Configure how many books are needed to satisfy a reading challenge prompt
posts.description: Thanks so much for your work on the new types of reading challenge! I'd love to see an update in the future where you can have multiple read X number of book prompts in the same challenge. For example, if you need to read 3 fantasy books, 3 sci-fi books and 3 literary fiction books for a challenge, then you could have one challenge with three prompts that won't mark themselves as complete unless three books are read for them. Hopefully my vision makes sense haha.

posts.title: Compare stats against other users for same set of books
posts.description: A neat Plus feature is Tag stats which we can also compare against another Tag. This is an extremely powerful feature as I can curate lists of books, then compare and contrast them e.g. competition entries from one year to the next. I would like to compare a curated list of books - i.e. the results assigned a particular Tag - against another TSG user in my Friends list. Most of the data in the Tag stats will be identical - moods, pace, length, genre - but some are unique to the individual - format, language, and star ratings, plus whatever gets added in future. In this case it’s the ratings that I’d like to compare - how did we each liked a particular set of books, *without* having to delve into each book individually to collate the information manually: Tag a set of books, compare against a user, view how we compare. This might be part of this request/work package: https://roadmap.thestorygraph.com/requests-ideas/posts/see-stats-for-all-users

posts.title: tbr search tropes
posts.description: similar to the new recommendations advanced search (love!), I want to search my TBR for tropes/themes/etc.

posts.title: Use book info to filter which books can be added to a reading challenge prompt
posts.description: For example, there are a lot of reading challenges that include prompts like "Read a middle-grade horror book", but, especially for bigger more popular challenges, the books added can be filled with books aren't middle grade, aren't horror, or both. It would be really nice if the person making the challenge could use the same setup as filtering your to-read list to filter which books can be added to a prompt. So you could say, only books marked BOTH horror and middle grade can be added. I know this would be a ton of work, but it would be really cool to see and really improve the quality of the books when you look through challenge prompts for recommendations.

posts.title: Reminder to update reading progress
posts.description: Sometimes I forget to update my reading progress and I would like to have a notification or email at a set time. Best thing ever would be that I'd be able to enter the page directly in the notification, just like a quick reply to a WhatsApp message.

posts.title: Add a button to get to read books
posts.description: It's really hard to find the /read-books/ page, so a button somewhere more prominent would be great!

posts.title: Add a “New” icon if new books have been added to a reading challenge category
posts.description: There are times when a reading challenge used to track sub genres for different genres (ex: Challenge: Horror, Categories: Classic, Haunted House, etc) can have a couple thousand books listed and a single book is added. But it’s SO hard to tell where it’s been added in the categories Having “New” or “Book added” for categories you’ve already gone through would be amazing

posts.title: Filter by multiple tags
posts.description: I’d like to look at books with a certain tag and then within that list filter to either show books that also have another tag, or exclude from that list books with a certain tag

posts.title: Rereading Same Edition
posts.description: I think it would be really nice for there to be better separation between reading periods when rereading an edition of a book you have read before. Currently, you can only replace your star rating in the review section. Being able to see each reread log (dates read and star rating) would be helpful when tracking stats.

posts.title: Add "reference" as an exclusive shelf
posts.description: I would love to be able to keep track of books that are meant for reference rather than reading from cover to cover – such as cookbooks, art and photography books, or even books that are compilations of essays of which I may only need to read a couple for research purposes. Shelving these as "to-read" skews the actual number of books on my TBR pile and shelving them as "did not finish" doesn't do justice to some wonderful books out there that shouldn't be penalised in their ratings just because of the nature of content that they entail.

posts.title: Add to Reading Challenge from Anywhere
posts.description: Right now you have to be on the book page to add it to a reading challenge. Would be cool if you could add it from your Read, TBR or Owned lists without having to open the book page. Also assuming that this would then allow you to see that it was added to a reading challenge from those lists, as you cannot see this now.

posts.title: "Only show reviews with written explanations" for users
posts.description: The exact same feature that already exists on a book's review section, but for users profiles. I sometimes read a really good review and would like to know what else the user has written, but often find that they mostly leave empty, star-only ones.

posts.title: Mass Delete Tags
posts.description: I started tagging my books, but I decided to start over when the list became unwieldy at over 200 tags. I realized now I have to individually delete all the tags, instead of marking the ones I want to delete and clearing them all at once. Could this be a feature? Thanks!! This site is great!!

posts.title: Track short stories individually (exclude from book finishing achievements)
posts.description: It'd be lovely to be able to rate, review, track, etc. short stories without worrying about which collection they happen to be in when you read them. This would involve inventing a separate class of object from "book", so I understand this could be a heavy lift.

posts.title: Option to count DNFs towards reading goal
posts.description: Maybe this has been addressed before, but will there ever be an option to count DNF’d books towards our yearly reading goal? Bonus brownie points if we could maybe decide if we want it to count or not depending on the book. For example, I generally count DNFs towards my reading goal, but if maybe I start a book on audio and I’m not enjoying it, I might DNF that edition and carry on with the physical book. In this last case, I’d probably want to mark the audio edition as DNF, so that those hours that I’d already listened to could be counted towards the total, and then carry on counting the pages in the physical book, which I’d eventually finish, but I wouldn’t want to count the book towards my yearly goal twice. I hope this made some sense 🫣

posts.title: Reading challenges on homepage
posts.description: Reading challenges are the feature I would say I use the most, and it would be cool to have them featured on the homepage in some way. Maybe challenges in progress, pinned challenges etc.

posts.title: Break the "religion" genre into different religions
posts.description: As someone from a minority religion, I hate "religion" as a genre. I don't want to see all books in "religion," because the vast majority of those books will be Christian. There's a big different in genre between books on Christianity, Judaism, Islam, Buddhism, etc.! "Religion" should exist for books that cross religions, but there should also be separate genres for unique religions.

posts.title: Merge different formats of book to acknowledge as the same book
posts.description: I'm not sure if this is something that has been stated - or if there can be a work around. I absolutely love how I can track my audio reading VERSUS my physical reading.
