However, if I mark a physical copy as owned and TBR but then read the audio edition, the physical copy stays on my TBR instead of acknowledging that I've read that book, just as a different edition. The same thing with tags - if I tag the physical edition, my tags don't transfer to the audio addition. Not an immediate issue or concern, but just one of the things that right now I have to manually correct. Thank you so much for all you do!!!

posts.title: "End" Buddy Reads that you do not own
posts.description: I've been in a few buddy reads with friends where interest fizzles out, but because I was not the one who started it, it just hangs out in "Current Buddy Reads" even though it definitely is no longer current. I'd like a way to move this Buddy Read into the list of "Past Buddy Reads" on my own account, even if it does not "end" the Buddy Read for everyone else. Currently the only option is "Leave" and for one like this one, it feels a little bit sad to leave, since there *was* commentary that we chatted about.

posts.title: Edit Genre (Just for you)
posts.description: I’d love a feature where we could set our own genres for the books were read (example: lumping together comic and graphic novels). I wouldn’t have it so you can edit the genres for all users, just for yourself. With the way I like to organize my books, setting a genre as a tag just doesn’t quite work. And sometimes I personally disagree with how a book has been labeled by the publisher so I’d like to be able to fix that for myself.

posts.title: Individual day stats
posts.description: I would really like a way to look at the stats for an individual day or custom period of time (so I could say I wanted to look at Jan 4th through April 7th or if I just wanted to look at one day I could input Jan 4th to Jan 4th). This would be nice if I'm trying to figure out how much I read and/or listened to in one day (especially when I do a reading challenge in a day).

posts.title: Audio stats in tag stats
posts.description: Could the new audio stats get added to tag stats? I've got a few tags that only have audiobooks in them and the headline looks a little sad since it says 0 pages!

posts.title: Link Audible/Kindle account
posts.description: Would it be possible to add a way to connect my kindle and audible accounts so that the book progress automatically updates?

posts.title: Line graphs to illustrate month-to-month
posts.description: I love comparing my stats from one month to the next (the main reason I have Plus!), but a line graph would make it 1000x easier! (One graph for moods, one for genres, one for tabs, etc.)

posts.title: Filter Challenges by Dates
posts.description: When looking for a new reading challenge I would like the option of filtering those that start/stop within certain months/years (ex: I'm looking to join challenges now for 2023). (Apologies if this has already been requested, I didn't see if when reading through)

posts.title: Save excluded/included genres under Recommendations
posts.description: There's a lot of genres I will never want to read, but every time I use recommendations, I have to add in all the ones I want and exclude all the ones I don't. This is currently quite cumbersome on the phone.

posts.title: PayPal option for Plus
posts.description: Right now, "The StoryGraph Plus billing, powered by Stripe" does not have an option for paying through PayPal. Would love to have that option!

posts.title: Update percentage read when entering pages for Buddy read comment
posts.description: I have noticed that when I put in the page I am at when adding a comment in my buddy read the percentage of the book I have read that I see on the home screen in the app does not update. Would be nice if that could be synced.

posts.title: Hide stats
posts.description: It would be great to be able to hide certain stats that I'm not interested in seeing (e.g. I would hide the fiction/non-fiction split as I only ever read fiction so its not as interesting to me)

posts.title: Generated book cover artwork montage images
posts.description: On my Profile page I can see images of the books I’m currently reading and have read recently. Is there a means of leveraging this to produce artwork that summarises things like: everything I read in [August], * ratings for my recent reads, sets of books by tag, etc? I’d like a little montage artwork that I can slap onto my Twitter to graphically summarise some search criteria, reading list or reading challenge, using book cover artwork in a grid or block of some kind. At the moment I get the book art and book details in a scrollable list when I’d just like a grid of artwork without any accompanying text.

posts.title: Option to unlock buddy reads comment regardless of your progress
posts.description: Right now, you can only open comments if you've logged enough progress on the buddy read book, however, there are cases where even approximate page numbers do not apply at all (in my case, a short story collection with the stories in a different order than in my buddy's book). To be able to see the comment my buddy left, I had to text them and ask them what page they were on and add that progress for my book. This is why I'd like to suggest a way to open a locked comment regardless of whether you have logged any progress at all!

posts.title: Synopsis as a drop-down text
posts.description: Instead of having to click on a book (and then click back to get back to your search list) to read the synopsis, a drop-down feature would be nice when you click or hover.

posts.title: List or simplified challenge view
posts.description: The challenges page can be pretty overwhelming once you've joined a lot of challenges. I'd love a simplified/condensed view (like a list view) to make it easier to see all of them. Even better would be to be able to sort and categories challenges (such as separating diversity challenges from 'read every book by X' challenges)

posts.title: Feature to track bookstores you’ve visited
posts.description: A way to track stats on bookstores you’ve visited such as location, date visited, etc that would show you how many bookstores you’ve visited in a year and over time

posts.title: Keep Progress Bar
posts.description: Lets say I read 20% of a book but stop and come back to it later. If I change from "currently reading" to "to read" the "track progress" bar disappears. It's still missing when I switch back to "currently reading" Is it possible to keep the progess bar there so when you come back to a book you know where you left off?

posts.title: Compare several months to several months
posts.description: It would be cool to be able to compare a few months to a few months, or to see just a few month’s stats (e.g. January-June 2021 compared to January-June 2022, or January-June compared to July to December, etc.)

posts.title: Ability to select moods and pace for dnf books
posts.description: I recently had to DNF a book and gave a short reason why. I suggest being able to select the moods and pace to dnf books as well. Right now the only way to select them is by marking a book read.

posts.title: Search all edition titles
posts.description: I saw that a friend of mine read a book I am currently reading, so I went to her profile and searched her read books for the title, but nothing turned up. When I asked her about it we found out that she had read a translation of the book, while I was searching for the English title. The search didn't include all editions of the book, so my search turned up nothing, even though she had added the book to her account - just the translated edition. As a reader who wants to talk to their friends about books, I don't really care which edition/translation they read, but I am interested to find books I can talk about to them. Is there any way the search could be optimized to search all edition titles of a book?

posts.title: Gifs in Reviews
posts.description: I would like to see the ability to add gifs and pictures in reviews

posts.title: Show which edition you've added or read
posts.description: When browsing books you've read or added to the TBR pile, it would be useful to see which edition it is (paperback, hardback, ebook, audio...) from the list without separately having to click "switch edition" to see which one is the current one.

posts.title: recommendations from to read pile
posts.description: i would like an option to get a recommendation from my to read file.

posts.title: Longest and shortest book read for each year/challenge
posts.description: Would love to see this in stats for the selected time!! Aka 2021 longest book I read was x words/pages, shortest is x words/pages.

posts.title: Breakdown of Recommendations
posts.description: I would love to see recommendations broken down by things like poetry, political science, etc.

posts.title: Add a buddy read from user page
posts.description: It would be great to be able to start a buddy read from a user's page directly. Separately, it would be great if my friends and following would pop up first when I search for people to start a buddy read with.

posts.title: Filter recommendations for publication year
posts.description: I want recommendations for books published in recent years. I can filter my "to read" list by original publication date - I'd like that same feature in the recommendations, please!

posts.title: See Currently Reading + Up Next
posts.description: Sometimes I add a book to currently reading but then change my mind to read something else from my Up Next list. It would be nice to be able to switch between these lists easily. Also it would be nice to see the Up Next list with book covers near the "Currently reading" section with book covers on the Profile page

posts.title: Show Books Written on Profile/Claim Author
posts.description: I know this won't be a popular or widely-needed suggestion, but I do know some authors who have reader profiles on The StoryGraph, and I think it would be really cool if there was an option to "claim" an author so it could connect to your user profile. Basically, I want to be able to see any books someone has written/published on their profile, if they have any.

posts.title: View Time within Tags
posts.description: It would be really nice to be able to go into a tag filter by books read within that tag and then by month/year to view what books you've read under that tag in a given time period. i.e: I tag my Own Voices books and would love to be able to view how many Own Voices books I read in a year or a month.

posts.title: Pop up description
posts.description: When you mouse over a book, it would be great to get a pop up window with a brief description. On the phone, you could tap to get a brief description with a More Info link.

posts.title: Enable Choice of progress defaultt
posts.description: I've read one dead tree book in the last 5 years, so it would be lovely if the progress could be set to the user's own choice of default, instead of defaulting to "pages". If I had a dollar for every time I've added a progress figure and THEN realised it was counted as pages not percent, I could buy another Plus subscription :)

posts.title: private ratings or reviews
posts.description: I want to share my reviews, but would like to keep my star ratings completely private. If this doesn't sound feasible, it isn't a major issue. Even the option for hiding the checklist, review and rating would be good. I don't mind people seeing what I read, I just don't want to share how I rate the books I read.

posts.title: Sync Libby audiobook progress
posts.description: If I listen to an audiobook with Libby, it would be great if it could automatically sync with The StoryGraph (basically, same as with Kobo, but for Libby audiobooks)!

posts.title: Do Not Buy / Recommend
posts.description: I currently use a tag for authors whom I have no interest in buying from again. The part that stinks is I have to basically do it for each book (or each first book in a series) to gently remind myself - hey you didn’t like these other books by them — DO NOT BUY, WISHLIST, etc. It would be really nice if we could somehow create tags for authors where it would tag the entire author and books they’ve written. This could also be expanded to have favorite authors, auto buy authors etc. I would love this type of feature and functionality and I think others (once they see it in use) might also enjoy it. It could then allow promos of author books to accounts that have them on specific lists - such as Rebecca Yarros - receive book updates from “following” or adding her to your Favorites List, etc. This could work similarly to following authors on Amazon. The key is that I am sure for favorites, etc it’s easier/more common than a Do Not Buy…I just hope that can be considered with this feature idea!

posts.title: Notification and question before adding book through integration
posts.description: Would it be possible to receive a notification that asks if a book should be added through the kobo integration. Now, if I accidentally open a book or want to read my notes on it, it directly marks it as 'reading'.

posts.title: Change edition for only one readthrough
posts.description: I would love to be able to switch the edition of one readthrough or journal entry. My particular use case is that I read one edition one time and a different edition the second time, but both rereads are listed as the edition I read the second time. I want to change the first to be the correct edition, but if I switch editions, it changes both rereads. I don't want to have to delete and remake the journal entries.

posts.title: Favorites- add from Add Review page
posts.description: It would be nice to have a box to check on the Add Review page to add a book to my favorites. 👍

posts.title: Additional Filters for To-Read
posts.description: I would like to see some additional options added to the To-Read page. The highest priority for me is to have a filter for books that I have NOT added to a reading challenge. I like to use my To-Read filtered on books I own to plan out my challenges. Currently I have to individually go into books to see if I’ve already added them to a challenge. With the new filter I could hide anything already added and start from a clean list. Additional options that could be helpful: filter by hours for audiobooks, filter by average rating.

posts.title: Auto Tagging
posts.description: It would be nice to have a way to format a tag automation for if we mark specific books in certain ways. For instance, I love to track all the books I've read for any and all challenges across multiple websites I use and would love to just have my book challenger tag auto every time I complete a book listed in one of my SG challenges. I would love to have anything I read in 2026 auto get my "2026 reading challenge" tag and similar.

posts.title: Add Pause Dates to Reading Journal
posts.description: My main argument for why I would like this is so that I can go back and update/manipulate pause dates for books that take me a long time but that I repeatedly keep forgetting to “pause”, such as my textbooks. If pause periods showed in the Reading Journal then I could theoretically go in and edit the dates for the pause and make sure it’s reflecting correctly. If there is an alternate way to do this, I’m all for that as well! I just want the ability to manipulate the dates Storygraph views a book as being “paused” and not counted.

posts.title: Goal stats: X pages/day remain
posts.description: I’d love to be able to see on the goals tab (or tap on them for another page or a popup) how much per {timeframe} I need to do to either catch up to current tracking or see what my average per {interval} is to hit my goal. Example I have an 800 hour goal for audio and I’m 60.58 hours behind. There has to be calculation in there already to do this right? Why not work forward too and show that I have to average X hours per {timeframe} (daily/weekly/monthly) to make my goal? I keep doing this math myself and it’s more depressing doing the math than it is seeing how far behind I am.

posts.title: Reading History Page Access To All Editions Read
posts.description: I would like to be able to have an easy way to access other editions of a book that I've read multiple times. I am meticulous about the specific edition/format while tracking reading. It's not uncommon for me to read the digital edition first and a paperback/hardback edition on a reread, etc. Currently, when you click on the view/edit read history from a books main page, you'll see the total number of times you've read that book with years listed and then more specific dates for that particular edition (see photo attached). It appears that the Reading History page is tied to individual edition Book ID. Would it be possible to either: A) change the Reading History Page to be tied to the Book Family ID and have links to each edition tracked, or B) have a link to other editions read on the individual Reading History page as it currently exists?

posts.title: Control over community tab notifications
posts.description: I would love to have a bit more control over what I share on my community feed. Mostly thinking of being able to opt out of sharing "Up Next"s, as well as "separate" ratings (i.e., books I have rated days/months after I have marked it as completed).

posts.title: View all comments in a Buddy Read if you DNF the book
posts.description: I’d love an option that allows all comments to be shown if a Buddy Read book is marked as DNFd. I’m currently Buddy Reading a book that I’m not enjoying and am tempted to DNF but I still want to be able to see and reply to my friends comments as she reads further. There can still be valuable discussion even if a book isn’t finished. Maybe there could be a button that lets you choose whether you see the comments or not.

posts.title: Profile Customization & Aesthetic Themes
posts.description: I would love to see the platform adopt a more 'cute and aesthetic' vibe similar to PageBound or Fable. I'd love to have more ways to customize my profile, like changing my picture and adding a header image (think Twitter or Tumblr). Plus, choosing different color themes would be awesome for making it feel more personal and visually appealing.

posts.title: Open source the app code
posts.description: If you published the code on github or similar, I would consider helping address issues in the backlog. I bet other users who want to support you would, too.

posts.title: Let users choose the book page's buttons sizing on mobile
posts.description: Inside the preferences page on mobile, users can already choose between a compact or a detailed view for their current reads layout. I'd like if there was a similar option also for the book page where we can choose between the previous layout (more compact and small) and the newest one (bigger). One day this option could be extended to apply changes to all the buttons and texts on the platform as an accessibility feature, but for now it would make both who likes the new sizing and who doesn't happy.

posts.title: Compare stats scales for No. of books read
posts.description: When I compare stats (say across 2 years) the scaling used for the No. of books read in the charts for Genre, Tags, Authors, and Star Rating do not match. For example if I read a lot more books in 2024, the x-axis may extend to 6, but the x-axis for 2025 only extends to 4. This makes it hard to visually compare stats based on the length of the bars. 3 books in 2024 would be the same length bar as 4 books in 2025, making it appear based on a glance that I read the same amount both years.

posts.title: Visual for how book moods correlate
posts.description: With the new update I was thinking more about the mood chart and I started thinking about how the moods are distinct from each other in the chart, but books usually include more than one. I think it would be really neat to have some way to show how often moods correlate with each other. For example, a book that's funny and lighthearted is pretty different than a book that's funny and dark. Looking at my top two moods, a combination of them accounts for about half of #1 and 2/3 of #2, so it would be interesting to see what the other related moods are. Right now, if we click on a bar, the book list ONLY shows the mood we clicked on and not any of the others that the book has, so it's kind of difficult to see easily.

posts.title: Filter Edition options are saved
posts.description: When searching through editions of books, I think it would be a slight improvement to have your filter options saved to a default chosen by the user.

posts.title: Add isbn validation on camera scan
posts.description: When using the camera scan to read a ISBN, sometimes it reads it incorrectly. I guess it is inevitable as the photo could be bad quality, a number could be a bit cancelled, and so on (even if sometimes it can happen also with good quality small ones, like confusing 6s with 8s) The last digit of a ISBN is a check digit though (both in ISBN 10 and ISBN 13), so it's very easy to check if a ISBN is valid or not by checking this digit. It would be nice to add a validator to the camera scan, so if the wrongly scanned ISBN is not valid, it can give a popup error saying it can't read the isbn, rather then redirecting to the book import page autofilling it with the wrong ISBN, which could lead to people trying to import wrong ISBNs or adding those manually, or simply thinking that their book is not in storygraph even if actually it's already present, and by scanning again maybe they would find it. Some reference for ISBN validity algorithms: - https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISBN#Check_digits - https://www.geeksforgeeks.org/dsa/program-check-isbn/

posts.title: Make Dewey Decimal Easy to find
posts.description: I want to see the dewey decimal call numbers for nonfiction books so it’s easy to browse the physical stacks at my public library.

posts.title: Click to generate AI features not immediate generation
posts.description: For those who keep the AI features on, it would be nice if the AI did not generate until a button was clicked to request it for that book profile. This would help cut the energy expense by AI to only happen on request and not as a default for people who leave it on but don’t need it for every book profile they look at.

posts.title: Link Owned Books with another User
posts.description: My partner and I share a book library (and have for many years) and I would love if we could have a shared 'owned books' section. If they were linked, we could both benefit from using the 'owned' filter in To-Read Pile and other bits of functionality.

posts.title: Weekly stats
posts.description: Sorry if this topic exists elsewhere and I couldn’t find it! I’d love to see more stats for weeks—we have lots for days and months. I know we can run custom dates, but I’d love to see built-in stats for weeks in the streak page and/or general stats page. Especially since my streak goal is weekly, I’d love to compare week to week in addition to day to day. I remember you were looking for more plus streak ideas so maybe this helps!

posts.title: Prefix tag typing
posts.description: As of now, when I want to add a tag to a book, it matches the typed string in the entirety of the words ("fulltext"), instead of their beginnings. Example: starting to type "bo" will keep listing all the tags having "bo" in them like "notebook", "nabokov", etc. instead of showing "botanical" which starts with those letters. I always have to type the entire tag for it to appear without scrolling. Would love for that to change!

posts.title: In Progress books on monthly wrap up
posts.description: I love the monthly wrap ups! I've been working my way through a long book over these past few months in addition to one shorter book, so my page numbers show 500+ pages but only 1 book finished. It makes it seem like that one book I finished is way longer than it actually is. It would be great if we could show books that were in progress, but not finished. Maybe in the corner like the books are displayed in the calendar wrap up? Thank you for considering, and for all the work you put into making Storygraph so awesome!

posts.title: Current reads scroll feature
posts.description: I think a scroll over feature on the main page in the compact current reads layout would be nice, because I tend to read more than 3 books at once, and when I want to update a book that I am reading but it is not showing I have to click view all button. I just thought it would be nice to be able to scroll over like you can with the to-read pile and the recommendations, sections on the homepage of the app.

posts.title: owned books as tags
posts.description: Could the "owned books" also work as a tag? So we could also have graphics for the owned books

posts.title: Social Media-Like Community Feed
posts.description: I’d love to see a community feed feature similar to Fable's, where users can share their reviews and reading updates. But also post things like book lists, photos of current reads, book hauls, and even links to YouTube videos or blog posts. Essentially, a space where users can treat their feed like an Instagram/twitter combined timeline but focused on books—creating a more interactive and engaging experience for the bookish community. The idea of being able to delete all my other "social" media accounts and just focus on one book-themed platform is everything that I want!

posts.title: Notes for Submit by ISBN
posts.description: When I submit a book by ISBN, it usually takes days or even weeks to be processed. It would be helpful if we could tag these submissions with a little note for ourselves, because by the time I get the message saying it couldn't be imported that way, I've often forgotten which book I submitted.

posts.title: Tag automation
posts.description: I wish there was a way to make a tag and have it automatically add books to it using filters so I don't have to manually add it every time. Ex: If I want to have an "owned tbr" tag I could have it set to "want to read" and "owned" filters and any books that apply to both these filters get added to the tag automatically.

posts.title: Unique Books Read stat
posts.description: It would be great to have a stat for the number of unique books read; so that if I read Book1 in ebook, and then later in audiobook, the "Unique" books stat would only count that as 1 book.

posts.title: Ability to see past Roadmap posts
posts.description: I know that I've made several posts/suggestions here before, but it's almost impossible to find them unless I remember exactly how I worded it.

posts.title: please please get rid of the AI
posts.description: it was fine but now AI’s become super mainstream and is taking creatives jobs and sucking the joy out of so much, it just seems wrong to still have it on such a brilliant app. If more librarians are needed to fill the gap, lots of people would be willing to help (myself included).

posts.title: Why a books fits a challenge
posts.description: I would love for there to be a space when adding a book to a challenge that states why the book fits the challenge. I have looked up around the world challenges and have seen books added that are not set in that place, so maybe the author is from that place or maybe it’s a different reason it fits the challenge.

posts.title: Date Picker allow typing
posts.description: For the date picker you can only select dates via picking from the calendar, it would be really great if you could type (sometimes faster if it's not the current month) and have it pick the date that way!

posts.title: Filter/warn on books used for multiple prompts in Reading Challenges
posts.description: As either a Reading Challenge creator or entrant, I'd like the ability to warn that a single book is currently being used to complete multiple prompts on a Challenge. I'm in a few challenges where I've added multiple books to each prompt, and some of those books are in multiple prompts. Maybe the easiest way to do this would be to visually identify which book is currently being used to count a Prompt as "completed"? I could scan those and remove duplicates in other prompts.

posts.title: Reading Challenge condensed view
posts.description: I have private reading challenges where I add many books to a single prompt over the course of a year, so 6 prompts each with over 20 books. With the new challenge page design, I have to scroll a lot to get to the lower prompts. I'd like a way to see all the prompts and the number of books added to each, similar to the view when adding a book to a challenge. Maybe a way to toggle a condensed view? Even just a way to collapse the giant green boxes or limit the number of book covers shown would help. This is a core use-case for me and it's pretty painful right now.

posts.title: Add books to reading challenges without using them for the prompt
posts.description: Apologies for the confusing title 😅 What I mean is: I would like to add books to reading challenge prompts as a suggestion to other participants, but I don't necessarily want to use that book for myself, for that prompt. Sometimes, especially in challenges without set dates or challenges I created, I will add a book I have already read (because other participants might find it interesting), and the prompt will be marked as complete. I wish I could keep that book in the prompt, but not use it to complete the prompt for myself.

posts.title: Graph of years read
posts.description: I'd love to be able to create a graph or chart showing the publication dates of the books I've read. (This is probably on the roadmap, but I didn't see it.)

posts.title: Spell Check on Book Reviews
posts.description: Is there any plan to perhaps add a spell checker to the book review "box"? I think I have caught most of my mistakes, but it would super helpful to have an internal spell-checker!

posts.title: Partially Complete Streak Graphic
posts.description: I love the little two-toned flame graphic for streaks. Every time it fills in, I think it would be fun to adjust the feature so that if you only read a portion of your streak goal (10 pages instead of 15), then only the inner, light orange part of the flame would color in. (Right now it just stays empty if you partially meet your streak.) When you meet your streak, it colors fully as usual. It would work as a nice visual reminder that you've started but still have a little way to go.

posts.title: Stats by pub. date
posts.description: I would love to be able to look at my stats page and see data for books based on publication date. Like, how many books I read this year were pub this year v last year v last 10 years v 100 years ago, etc.

posts.title: Grid View Format for Book Collection Management
posts.description: I would like to suggest a new feature to enhance the user experience when managing book collections. The current column format, while functional, is not ideal for reviewing and organizing large collections. Here is a proposal for a grid view format, similar to the interface used in other collection solutions, which I believe would greatly benefit users: Proposed Feature: Full Page Grid Format Description: Implement a full-page grid format for displaying book collections. This grid view would allow users to see their books in a more visually intuitive layout, making it easier to review and organize their collections. Key Features: Grid Layout: Display books in a grid format, showing book covers and key details such as title, author, and status (e.g., owned, to-read, currently reading). Advanced Filtering and Search: Integrate robust filtering and search functionalities to allow users to quickly find books based on various criteria such as genre, author, reading status, and more. Customizable Display Options: Allow users to customize the information displayed in the grid (e.g., book rating, date added) and the size of the book covers. Batch Editing: Enable batch editing options to make it easier to update the status or details of multiple books at once. Collection Organization: Provide tools for better organization, such as sorting by different attributes and creating custom collections or shelves. Benefits: Enhanced Usability: A grid format offers a more visual and user-friendly way to browse and manage large collections. Improved Organization: Advanced filtering and search capabilities will help users quickly locate specific books and organize their collections more efficiently. Customizability: Users can tailor the display to their preferences, enhancing their overall experience on the platform. Visual Example: Attached is an example image from Collectorz Comic Collecting software that illustrates the proposed grid layout. This layout allows for a clear and concise overview of a large collection, which can significantly improve the user experience when managing books.

posts.title: DNF shows over rating
posts.description: A friend went to the book page for a book I'd recommended and saw that I had DNF'd it. It's true that I had DNF'd my reread, but I had read and reviewed the book previously. She was not shown my rating/review from my original read.

posts.title: Change how spoiler text is hidden in reviews
posts.description: Recently tagged spoiler text in reviews changed from a drop down to a blacked out bar. Whilst I agree the drop down wasn't always ideal, the black out bar has its own problems as if someone writes a long spoiler text it creates a huge redacted section which can be hard to read (at least for me) and hard to scroll past if you are skimming reviews. Would it be possible to have both options available? So you can choose to do a small blacked out section or a longer drop down spoiler? Or maybe just a way to condense long reviews in general? Similar to the "read more" tag they have on tumblr which cuts off a post at the tag and reveals the rest when you click through/drop down. Would make looking through reviews a lot easier especially on the app where it takes longer to scroll. Would also make me feel less bad for leaving a longer review and clogging up the page

posts.title: Starring journal entries
posts.description: I've started using the journal entries feature more and more for saving favorite quotes and I wish I could star entries for quotes I REALLY love and want to refer back to. I could even imagine wanting a "Starred Entries" collection somewhere that pulls together starred entries across books so I can see all of my favorite quotes from different books all in one place.

posts.title: Filter Stats by Type
posts.description: I read a lot of short stories, and some graphic novels and comics. I'd love to apply a filter to all stats (like a drop down below the dates) to, say, show books only, or short stories or nonfiction or poetry only--probably would be good to also be able to filter by eBook, print, or audio.

posts.title: Progress Tracking by Chapter instead of/in addition to % or pg #
posts.description: It would be nice to be able to track my progress with Chapter numbers instead of/in addition to tracking my progress with percentages or page numbers. I typically read books multiple ways (e-book/audio or audio/physical) and so knowing what chapter I am on is important. Currently, I use the Journal entry portion to keep track and that works well. It just would be nice to see that at a glance instead of having to open up the journal entries. I'm not sure if this would be helpful to anyone other than me, but I figured there is no harm in asking (◕‿◕)

posts.title: Custom tag importing
posts.description: Every time a new Instagram story gets shared with other people's custom charts, I'm like "ohhhhhh those are incredible, guess I'm going through and tagging ALL my books again" 🤓 I wish there was a way to do something like: - export my spreadsheet - update a field in my CSV with new custom tags, because going through all the books there is currently a lot faster than doing it in the UI - re-import the CSV and have the new tags be reflected in the UI to seed new custom charts I guess another idea would be an API to post to 😅 but really just some way of updating ALL my data quickly. I know there is another ticket for bulk updating in the UI itself, and maybe that would meet my needs, but I feel like for the task of "update every book with "Country Setting" tags", that would not be an easy case for bulk updating to solve because there isn't an easy way to filter on all the books from a particular country that I would want to tag at once.

posts.title: Share streak to social media
posts.description: It'd be cool to be able to share your streak to social media

posts.title: Publication Year vs Read Date Chart for Custom Timeframe
posts.description: I wish that the published year v. read chart and the line chart for books read over years could show up if there was a multi year custom Timeframe- in the case of the published year v. read I think it could even work on the yearly stats pages too

posts.title: Swap out books in Book Reading Challenges
posts.description: I realized belatedly that I picked the wrong book in a series for a reading challenge that I put together. There's no way for me to leave my prompt and description intact and get rid of the wrong book and swap in the right one. Instead I have to: - add numbers to all of the prompts to make sure they stay in the right order (something I had not previously needed to do) - make sure I copy the description - delete the entire book - add a new book - pick the right book and paste in the copied description - make sure I put the right number in the prompt so it will go back in the right order I really wish I could just do a swapperoo right here!

posts.title: Buddy reads: share invitation link
posts.description: Besides having to invite users by adding them manually, could it be possible to have a shareable invitation link of the buddy read? So that users can join them directly. You could also add another level of “privacy” for public buddy reads, where an user can request to join one and the host has to approve them. I imagine this could be implemented more easily once the navigability improvements of public and available to join buddy reads are released.

posts.title: Option to exclude books from personalized preview
posts.description: I use the personalized preview a lot and like it so far. The following are ideas to improve it even more: Exclude books... - I did not rate / review at all from the recommendation - I rated poorly (e.g. below 2.5 stars) - I have on my TBR We already have the survey for recommendations, which I like and use. It would be nice if it was used for the personalized preview as well. For context, I added all my child and teenager reads to StoryGraph, but without review or rating. E.g. the whole Harry Potter is something I would most likely not enjoy as much today as I did twenty years ago, but I don't want to rate it poorly to exclude it from the preview or recommendation. But more often than not I see it as a reference for books I might enjoy, which is most likely not true. The same goes for books I read recently, but did not enjoy as much and rated e.g. 2 stars. That's not a good reference point to me for a preview recommendation when I also read books of the same genre which I rated 4 stars or better in a similar time frame. But those books also appear in the personalized preview. And lastly I use my to read pile also as a point of reference for me to not forget about certain unpopular books. Those do interest me, fair enough, but I did not read them, so I think they might be a weak reference for the recommendation in the preview at best.

posts.title: Add Acquired tag to reading logs
posts.description: Include a dropdown for users to track how they acquired the books they are reading. Drop down could include the following: Owned, Borrowed, Gifted, Library, Kindle Unlimited, ARC, Giveaway, Review Copy, etc. It would be awesome to see this as a pie chart in the stats page as well! I did this manually for my 2023 reading wrapped and it was awesome to see both the Format of the book (Audio, Digital, etc) and Acquired next to each other, especially seeing how much I utilized the library and seeing if my subscriptions were worth the money. This may also be helpful for users reading reviews to know if the reviewer was given a copy as promotional material and adhering to FTC's endorsement guidelines.

posts.title: Add Book Setting Details
posts.description: Adding the ability on the book details page to add or tag the location the story is set in. Would be nice to say the country as well as city and or state (US). Maybe even more details like the year it's set in?

posts.title: Add a user profile option to automatically receive book ticket notifications
posts.description: An option in the profile settings to automatically receive notifications when you book ticket is closed/complete. Right now users have to check the box to receive notifications each time they send a book ticket in. Can you add a profile option to automatically turn on notifications for every book ticket without checking my box? Also. could this option be part of the in app notifications feature already requested by user. I would link the post if I knew how to do that in this roadmap section.

posts.title: Ability to search by author & mood
posts.description: Ability to search or filter recommendations by author & mood. Example: looking for a Brandon Sanderson book that has “funny” as one of the top moods.

posts.title: Multiple to read lists
posts.description: Multiple to read list in order easily access different kinds of books you may want to read. For example I would like to compile a list specific to books related to my work and not have to sort my entire to read list to find them.

posts.title: Markdown Formatting in Reviews
posts.description: Being able to format text using some basic markdown. I'd particularly want to be able to add links, footnotes, a horizontal line (with '---'), and markdown implementation of existing formatting options (bold, italics, lists, strikethrough, etc.) Please! Hopefully it wouldn't be too hard to implement, and I literally paid for Plus so I could suggest this feature.

posts.title: Manually set end page in currently reading
posts.description: I'd love to be able to enter a custom end page in the currently reading section. Many times books will have an afterword or other content unrelated to the story that I may just want to skip. However, hitting marked as finished makes it seem as if I had read all those pages when looking at my stats.

posts.title: Currently Reading Stats
posts.description: I'm craving a stats segment for my books that are in the "currently reading" stage, similar to the options for read, to-read, DNF, and owned books

posts.title: Add new entry to reading journal
posts.description: Hi, I'd like to be able to add a new reading journal entry (after the day of reading). An example to clarify - I have been reading every day, so I have been entering my days read each day, but sometimes I forget to add it on the day of, so I add it the next day then edit the entry and change the date back to the previous date. However, i've missed a day and now finished the book - so it jumps from 1 July as my last day read, to 3 July and finished book, so it has broken my streak. I'd love to be able to add an entry to 2 July to fix.

posts.title: Increase Font Size In App
posts.description: I am not sure if this has been brought up before, but I was wondering if there was any chance that there could be a way to up the text size in app? (or maybe work more fluidly with the text size on people's phones?) I know a couple of people who have issues reading small text, and they usually have larger texts on their Ebooks as well! I think it would be beneficial.

posts.title: To-Read and Owned Stats
posts.description: Would it be possible to see the stats breakdown for the books marked as to-read AND owned? I mark basically every book I hear about as to-read lol, so having the option to see the stats on which and what kind of books I own but have yet to read would be amazing

posts.title: Add Western as genre
posts.description: I was kind of surprised recently that Western wasn't available as a genre. Maybe it's because I'm American, but our bookstores often have several shelves of "westerns." I guess Western counts as a sub-genre of historical, but I feel like it's distinct enough to count as its own genre. And sometimes it's not historical, like a lot of modern western romance. I was looking for some weird western books and thought I'd be able to just filter for Fantasy and Western, but couldn't. (I have added it to my preferences, but not all the books that show up are weird western and filtering fantasy and historical doesn't get me what I want.)

posts.title: Add option to vote on buddy read selection
posts.description: Choosing the next buddy read often includes voting on different book options to select the next pick. I'd love an option to propose buddy read books and have the other users vote on them directly in the app so we don't even have to leave StoryGraph for this part.

posts.title: Adding Notes & Highlights From Kindle
posts.description: On the kindle you can pull your highlights and word look ups. It would be great to be able to upload the file to my progress report and have it saved on your database and easily searchable. I know that this is probably low on the important updates, but it would be great.

posts.title: Buddy Read Onboarding Flow
posts.description: If you ask a friend to create a SG account so that they can join your buddy read, it will be awkward. Your friend won't know about SG, so they are likely to create their account with the default security settings -- thus you won't be able to add your friend to the buddy read, because their username will not appear in the search. To get them into the buddy read, you'll have to ask them to change their settings (if you can even figure out the problem yourself). By this time you start to lose their attention -- but even if they do it, it still may not work. In my case I wasn't able to add my sister after we went through this (which seems like a bug, but I don't know if she followed my directions), so finally she created her own buddy read and invited me instead. Buddy Reads is a great feature in itself, but also a great way to get people to join SG, so I think this flow needs to be smoother. I don't have a clear suggestion for how to do that however. It might be as simple as changing the default settings. Or maybe there could be a flow for inviting friends to buddy reads who don't have accounts, which sets up their account to allow the invite to happen, or auto-joins the buddy read for them if they click accept.

posts.title: Limit books that show up under 5 Star Reads
posts.description: Many of the books listed on my profile under 5 Star Reads are ones that I read years ago. I may not remember a thing about them, or my tastes have changed, or I no longer want to support the author. It would be nice if I could hide this section, or set it so that it shows only 5 stars reads from the last year or 3.

posts.title: RSS Feed of Reading Journal Entries
posts.description: I have a bit of an automatic life-feed journal in Day One that's fed via IFTTT integrations and I used to use the GoodReads RSS feed to journal book progress. Now that I've left GR behind for StoryGraph, I would love to be able to utilize a similar functionality.

posts.title: Share to Mastodon
posts.description: I'm in The StoryGraph's bookstodon instance, and I'd love to be able to automatically share books I've finished reading along with my rating to Mastodon instead of Twitter.

posts.title: Be able to add star rating from the book page
posts.description: When you add a book to your read list from a book's main book page, the option to add a rating from there should also be present alongside read dates. Currently, we have to go into the review section to do it, which is kind of tedious.

posts.title: Show decade published in stats
posts.description: A bar graph or chart that shows which decades you read the most books from- to help diversify readings in terms of contemporary or classic

posts.title: New status for books not yet in to-read or books owned
posts.description: I would love a new status other than finished, reading, etc. to describe books that are catalogued but not currently in my “to read” pile—such as books further along in a series. Books that are just marked as “owned” without a status don’t show up in general searches. I tried using a ‘stacks’ tag for these books, but again they don’t show up in searches without a status attached.

posts.title: Genre and fiction/nonfiction stats by pages read
posts.description: It would be nice to be able to see pie charts for percent pages read by genre like we have for completed books. I tend to read longer nonfiction books compared to the fiction I read, so the “by book” stats don’t necessarily reflect percentages of my reading

posts.title: Author's Writing Style "Moods"
posts.description: I'm wondering if maybe when you are able to incorporate more author stats and pages, would it be doable to be able to select "moods" for the authors writing style, not just the story? For example, I read two books in a row that made me wish I could differentiate between the two. The first I really enjoyed the authors writing style but not the story, and the second I enjoyed the story but not particularly the writing. Perhaps there could be a similar tag system as the moods for the story but with writing style tags, e.g. "lyrical", "prosaic", "classical", etc.

posts.title: Filter by tags in up next suggestions
posts.description: My library doesn’t have every book in my to read list, so I added a tag, which allows me to exclude non-library books throughout. The downside is that it doesn’t work on the up next suggestions list, which means the app keeps suggesting books I have to pay for. I don’t want to remove these books from my to read list and I don’t know if another way to keep track of them. Allowing include/exclude tags in the suggestions would solve this problem and allow for more fine tuned suggestions, like for a book club or specific challenge.

posts.title: Manual sort for To Read list
posts.description: Apologies if this has already been posted but I'd love a custom sort for the To-Read list. This could function similar to how the arrows work in the Up Next list and could just be a new sort option in the filters.

posts.title: Updating default "Mood" for books
posts.description: It'd be nice if the main mood(s) listed for a book matched what reviews have tagged it as. For instance, the Orange manga has "light hearted" as its mood, but the top 3 moods tagged by reviewers are "emotional, sad, and hopeful," and it deals with heavier topics (such as suicide).

posts.title: Estimated ratings
posts.description: Not sure if this is feasible, but it would be great to see what StoryGraph *thinks* my rating of a book would be based on other books I've rated and how similar users have rated a book.

posts.title: Ability to end free trial early
posts.description: It only took a few hours to figure out that I wanted a Plus membership, but I couldn't find any way to purchase one until my free trial had officially ended.

posts.title: Sort by missing information
posts.description: Feature to sort by missing information would help help users sort their shelves buy the books that are missing information so they can either get rid of those books or add the information to them

posts.title: Count audio and non-audio books separately in reading/page/hours goals
posts.description: When looking at stats I wish the first stat stayed the same (total books) then I wish the pages read challenge only had read books in parentheses and then minutes listened only had audio books.

posts.title: Show me my next read randomizer
posts.description: I would love to push a button and one random book off my TBR, I can't choose sometimes and I just want to let the Random choose for me.

posts.title: Add ability to filter based on review attributes
posts.description: I’d like the ability to filter and search for books based on the attributes that are filled out during reviews like strong character development.

posts.title: Add “Read Recently” Sort option to tags
posts.description: It would be great to be able to filter my tagged books by read recently. I recently updated information on a bunch of books I read a while ago, and now I can’t set my tagged books to sort and show books I finished recently.

posts.title: Stats for books added
posts.description: This is a pretty shamelessly self-serving request, and if it can't/won't be done I'd understand why. BUT, having added more than one or two books since joining TSG, it would be a massive boost to my fragile sense of self-worth if there was a stat that let me know exactly how many more than one or two. :)

posts.title: Don’t count bibliography in pages read
posts.description: A lot of nonfiction books have dozens of pages that aren’t read- because they are the sources, so I think it would be great to have the option to edit the total pages for a book to reflect that. I really am not sure what would be the best way to do that though.

posts.title: No Communication during Plus Trial
posts.description: When I did my month-long trial period for the Plus plan, I didn't receive any type of communication from the app? No confirmation email about the trial, no email notifying me of what features I was able to try during the trial, nothing. The only time I received something was the email notifying me that my trial had ended.

posts.title: Archive Hosted Challenges
posts.description: I created several personal challenges for myself and have created several more that have now passed, and would like to see them archived as to not clutter up the main page when you scroll to hosted.

posts.title: Sort 'Browse Editions' Page by Editions I've Read
posts.description: So sometimes I've read several editions of a book, and I enjoy being able to track those separately. For example, I may have read an ebook and an audiobook version and left separate reviews for each. When I click 'Browse Editions' I would really like to be able to see the editions that I have read/reviewed or marked as read/to read at the top of the list. This would be fine if it were added as a sort option as well (like how you can sort by digital/audio/print editions.)

posts.title: Ability to add yet to be published books
posts.description: For example, I'd like to be able to add a book to my to be read list even if it isn't published yet. "What Lovers Do" by Jewel E Ann is sweet to be published/released March 24 but I can't find a way to add the book yet.

posts.title: External links in reviews
posts.description: When I write a review, I'd like to include a link to my own website where I have an expanded version of the review.

posts.title: Find Similar Users Based on Average Number of Books Read
posts.description: When searching for similar users, my recommendations are pretty good when it comes to mood, pace, etc. However, sometimes I also look for users who read around the same average number of books as me. If I usually read about 20-30 books a year, it's nice to find other readers like that as well since following someone who reads a book a day can feel discouraging. And on the other side of that, if a user reads prolifically, they may want someone to match their pace so that they can discover new books more often. I'm not sure if this is already factored into similar user recommendations, but wanted to throw this out there!

posts.title: Want To Read + TBR
posts.description: It would be great to have separate drop downs for Want To Read and To Read so that you can correctly allocate books and also quickly search by the books you own vs books you want to read that you may borrow from the library/ARCs/loans or purchase.

posts.title: shareable up next and currently reading
posts.description: I think being able to have a grid or pdf option for the up next and currently reading would be awesome and make sharing with friends simple.

posts.title: Attachment section to the book ticket page
posts.description: Give users the option to include attachments with book tickets; this would enable users to include the cover image and/or screenshot of the book’s information

posts.title: Gift guide search tool
posts.description: Create a search tool to help me find books for friends and family that is completely separate from my own recommendations. Allow me to enter authors or genres I don’t typically read/enjoy, and get gift suggestions back.

posts.title: Easily seeing other users' ratings
posts.description: I wish there was a way that when you look at another user's "Read Recently", instead of only having the options "view all" or "reviews" you could somehow see both. When I click on the view all link, it's a much better experience for me to see all that data, and something that would indicate that user's star rating or review. When I click their "reviews" I'm not seeing covers or other information which I feel is not as rich of an experience. Thank you!

posts.title: Access to notes/quotes/journal entries via book titles.
posts.description: I always add quotes into my reading journal when I finish a book and I like to look back on them as I borrow a lot of books or delete them off my kindle. I also read about 8 books a month on average. I would really like to be able to access my reading journal entry for a specific title via that book’s page. This would be SO much easier than scrolling back through my reading journal.

posts.title: Book Giveaways
posts.description: It' really the only reason I haven't deleted my GR profile yet. I love getting those emailemails thaT there's a giveaway for a book on my TBR. Its part of my morning routine lol

posts.title: DNF journal and reviews
posts.description: At the moment, accessing journal entries is through the 'read dates' link, which is not accessible for DNF unless you've read the book before or after DNF-ing. In order to access them, you need to go to the journal entries via your profile. Would it be possible to have a link to journal entries from the main work page? (Also, perhaps regardless of edition?) Further, would it be inappropriate to give DNF the same questionnaire as the reviews? I can understand reluctance if you haven't finished a book, things can change, but I think it might have value all the same. Maybe not. Thanks! (The new colors and slightly adjusted layout looks very nice on desktop. ::big eyes::)

posts.title: Distinguish authors related to book who didn't write the book
posts.description: I often see classic works, especially, with authors on them that wrote a forward or notes section for the work, rather than the work itself. Same with someone who translated a work. It would be nice to see those marked somehow in the search results. Sometimes an author writes a preface or forward and their name appears before the author of the work, so it would be nice to get some clarity there. It would also be nice to be able to click on those names and see, for example, all of the works that person has translated. Maybe related would be anthologies? Where the "primary" author is usually the editor or the biggest name in the collection. It would be nice to have all of the authors who have a piece in the anthology listed as an author, with the editor distinguished.

posts.title: eBook Options for "Buy this Book"
posts.description: Can we get some ebook options for the purchase choices? Kobo would be great!

posts.title: Translate review button
posts.description: I would like if there could be a way to auto-generate a translation of non-English reviews. This may be somewhat niche, especially since I haven't bumped into any non-English reviews yet. I just know that I generally review in the language that I read. Then again, this may be good for non-English speakers who speak enough to get by, but would like to read reviews in their native language... Then again, it might make the reviews page too cluttered.

posts.title: Ratings by genre?
posts.description: I'm not sure if this is already possible, or technically feasible, but I was wondering if it is possible to get a breakdown of ratings by genre? Especially, fiction vs nonfiction. Clicking on the "nonfiction" wedge in my "all-time " stats and eyeballing the list does seem to confirm my hunch that I tend to rate NF higher, but having stats generated for data like these would be awesome, if doable.

posts.title: allow DNF duality
posts.description: allow a book to be both DNF (for pages to count?) and read (if finished at a later time, or to be DNF and to-read (a book to come back to).

posts.title: Track international reading
posts.description: I was thinking, wouldn't it be great if you could also track international reading. I mean, get statistics on which country the books you are reading are from. You could visualize this in a map of the world with the countries you have read books from coloured in. Like a scratch-your travel map, but for books. It could motivate people to read more diversely, i think. You would need nationality information on the author, which is probably more complicated than it sounds and an extra layer to add to all the existing info (although I did notice author stats were already on the roadmap for the long term ;) ) but I think it would be super cool.

posts.title: Competitive Challenges
posts.description: I'm wondering if we could could have competitive Challenges, where one Challenge would have a face-off with another - maybe to see which one could get more books read by a certain time, or how many people could fully finish a challenge by a certain time. The reward would be bragging rights (badges? I'm not sure of that actually), and electronic confetti on the homepage for a week. Not sure if humans should pick the faceoff partner or if it should be auto generated for a certain class of Challenge. We want to minimize the bias humans have towards meanness that the internet brings out sometimes. Maybe there would only be one face-off per month, and people could join it or not, and choose the side they wanted to support. It could be a featured part of the community page. There would have to be an option for Challenges to be non-competitive, as not everyone would be interested.

posts.title: Additional Theme Request: Warmer Toned Light Theme
posts.description: I'd like to request a third theme option. Would it be possible to get a light theme with a light tan/cream/sepia type of background to replace the white?

posts.title: Tag book club members
posts.description: It would be great if book club admins could tag their members (as in a general @members/@everyone) in the forums.

posts.title: Reading stats for a single book
Start showing a series from selected volume
posts.description: Some series have hundreds of volumes - e.g. comics. If I want to scroll to volume 480 then have to start from the first and go page by page by page by page by page. This takes forever (some index links would be useful too!). So, instead, if I search for “COMIC 480” and am on that book’s page, when I tap on the series link at the top of the page, could I go to that volume in the entire series (such that I’m immediately in the correct block of 10) rather than the first volume in that series (and then have to scroll and scroll and scroll and scroll and scroll and scroll and scroll… you get the idea… 😉)

posts.title: Kobo buddy read with annotation
posts.description: It would be awesome if you guys could work with kobo to make buddy reads where you can share annotations between people on the actual books! I love when I get a annotated book from a friend and it would be so cool do do this digitally.

posts.title: Stats for pages read in the previous week
posts.description: I would love to have the option to see the number of pages read in the previous week. The closest to this is the line graph for the reading streak. But I'd have to add up the page number for each day so I know the total. Similarly, having a chart that shows the number of pages read per week would also be useful for comparisons.

posts.title: Pairwise Ranking
posts.description: Right now the books are reviewed out of 5 stars. Although the users can give partial stars, it is actually hard to rank the books. There are some alternative approaches, for instance the pairwise ranking (there are many tools available online). In essence, you compare 2 books at a time and indicate which one you prefer. You do this comparison many times, and you end up getting hopefully an unbiased list of ranked books. What I usually do is at the end of a year is that I copy/paste the book titles I’ve finished to another app and do this comparison. I think having a version of this tool built in to StoryGraph could be nice (and ranked lists to be stored). For instance, there can be two flavours: - Ranking of read books of all time - Ranking of read books of a specific year You can even add some of the results to the end of the year wrap-up.

posts.title: Search feature for tagged section
posts.description: Hey there, is it possible that we can get a search feature for the tagged section??! I have 84 different tags and it would be great if I can just type in what tag I want instead of scrolling through all of them. Thank you! :)

posts.title: UI Translation to another language
posts.description: The ui of Storygraph is only available in english making it unusable for people speaking other languages, on top of that, the option to add books on other languages is already there, and the stat is also there. It feels deceiltful to not have the ui also in other languages, is just a basic translation so is accessible for more people

posts.title: to read counter
posts.description: I'd love a way to give books in my TBR pile a counter for how many recommendations I've read for them. Sometimes I go to log a TBR to find it already on my list - I'd like to be able to note that so that it could be used as a sorting order for my TBR pile.

posts.title: Read + TBR option for stats
posts.description: I'd really like an option on the stats page for a view that combines Read Books and To-Read Pile books.

posts.title: Manga/lightnovel genres
posts.description: I'd love if genres like shounen, shoujo, isekai, etc etc would get added since a lot of manga/light novels use these

posts.title: Let series have multiple names
posts.description: I read a lot of manga, graphic novels and old age comics that have been published under multiple names over the years, or mangas that have a Japanese kanji name, English translation name, and a romanised name, or things like the Resident Evil series that publishes stories under both "Resident Evil" AND "Biohazard". This has lead to a lot of convoluted series/etc on the website, a lot of incomplete series where issues 1, 3, 4 and 7 end up in the Japanese name series, and 2, 5 and 8 are in the English name and co and many, many, many dupes (librarians i'm so sorry, ive been doing my best with these 1980s comics). I'd like to see the ability for series to have a handful of names/aliases available to make this easier, hopefully reduce the amount of dupes that occur and co. Thus when searching for "biohazard heavenly island" , "resident evil heavenly island" would come up as the series suggestion, which would be the correct series (and maybe this could be implemented for books too in the future?)

posts.title: Search by reread
posts.description: I’d love if we were able to filter our read books by reread. Like, be able to see all the books we’ve reread before. It’s rare for me to do a reread, so being able to see what books I’ve reread would be amazing.

posts.title: A way to designate that the version you're reading is an ARC and/or is a digital copy (non-ebook) copy for a physical book
posts.description: Hi! I often read ARCs that digital versions of physical books. In other words, the copy I receive has an ISBN of a physical book, but I'm still reading it in the form of ebook, myself, because I'm reading it as an ARC. The current set up makes it confusing when entering new books as well. Here's an example: https://app.thestorygraph.com/books/6cbd787b-b753-4e55-b8fb-ec4ea53e68eb. I entered it as digital, because my copy itself is digital. This also allows it to show up as an ebook in my stats. I realized after the fact, however, that I technically probably should have entered it as physical. I'm really not sure though. I wish there was some way to handle this nuance. Thanks!

posts.title: Check for books not added to a challenge
posts.description: Be able to find books that have not been added to a reading challenge for the year. If I miss adding it? I need to go through book by book to see if I missed adding them.

posts.title: Add Search Results to Challenge
posts.description: It would be great to be able to add all titles from a given search/filter result to either a new or existing challenge.

posts.title: Add multiple books per book club date.
posts.description: I am in a book club where we read multiple books each month, so it would be nice to be able to add multiple books to one book club meeting.

posts.title: Kids' book list
posts.description: I'd love to have a way to track books for my kid, without those books feeding into my stats. Sort of like a sub-profile for my child.

posts.title: Make current reads into carousel
posts.description: Current reads on the home page would be better as a carousel so that I can see more than just the most recently edited 3.

posts.title: A way to tell if a book is abridged and/or adapted
posts.description: This mostly concerns classics. I think it would be useful to have an official label or tag for abridged and/or adapted book families, like for easyread versions where the story is retold in simpler words, or kid adaptations or where the book is simply abridged in some way. In the future when we'll hopefully be able to filter on the author pages, it would be very helpful to be able to exclude all abridged books for example.

posts.title: Tracking AO3 fanfiction and page count through word count
posts.description: I commented on another fanfiction request, however, I wanted to put it as a separate request as well. Can you readers have a way to track fanfiction, especially from privately without having to put it in the overall database, especially fiction from ao3 And other users have mentioned authors of fanfiction typically do not like to have their work posted on databases, but it would be great if users could track it privately to include it in the reading for the year. Can you also have a way to track pages through Word count since ao4 list word count instead of page count. This post can be merged with the original post that I commented on which is [here](https://roadmap.thestorygraph.com/requests-ideas/posts/keep-track-of-fanfiction)

posts.title: Tracking pages even when total pages is unknown
posts.description: Hi, I tend to read a lot of digital official manga from sites like Webtoon and Tapas. Most of these manga's are still updating, so the completion of a season or volume isn't known yet. When I want to update how far I am, the only option I'm getting is percentage, which is impossible to know since it hasn't finished. Hence I would love for this to have the pages option still so it doesn't mess with my stats. Thank you!

posts.title: Easier way to read new buddy read comments
posts.description: I know we can sort all comments by descending instead of ascending, but if a person is replying to an old comment, you still have to scroll all the way to see the new response. Through notifications, you have to click one at a time. I'd love some sort of way to just see all new comments. It would be great to sort by time commented rather than part of the book (including replies—if the parent comment is 4 days old but there's a reply from 1 minute ago, I still want the parent and subcomment to be at the top as "new"). A filter would always be nice, but I'm assuming timestamps would be easier to not miss anything. My mom is catching up on an old buddy read I already finished and I'm having to scroll through all the comments again each time to see her responses. It's that, or going one by one in notifications. If I'm just missing an easy way to do this, please let me know!

posts.title: Quick link to books read
posts.description: Can you add a quick link to 'recently read books' on the main page or in the quick access bar? I feel like I have to click a bunch to get to that page and I go there a lot.

posts.title: More exciting badges when finishing challenges
Add urban fiction as a category
posts.description: Almost all urban fiction and urban romances are categorized as thrillers and romance. It makes accurate tracking of genres difficult. Urban fiction is a distinct genre with aspects that are different from general romance and thriller.

posts.title: Multiple Shelves
posts.description: It would be nice to have more than Read, TBR, and DNF "shelves". A way to separate out books that someone suggested but we may not yet want to fully commit to a TBR. Or even a main unread shelf so we can curate our TBR month by month or year by year.

posts.title: Change how audiobook minutes/hours totals are displayed
posts.description: instead of percentage or hours and minutes being converted into decimals, the amount would be left as is

posts.title: Show Read Status on Book Reading Challenges Before Joining
posts.description: The Challenge Book sets are specific books, and it would be handy when looking over the cover thumbnails to see which ones you've read (whether with 'read' over them, or a tick mark, or a color highlight) before you add the Challenge

posts.title: Sort/exclude read different edition from tbr list
posts.description: I sometimes read different editions of books and will have unread edition in my tbr. I would like to be able to filter/exclude if I have read a different edition of the book in my tbr list. Similar how I can search/exclude if I already own the book in my tbr.

posts.title: Poetry and Drama As Distinct Genres
posts.description: Currently, poetry collections are tagged as fiction/nonfiction in addition to poetry. Fiction and nonfiction are prose genres, distinct from poetry; poetry is neither fiction nor nonfiction. Personally, this means I don't really track my poetry on the app, as it messes up my stats for fiction and nonfiction. This also means that works of literary criticism have their genre marked as poetry. In other words, both a collection of poems and a work of prose literary criticism can be marked as nonfiction poetry. The same also applies for drama pieces. Shakespeare was not a fiction writer; he was a playwright: he wrote neither short stories nor novels; he wrote plays/drama. That should be reflected by the genre when you have read a play. This would also make for deeper accuracy in the stats and allow better tracking.

posts.title: Convert existing challenge
posts.description: Is there a way to convert an existing challenge into another format? Specifically converting an old challenge I made when the only choice was the prompts format into the books format? I don’t want to delete the challenge and start over because other people have joined

posts.title: Search Friends & Followers
posts.description: Would love to be able to search just my friends and followers to find a specific user quickly. Right now, you can view all but have to scroll to find a specific users. Would love a search feature when I select view all that only searches my friends and the people I’m following.

posts.title: Filter + randomise order/selection of TBR
posts.description: As someone with a huge TBR, it would be really cool if the app had the ability to help me pick a book. I know that there's already a randomizer thing but it just picks (I think 5?) random books. It would be great if I could use the filter to pick what type of book I want to read and then the app could pick a book from within that criteria.

posts.title: Enhanced Monthly Wrap-Up Book Stack Graphics
posts.description: The monthly reading recap graphics provide useful data, but the current visuals feel very basic and do not match the aesthetic standards of today’s book-tracking and book-sharing communities. As reading wrap ups are highly shared content across platforms like Instagram, TikTok, and Pinterest, more polished and customizable designs would better represent StoryGraph and support users who want to proudly share their stats without recreating graphics elsewhere. **Suggested improvements:** 1. Theme options (modern, minimalist, dark mode, illustrated, cozy, etc.) 2. Customizable color palettes 3. More refined book stack layout with better spacing and shadow depth 4. Options to toggle rating badges, text placement, and icons 5. Export templates sized for: - Instagram square posts - Instagram Stories - Desktop / blog sharing 6. Light design accents such as gradients, texture, or subtle dimension **Why this matters:** These upgrades would: - Elevate the visual presentation of monthly stats - Encourage in-app sharing instead of external redesigns - Strengthen StoryGraph’s identity in the book community - Support user engagement and organic platform visibility Improving the look and flexibility of these graphics would allow StoryGraph’s auto-created summaries to feel more polished and social-media ready, matching the quality of the platform’s data insights.

posts.title: TBR - share/export tagged list
posts.description: I would love to be able to send a list to someone. I’ve encouraged a few people to sign up with The StoryGraph but they’re slow to adopt new apps/tech. They also look to me for book suggestions (that I send but get buried/forgotten). I created a tag for books I’d recommend for one person in particular. I’d love to send her that list. Then she could add them all to her TBR without having to type each book title in the search box. What a great starting point for new users without feeling overwhelmed with a blank slate. I suspect this is niche but wanted to throw out there anyhow, just in case. Gracias :)

posts.title: Favorite series section
posts.description: I like the new favorite books section a lot. Can there be a favorite series section? Especially when you have a series that you absolutely love and can’t just choose one book from a series.

posts.title: de-emphasize book format by having all versions of the same book be the same item
posts.description: The fact that each version of a book is a different item in StoryGraph adds confusion (but maybe I'm not using it correctly!). I think that each book should just be one item in storygraph, and you can select which version you read the same way you can check genres. I saw someone else suggest giving readers the option to have a default version selected, and I think that could be integrated too! But it's really frustrating and unintuitive that different versions of the same book are treated differently. It's also annoying to accidentally select the wrong version all the time when trying to log.

posts.title: Multiple tags in custom report
