posts.description: I would like to be able to merge the data from two or more tags into one "pie slice" on a custom chart (I.e. my audible, kindle unlimited, and amazon purchases can all be grouped together under an "Amazon" label, or my library and libby borrows can be grouped together under a "Library" label)

posts.title: Filter Request: Owned Books Not on Your TBR
posts.description: You can already filter your TBR by their Owned status but not your Owned books by their TBR status. I happen to have a lot of books catalogued as owned on TSG that I don't necessarily want to read and that aren't on my TBR, and being able to filter for those would be very useful. Thank you <3

posts.title: See friends’ reading even if they don’t rate
posts.description: Right now I only see an update of a friend if they write out a review, but I want my feed to show anything they mark as finished

posts.title: Save Personalized Previews
posts.description: The Personalized preview is so helpful but I hate having to regenerate it if I close the app. Saving these for a set amount of time, say for a year, would reduce the amount of A.I. use (less A.I. tge better) and could be helpful for the future when looking back at reading history. Similar to the genres and moods data in the end of year recap, but with more details and recommendations.

posts.title: Include paused books on TBR
posts.description: Otherwise I'll forget 😂

posts.title: Summary Stats by Reading Challenge/Reading List
posts.description: I would like to see a summary stat report for the different challenges I complete. Average star rating being the priority, but ideally something very close to the monthly stat summary options.

posts.title: European Affiliate Partners
posts.description: Can you also add affiliated partners from Europe, preferably the Netherlands?

posts.title: Adding read books to up next (without adding to To-Read list)
posts.description: sometimes I plan to re read books and I would like the option to add them to up next without having to put them in my tbr list

posts.title: Filter books on friend's read/TBR that THEY own/don't own
posts.description: I can filter books on my lists to show which I own/don't own. I'd like that feature when I'm looking at other people's profile's so that I can see which book they own/don't own. This would help with giftgiving, because then you can look at someone's TBR and show books they don't own yet.

posts.title: Log comics unassociated with a book
posts.description: I've fallen *hard* into reading comics this year for the first time in my life and I'm loving it, but it's messing up my StoryGraph stats 😂 At this point I'm reading most of them on Marvel Unlimited, instead of in any type of book (physical or digital). The way I'm logging them is by finding a collection on StoryGraph that contains the set of issues I'm currently reading and log my progress against it until I read all the issues in that book. But, this means that both my format chart and my book length charts are pretty wildly skewed compared to the actual books I'm reading. I would love a way to easily make a container that is basically just for me to log pages against and have it not impact my book stats at all. I'm imagining being able to create something called "Marvel Comics" that would just exist for my own account, and just be able to add entries like any other book, but sans format or book length. I have done this in the past to log miscellaneous fanfic by creating a "not a book", but it felt like I was wrenching that feature to do things it wasn't designed to do, because it still needed a bunch of "book-like" info. E.g., you are required to set a page length of the "not a book", and I want to basically be able to log to this indefinitely without worrying about hitting a max. I don't know if I'm the only one who would want something like this, but just figured I'd toss it out there!

posts.title: Food Scarcity/Hunger/Starvation Content Warning
posts.description: It would be great to add “food scarcity/hunger/starvation” (or something along those lines) to the list of content warnings that readers can use. This type of content can be triggering to people with eating disorders and would be good to know going into a book, though it doesn’t fall under the “eating disorder” warning. As someone tagging books with content warnings, I would assume that the “eating disorder” tag is for a character who has an eating disorder or is engaging in eating disorder behaviors, while the tag I would like to add would cover situations where there is food scarcity or discussion of potential food scarcity, but it’s not self-imposed.

posts.title: More intelligent progress type selection
posts.description: Just a thought, but when you're entering your progress on a book you're currently reading, if the book edition is "digital", can you make the progress automatically chose percent, rather than pages? Since e-books don't really have consistent pages, depending on font size and such, it would be nice if it defaulted to percent read instead. Thanks!

posts.title: Recommend Local Bookshops!
posts.description: Would be great to be able to add local bookshops to our profiles. :)

posts.title: add any/all pronouns option
posts.description: hi, it's really cool that pronouns have been added to our profiles! however, there is no option for any or all pronouns. can this please be added?

posts.title: Sort challenge books with completed at the bottom
posts.description: I use a personal challenge to keep up with my book club books, and it’s growing cumbersome to have to scroll and scroll past my completed books to get to the newest unread at the bottom. I wish I could easily sort the opposite direction with the newest adds at the top and the oldest at the bottom. It’s too cumbersome to try to reorder them constantly.

posts.title: Toggle Average Time to Finish off
posts.description: As someone who reads rather slowly I would really like to have the option to turn off this stat so my inability to fly through books doesn’t mock me every time I open the stats page.

posts.title: Monthly calendar - One line per in progress book
posts.description: I read a lot of books at the same time, and unless I'm absolutely fastidious about making sure that I read all of the books every day, I end up with books sharing lines on the calendar. I find this a lot harder to read and understand (particularly when the colors for the bars are quite similar, which tends to happen a lot on my calendars). I'd really prefer it if each book had its own row until it was completed, or at the very least, if different books maintained at least one space between them so that they don't butt up against each other in a way that makes it look confusingly continuous.

posts.title: see challenge prompt a book has been assigned to
posts.description: It would be really helpful if there was a way to see which prompt/s I've added a book to in a challenge. It's one thing to see that I've added it to X and Y challenge, but I hardly ever remember which prompt I've added it to - I usually "add it to a challenge" again and have to scroll down to see where it's assigned.

posts.title: Cover Art Contribution
posts.description: Add in a contributor category for cover art - this looks to be frequent in comics to have a separate "cover artist" than the normal illustrator

posts.title: Option to remove audiobooks from time to read stats
posts.description: I usually finish a book a week or less, but my audiobooks tend to take a month and it really throws off my stats

posts.title: Fix cropped/distorted audiobook covers in stats wrap-up graphics
posts.description: I would like to request that square audiobook covers in yearly/monthly stats wrap-up graphics not be cropped to fit the rectangular cover template. The cropping often results in the title and/or author not being visible, and it's visually unappealing. I noticed the audiobook cover distortion has been fixed on the desktop homepage for the To-Read Pile display, and I would love if it were fixed on the stats graphics, too.

posts.title: Shuffle - To Read Pile
posts.description: I'd love to have the option to randomly select a book from my to read pile!

posts.title: Add images to buddy read and readalong comments
posts.description: I've done a lot of successful buddy reads and readalongs with my friends! We'd love to see a feature where we could upload images to comments. Right now we have to rely on channels outside of StoryGraph to share pictures related to our ongoing reads.

posts.title: User generated moods
posts.description: I would like to add different moods. I feel limited to the ones I have in reviews. I know I can add them as tags but having a setting where I can add the moods I’m interested in would be great. Like I don’t read a lot of non fiction. I don’t need “informative” for my books.

posts.title: Show edition on search screen
posts.description: When searching for a book it would be helpful if the one that comes up shows what edition it is. There are extra steps and clicks to make sure you are recording the right edition (digital/audio/hardcopy)

posts.title: Exclude my activity from newsfeed
posts.description: In the community tab, my newsfeed shows my friends activity but also my activity. I’d like for my activity to either appear elsewhere (perhaps on the profile page) or be able to exclude my activity so I can just see what my friends have read or are reading.

posts.title: A pop up for books added to a reading challenge
posts.description: I love to add my tbr to a reading challenge and instead of manually putting them in after I read them. I would love to have some pop ups that would remind me that the book I just finished reading was a part of a challenge so I can submit it for points or add it to my reading journal.

posts.title: Imprint
posts.description: Please track the publishing imprint of my reads. Anne Bogel said on her podcast that that info can be very revealing and indicative of reads you may like or not like in future.

posts.title: Group back-to-back reviews together in the news feed
posts.description: I tend to forget to review books after reading and my poor mutuals on my Community feed then are subjected to scrolling through 5-20 reviews from me. Would it be possible to put them together like "xyz just reviewed some books" and then it's a carousal of the covers and our friends could see the rating that way. It could be processed in a way that "You reviewed all these books in 5 minutes" and groups them together?

posts.title: Filter Similar Books to those on TBR
posts.description: When I'm on a book page and use the 'Browse Similar Books' button, it would be great if there was an option to show only the similar books already on my TBR list.

posts.title: Link to 'Tagged books' and 'All tags' from a single tag page
posts.description: When I'm on my 'Tagged books' page, there's a link at the top to my 'All tags' page, and vice versa. I'd like both of those links ('Tagged books' and 'All tags') to also appear when I'm on the page for a single tag. Often I'll be browsing a tag list and want to filter further by tags, but the only way to do that is on the 'Tagged books' page. It would be helpful to have the link there, instead of having to navigate to my profile, then 'All tags', then 'Tagged books'. The links would also be helpful for when I'm doing a bunch of tag organizing/editing.

posts.title: Exclude lower rated books and dnfs from recommendations
posts.description: I see that I always get recs from books that I've read even if I hated them including the AI recommendations. I feel like this defeats the purpose of a recommendation tbh.

posts.title: Categorise and Track Authors
posts.description: I would like a way to highlight different kinds of authors. To put is bluntly, I don't want to support authors I know I don't like writing or morality wise, so it would be nice to tag every book by them and the same for favorite authors. Could be like emojis next to the book title (start for favored, red dot for dislike)

posts.title: Book Availability on Various Services
posts.description: I know this is a dream item and may not be feasible but it would be so cool if Storygraph could automatically search and show me if a book is available on different services, particular for digital reading services. For example is this book currently available on Audible Plus? Kindle Unlimited? Others? Is this audiobook an audible exclusive or is it available on Libro.fm? Obviously you don’t want to push people towards any particular service or seller, and we all want to support independent booksellers as much as possible. I’m just looking for a way to automate the searching and tagging process I’m already doing to breakdown my TBR by where I can read each book. Obviously if I could go one step further and link my Libraries or my Libby and Hoopla apps to Storygraph and have the app tell me if any of my libraries have the book available that would be even better but I understand that’s a completely different undertaking than just searching the publicly available and universal kindle unlimited database.

posts.title: Add series data to export
posts.description: I would like to have the name of the series and preferably also which part of the series in the .csv export, so that I can make a filter on all series that I read, in my google spreadsheets and I also can see how many parts I still have to read for a series. (The name and the part can be combined in 1 value or named separately.)

posts.title: Sort/Filter Friends Read Books
posts.description: There are a lot of filtering options but I didn't see one for sorting or filtering by what they rated a book. Like I would love to select a friend and be able to see only their 5 star reads.

posts.title: Make stats not always default to current year
posts.description: It would be nice if the stats page remembered that I set it to "All time" when I come back to it, but even if that's too difficult I think it should by default be "All time", I think that's preferable to most people.

posts.title: Up Next Suggestions - Include public buddy/readalong
posts.description: Sorry if this has been thought of and posted about already but I couldn't find it! For those of us who are opted in to some of the more social features, I am wondering if it would be possible to add a up next suggestion which reccommends books based on those that have upcoming/currently running public buddy reads or readalongs? I know you can filter the buddy reads/read along lists, but having it imbeded into that up next feature would be really helpful for me and maybe for others.

posts.title: Games for creating an Up Next List
posts.description: Hi StoryGraph-Team, my idea was that a lot of people enjoy playing games in order to create their weekly or monthly TBR. It would be nice if any of these ideas would make it into StoryGraph. For example one might want to spin a wheel to choose books from their owned unread books. These wheels can have prompts, colors (book cover must match) or even just the title of the book. That would make choosing a TBR even more fun. Let me know what you think about that. :)

posts.title: Buddy Read Entire Series
posts.description: Would love to have one overall Buddy Read for a full series or tandem read that shows which book everyone is on and their progress on it. Comments could be attached to individual books or the full thing.

posts.title: Sliders on review page instead of drop-down menus
posts.description: I would love to have sliders instead of drop-down menus on the review page. I quite often want to put a bit more nuance on how the much character development there was or whether it was character- or plot-driven, I don't feel like the yes/no/it's complicated options always fits.

posts.title: Option to discount selected reads from AI Personalization feature
posts.description: The personalised preview option, generated by AI, I find has often likened certain books to previous reads that I did not necessarily enjoy, or read too long ago to be relevant. This may be partially my fault for rarely reviewing books, or having tried to log almost every book I've read in my life, however I feel like this would be easily overcome by adding an option to not include certain books in the data the AI uses to generated those recommendation paragraphs.

posts.title: Small QoL suggestions for custom tags
posts.description: I have already spend an unhealthy amount of time making all sorts of new graphs… and it is beyond great. But still i have some very minor gripes that maybe could be looked into: 1. A function that automatically assignes different colors for a pie chart… 2. A function so we can order how The segments in a vertical chart looks. I have one for time of purchase and would like it to show them chronological and not by amount of books with The tag 3. Would be nice to choose different looks for segments in especially vertical… a Line rather than blocks. Again something that would suit a rigged timeline. 4. Last and probably hardest…. Is it possible to add tags to a graph without using The dropdown menu from hell 😅 I have sooo many tags to filter through when adding one Still incredible boost to my ux so these are minor stuff

posts.title: Custom required Tags
posts.description: I have no idea how this would work in the UI, but now that I have custom charts based on my tags (🎉🎉🎉🎉🎉🎉), I want to make sure those charts stay up to date. One of the charts I just made was "Book Source" where I have tags for "from-libby", "from-store", etc feeding the chart. I would love some kind of notification when I mark a book as Finished of "hey wait! you forgot to set a tag from this set of tags on this book!" A bonus would be some kind of view of "all books marked as Read that do not have one tag in this set" so I could go through and update any I missed all at once. Being the data nerd that I am, I do try to go and check periodically to make sure that I have one of these tags on every book, but it would be cool if there was an automated way to enforce it.

posts.title: View Journal Entries while writing review
posts.description: Particularly on the mobile app, it is cumbersome to review my journal entries while I write my final review of a book. The review form doesn't save itself, so if I want to include any of my commentary I wrote while reading or any of the quotes, I either have to assemble it in a different text editor app or just use a desktop browser to have multiple things open at the same time. It would be really nice to be able to review my own notes. I'm not sure what the right UI would be, since depending on how many journal entries with text you have, it could get quite long, but it would be nice to be able to smoothly do this on mobile from within TSG itself!

posts.title: "Read" banner on books image
posts.description: Because we read in an F shape, it can take a while to identify that you've already read or shelved a specific book you're looking at. I found the Kindle development that shows read books as a banner on the image of the book as a very nice and useful visual cue to indicate you've already had interactions with that book. Ideally, it the banner should display the exclusive shelf that the book is on, so that if we end up having more exclusive shelves further down the line, it wouldn't need to be adjusted. This should apply to all images of a book, regardless of where they are shown across the site & app, so that it's always easy to identify a book that's already on one's radar (e.g. giveaways, or popular this week for example).

posts.title: DNF Stats on Books
posts.description: Is there a way to see a DNF percentage when browsing books? For instance, alongside the star rating, showing that x% who have started reading DNF on StoryGraph.

posts.title: Shareable TBR
posts.description: Especially with the option to buddy read, I would LOVE to have a running TBR with my friends that is specifically about the different books we want to read! To be able to have a "Buddy TBR" or just a personal group of books that we can share out to folks would be super cool.

posts.title: Shelf for currently checked out library books
posts.description: Is there a possibility to create a shelf for all the books I've currently checked out of the library or have borrowed from friends? Sometimes these books pile up... I'm currently using tags, but forget to remove the tag from a book when I give it back.

posts.title: Book Format
posts.description: It would be nice to have an option to check the book format (print, eBook, audio, ARC) and how it was acquired instead of searching through to find that book format on the shelf. This would help with accurate stats as I listen to audiobooks, but I typically select the first book that populates when searching the app for my current read. My format stats are currently inaccurate, and I don’t see any easy or user/friendly way to correct the format information.

posts.title: Make a Generic Readalong for every book
posts.description: I was thinking that when you clicked on a book, you could automatically see if there were any public/live readalongs. Or a way to search for a book to see if it has on ebefore creating one. Also, I wish there was a way to leave off an end date. Or maybe even each book automatically gets a read along with a generic "chat about it" like how buddy reads is, but someone can create a specific one if they would like to customize it more?

posts.title: Add books to reading challenge that you've read from list
posts.description: In the reading challenge, it would be great to be able to do a mass list to add books you've read this year with a checkbook instead of having to do it individually by book - example: "reading for cozies challenge" and I haven't kept up with it - be able to go to the prompt and it pop out the whole list of books I have read and I can check all of the ones that apply from the same screen to mass add to the prompt

posts.title: Rating/Explanation for DNF books
posts.description: I'd love to be able to review books that I did not finish, as well as being able to read why other people decided to start but not finish the book. It doesn't have to be a full review with a star rating etc... even a limited kind would suffice

posts.title: Summary Tab for Recommendations
posts.description: When browsing for new recommendations, I was wondering if it was possible to have a drop-down tab that lets you read the summary without having to open a new tab or click away from the list?

posts.title: Challenges Setup: Auto Create Prompts
posts.description: It would be nice and much less time-consuming if, when you initially set up a challenge, you could select the total number of prompts you want to have in that challenge—let's say 10. It would then automatically create 10 prompts that you could fill in to start with. If you later wanted to add more or remove them, you could do so manually, as you can now.

posts.title: Add star rating from book list view
posts.description: Add star rating to a book from stats menu without having to go into the full review page

posts.title: Review HTML for blog / social
posts.description: I'd love a feature that gives exportable html of your book review text like Goodreads does. That's basically the only feature I still use on GR so having it here would free me completely. 😍 I envision: - linked book title and author - book cover image - text of review And maybe checkbox options to include or remove other info like rating, moods, genre, pacing etc that you can add to reviews.

posts.title: Monthly Stats for Books Read but Not Finished
posts.description: In my monthly stats, sometimes I have pages tracked but no books finished in that time frame, and it would be cool if I could see where those pages came from without having to search through my journal entries to see what I was reading at the time. Maybe at the top of the monthly stats page, under "Read", similar to how you can click the number of books, the number of pages could be clickable as well and take you to a page showing which books had pages tracked during that month. Even further, if there was a way to show the total pages for a book that were tracked in that month, I'm always so curious what percentage of my pages came from what book in the month! It would also be cool if the plot points on monthly page line graphs were clickable with links to journal entries for that day. (On the yearly line graph of pages/books read, it would be awesome if the books plot point took you to the list of books read and the pages plot point took you to stats for that month, but maybe that's a wholly different request haha) Thanks and have a wonderful day! I love the StoryGraph so much and appreciate all you do to keep making it even better!!

posts.title: Don't recommend books on to-read pile
posts.description: The recommendation feature is amazing on this website, however there is one problem; if you have a book in your to-read (or even currently reading) list, it shouldn't show up in your recommendations list. I think the feature would be better if it recommended books you haven't added whatsoever, to help you find new and interesting books to read.

posts.title: Delete Tags
posts.description: I have old tags that imported from goodreads when I brought my library over and I would like to just be able to remove the tags but not the books.

posts.title: Recent reads can affect recommendations
posts.description: Have a checkbox option on the recommendation preferences page to include data from recent reads. I'm imagining something like, if you have read lots of romance compared to other genres in the last 3 months, add romance to the genre list that the algorithm is using (if it's not already there). If you've rated horrors a lot lower than other genres recently, don't show so many horrors. And of course the same goes for the more specific micro features, not just genres. I actually forgot that storygraph didn't already do something like this and so did a friend, I guess because we're so used to algorithms adapting based on our data everywhere else! It came up in discussion and this is what prompted me to make this request. Ofc it's good that it's not automatic, imo, because having the option to tell it what you want and only get those is great, but having the option to have it take into account recent months reading data would also be useful for many I think.

posts.title: Restarting a book previously DNF'd not from the beginning
posts.description: Some times I have to DNF a book because I have to return a book to the library. If I eventually want to reread the book I will start from where I ended (if it hasn't been a long time), but when I start from where I left off it counts all those pages/hours again. Is there anyway to say you started from the middle of the book so the pages don't count twice?

posts.title: DNF Stats skewed by edition swapping
posts.description: I really love all of the new stats options that just got added, and I'm particularly intrigued by the DNF stats. Mine are a little bit skewed by the inclusion of what I don't really consider to be "true" DNFs. I have a lot of different scenarios where I swap editions of a book while I'm reading it. Some examples: I started listening to an audiobook and didn't jive with the narrator so I just fully swap to an ebook; I start listening, get a little lost, catch up with the ebook, and then go back to the audiobook after I've caught up; etc. I track these edition switches because I want to get credit for the pages and minutes that I listen to, and then I have to mark the unfinished edition as DNF even though I've finished the *book*, otherwise it would either languish in Currently Reading or I'd lose credit for the pages/minutes I logged. To me, a DNF is a book that I start, regardless of edition, and decide to abandon and not complete, so it always feels a little odd to mark these editions as DNF and leave in the explanation "didn't finish this one but I did finish a different edition", and now having those mixed in with "true" DNFs feels like it is muddling my stats. I'd love an option for "don't include this in stats", because I imagine that a blanket "don't include a DNF in stats if another edition is Finished" would mess up someone *else's* desired stats.

posts.title: Give ratings more objective meaning
posts.description: User story: As a viewer of other people’s book ratings I want those ratings to have been made relative to some relatively objective standard so that I can better evaluate books I’m considering. Expanded info: When people are writing reviews it would be helpful if The StoryGraph provided meanings for ratings so they can be more consistent. Here is the scale I use and find useful, and hope you find it useful, too: 5 stars: One of a small-ish list of best books I’ve ever read. When I finished, I said “Whoa," and either proceeded to read it again immediately, or pinned it for review again sometime. 4 stars: A good, well-written book that I’ll remember and speak positively about, but am unlikely to read again. 3 stars: Serviceable, but likely won’t remember it very long - or will speak of it as “Ok, but a disappointment”. 2 stars: So bad it makes me sad for the author, and other readers. 1 star: I can’t reach past chapter 3, even as penance for my sins. Of course, users are not *required* to use this scale, and can use their own. But I'm willing to wager that most people's ratings are not intentionally / objectively defined, nor consistently-applied. Providing a rating guide does the work of the first job, and gently encourages the second.

posts.title: Allow ISBN reassignment, cloning, or correction for user added editions
posts.description: When adding books on StoryGraph, I often run into issues with user added editions that already claim an ISBN but contain inaccurate or low quality data. Common problems include incorrect page counts, poorly chosen or low resolution cover images, or metadata that does not accurately reflect the actual edition. Once an ISBN is associated with one of these user added editions, it becomes effectively locked. If a better or more accurate version of that same edition exists, there is no way for another user to correct it, clone it, or create an improved version using the same ISBN. This prevents proper edition tracking and results in long term data quality issues. Feature Request Please consider adding one or more of the following capabilities: Allow trusted users or moderators to reassign an ISBN to a corrected edition. Allow users to clone an existing user added edition and improve metadata, then submit it for review. Allow ISBN recognition across editions so a corrected version can replace a poorly created one. Add a flag or review process for inaccurate user added editions, especially when core metadata like cover image or page count is incorrect. Value This would significantly improve edition accuracy, reduce frustration for users who care about correct metadata, and improve overall data quality across the platform. It would also prevent early, low quality user submissions from permanently blocking accurate editions tied to the same ISBN.

posts.title: Improve Recommendation Relevance Based on Reading History and TBR Activity
posts.description: I would like to request improvements to the recommendation system, specifically how it connects recommendations to a user’s actual reading activity. At the moment, the books being recommended to me do not appear to meaningfully relate to the books I have already read, recently finished, rated, or even added to my TBR. Even after completing the preference survey and actively maintaining my reading data, the recommendations feel disconnected from my demonstrated tastes. They do not seem to reflect patterns from my reading history, my recent reads, or the types of books I intentionally save to my TBR. As a result, the recommendations often feel random rather than personalized. Because of this, I no longer rely on the recommendation feature and instead use reading challenges as a workaround to discover books, by exploring what other titles appear within those challenges. While that approach works to some extent, it highlights that the recommendation system itself is not functioning effectively for my use case. It would greatly improve the experience if recommendations more clearly accounted for recent reads, highly rated books, recurring genres or tropes, and intentional TBR additions. Right now, there feels like a missing connection between my reading data and what is being suggested.

That way I only break my streak if I fail to start a new book the day of or day after I finish the last book. posts.title: Page Count Total in Challenges
posts.description: I think it would be cool to see the collective number of pages in books added to a challenge. So when I make a challenge to track my library books I can see book a, book b and book c equal 920 pages all together so I have to read such and such pages per day to finish them before the due date. Or just as a fun fact feature like oh you've read all of the books in this Stephen King challenge? You've read a billion pages!

posts.title: Copy Book Cover
posts.description: I would love a way to quickly copy a book cover from the app so I can paste it into Canvas (or something similar). I used to screenshot and crop, but now the app no longer allows it, which means I have to leave the app and pull a pic from another app/site.

posts.title: Adding books to challenges
posts.description: It would be great when we are in the challenges to be able to add books from our reading or read list. instead of having to go in our read list and than adding it to the challenge.

posts.title: Hide non-official book covers
posts.description: Since fan-made book covers are apparently allowed, can a way to hide them be implemented? I hate looking at out-of-place covers that don’t fit the series or even the genre. (I requested some be removed from the October Daye series, but my ticket was marked resolved with nothing changed, so I guess it’s fine?) I’d also like to hide the covers on short stories that are included in the back of books that people have added the book’s cover to, so it looks like the book is double listed when looking at the series as a list.

posts.title: Ability to hide community reviews/average star rating
posts.description: One of the big draws to TSG for me was not having random peoples opinions constantly in my face when I opened the app. This might be a really niche problem, but for me if I look up a book, and see it has 3 stars out of 5 I get bummed out, and just go in expecting a bad time. I'd much rather be able to hide community reviews, the average star rating ect. and be able to form my own opinion. I could quickly find the book add it and leave, but sometimes physical books seem to hide away their blerp, and looking online, or TSG is the best way to find out what the book is about, but I have to see review rating. So just a way to hide that would be lovely... as niche as it is.

posts.title: Add Season to Review Info
posts.description: I'd love to know if a book has a strong seasonal (spring, summer, winter, fall) element. I think just having the 4 seasons as a dropdown would be great. Thanks for considering!

posts.title: Reading Challenge - Add option will not read
posts.description: Add an option to the challenge of will not read so that it will mark it as a book that I won't read but still included in the percentage so I guess in the percentage it will show read not read Will not read. Especially when it comes to like reading author’s catalog.

posts.title: section for "on your TBR" in read/unread graph
posts.description: Currently, there's a graph for your owned books that shows what percentage of your books are read vs unread. However, since books on The StoryGraph don't (thankfully!) have to be on your TBR even if you log them as owned, I think that graph would be more interesting/useful/feel less mocking if it instead had sections for read/on your TBR/not on TBR, or if that's not a popular idea, that there was another such graph for your unread books. I know we can already filter owned books by if they're on your TBR or not and calculate the percentages manually, but it would also be a cool graph!

posts.title: Stats see simple list of books read or to read
posts.description: Is there a way to get a simple list of all books read that you can sort by title or author, also the same for to read.

posts.title: Omit Certain Mood Tags
posts.description: It would be great to be able to omit certain tags from our profiles. So many fictional books (especially now) have a romantic element to them. I understand the "romantacy" genre is all the rage, but that is significantly different than a romance novel. I am not looking for romance novels, but it is one of the main moods on my stats and my recommendations. I would like a way to omit that from my "algorithm" so that isn't weighted when I search for books/my StoryGraph recommendations.

posts.title: CAWPILE
posts.description: Would love a feature that included a CAWPILE formula on the ratings page to help readers determine star ratings. Characters Atmosphere/Setting Writing Style Plot Intrigue Logic/Relationships Enjoyment https://bookriot.com/the-cawpile-review-system/

posts.title: Show the prompt description when adding a book to a challenge
posts.description: When you go to add a book to a challenge prompt from the book page, it only shows the name of the prompt. Often, people will write the prompt name in the name part and the actual prompt in the description. (For example, in the Get a Clue Readathon, based on the Clue boardgame, the prompt titles may be Dining Room or Ballroom, then the description will be the actual prompt.) I think it would be a good idea to include the first bit of the description in that page so you can easily know which prompt you're actually adding the book to.

posts.title: Move the tags bar chart to the bottom
posts.description: The bar chart showing all your tags should be at the bottom, or better yet, we should be able to hide it. On custom, we use tags to build our own graphs, so it's just a long list of out of context nonsense. I like to see the graphs underneath (star ratings, authors, etc), and it is annoying to scroll past such a long list to get to it

posts.title: Averaging reading stats
posts.description: Updating my books with my progress every day just isn't intuitive for me - I'd love if there was an option to still get a reading streak (or those cool calender graphics!) by just averaging pages over the number of days you've read the book.

posts.title: Up Next priority on To Read
posts.description: It would be great if the Up Next selections were locked/prioritized In the "To Read Pile".

posts.title: Allow audiobook users to use chapter # in buddy read comments
posts.description: I started using Buddy Read, and noticed there's only 2 options for tracking your progress in the comments (time spent and percentage of book read so far). I'd like to be able to mark what chapter I’m referring to, as sometimes I am not as attentive to what time in the book I’m at (Audible doesn't make it easy when you're listening on 2x speed). I use multiple apps to listen to books (mostly Libby, Audible and Spotify), and they all track your book progress differently.

posts.title: Examples/ideas/templates for custom graphs?
posts.description: I absolutely love StoryGraph and use it more days than not. I think I've used most of its features, but I've never used tags or created custom graphs (even though I have a Plus subscription). And since there isn't a forum... I didn't know where else to ask and thought maybe someone coming across this post can guide me to some ideas for how I could utilize the custom graph feature.

posts.title: Updating progress in a readalong
posts.description: I'd love the ability to update my percentage read/pages read within a readalong. For example when I'm reading I have the readalong open but as chapter access is determined by your percentage read I need to go back to the main page to update my progress then back into the readalong

posts.title: Export total daily reading data
posts.description: I didn't see an existing post for this, but I would love to be able to export my daily reading totals either as part of the existing data export or as a separate thing. I'm working on a reading journal this year for the first time but I know myself and know that I will most likely inevitably get behind on filling in my pixel trackers. Being able to just export it in one go and have the total pages and hours read for each day instead of having to hover on each day in the line charts would be super helpful!

posts.title: Search Read Books
posts.description: I would like to have a search function for read books (just like I can do for my tbr) so I can easily find a book I have read to recommend to someone else. (Maybe this exists? If so, I can't find it on the app.)

posts.title: Forum notifications
posts.description: I run a book club but when people add comments in the book clubs forums or readalong forums I don't get a notification. It would be really great to have an option to receive notifications perhaps with a follow forum toggle feature at the top of each forum? Or a notifications on/off toggle which members of the readalong or book club could choose to turn on or off also. I feel this would really improve participation in book club forums.

posts.title: Invite previous years' participants to this year's challenge
posts.description: I host a challenge every year, and there's no way to communicate to all the users of the 2024 challenge that a 2025 challenge is available. It would be handy to be able to link annual challenges together in some way so that participants could be notified.

posts.title: Ability to note which page numbers read, not just how many
posts.description: I'd love to be able to note exactly which pages I read from a book, especially when doing partial readings, and not just how many. So, for instance, being able to say I read pages 136-156 and that being counted as 20 pages read. As a grad school student, I often read books piecemeal and need to be able to account for exactly which pages I have read. For books I read cover to cover, this would also mean I don't have to do math every time I update my reading status. I end up having to add the number of pages from the front matter (usually a separate page count in roman numerals) to the page number I am on.

posts.title: Count Read Time By Entries
posts.description: It would be nice to have a feature that we could turn on or off depending on our preference that tracks how long it takes to read a book based on the days page/minute entries are made or by the start and stop dates. The new pause feature is great when you want a long break but for those who only take 2 or 3 days between books when reading multiple at a time it would be nice to know how many days of actual reading it took you to read a book.

posts.title: Custom Chart data type option - reading duration
posts.description: I would love to have a custom data type where I can put the days it took me to read a book and it sorts it for me. Kind of like the page option but for the time it took me to finish a book instead.

posts.title: Ability to track skipped pages in a book
posts.description: Hello! I've recently started tracking my textbook reading habits (to encourage myself to read the whole book rather than just read the assigned chapters) and I realized that it would be really helpful if I could track a range of pages I've read, rather than just log the number of pages I've read through. For example, sometimes in non-fiction readings, I'll read Chapter 8 before reading Chapter 2, so I'll skip from the last page in Chapter 1 to the first page of Chapter 8. I wish there was a way to track that I haven't yet read those skipped pages. I wouldn't want my 'pages read per day' graphs to include those skipped pages in their counts. Also, it would be nice to have some sort of reminder that I haven't yet read those pages from Chapters 2 through 7. Thank you!

posts.title: Compare Stats - Ability to expand genre chart
posts.description: I noticed that my genre stats for this year are a bit anomalous because I read way fewer memoirs and way more comics and horror. I went to the Compare Stats view and I wished that there was a way to expand the genre chart to be able to see all of the genres in that view. Totally makes sense for it only to show top ten normally, but the ability to click to expand would be neat! I'd love to be able to see where Classics, my #10 genre so far in 2024, falls in the All-Time chart, for example.

posts.title: filter book-specific challenges
posts.description: In the book club I'm running, it came up that people would like to be able to search for book names in book-specific challenges and they would like to filter for "to-read" books, too. I created a challenge with all the books the club has read so far, since 2008, and it's ... well, a lot of books. XD So being able to see which ones someone would still have to read, would be super helpful.

posts.title: View feature requests/ideas you've submitted
posts.description: This is possibly a little too meta, but I'd really like to be able to see feature requests/ideas I've submitted so that if I notice something, I can see whether or not I have already submitted it in the past. Sometimes I notice a feature that could be added or improved and have the thought to report it multiple times but can't remember if I've done it before (and don't want to double-report). Thanks!

posts.title: Option to start Calendar Monthly Graphic on Sunday
posts.description: Apologies if this has already been suggested, but I would love if there was an option for the Calendar monthly wrap up graphic to start on Sunday. For the Americans, lol. I just realized it started on Monday and that was why I was struggling a little with matching the books to the days I read them.

posts.title: Tags follow editions
posts.description: Tags automatically switch to the edition that you’ve read (instead of showing “You’ve read another edition of this book” in the tag list).

posts.title: Comprehensive Author # Read Books Chart
posts.description: I don't know if this quite fits here or in the future Stats V5 but it would be cool to see your Most Read Authors chart going through all your authors? Like maybe you can click on it to see more authors? I mostly ask cause I read like 10 graphic novels by these 2 guys and frankly I'm not that into them and I'm curious who's below them hahaha

posts.title: Character name search function
posts.description: A way to search for books by character/protagonist name, similar to IMDB’s advanced search character field. Some reading challenges have prompts like “read a book where the protagonist shares your or a friend’s name” and it would make it easier to find books if we could search by character name. Google and other search engines give poor results, so I have to rely on asking other people on Discord if they know of any books.

posts.title: Count up books over time chart
posts.description: I’d love to have a comparison chart that says for over a period of time, to see how many books I’ve read cumulatively. Like two line graphs over months but adding up instead of just how many read in those periods of time.

posts.title: DNF book progress percentage more easily visible
posts.description: On the DNF-ed books page I can see all the books that I’ve DNF-ed and click for an explanation. This books list page offers a Stopped date field. Could we also see the stopped at percentage progress alongside this date? Background: Currently I have to dig into each book individually, then select ‘view journal entries’, before I can figure out how far into the book I got before deciding to DNF. Ultimately I’d like to see my DNF progress stats charted, as I was trying to visualise if I was DNF-ing quicker more recently. There is the average %-age progress stat, but I wanted to see all the data that contributed to that stat so that I can see my trend.

posts.title: Show Average Book Rating Per Year Across Years
posts.description: Like the graph in the All Time where it shows number of books and pages read in a line graph per year, it'd be fun to see what my average rating per year was. You could even include it in the same graph with another line.

posts.title: The ability to see someone's reviews easily
posts.description: Would absolutely love if we had a section on someone's account where we can easily see all their reviews. Like if I found someone's account from the reviews tab and loved what they said, how they formatted their post, etc, and wanted to go on their account to see if they had any reviews for other books I read; there's no easy way to find them. That is, of course, if we follow them and then go to each book one by one. It would be nice to see "All of ___ Reviews" or something.

posts.title: Hide Certain Stats
posts.description: It would be good if you could hide certain stats.I don't need the most read authors or language stats, for instance. I know you have a drop down list, but it would be nice to look at all stats with those not wanted hidden.

posts.title: Review Template
posts.description: I think it could be nice and helpful to have an optional review template for written reviews. Help guide those of us who want to read some salient information about the book but don't want to read a paragraph long review that doesn't mention what we want. Entries: X meets Y: This book is like X meets Y with some Z thrown in Best Scene: Would you reread? Would you recommend? etc...

posts.title: Reading sprints
posts.description: It would be so cool to have a reading sprint (pomodoro) bot/timer in the app. Even cooler if it could be a community enriched feature with the ability to invite friends and a chat room. Possibly added into Book Clubs?

posts.title: Change Edition/Cover for Book Specific Reading Challenges
posts.description: I would love the ability to select which cover/edition shows up on specific book challenge prompts! I've figured out how to get the covers I want by marking those editions as To Read if I'm creating the challenge but it would be nice to change it after the fact without having to re-add books, or to change them for challenges I've joined. Also, some of the books I added had been read as audiobook versions, so it populated the audiobook cover when I added those to the challenge, but I wanted a print version cover for aesthetics, so I don't always want the cover for the edition I tracked. Thanks so much!

posts.title: Better way to browse periodicals/series and search for issues
posts.description: I've recently been reading some long-running short fiction periodicals. Some of them only have 100 or fewer issues, which makes browsing to find the correct issue in the series easier. But for others, especially ones that have been running 500+ issues it can be time intensive to find the right issue or to see if it's there. It also makes it hard to figure out if the issue you're reading has been added or not. It would be great if there were a way to search within a series by issue number or title, or if there were just a way to look through that didn't require simply scrolling down until the end.

posts.title: A fiction/nonfiction filter for the to read list
Tags for reads/re-reads instead of just books
posts.description: My favorite custom chart that I have made so far is my "book source" chart. I went through all my Read books and added tags for where the book was from when I read it. However, if I ever re-read books in the same edition, my data will become incorrect. Scenario: I buy a new book and tag it "from-store". I read it this year and love it. In two years, I read that same edition again. I'm in a pickle... I need to either - have an erroneous "from-store" in my 2025 data - change the tag to "from-shelf" to be accurate in 2025 which would make 2023 inaccurate - pretend I'm reading a different edition even though it's the same one so that I can tag it differently

posts.title: Better default color for custom stats
posts.description: For the new custom charts, it would be nice is the chart colors would be automated to be not black. I don't care what the color is, but prefer a bit of color to the chart.

posts.title: Stats/Recommendations/AI by format
posts.description: I'd like to suggest some deeper looks at books-by-format. 1. Compare ratings for a book in print vs digital vs audio. Helps us to answer "Hey, what's a great audiobook?" if we look at ratings for the audio vs digital vs print copies, for example 2. Recommendations include a filter for format. "I want a long sci-fi audiobook; what do you suggest?" 3. In Personalized preview, account for relative ratings - something like "readers especially liked this in print version".

posts.title: Add Book Button on Author Page
posts.description: When you click on an author and see all their books, it would be great to have a link at the top of that page to add a book for that author. It would help with making sure you have the correct author when multiple authors have the same name.

posts.title: Invite friends to challenge
posts.description: Currently, you can send friends a link to a challenge outside the app. Would love an in-app invite button to invite current friends :)

posts.title: compare stats by tag
posts.description: I use tags to track the sources of my books as well as books I've read for my book club or library challenges. I'd love to be able to see what my overall rating for books by tag and how it compare to my overall ratings. For example, if I filter Stats by my book club tag, can it tell me the average rating for this tag instead of having to calculate it manually.

posts.title: Different app icons for Plus members
posts.description: Several apps let you switch out your app icon if you pay for a premium subscription. For example X, Discord, Letterboxd. It would be cool to offer different StoryGraph icons for Plus members. One example could be a dark mode/black icon. Maybe different icons for different genres or just a variety of colors.

posts.title: Top list/charts
posts.description: I would love to have some charts based on the data we already have. Similar to databases like Letterboxd and Rate Your Music, I'd love to see the hightest rated books and to be able to generate my own charts based on things like publication year, genre, mood etc. Links to both examples: https://rateyourmusic.com/charts/ https://letterboxd.com/films/

posts.title: Display genre stat changes over time
posts.description: I know you can see how many books of each genre you can see in a given time point, but it would also be nice to see a graph (line graph) of how these change over this time (like we do for the change in number of books).

posts.title: Reminder to update neglected book in "reading" pile
posts.description: Sometimes I start a book, then read something else and it stays in the "reading" pile for months. I would like to receive an email or notification asking "are you still reading this?" For the book that has not been updated the longest. Let's say a week or a month later, or a set period.

posts.title: Hide progress updates in reading journal
posts.description: Is there already a way to hide progress updates in the reading journal? I would like to use my reading streak & stats more but that clutters up my reading journal. I only want to see what books I've started & finished there (it's the first place I go when I can't remember the name of a book I'm recommending, so daily updates of several books is a pain to wade through)

posts.title: List "Content to Avoid" per book
posts.description: I love that storygraph adds a warning symbol next to books with content types I want to avoid. However, neither the tooltip nor clicking through to the book page show which content types triggered the warning. If there are a lot of content warnings tagged on the book I may miss the one relevant to me and have to sit and scour them multiple times. Without knowing at a glance which things caused the warning to appear it isn't very useful. Instead of saying "users have tagged content types that you don't want to read about" would it be possible to list them?

posts.title: Get book recommendation for a specific author
posts.description: I often get new authors suggested, but when they've written a lot, it's hard to decide which book of theirs to start with. So I think it could be cool to have some kind of recommendation or filter within the books of a specific author. Maybe like the regular recommendation section ("most like things you liked before" / "most different from what you usually read" / "most loved by readers (un)like you" etc)

posts.title: Buddy Read Remove User Warning
posts.description: Recently, I removed one person from a buddy read and it somehow removed others who had already commented. Would be good to have some kind of message pop up to ask "are you sure, this will delete comments" to prevent existing comments from disappearing.

posts.title: Filter Challenges by Number of Participants
posts.description: It would be really helpful to filter them by number of participants -- I've noticed it's hard to find some as there are duplicates (52 Book Club one in particular)and sometimes the keyword function doesn't return all the results. It's also fun to see which are the most participated in!

posts.title: Start Date shown on the stats/book page
posts.description: When viewing the books for a time period, it currently shows the date that the book was finished. It would be nice to see a line above it that says Started with the date as well

posts.title: Adding Donate option alongside owned books
posts.description: Instead of just removing a book from owned books, I would love to have an option to categorise books as Donated. It would really help to see how many books I've donated in a month or year (those are popular challenges on Instagram) and would be great to have in a yearly review. It possible, it would be nice to have options like, owned, gifted, borrowed from the library/friend, rented from apps like Everand or KU, donated to charity shops etc.

posts.title: Distinguish European Portuguese from Brazilian Portuguese
posts.description: I'm sure this is something that impacts a small percentage of users. So, European Portuguese and Brazilian Portuguese are not the same and there are usually different editions for each language. As an european portuguese I don't like to read in Brazilian, unless it is the original language for the book. It's not the same as reading the UK vs the US edition of a book, it's actually different the way the sentences are put together. It would be nice to distinguish between the two and have the two options available. I usually have to look at the publisher to make sure I'm choosing the right edition. I'm not sure if this is something that applies to other languages, it might be.

posts.title: Nudge/Co-host challenges not being updated
posts.description: I’m at at least one challenge which is ongoing reading of award winners (Hugo). I’m not sure if the current owner is still active on the site, as the 2023 winners have not been added to the challenge. I’d like a way to nudge or offered to cohost a challenge.

posts.title: Gift Plus Monthly
posts.description: Would be a nice option to be able to gift someone 1 - 12 months of plus rather than just a full year as it is currently.

posts.title: Readalongs posts on the Community News Feed
posts.description: Now that we have readalongs it would be nice to have them promoted so they are easier to find and join. For example seeing in the community page whenever a friend joins a readalong or when a readalong is created for a book in your tbr.

posts.title: Series Format Selection
posts.description: I'd be really cool to be shown audiobook versions of the rest of a series (if available) when you click on the series name from an audiobook format of a book in that series. If there's a way to try to further match to that edition, that would be great, but just the format matching would be a big improvement as someone who primarily reads audiobooks.

posts.title: Add secondary role to author field
posts.description: Be able to add an additional role To the author field. especially when the author and narrator are the same person. Example: (Author/narrator) similar Goodreads. Rather than having to copy the name in the contributor section.

posts.title: Buddy reads: Make all comments visible when rereading
posts.description: Whenever I’m buddy reading a book that I’ve read before, I can’t see comments past the point I’m in for my current read. I can see how that may be useful/motivating for some people, but it’s often been a bit of a bother for me. It would be nice if the default behaviour were different, or at least optional (e.g. if there were a [view comment] toggle). One of my current buddy reads is for a book I’ve been both rereading and listening to on audio for the first time. I finished the audiobook first. When I did, all the comment threads for later points in the book were suddenly hidden again. So it turns out that the feature doesn’t even take into account whether I already finished reading the book *during* that buddy read itself.

posts.title: book cover tool tip
posts.description: In views where the book covers are displayed smaller (reading challenges, profiles, "similar users" etc.) it's sometimes hard to recognize a book. I have to click through to the book page to see title & author, only to go back because I realize I already know the book and am not interested after all. If would be helpful to have a tooltip in those views which displays book title & author in plain text when hovering over a cover.

posts.title: Tag Stats for Time Period
posts.description: Currently, when viewing or comparing stats for tags, you see the stats for all-time. I would like to be able to see just the stats for a given year. That would allow: * Viewing the stats for a tag for a year * Comparing the stats for a given tag between two years * Comparing the stats between two tags for a given year

posts.title: Additional stat categories
posts.description: I'd like to have additional stats to track: 1. Gender and ethnicity of the author. 2. Countries that I have read from - where author is from/ book is based. 3. Other diverse stats about the author or characters: - LGBTQ rep - Disability rep

posts.title: Multilingual books
posts.description: In my country, anthologies are usually written in two languages (there are some works in language x and some in language y), it would be wonderful if there was a possibility to tag books with both languages instead of trying to figure out what it should be listed as.

posts.title: DNF not counted toward reading goal
posts.description: I would like to be able to change the setting to NOT include books I DNF as counted towards my reading goal. I know some people do like it to count but I don't especially if I didn't get to at least half way through the book. So maybe a happy medium is a toggle to include or exclude DNF books depending on percentage, pages, length or just personal preference.

posts.title: List personal tags first
posts.description: Would it be possible to list my personal tags before/above the generic ones? I often have to click the tiny down arrow on my phone to view my own tags.

posts.title: Clickable Link to Reading Challenge on Book Page
posts.description: Hello! Apologies if this has already requested, I didn't see it when I searched. I'd love if from the book page I could click the "You have added this book to [Reading Challenge]" under activity and have it bring me to the reading challenge referenced (ideally to the prompt the book is assigned to). And/or have the specific prompt listed on the book page as well!

posts.title: Stats based on our opinions
posts.description: I'm not sure how to word this to see if it's already been suggested, but I would like to see stats for specifically my answers the review questions. A pie chart for how many I've answered as "character based" vs "plot based" or which I've considered diverse or not. In the same vein, it bothers me that the pie charts that indicate a book's mood and the one for pace are NOT based on my answers to those questions. If I think a book is fast paced, but the majority has labeled it as medium paced, my own stats display it as medium. Same with book moods.

posts.title: Hiding "Challenges you’ve created"
posts.description: Would it be possible to find a way to hide "Challenges you’ve created"? Under "reading challenges" I like to focus on just the ones being active and I end up having challenges from last year and finished challenges take up most of the screen.

posts.title: Suggestion for stats when you compare tags or reading
posts.description: It would be cool if when you compare tags could see stuff they have in common like authors or books. The same could be dine when you for example compare your reading for 2021 and 2922 - which authors have you, if any, in common

posts.title: Disable genre field when adding/editing books that aren't flagged as "main"
posts.description: Maybe there are niche cases where editions of the same book legitimately need to have different genres. However, in practice what I often see is a lot of inconsistent genre info among different editions within the same family. It would be really nice if the "genre" field did not appear on the form at all when people are adding new editions to an existing book family (or when librarians are editing a non-main book). That way, if anyone wants to fix a book's existing genres, they will always have to submit a book ticket to fix the entire family, instead of adding an edition with their preferred genre, which won't affect the rest of the book family.

posts.title: Keep track of fanfiction
posts.description: The possibility to add your fanfiction readings without adding the actual fanfiction (because many ff authors don't like that). So it could work via words read for example. And keeping the name of the fanfiction hidden from the public (like the notes).

posts.title: Owned books in Search Results
posts.description: I’d really like my owned books that are not on my TBR/Read list to come up first in searches. So if I search for a book I will know that I own it, even if it isn’t currently on my TBR pile.

posts.title: Alerts for new book adds
posts.description: I am a librarian and one of my duties is add comics and graphic novels that have lgbtqia themes to our special 'rainbow shelf' Ville tuon. I have my native tongue Finnish well covered, but we also include English and Swedish releases to the collection. I just realised it would be great if I could get notifications every time a book in those languages gets added to the site and is categorised as lgbtqia. It would help to get those smaller releases on my radar that might otherwise fly past :)

posts.title: Page count for To be Read pile
posts.description: Hi. It would be great to have a total word count for books that are showing on my TBR pile, be it the whole pile, or the filtered TBR, when one applies filters. I think it would be nice to be able to get a general sense of how many hours of reading would be necessary to finish all the books I want to read. :)

posts.title: Export CSV
posts.description: Hi! It'd be great to be able to export a csv of my books (or a subset thereof), with information like tagged, owned, TBR/ read etc against them. There's several use cases, but the two that I'm thinking of is loading into something like Calibre, and loading into a wish-list on a book buying site

posts.title: Streamlined genres tab on stats
posts.description: The genres chart has always kind of just felt cluttered to me. Especially if there are like 10 categories where I have only read one book from. There are, also, a lot of arbitrary distinctions, for instance, between tabs like autobiography vs memoir or self-help vs psychology It’s a bit of a bother to have to search between different tabs, especially on the app, just to find the exact genre-labeling of the book I’ve read, or map out how many self-improvement books I’ve read. Maybe group certain tabs together based on very general genre and then allow users to choose increasingly more specific subgenres from there to avoid clutter. Or just combine certain tabs It would also be nice to be able to look at more specific subgenres, even in using the search functionality to find new reads. For instance, being able to search for specifically Urban Fantasy books.

posts.title: Add report missing/incorrect information option for a series page
posts.description: Give users the option to report missing/incorrect information for an entire series. This feature would be helpful for things like correcting the order of a series or the ability to include a StoryGraph link to merge a book into a series.

posts.title: Up Next suggestions already in Up Next?
posts.description: Apologies if (as I strongly suspect), this is a duplicate, I couldn't find the post. Over the last few weeks I've noted that, despite having 90-110 books in my TBR, on average of 60-80% of the Up Next suggestions already are on my Up Next. Are there any plans to change this so that only books not already on the Up Next list get suggested for adding to it?

posts.title: One Year Later Prompt
posts.description: Create option/prompt you to update the review/star rating you gave a book a year on. Interesting to see how things change between initial reaction and things having sat with you...

posts.title: More people in a buddyread
posts.description: I'd love to be able to add more people to a buddyread then the current number!

posts.title: Deal alerts for books in TBR
posts.description: This may be completely out of scope and seems like it would be really difficult to implement, but one thing that's really nice about Goodreads is the notifications for books going on sale or giveaways. I think a feature on TSG that directly competes with that would be appealing to many potential users.

posts.title: Is there a FAQ somewhere?
posts.description: I have had several questions that are little and annoying. It would be great if there was an FAQ but I can't seem to find one. Instead I end up clicking around trying to find the answer or googling it the whole time getting frustrated or just giving up.

posts.title: Distinction between prompts when creating a challenge
posts.description: As a creator of reading challenges, I wish for a more clear distinction between the separate prompts in a challenge. Right now, I can only distinguish them via the small (x) button, but other than that, I don't really see where one prompt ends and another begins, or which input fields belong to which prompt. As a user, I have to pay extra attention to that. It would be great if they could be divided by a line or something similar, so it's easier to see with one glance.

posts.title: Archive/Remove Suggestions
posts.description: Could there be an option to archive suggestions from the suggestions on the main page? (For example, when Facebook suggests friends to add to your friends list, but you don't want to add them, you can click a "remove" button and the person is no longer suggested. Can this be done for books suggested on the main page?

posts.title: Sort scores by tags?
posts.description: I don't know if this feature already exists, hence the question: More than 80% of the nonfiction books I read are linguistics books. That science doesn't exist as a genre at TSG, and most of the linguistic books I've read and recorded here don't even have "science" as a genre, simply being categorised "nonfiction", or sometimes "history", which as labels go can be "technically true but misleading". Although linguistics definitely has a long HISTORY of not being recognised as a science. :) Therefore, I have my own "linguistics" tag to add to all these books, but afaik the "view ratings by book type" only works for TSG-assigned genres, not user-created tags. Is this sort of ratings comparison currently possible, and if not, is it on the roadmap?

posts.title: Compare Stats only shows books  — Show pages & hours too
posts.description: At the moment, the graph for "compare stats" only shows books in the month by month display, as in the screenshot it would be a nice addition if pages could be selected too. Not critical, just a very low (subterranean low) priority, "ooh, this would be a nice bonus" kind of thing.

posts.title: community section in homepage
posts.description: Not sure if this has already been suggested or is in the works, but is there any way to include community updates on the homepage? Maybe have it as something we can toggle on and off? I know we have that community tab, but I think it would be a cool option to be able to add it to the homepage rather than have to go elsewhere to see what my friends/people I follow are reading. Thanks for all your hard work!

posts.title: Humour/Comedy as a genre
posts.description: I saerched for these keywords before posting, I hope this is not a duplicate entry. Would a humour/comedy be possible/feasible? Given the specificity of the genre options already available, the omission of this genre seems a bit surprising. The ill-yclept Amazon-owned Storygraph wannabe DOES offer this genre, I note.

posts.title: Tracking books with Roman numerals
posts.description: I notice there is no feature to track the page numbers of books that feature Roman numerals. This would be a useful feature to have, mostly when tracking non-fiction reads, but editions of classic literature often use the Roman numeric system too, especially with introductions/commentary etc. Would it be possible to implement a method of tracking books in this way?

posts.title: Complete any X/Y Challenges (e.g. any 25/30)
posts.description: I'm working on the Free Black Women's Library Challenge which has thirty prompts, but the description of the challenge says "the goal is to read 25 books..." It would be really nice if the challenge in StoryGraph had a way to basically say "here are the 30 prompts, if you complete any of these 25, you get the 🎉 emojis". I don't even know of a way to workaround this, unless the challenge author picked which five were optional (not ideal) or made them all optional and left it up to the person to complete 25 (even less ideal). https://app.thestorygraph.com/reading_challenges/8cc6093b-cc8b-42b6-aeb7-0178d60974fc

posts.title: 'Other edition' read button
posts.description: When I've read an edition of a book but look at the page of another edition, the button is green and says 'read'. While there is still the notification at the top that says I've added another edition, wouldn't it be better if the 'edition' is marked the same way because it's the same book?

posts.title: See and sort list of my "owned" books
posts.description: I can't find how to see a list of all my owned books. I would like to be able to see my owned books and sort by author, title, or genre/tag

posts.title: A chat/message board function
posts.description: I would love it if their was a coial aspect, even if it started as a simple message board. But later the option to have a chat/message board with just those invited so you can do buddy reads/book groups.

posts.title: Link for friends to join
posts.description: Is there a simple way to link my StoryGraph profile (specifically on FB) so friends can easily join + be part of my community?

posts.title: Nonfiction
posts.description: Do you think TSG would be able to have a "nonfiction" tag in the "what is your favorite genres" section of modeling our recs? I know it's a pretty broad genre but I would certainly appreciate being able to put that tag in to help filter my recs!

posts.title: audiobook vs physical/ebook
posts.description: it would be cool if there was a way to mark whether you listened to a book or read it physically (esp for stats/personal trends purposes)

posts.title: More flexible reading challenge date options
posts.description: For book-specific reading challenge prompts, a participant may have already read a book at some point in the past and may prefer only to tackle books on the list that they may not have read—there should be a way for old reads to ‘count’ if they want. Current reading challenge rules only allow either open-ended start/end dates or a specific start/end date. But even for challenges that end on, say, December 31 of a given year, if it’s a book-specific list, a participant may want to include old reads too. Please make it possible for challenges with a specific end date to have an open-ended start too.

posts.title: Translate others reviews
posts.description: I’d love to be able to read users from other countries/languages reviews. I’m currently reading a translated spanish book and all the reviews are in spanish which I don’t speak :(

posts.title: Add “X” button to clear search field
posts.description: Can you add a “x” in the search field so we can quickly clear it out? It seems so silly to ask, but would be a nice to have. Thanks!

posts.title: Show book format on results page
posts.description: In the results page, if there is more than one edition of a book, it just shows the same book multiple times. In order to tell which is digital, paperback, audio, etc. you have to click into the record. It would be helpful to either have the format of each edition on the result for each, or combine the results into one and have a drop down selection below it for formats that you can add the specific one you need.

posts.title: Import TBRs from CSV
posts.description: I use Calibre to manage my ebook library, and am increasingly finding it a challenge to make sure my TBRS from Calibre and TSG are perfectly synced. If we could import from CSV, then it would be simple to export TBRs from sources other than GR and keep our TBRs here up to date. Even if it was a one-off, like GR imports, at least it would mean starting with synched TBRs. After that, any deviation would be the user's problem :)

posts.title: Advanced Privacy Settings
posts.description: It would be nice to use this platform as a social one, but still maintain privacy/anonymity if desired. To this effect, the ability to choose individual privacy settings for reviews, profile, likes/comments, etc., would be great. This could include making it so only friends are able to see that you made reviews or comments, either by either hiding them completely to non-friends, or adding an anonymous placeholder name for non-friends. I would also be happy to see a level in-between current privacy settings, where my profile would still be searchable but would require a friend request.

posts.title: Reading Challenges: Mark Books Added to Prompt by Others
posts.description: Once a reading challenge is added, please consider a way for the creator to quickly see which books others added to a prompt. As a list grows, it's sometimes hard to remember what I added.

posts.title: Email updates
posts.description: Email updates that show me the books that the people I follow are reading currently

posts.title: We all choose a book to read for the year
posts.description: We could upvote a book to all read the next year. Like a challenge, but without the fixed prompts. Maybe a book for each genre?

posts.title: Default for what are you in the mood for
