posts.description: The filter values for "What are you in the mood for?" should default to the values defined in your profile.

posts.title: interactive genre bars
posts.description: right now the pies are interactive and that is both visible and useful. it would be good if that were the case for the genres because not everyone has noticed it.

posts.title: Filter Suggested next reads to not include unpublished books
posts.description: I love the suggestions page for deciding on my next book, but at times I will have put in my TBR a book that hasn't been published yet. I would like the suggestions to not include these since it is impossible for me to read them next.

posts.title: Mark an entire review as containing spoilers
posts.description: Goodreads has this option and it would be extremely useful to have here as well. The spoiler tags only work on a single paragraph and adding multiple spoiler tags in a single review is inconvenient.

posts.title: Easier Tag Creation
posts.description: I would love the ability to first create tags, for instance on the "your-tags" page and then later assign them to the books. Right now, I need to go to a specific book to create a new tag, to me it would make sense to also allow tag creation on the "main" tag space, so to say. So I can easily see which tags I already have and directly add new ones.

posts.title: When removing a book, it will be auto-removed from all your reading challenges
posts.description: When removing books from your to-read list, the app asks if you want to remove all your tags. In that pop-up, would it be possible to also include “remove from all reading challenges”? It’s tedious to have to individually remove a book from a bunch of separate reading challenges (especially if they’re from past years or numbered challenges) once you've decided you no longer want to read it at all.

posts.title: Mood map in "regular" stats
posts.description: Perhaps the thing I love the most about the yearly wrap up is the mood map (the line that goes up with lighter books, and down with darker ones), but I think it's such a shame that it's only visible in a yearly basis. I would love for it to be part of the "regular" stats page, like the pages/books read per month line is.

posts.title: Comparison chart - pages read per month
posts.description: I look at the yearly “Number of books and pages” chart often. Now that I have plus, I really like that I can compare the number of books read per month between 2025 and 2026, for example. But I’d really love to be able to do the same for pages read! A separate chart would work, or maybe even combining the books and pages read charts, like the single-year view. I find the single-year chart really easy to interpret with those stats overlaid. The pages read could be represented w/ different colors or dotted lines or something! I hope that makes sense. p.s. thanks for all your hard work on the app! :)

posts.title: Filter to won giveaways
posts.description: When you go into the entered giveaways, it would be helpful to be able to filter to giveaways you’ve won. It would make it easier to accept and download giveaway wins.

posts.title: Import book via photo on phone
posts.description: It would be very helpful for those who read primarily on our phones to be able to upload a screenshot from our camera rolls when searching by cover image. (I think right now the only way to search by image for ISBN/cover image comes from opening your camera, which doesn’t work for digital content.) Used to get around this problem by using ISBN import but that is no longer available.

posts.title: Move “Update” button when adding a tag
posts.description: When I click on the text box to add a new tag to a book, the drop down list that appears is on top of the update button. More often than I’d like to admit, this causes me to forget to hit the update button (out of sight, out of mind, I guess!), and thus I lose my changes and have to redo them. Plus it requires an additional tap to close the drop down list (which isn’t immediately obvious, adding to the problem) Is there any chance the “Update” button could dynamically move to just after the bottom of the drop down list, or perhaps move the button to above the tag box (or somewhere else that’s more visible). Thanks!

posts.title: Edition switching after the book is added to a to read or currently reading shelf
posts.description: Because the search results only display the initial version of the book, which is usually the hardcover, it is inconvenient to then go to the editions list and click a three line menu and then go to switch edition when I'm selecting the audio or electronic version. It would be nice if on the currently reading/to read drop down. We could see the switch additions when we've already added a different addition of this book to a shelf.

posts.title: Filter readalongs by language
posts.description: Please add ability to filter by language

posts.title: Challenges: the app picks my next read
posts.description: I've made a reading challenge for myself to read most of my physical TBR in 2026. I added almost all the books I have to this challenge and I thought it could be really fun to have a button on the challenge page for the app to pick a random book from the books I/someone else added! I just finished a book and then I could press the button and let the app pick my next read for me :) I have no clue if it's easily achievable, so no worries if it's not!

posts.title: Switch ownership of reading challenge
posts.description: Someone in our book club started a reading challenge of all the books we've read. She's now left the book club so the reading challenge isn't being maintained. It'd be great if there was a way to switch ownership

posts.title: Square Version of Cover/Ratings Collages
posts.description: While the generated Summary wrap-up is available in both square and vertical formats, just split into multiple pages when converted to a square, it would be super neat to have the same for the Cover and Ratings Collages. It would make it easy to share to socials

posts.title: More compact interface for joined challenges
posts.description: Having an interface that shows a more compact view of challenges ive joined would be helpful to reduce scrolling. I like seeing the percentage finished for each without having to click into the challenge, but maybe just showing it in the format of a straight bar instead of the current large circle would be better. This would be similar to how the book/pages/hours goals show in the challenge interface already.

posts.title: Minimum number of prompts for challenges
posts.description: It would be cool if reading challenges had the option to allow for participants to consider challenges complete if they fulfill a certain number of prompts. I know sometimes hosts would only want everyone to do just a certain number and would like their challenges to be on the Storygraph, but participants would feel pressure to complete them all even when they don't strictly need to for that particular challenge.

posts.title: Streak period in Stats
posts.description: The ability to select your current reading Streak as a time period in the Stats dropdown. Currently Plus can do a custom period, and I love the ability to generate Wrap-Up graphics for that period, but having to count or look up forever many days it’s been is cumbersome to achieve the result. This could also be integrated into the Streak page? Keep up the great work, Nadia!

posts.title: Additional filter options for 'owned books' stats
posts.description: I'd love to be able view stats for the books i own physical editions of seperately from those I own audio or digital editions of. A secondary drop down or set of radio buttons for format would be amazing. Just generally adding more filters to the stats pages, like the ability to exclude certain tags etc. would be great too!

posts.title: Bring back titles in the personalised who’s it for? tab
posts.description: I love the personalised who’s it for section. It’s always so interesting. However, I’ve noticed in recent months that it no longer uses specific titles as examples; they weren’t always the most accurate but I miss it and would love to see them brought back!

posts.title: Link to Explore page from Wrap-up Components section
posts.description: I was going through my 2025 wrap-up and noticed the potential for a new feature for the 2026 wrap-up! I really appreciated the components of my highest-rated reads section of the wrap-up as a plus user and especially the message "Try mixing and matching some of these features to find your 2026 favourites!". I got to thinking that it would be a great place to link to a search in the explore page where those options are selected, so that the user can immediately search for books that fit those criteria. Otherwise I'm really loving the stats and am looking forward to discovering new titles in 2026!

posts.title: Ability to filter star ratings by language
posts.description: I read for pleasure as well as language learning (also pleasant but different), and would love the ability to filter my five star ratings at least by language so I can more easily see my "serious" five star reads vs my enjoyment coupled with how useful the book was to me as a language learner. This may be a niche problem but I feel that I will be using the same rating system slightly differently in different languages.

posts.title: more visually appealing / interesting wrap-up designs
posts.description: I would love prettier / most interesting designs for the wrap-ups (both monthly and yearly). This year the goodreads year "wrapped" was prettier, more interesting, with some cool facts, in my opinion a bit better than storygraphs. I ended up sharing theirs online. The graphs on storygraph are cool and super interesting to navigate year round with a lot of information (which goodreads doesn't have), but the monthly and yearly wrapped designs on storygraph are not always that pretty / easy to share, or that visually appealing, in my opinion. Here are some of my goodreads year wrapped images of this year, compared to storygraphs, just to give an insigh on what I mean.

posts.title: Access to archived Challanges
posts.description: For the archived challenges. It would be amazing if we still could search for them as it is a great resource to find books with very specific representation the content is already there generated by the users, please make it available ❤️

posts.title: Stats: # of books read for challenges by month/year
posts.description: If possible, would love a monthly/yearly stat for the number of books that I've finished reading that were apart of (or I added to) challenges I elected to participate in for a given month or year.

posts.title: Linked liked reviews (once likes are a thing)
posts.description: I would like a feature where you could keep track of reviews you've liked, and also have the reviews you've liked of a particular book be linked to your own review, kind of like Letterboxd does it. Obviously this is in the potentially distant future, but I wanted to throw it out there!

posts.title: Streak “Overflow”
posts.description: An optional feature where reading past your reading goal builds up a surplus that counts towards your next streak interval (day, week, etc.) For example: If my daily reading goal is 50 pages and I read 70, then the next day carries the 20 surplus and I only have to read the remaining 30. If I instead read 150 pages in a day, then the current and the next two days’ streaks will have been completed. This way reading past your reading goal feels meaningful.

posts.title: More Onboarding Challenges
posts.description: Please create more than one onboarding challenge a year for new features, using tags, using random, creating a challenge or joining one, participating in the community, etc.

posts.title: Please bring back "View Editions" on main book page on mobile
posts.description: I just saw that there have been some updates to the book page on mobile and I'm really sad that the Editions picker is now hidden behind a drop-down. I use that button on basically every book I read, because the format that pops up on search is almost never the correct one. Having to tap the drop-down every time I do this now is a disappointing change since it's such a high traffic button for me. Additionally, I already just exploring one single book accidentally hit the "To Read" button when I meant to hit the new drop-down. An easily rectifiable mistake, but also one I'm sure I will be repeating very often. I know that space is at a premium on this page, but please reconsider this design choice, because it will make the app so much harder to use for my most common workflows.

posts.title: Ability to not go back to start of challenges when leaving or updating a challenge
posts.description: Ability to remain in current order instead of going back to newest challenge

posts.title: Ability to leave a challenge without opening the challenge
posts.description: A button similar to the archive button.

posts.title: Show relevant editions on contributor pages
posts.description: A lot of the time a person is only a contributor on some editions. When browsing the list of books on their page, I'd like to be able to see the specific edition that they contributed to. eg on an illustrator's page I'd like to see the illustrated edition of a book and rather than the default one; on an audiobook narrator's page it would be nice to see audio editions.

posts.title: Misc Pages/minutes
posts.description: It would be good if you could add pages you've read but might not necessarily want to add as a book you've read. For me, this is novellas or short fanfics that I wouldn't necessarily add to my account, but sometimes I get in a binge of fics and can't track any reading unless I read one that is either already uploaded, upload one for it myself (even if it's very short and I don't want to add to my book count for the year) or pick up another book.

posts.title: Tracking books without pages
posts.description: Add a way for users to indicate that a book does not have numbered pages but has tracked parts. I read a lot of trade paperbacks (collections of previously published comic books) and some of them do not re-number their pages when they combine the books. They do give you an indication of how many books/chapters are in the series (ex: 3 of 12, 2 of 6) so I'd like to be able to indicate the number of chapters in a trade paperback/graphic novel, put in what part I've finished, and have it auto-calculate the percentage and page numbers. Example: https://app.thestorygraph.com/books/f4c81882-a81d-4335-bf5d-4f4ad8c51e71 This book has no page numbers but it has 12 chapters. So after finishing chapter 6, it would tell me that I'm 50% finished or finished approximately 164 pages. There's often some extra material in the Trade Paperbacks that don't count toward the story but I think the page number approximation is fine in these cases.

posts.title: Custom Charts with Read/Unread Tags
posts.description: I've been trying to keep track of what % of my owned books I have read and what I haven't read yet- and sometimes based on a certain event (for instance, I participate in indie bookstore day every year and I like to see how many of my titles from the previous year I have read). I had to do a workaround where I tag all of the books that I own as "read, unread, reading" in order to sort a chart by both where I got it and where I'm at in the reading process. Would be cool to be able to sort by a main feature (i.e., read status is already some of the metadata), plus then additional tags or something.

posts.title: Link book club and reading challenge
posts.description: Hello! Would it be possible to consider linking the reading challenges, like the Book-specific prompt challenge, to a book club? Our book club uses an annual reading challenge in addition to the overall reading list to track what we have read this year and it would be beneficial if it could be linked! Thank you!

posts.title: Notifications for App Updates
posts.description: I'd love to be able to opt into emails or some kind of notifications that announce/explain new app updates. Previously, I was able to keep up with app updates on Instagram and really enjoyed seeing those posts from The StoryGraph. However, I've recently decided to deactivate my Instagram account and feel a little out of the loop with recent updates. For example, I noticed the new Favorites bar on my profile, but don't fully understand its purpose, best ways to use it, if I can choose to hide it, etc. Just looking for a new way to stay informed because I love The StoryGraph and want to hear about all the amazing things it's doing!

posts.title: Add cover of the book in the Reviews page
posts.description: It would be nice visually to have the cover of the book on the Review page so it's a lot easier to scroll and find the one you were looking for PLUS it makes it pretty for screenshotting and sharing! Added a mock-up of how it could look like for desktop/mobile :)

posts.title: A way to count special edition of a book as two books in a series
posts.description: I have hardcover special editions of a series where the prequel is included in the first book, and a novella is included in the third book. I wish there was a way to link or separate these within the special editions so each book's pages could be tracked individually. It’s like having two books in one, but it’s not a collection since the novellas are just included in the special edition hardcovers and aren’t listed as part of the main books.

posts.title: Add date range to compare stats
posts.description: Add the ability to pick a custom date range, YTD, quarters, MTD, etc. in the compare stats on plus, not just the year or month as a whole. I’m interested in comparing my progress year over year and currently I have to go into each month to get the numbers and calculate them elsewhere.

posts.title: Toggle to Hide Short Stories on Series Page
posts.description: One of the series pages I frequently look at has lots of short stories, and it makes it difficult to find the main books in the list. My particular example is the InCryptid Series by Seanan McGuire. I'd love a feature at the top of the page to toggle and hide anything tagged as "short stories".

posts.title: love child of book list + book club?
posts.description: I'm interested to merge the ideas of a book club with a curated, hand-picked suggested reading list: Partly book club functionality (folks with similar interest reading similar/same books and interacting in the forums or maybe answering interesting Qs from the moderator). Partly tags/book-list functionality (selected titles curated by the moderator, and possibly with polls or admin-rights to let the group suggest or vote on titles) But without requiring meetings or specific dates, in order to get a book on to the curated list. (Which doesn't seem to be possible with book club functionality right now. I think?)

posts.title: Reading Challenge displays books in viewer's selected language when available
posts.description: It would be really nice if when scrolling through books added to a reading challenge prompt, the display would default to an edition of the book in the language the viewer reads, if available. Sometimes I scroll through and see a bunch of books in a language I don't read and it makes it kind of hard to see if it's something that I want to read for that prompt.

posts.title: Make it easier to follow someone using a link
posts.description: When someone provides their storygraph profile some websites like instagram or tiktok open their own browser and they make you sign in before viewing the profile. I feel like the page should show the profile instead of making you sign in, then allow us to open the profile instead app.

posts.title: Checkbox for read aloud
posts.description: We read aloud a ton with our kids and it would be awesome to be able to have a box to tick off to mark a non-audiobook as (re)read aloud. We were just trying to estimate how many novels we’ve read with our 10 year old over the last 7 years and we don’t have a good way to keep track.

posts.title: exclude dnf rating (and data) from all time stats
posts.description: I noticed this discrepancy in my all-time stats: at the top it says I read 108 books but on the rating graph it says there are 109, and I know for certain that that one extra review is a dnf (which shows up in the "no rating" bar in the ratings graph but doesn't in the "books read" list). Since there is a separate stats section dedicated to them, shouldn't the dnf rating be excluded from the books read one? I know the suggestion of choosing whether a dnf'd book counts towards your reading goal or not has been made already in the roadmap, but for the time being keeping only its rating with the others is confusing

posts.title: Easy link to current month stats
posts.description: I most often go to the stats page to see my stats for the current month. This can't currently be done without using the dropdown box on the stats page (which can occasionally lead to errant selections, especially on a phone screen). It also means that I have to remember to change which month I select when we get to the start of a new month. I would love an easier method to access current-month stats… some ideas I've had: 1. a URL that redirects to the current month, or 2. adding "Current Month" as an option in the dropdown, so the current-month option is always in the same place in the dropdown. You may have other ideas for simplifying access to the current month's stats.

posts.title: Tracking decimal places in percent read
posts.description: When reading longer books it would be extremely useful if I could track my percentage read with a decimal place or two. I’m doing a buddy read on some large books (900+ pages) and each percent corresponds to over 9 pages in the physical copy (I am reading the ebook). It makes it difficult to match progress across both versions (print and digital). Being able to enter something like 5.2% instead of 5% would solve the problem.

posts.title: Add 'My Profile' as one of the main banners
posts.description: It would be great to add my profile as one of the main banners on the app - for example between the 'stats' and 'explore' tabs. That way I wouldn't need to go digging for my current reads pile in the desktop version, and its a really good summary of how I'm currently using the app (for example my to read pile and tags)

posts.title: Librarian stats
posts.description: Hey! I think it would be really motivating to be able to see how many edits I've made so far. I feel like there is a gamification element in this which would make edits more fun. Maybe a yearly librarian challenge too, the way we have reading challenges? I can't see anything like that on the site currently. Thanks!

posts.title: Streak without amount read
posts.description: Can I track my reading with simply indicating I read a book that day? Instead of having to input how much I read.

posts.title: use standard share icon
posts.description: This has happened to me several times - I'll be on my phone and really want to share a link to a book. I'll look over the entire book page a couple times and get frustrated that there's no option to share. Then I'll start to wonder why there's an upload icon in the upper right. What would I be uploading? Upon tapping it, I discover that it's meant to be a share icon. I've only ever seen that icon used for uploads, and most apps are consistent with using an icon that looks like the Material Design share icon for sharing, so that's what I look for.

posts.title: Ability to have a book simultaneously in "read" and "to read"
posts.description: This is just to accommodate re-reads.

posts.title: Slide to remove books from tags on mobile
posts.description: I would love to have to swipe left and remove a book from tags on mobile as it would be much faster than clicking on the book and tag to remove it

posts.title: Option to remove count from the TBR on home page
posts.description: This is either new or I only just noticed it. On the landing page, the to read pile now seems to display the total count. I honestly find looking at that every time I open the app overwhelming and anxiety-inducing. Is there a way to remove that parenthetical number from the home page?

posts.title: "Finished" vs "Read"
posts.description: I get that there are slightly different connotations ("Read" meaning "I have read this book" and "Finished" meaning "I have finished this reading of this book") but I find it confusing to use both of these terms to mean essentially the same thing. I also get confused by "Read" because it can be seen as the verb ("reed") or the adjective ("red"). So sometimes when I start to "reed" a book, my mind takes me to "red," rather than "currently reading." Maybe I'm the only one who has this very minor confusion, though!

posts.title: Bring back the old layout for the front page
posts.description: The new layout relies on covers of books instead of titles. It’s flashy but less functional. Please upvote this so Nadia knows we want an option to go back to the old way.

posts.title: Edit Dnf to Paused for past journal entries
posts.description: On my reading wrap up, it listed Jade War as a DNF even though that's inaccurate. I did soft dnf it with the intention to get back to it and ended up finishing this month. I love the recently added pause feature, However, when I go to edit journal entries, there's nowhere to switch a past dnf into a pause. It would be lovely if that was a possibility

posts.title: Book Haul/Unhaul Stats
posts.description: Add Book Haul & Unhaul stats for Owned Books so can organize and compare by year, month, tag etc. to better monitor physical tbr budget etc.

posts.title: Consolidate pseudonyms in "most read authors"
posts.description: Is there a way to count books written by an author's known pseudonyms in the "most read authors" stat (or even in searches by author, though that seems even more complex)? So, for example, if I read one book each by "Louisa May Alcott," "Tribulation Periwinkle," "Flora Fairfield," and "A.M. Barnard," it would show a total count of four books by Louisa May Alcott, reflecting my actual preference for the writing of the actual person, rather than diluting it across pen names with one book under each?

posts.title: Sort owned books by last read date or rating
posts.description: I like to mix re-reads in to my TBR and being able to easily see which books I own but haven't read in a while or rated really high would be so helpful!

posts.title: An option of tracking different page numbers for digital editions without adding a new one
posts.description: Currently it's accepted behaviour to add a duplicate digital edition with a different page count in order to track it accurately according to user's device. This leads to multiple books in the family with 'user-added' tags that are not merged (according to the handbook) even if the book only has 1 official digital edition. As a user it makes it confusing for me when selecting the right edition (I mostly read digital and don't track pages, but want to pick the right edition) as I need to check if more than one digital edition exists and which one I have. I don't know the best way to do it as I understand that some people want to track their pages with the highest accuracy, but perhaps adding a hidden/personal page counter for the corresponding digital edition would work.

posts.title: Misleading wording of reader summary
posts.description: The reader summary on the profile page ("mainly reads...") currently has a skip in logic: mine says I mainly read fiction books that are reflective, informative and challenging, but the moods come from my entire reading history (which is 47% nonfiction) and not the fiction portion only (my top moods for fiction being reflective, dark and mysterious). My request is to either restrict the moods to the subset of fiction/nonfiction, or change the wording to say eg "fiction books and books that are [moods]."

posts.title: Select date when comparing Tag stats
posts.description: It would be wonderful to be able to select a date range when comparing tag stats, similar to when comparing other types of stats. Sometimes I would like to be able to: 1. compare 2 tags during a specific time period (instead of over the lifetime, which is the option given now) 2. Compare the same tag over 2 different years 3. Compare the same tag over one year versus lifetime

posts.title: See friends' other friends
posts.description: It would be great to see who your friends are following/are friends with so you can connect with other like readers.

posts.title: Automatically mark a book as read When editing a journal entry to indicate 100% Reached
posts.description: Since we don’t have a option to manually Set the end page yet, can there be an option like in Goodreads when you go into a journal entry and At the end page to your desired point and then set the percentage reach to 100%, can that trigger the journal injury to automatically switch to finished instead of just 100%? Attached is a screenshot of a book. that I manually changed the end page and percentage reach to 100% but I still had to mark the book as finished and delete the unnecessary pages in the finished journal entry. Put simply if a person marks the percentage complete manually to 100%, cannot automatically trigger The finished journal entry with Excluding unwanted pages and mark the book as read?

posts.title: Slight tweak to wording on lost giveaway notification
posts.description: I'm sorry, this is a nitpick thing, so feel free to ignore it, but I notice it each time I get a notification that I've lost a giveaway (which is all of them so far, but I'm still holding out hope lol). "Unfortunately, the prize draw for X's giveaway of Y has come to an end and you haven't been selected as a winner this time around." The placement of 'unfortunately' at the beginning makes it seem like it's applying to the fact that the giveaway has ended, not to the fact I haven't been chosen. A small change would clarify this: "The prize draw for X's giveaway of Y has come to an end, and unfortunately you haven't been selected as a winner this time around."

posts.title: Hide or exclude bonus books/prompts in reading challenges
posts.description: I would like to be able to hide/exclude some or all of the bonus books/prompts in a reading challenge. For example, a reading challenge for an author's backlist may include bonus books like freebie stories or out-of-print titles that I either don't plan to read or don't want to track as Read or DNF. Even though I don't have to read those books to complete the challenge, they still show up on the challenge page as "to-read" and since they're outlined in green, they stand out more than the non-bonus books. Having the option to opt in/out of those bonus books/prompts would be great! I'm envisioning something similar to the "x" option on the recommendations page, where I can just click the "x" and the book/prompt would be excluded from my challenge page. But another (simpler?) implementation could be a toggle or filter that hides all the bonus books/prompts, similar to the idea posted here: https://roadmap.thestorygraph.com/requests-ideas/posts/toggle-hiding-completed-prompts-in-reading-challenge

posts.title: csv export last name sortable
posts.description: It would be great if the csv export of user data had a distinct column for author last name, or listed [Last name, First name] so that the sheet could be sorted alphabetically by author.

posts.title: Book Club Discussions
posts.description: It would be nice if book clubs could be set up similar to readalongs in the sense that they don't necessarily have to have video chat/in person addresses included. King of like the readalong feature, but specific to your book club. I am an admin on a Facebook group and was hoping to use StoryGraph to host our non in person book club.

posts.title: Popularity Charts To Track Popularity Over Time
posts.description: I love the feature which shows which books are popular this week. Would it be possible to track popularity over time so that when you look at a book you can see how many other users are currently reading it as well as how that has trended historically?

posts.title: Audiobook Tracking As Pages AND Minutes (at the same time)
posts.description: Would it be possible to have an AND option instead of just tracking audiobooks as in minutes OR in pages? I personally like to count my audiobooks within my page goal, but I cannot do that and track my hours listened goal which I also like to see.

posts.title: Accessibility: Change dots to different shapes per line to make it more accessible on line graphs with multiple lines
posts.description: For accessibility purposes, it's recommended to use different shapes per line (i.e. one line has circles, one line has squares, etc.)

posts.title: Improve Reading Challenges view and navigation
posts.description: I was looking at the immense amount of reading challenges I have currently joined and found myself thinking about how I'd make them even better, so I'll leave some suggestions here: - Compact view of the Reading Challenges page (I've joined so many that it's not easy to scroll through the page, it would be cool to have a more compact, list-like view) - Filter prompts within a challenge (I'd love the ability to filter "Non- complete prompts" of a challenge. This would be really useful for challenges with lots of books. Or maybe "filter owned books on this challenge") - Add to up next from the challenge page; - When creating a book specific challenge, have the ability to choose if it is a edition specific challenge or if it is ok to read any edition of the book to complete the prompt; - When browsing challenges to join, see without needing to enter the challenge page if it is a book specific challenge; Thank you!

posts.title: Customizing main navigation tabs
posts.description: I would like to be able to choose what tabs I have at the top of the website, for example I would like to have Tags showing instead of giveaways. Nadia Update (13th July 2024): Have edited your title slightly.

posts.title: Editing Tags While in the Custom Chart Editing Section
posts.description: When you open the Editing Section for the Custom Charts, is there any way to edit the tags shown above each title within that section instead of having to go to the Editing Section for Tags everytime?

posts.title: number of attendees for book club meeting
posts.description: In the "upcoming meetings" and "past meetings" views, I would like to see the number of people attending each meeting without having to click on them. We do not hold meetings for one book, we get together and everybody talks about a book they like. I create "upcoming meetings" for books we have talked about, and when enough people are interested, we see if we can schedule a buddy read. So it would be helpful to have an overview.

posts.title: A prominent Daily listen count
posts.description: Similar to daily page count, can we have a daily hours listened count?

posts.title: Accessible Tags
posts.description: I would love to be able to have more options for accessible tags. Right Now only kebab-case are available but because underscores and capitalization autoconverts to lowercase/one word tags and I find them very hard to read. This could also help with future improvements like parent/child tags, and other expansions. https://www.boia.org/blog/make-your-hashtags-accessible Thank you!

posts.title: Could we prioritise are reading preferences?
posts.description: I would love it if we could rank our reading preferences by what matters to us most. At the moment I feel like my recommendations overly value genre and it would be great if I could state that mood and pace are more important to me.

posts.title: Automatic time zone detection
posts.description: I woke up this morning and was confused about why the app already said I had a streak when I went to bed before midnight, and then I realized that I'm in PT and my app is set to ET, so the logs I did at 10pm last night actually got logged as 1am. I'd love it if the app could use my system time so it updated automatically when I cross time zones!

posts.title: Buddy read comments automatically unlock when you add a comment that's past the locked ones
posts.description: My friend and I are LOVING the buddy reads. (Basically we have been doing every buddy on SG and not just messaging each other. It's glorious 😂) Anyway, the one "complaint" we have is that when we are posting our comments, even if we have a comment that is further along in the book percentage-wise, the comment before is still "locked." I know it's because we haven't updated our page progress on the book itself, but it would be really helpful and easier to navigate if it was able to unlock once we commented past that page/percentage. Sorry if this has been addressed. I couldn't find anyone specifically saying it this way, but may have missed it. Thanks!! 🩷

posts.title: Compare Yearly Reading Challenges With Friends
posts.description: A page in-app to view your yearly challenge along side your friends’ challenges. Ability to import previous years challenges from GR to StoryGraph.

posts.title: Because you read this...
posts.description: Would it be possible to implement a feature that suggests similarly themed/vibed books because you highly rated another? I recently read Call Me By Your Name and loved it. It really reminded me of The Catcher in the Rye in terms of the narration and themes. I would like to find similar books that also have a similar feel and then thought that it could be a cool feature!

posts.title: Tags in Ratings Per Book Type
posts.description: I would love for tags to be included in "Ratings Per Book Type" stats. I tag my books by the country they're from, so it would be cool to see a ranked list of my average ratings for each country's books, rather than having to compare each tag stat 1-on-1 against another.

posts.title: Fine-tune which edition appears first
posts.description: When I am searching for a book that I have read, I want the most information-salient edition to appear first in the results. A few examples: - If I've read a book twice in two different editions, I typically will only put a full review in the first one I've read, and then just do a star rating for the second read-through so that it will factor into the stats correctly. But often, when I search for that book later, the edition with just the star rating appears first, and when I try to read my review, I then have to go into the edition searcher and scroll an unknown number of editions down to find the one I'm looking for. - If I have a book that has one edition with a DNF and one edition that I finished (happens often when I read an audiobook and digital edition at the same time and want to log reading for both), it seems like without fail, the DNF edition appears first in search. Again, I need to then go into editions and scroll for an unknown number of entries before I come across the one I actually care about. This in particular leads to a momentary confusion of "wait, DNF?? I really thought I finished that??" until I remember why I'm seeing that.

posts.title: Generate text lists of book/author for easy sharing
posts.description: It would be lovely to be able to generate a simple text list with a book's title and author. It could be for any category: a list of all the books you read in a year, or all the 5-star books, or all the books in a given genre/format/language, etc. This would be so helpful for end-of-year posts, but also to give a professor or a book club for voting, things like that. I'd also love to generate that at the end of a reading challenge with each prompt and the title and author of the book you read for that prompt. It would simplify things when trying to submit your proof you took a bookstore/magazine's challenge.

posts.title: Show others' to-read books in Community feed
posts.description: I love The StoryGraph and never use Goodreads anymore, but there is one feature I miss. I used to discover a lot of great books by seeing them on my feed when friends marked a book as "want to read"...I'd love to see this feature on The StoryGraph! It would also probably be nice if people had the ability to turn this off if they don't want the books they add as to-read to be shown in the Community feed.

posts.title: Filter plus stats (mood, star rating etc.) by year
posts.description: I'm really enjoying the new plus stats (mood, fiction/nf, genre, star rating), but would love to further refine by a specific year, as you're able to for stats on read books overall. I'd like to be able to answer questions like: "Which adventurous books did I give 5 star ratings this year?" I can find adventurous books with 5 star ratings, but get stuck when trying to limit to a specific period of time. I can likewise filter for year and mood, but then don't have any easy way to identify the 5-stars from that list. Setting a custom time period for these stats would be nice, but being able to view by year is more than enough for me!

posts.title: Track reading with percent vs pages read
posts.description: I read almost exclusively ebooks and the app I use to read them (BookFusion) does not use page numbers. So I am constantly guessing what page number to put into the reading tracker. The app I use does have percent read, so I would love it if I could enter in a percentage for how far I’ve read instead of page number.

posts.title: A11y / Accessibility improvements
posts.description: It would be great to see continuous a11y improvements on StoryGraph, small or big! I noticed that web version of the app already supports keyboard navigation, so that's pretty awesome! Some other issues that could be fixed: A. Colour contrast: Currently not all datavis colours have enough contrast with the background - e.g. I noticed that dark magenta really doesn't stand out against the background colour in dark mode (see "slow pace" part of the pie chart on the screenshot attached) even as a person with no contrast perception issues, so it definitely doesn't pass a contrast check. B. Touch target sizes: It would be great if all touch targets on mobile passed the 44px minimum. Some can be pretty challenging to tap. C. Semantic structure of the pages. In the future, it would be very cool to somehow be able to add full alt text descriptions for book covers, not just book title/author, - although that is probably a much more complicated solution beyond any quick fix. I love StoryGraph and would love to see it become more and more accessible for everyone to use.

posts.title: suggestions for book genres/information
posts.description: On the book information page, that includes young adult, short paced, etc., could there be a way to add additional categories for everyone to see (so not a tag)? I'm thinking it would be nice to have more rectangles, such as "pandemic" and "fat main character." (And if I could click on that rectangle to see more books with that tag, even better.)

posts.title: Add optional start date to "next up"
posts.description: I tend to juggle a lot of dates for book I've added to my "next up" - buddy reads with friends, book club reads, library holds that are coming in soon. Since I primarily use StoryGraph to track my reading, I would love to have an overview over these dates directly in the app. Right now, it's hard for me to keep track of all the dates separately. The easiest way to do this might be to add an optional start date to a book I've added to my "next up". It would be even better if the date was added automatically when I add a book to my "up next" that I've joined a buddy read for or when I create/join a buddy read for a book that's on my tbr/in my "up next". Once book clubs are live, it would be nice if the app automatically synched start dates of group reads, too.

posts.title: Move Edition Publication Date Location
posts.description: Adding the publication date to the main book card. I know it says first published and the year but I find myself having to click the editions to find an actual publication month/specific date which I prefer knowing quickly often.

posts.title: Bump unread buddy reads to top of list
posts.description: I would love it if a third section was added to the buddy reads homepage: "currently running but read" or something. I tend to have a lot of big group buddy reads going at once, and in some of these I have been finished with the book for months, but others aren't, and it makes it harder for me to check which buddy reads I still haven't read the book for. I would love if looking at this page gave me three sections, top one for books i still haven't read, second for ones I have read but the buddy read is still active, and then the third for finished buddy reads

posts.title: Shareable link to custom tag/list which includes curator's ratings/reviews
posts.description: It would be great if we could have a shareable link to all books we've added under a specific tag in the Filter list.

posts.title: Alternatives for Challenge numbering/organization
posts.description: I'm trying to make a challenge for myself that has all of the Hugo winners and nominees for Best Novel. It's going to be a lot of books! I thought that a neat way to organize it was to use the "Prompt #" as the year so that all of the books for a given year get grouped together, rather than me having to sequentially keep a list of numbers up to date, and having it be immediately clear in the challenge list which year a book goes with. Unfortunately I just discovered that I can't set a prompt # higher than 2000, even though I definitely won't have that many total prompts in the challenge, so it's back to the drawing board. I'd love to see, as the UX around challenges is considered, different ways to organize the books in challenges to make them ergonomic. Blue sky, what I'd love for something like this, is a way to have dropdowns for the years, with all of the relevant books nested underneath, but in the short term, I wish that the "Prompt #" field was not limited to 2000, but that the *actual* number of prompts in the challenge was so limited.

posts.title: Librarian: Quick copy of family ID
posts.description: It takes some clicking and scrolling to go from a book to copying the family ID for merging. It would really help to have a quick "Copy family ID" link in the Librarian Links that will put the ID on the clipboard. That should hopefully be a small change, but one that would make family merging a lot faster. (Goodreads has librarian tools that allows you to select duplicate families from a list of all the author's books -- easy tools make it much more likely that people will make a quick correction when they see the issue)

posts.title: Rearrange button in reading journal
posts.description: I know we can backdate our entries, but can we have a way to rearrange the entries that have the same date so that they’re in the order we read them? Maybe we can have a rearrange button (i.e. a hamburger sorting button). I attach an example. I couldn’t make my lines as straight as I wanted to with my Apple Pencil.😂

posts.title: Series tabs for different adaptations
posts.description: This ties in a bit with what was suggested in [this post](https://roadmap.thestorygraph.com/fr/requests-ideas/posts/series-differences-in-editions-because-of-language), but it would be nice to be able to toggle through different adaptations of a series with a button similar to the "collected editions", rather than having separate series for each, which can hinder discoverability. A few examples I had in mind: - light novels and their manga adaptations - graphic novel or audio drama adaptations of prose series - series that have different numberings depending on translations - comics with varying numbering between single issues, trade paperbacks, omnibus editions, etc. I know the overhaul of the series page is still pretty far down the line, but thought it was worth mentioning! Thanks for all your amazing work 😊

posts.title: Readwise sync
posts.description: Sync favourite highlights from readwise to storygraph for books read

posts.title: Ability to edit book information that I've added
posts.description: I try to add missing information to book records when I can, but sometimes I mess up and don't notice until after I've clicked save. It would be nice to have some window of time to correct these typos without having to (shamefully) file a book ticket.

posts.title: obsidian plugin
posts.description: Make an obsidian plugin that works with dataview to make it easier to create detailed book notes.

posts.title: User options for percentage display
posts.description: I don’t know if it was a glitch or a test on redesign launch day, but I prefer the percentage with the green background, over the progress bar with the percentage at the end. Maybe users can have the option to choose which way they want the percentage displayed. I attached a screenshot below.

posts.title: Audio and non-audio longest/shortest book on wrap-up
posts.description: Hi, On my wrap up my longest and shortest books were both showing up as the longest and shortest audiobooks I listened to. As someone who does both audio and non audio reading, would we be able to get stats on both for the year? Like your longest/shortest audiobook and longest/shortest “physical” book?

posts.title: 'Not A Book' Edits
posts.description: It would be really helpful if we had more control over editing/updating things labelled as 'Not A Book.' I'm not sure how feasible this is, but I'd really love to be able to update the synopsis/blurb as details change. This is particularly relevant for serials or maybe even fanfiction that turns out to take a different twist and the description is updated by the author? It seems like a hassle and waste of time to burden the librarians with updating something like this, since it's not actually a book in the catalogue, but it would be really nice to be able to update things like that ourselves.

posts.title: Preview/Sample books
posts.description: If at all possible it would be amazing to be able to read samples or previews of titles right from The Storygraph app. The same way that you can read samples on Kindle, book buying sites, the Libby app, etc.

posts.title: Book and series ID visible in the app
posts.description: Have an option for users to make this series and book ideas visible within the app. If users want to send information regarding merging either duplicate additions or consolidating books into a series, right now, users have to copy and paste the web address into the app’s librarian notes section. It would be nice to see series and book iDs in the app to provide the necessary information to the librarians quickly. Visible series IDs would also help users identify the correct series when filling out information for the librarians or importing a new installment to an existing series.

posts.title: More prominent daily page count
posts.description: I have a personal pages read per day goal across all my books and it would be helpful if I could access that stat more easily. Right now I have to go into my stats for the month, scroll down to the pages chart and then hover over today's date which gets me what I need, but is kind of a pain (especially on mobile). I think it would be a great addition to the Currently Reading widget, but could also see it added to the yearly page goal progress section.

posts.title: Changing the genre of an existing book
posts.description: I realised that one of the books I have read is marked as the wrong genre (fantasy instead of science fiction) - I would love to be able to flag that somehow

posts.title: Updating tags with CTRL+Enter
posts.description: So at the moment, as you write a tag it will recommended the closest knowns tags to what you have written, and then you can go down and press enter to select it. However to then finish the process you have to click the "update" button which can be troublesome especially when you are doing this with a lot of books. Would it be possible to just press CTRL+ENTER or some other keyboard shortcut to update so we can do it all through the keyboard? This would ultimately make the process more efficient, for those who care about such things.

posts.title: update personalised recs to ignore books already on my tbr
posts.description: sorry if this has already been asked (I tried searching for a similar post) but is it possible for the recommendations feature to ignore books that are already on my tbr? I would prefer to see books that have not come across my radar yet

posts.title: Date read and star ratings should appear together
posts.description: When adding a book to your read shelf, it should automatically come with date read and star ratings immediately, instead of having to go into the review section. Not everyone wants to write a review about the book they read and would simply like to note when they finished it and the rating. Having one option hidden in the review section is a needless annoyance.

posts.title: Reading Log/Integration Index
posts.description: Would be nice to be able to add comments on a book as you go, maybe add a specific section for quotes you liked, or just being able to put parts of the text down in various categories that you’d choose.

posts.title: Suggestions for content warnings
posts.description: Is there a way to suggest content warnings that don't currently exist?

posts.title: suggested books relevant to most recently read
posts.description: for clarity ill share my scenario, I’ve read a lot of classic literature in the past and when i imported my goodreads data it was all transferred which is what i wanted. More recently the past several years i’ve been reading only fantasy. But a lot of my recommendations seem to be more heavy on the classical literature side when what i really want suggestions for is the fantasy because that’s what i read most of for the past 2 yrs. And i think it should be suggestions for the **most recent genre** you read **unless** you toggle a button that makes it a mix of everything you’ve read in a randomized list. There could also be an **’enhance button’** where it branches out to mix in suggestions for books from **similar genres** (example: i read fantasy romance and when i enhance the recommendations i would see something like sci-fi romance or magic realism) TL;DR 1. suggestions for most recent read genres as default 2.able to toggle and mix all genres you have read 3. enhance button to provide suggestions from genres that are similar to the ones we read the most recently

posts.title: List of books I've read that can be sorted
posts.description: I'm finding it difficult (impossible) to view a list of just the books I've finished reading and be able to sort them in various ways, especially from most recently read to most recently read. Maybe I'm missing something, but, if not, would love to have it please!

posts.title: Definitions for review stats
posts.description: I’d love some clarity on what some of the review stats mean. Does “diverse characters” mean diverse from other characters in the book, or diverse from current publishing standards? Like, if a book has only characters of color, or mostly characters of color, how should we track that? What does pacing really mean?

posts.title: Show review updates on community tab
posts.description: A lot of people fill out the review form when finishing a book, but add a longer review text later in "Anything else you'd like to add?" I am mostly interested in those texts when it comes to single reviews of the people I follow, to learn about their thoughts and engage with them. The questionnaire is more useful to me on the book page, where I can see the statistics. So I would like to see on my community tab when a person I follow edits one of their reviews, or just when they edit the text field.

posts.title: Profile stats (friends, followers etc)
posts.description: It would be helpful if I could easily see the number of friends and followers I have. I want to be able to include this type of info in my NetGalley profile,

posts.title: Change Threshold for Vertical Resolutions
posts.description: StoryGraph swaps to the mobile layout very easily, leading to a massive search bar and no home/stats/reading challenges/community icons, which makes navigating clunkier. When this happens, the search bar takes up more than enough room for the buttons. All of this combined makes a vertical monitor experience look awkward and frustrating to navigate. Even on a horizontal monitor, it's easy for the site to take on the mobile appearance. I've uploaded two pictures. One compares how only the slightest adjustment changes the entire look of StoryGraph on my horizontal monitor. The other is my friend's vertical monitor. She expressed her confusion on why her StoryGraph format is harder to navigate than what was advertised, leading to this request being made.

posts.title: "Real" page count for non-fiction
posts.description: I've been reading a lot more non-fiction in the past couple months and I'm finding that it's messing up my stats because the actual pages of the book are dramatically less than the number of total published pages when you include references. So, for the book I'm currently reading, I'm only a little over "50%" of the way done, but I've only got one actual chapter left, and so as soon as I say finished, the stats will say "great job reading 200 pages in a single day!" which isn't really accurate. Maybe there is a way to go back into my journal entries and edit this, but I worry that it would leave me in a weird mismatch state around finished/DNF. This would probably be a data nightmare, but just musing about whether there is a user-friendly way to keep this sort of thing accurate.

posts.title: Read date vs publication date
posts.description: It seems like you can only view the read date vs publication date chart when you select your “all time” books - it would be great to see also this on the pages for the current year’s reading and possibly also under a specific tag too. It’d also be great to be able to interact a bit more with the chart. At the moment it just seems like dots that you can’t click into but would be great to check for example what was that book from 1790 that you read in 2017. I am trying to read classics across certain centuries for a challenge and at the moment can’t find a way to simply view books by publication date without setting up my own tag system.

posts.title: List of books read by month
posts.description: If there could be a list of all books read by month when you filter your stats that would be awesome

posts.title: Drop-down menu for tag stats
posts.description: When viewing the stats for a specific tag, it would be nice to have a drop-down menu or something similar to quickly swap between tags, the way there is when comparing tags.

posts.title: View Challenge Prompts Associated with Book
posts.description: It would be helpful to see (or be able to click into) which prompts other users have added a book to. Currently, it only states "People have added this book to XXX". It would be nice to be able to click onto or hover over to see which prompts were selected so users can easily add it to the challenge promote if desired or if the prompts are different than what is currently selected.

posts.title: Support Dynamic Type in iOS app
posts.description: It’s small potatoes, but the browser/PWA has a more condensed look/smaller font size on my phone. I prefer this, but I’m sure not everyone would, so it’d be useful perhaps if the font size were based on the device setting.

posts.title: librarian notes
posts.description: Since I'm not a librarian, I may not see what is already there behind the scenes, but I just noticed as I was adding a new edition (different publisher, new cover) for a book that the eBook page numbers differed depending on the retailer. (Here's the book, for what its worth: https://app.thestorygraph.com/books/5e0329e7-61f1-41e5-b0dd-10c96dd91fa9) I went with the publisher stated page number, but I thought it might have been useful to make a note for future librarians looking at the backend of things that there is discrepancy and to pre-address future flags may say something like "my edition has X pages." I could imagine this being useful for other books and instances I can't imagine at the moment. Thanks!

posts.title: Allow commas as decimal separators in ratings field
posts.description: (This is super minor, I’m well aware, and likely only an issue for people whose native languages don’t use periods as decimal separators!) Given that the ratings field is number-only, depending on the language option that’s on at the moment, I don’t even have “.” on my iOS numbers keyboard (which also has no language switch). I enter “3,5” and whatnot on autopilot very often, and then I get a “please enter a number” error. (I hadn’t realised how often I relied on the ratings arrow buttons to fix this until they disappeared :D) Given that numbers in the ratings field will never be in the thousands, and so decimal/thousand confusion is a non-issue, would it be possible to allow commas someday too and convert them after input?

posts.title: Recommendation list at bottom of Reading Challenges Dashboard
posts.description: I'd love to see a recommendation list (ideally, a picture list) at the bottom of the Reading Challenges Dashboard based on the books read in the dashboard. Basically, it automatically picks books similar to the books that have been read in the dashboard. Something similar to what Amazon does where it recommends items based on your shopping history.

posts.title: Add tags from review form
posts.description: It would be nice if I could add custom tags to a book while filling out the review in case there's something I remember as I write the review.

posts.title: Sort “Currently Reading”
posts.description: It would be great to sort the current reading list, specifically by progress or date added.

posts.title: More detail in searches for books added to reading challenges
posts.description: I'd love to see some nuance with the marker that shows a book has been added to a reading challenge you follow. Like maybe it's green if you added the book, yellow if someone else added the book, and red if you've completed that part of the challenge.

posts.title: Adding Updates from a Book's Reading Journal Page
posts.description: Currently when you add a reading update with notes it takes you to the book's reading journal page where you can edit your journal entries. However you cannot add entries from that page so if I have multiple entries during a reading session I have to keep coming out that page and go back to the book.

posts.title: Add a help section
posts.description: I have not been able to find one. If there is one, then I would change my suggestion to: 'Make it easier to find the help section.'

posts.title: Got rid of option
posts.description: Currently when removing something from owned list, it just makes it like it was never on the list. I think it would be good to have an option to have it on a got-rid-of list(or a nicer term for it). That means you can keep track and not accidently rebuy books you have already decluttered and your friends wont got go thought you would like this book and you dont one to here is it as a gift (when the reason you dont own it anymore is you got rid of it)

posts.title: Align or pad images in cover collage
posts.description: Different book editions/formats have different cover image dimensions. In the cover collage (especially after logging audiobooks), the covers can become quite misaligned. It would be great to either i) add padding to the covers in collage so that smaller books have white spaces around them and collage becomes automatically aligned or ii) top/bottom/center align each row and column of the collage. I love looking at my cover collages and every time I generate one I wish the covers were aligned...

posts.title: Add academic papers
posts.description: There should be an option to include academic papers as a "book" format to track how many we read! They can be 20-30 pages long and they start adding up throughout the year. It would be a nice way to acknowledge the trials and tribulations of reading them (as they can be dense).

posts.title: Total number of friends
posts.description: Hi. Wish we could see our total friend count at the top of the friends page.

posts.title: Question Bank for Read Books
posts.description: I'd like to be able to view all the unanswered/less answered questions for the books I've read in one place.

posts.title: Filter users in friends/following newsfeed
posts.description: I would love the ability to filter on certain friends/following so I can focus on just their newsfeed updates. Some people read a LOT and clog up my feed. This seems like a good middle ground so slower readers don’t get lost in the shuffle but I don’t have to consider unfriending the prolific readers. Bonus points if you can select multiple people at once for the filter. Ex. Reddit has a way to pin certain subreddits so you can only scroll through that subset in a custom view.

posts.title: Pin a few currently reading books on home page
posts.description: I would love to be able to pin a few books currently being read at the top of the home page and eventually on the currently reading page itself. (A bit like the “up next” feature in the TBR). I read several books at a time and some I would like to prioritise slip at the bottom and get forgotten, because others get percentage updates more often. Edit: actually for the homepage version, it could look like the favorite shelf but at the top, above “currently reading”.

posts.title: Easier way to set challenge dates to blank
posts.description: Could we get a faster way of setting the start date and end date of a challenge to none, so that the challenge doesn’t have a set time to complete it? The current way of doing it by setting both dates to blank by scrolling through the three menus (day/month/year) for both start and end date is a bit fastidious. Propositions: 1. A new button to set both dates to no date 1. Make it easier to set to no date on the two menus for example by clicking on the existing “start date” then “end dates” and it would set all menus to blank

posts.title: Options to exclude books via tags in custom charts
posts.description: For example, if I have a read vs unread chart of my owned books, I would like to exclude books I have tagged as “husband” which are books we own that are his that I will never read. My read vs unread ratio is skewed since I track our library together, but my goal isn’t to read 100% of our owned books it is to read 100% of owned books minus “husband” books. This could also be useful for other reasons

posts.title: Add pictures in notes
posts.description: I’d like to be able to add a picture in the notes page rather than text being the only option

posts.title: Pin "N" favourites
posts.description: Apologies if this is duplicate, I searched but came up empty: At the moment, we can pin up to 5 favourites, or none. If none are pinned, 5 will be shown. If fewer than 5 are pinned, they are the only ones shown: Pin 4, see 4, pin 2, see 2, etc. Would it be possible to pin fewer than 5, and have the "remaining" ones of the 5 maximum still selected randomly, so that 5 are still showing - some pinned, some unpinned?

posts.title: If the author appear twice or more in the same book, leave only one
posts.description: It's very common to see books in storygraph where the same author appear twice (sometimes more) in the list of authors. I'm not talking about in other roles (contributor, illustrator, etc), which i imagine there may be cases in which it makes sense to have it, but just in the regular list of authors the same author (with same author id) appear twice. I imagine this is due to some wrong import, but as a librarian i had to fix hundreds of this so far, and everyday i find more. It would be nice, in order to have better data and to remove some work from librarians, to do a cleanup directly in the DB removing all authors that appear more than once in the same book, and leave only one, so we cleanup the data we already have. Also it would be nice to have this automatic cleanup every time someone add the same author twice, or if an author gets merged into another author redo it on all their books, in case it appear twice after the merge

posts.title: Lower price option
posts.description: I don't plan to use the extra features that come with a subscription, but still want to support the app. I'm on a very tight budget, but could afford $1 a month. It would be nice to have that option instead of canceling the sub for a few months, then resub for 1, and repeat.

posts.title: Recall quizzes
posts.description: After reading a book, having AI powered recall quizzes with stat tracking to test recall of books read. Accelerated reader-esque

posts.title: Archive book club
posts.description: Hello! I have been historically part of some books clubs that are no longer active, so would it be possible to archive book clubs like reading challenges?

posts.title: Easy Add to Favorites
posts.description: When reviewing the books read in a year, or based off the ratings, I wish the 3 little dots allows me to “add to favorites” so that I didn’t have to retype in the book on the favorites shelf page. Almost like being able to say this is a favorite read and then being able to see all favorites on the favorites shelf page.

posts.title: Create a challenge from filtered books
posts.description: I often make a challenge in order to visually see how far through my physical TBR, or planned reads I am, but I find it quite time consuming to create challenges and add each book to them. I'd love to be able to filter my TBR and add all results (or first 50 or something if you need to cap the number of challenge prompts) to a challenge. for example, filtering TBR by owned hardbacks, maybe with a particular genre or tag, and add them to a specific-book challenge.

posts.title: Larger covers on audiobook graphics
posts.description: I would love it if the audiobook covers were full size on the wrap-up graphics. When you add the rating, it takes up so much of the small audiobook cover.

posts.title: Ability to Sort on Stats Segment Book List Pages
posts.description: When you click through from the Stats page to any "Your Books" list (e.g. select a genre or a mood), there's no way to filter or sort the results in the list the way that you can on the "Read Books" page. It would be great to have that ability there, too.

posts.title: Group Challenges with combined book totals
posts.description: The idea being that a specific group of people could set a combined reading total. Reader 1: 5 books Reader 2: 20 books Reader 3: 50 Group challenge being the 75 book total. Itd be nice to have a reading group that can help each other read a little more.

posts.title: Similar User Fix
posts.description: Currently, when I go to find similar users, book series with a large number of books are warping the results. Yes, like most people my age, I read all books in the series of unfortunate events... so now I'm getting primarily matched with people who have also read it/favorited it despite having nothing else in common! Not sure how to fix, but it's definitely an issue in trying to find community here.

posts.title: AI Recommendations based on input
posts.description: Hello! I have been looking for new books similar to an author I have read, but all the recommendation in the personalised and non-personalised book recommendations aren't what I'm looking for (https://app.thestorygraph.com/books/77a020da-5351-42ff-a144-f34b0b3c32d2/similar) I was wondering if it would be possible to forsee an option for Rob to develop similar to a chatbot where you could ask questions for new recommendations. I'm specifically thinking questions like "I like this series (URL or click and select) and this series/author. What do they have in common and what does this tell you about my tastes in books (referencing reading history and reading preferences survey)? Based on this info, what books/series/authors do you recommend I read next?

posts.title: Add stats for completed, expired, and active challenges in which you enrolled
Save/Respond to Questions
posts.description: I just discovered the question bank on a book I'm reading and I am so excited about it! Most of my book club members are now on Storygraph so I will definitely be using this feature! It would be really cool if there was a way to save/respond to the questions. Maybe clicking on a button to add it to your reading journal so you can write out your response? Or a discussion forum so people can share their thoughts?

posts.title: Link Tags to Challanges
posts.description: Would love a way to set specific tags to challenge prompts so that books read with that tag added will automatically add themselves to that prompt. This could be specifically helpful with large challenges like reading a book from every country. A participant could effectively tag each prompt. Putting it on the participant would also make sure people have full control over how their tags are set up and if they want to use the auto system on each challenge. Often I find myself realizing that I have already completed a few prompts only when I check my tags.

posts.title: Book of the Month and other subscriptions
posts.description: I often find it difficult to find a Book of the Month club subscription book as an option in the book versions. I can add them myself, but it's hard to get the cover image and the ISBN usually overlaps with another and then my book version is incomplete. I imagine people have the same issue with other subscription book boxes. It would be awesome if StoryGraph could partner with BotM and other subscriptions in some way to get those imported.

posts.title: Let reading challenge hosts view individual participant books
posts.description: For those of us who host "outside" reading challenges (those originating from a library, bookstore, community program, etc.) here on StoryGraph, it would be GREAT if we could see the books that individual participants have added. That would allow us to accept the StoryGraph challenge as verified completion of the program challenge. We could use/promote StoryGraph as our paperless digital tracker. Context: For our community reading challenge, we do recommend StoryGraph and link to the challenge each year. We explain that people can use it to keep track of their own progress and to get ideas from other users about books to meet individual challenges. Most participants are enthusiastic, but the enthusiasm wanes when they realize they have to use a different method to submit their progress. Most would be happy to use a share feature to submit the challenge progress to us, but those of us running the community reading program would be even happier if StoryGraph challenge hosts could see participant progress without requiring participants to do anything other than join the challenge.

posts.title: Hide Certain Covers from To-Read Pile Homepage
posts.description: As it currently functions, the To-Read Pile widget on the Storygraph homepage displays 6 or so random books from your whole TBR. If this is not already a feature, I would love to be able to mark certain TBR books to never show on the homepage. I have some books in my TBR with risque or obviously political covers. I work as a librarian. I like to evangelize for Storygraph, so I occasionally walk someone through how to use it or answer certain questions by visiting it. If I'm logged in when I do this, I run the risk of one of these more eyebrow-raising books showing up in front of this colleague or that stranger. In the moment, I may not remember to make sure I'm signed out, or I might want to show a specific feature that requires me to be logged in. It would be great to eliminate that risk of having a risque or political cover showing up in those situations, while still keeping the book in the to-read pile.

posts.title: Streak Page Access
posts.description: Right now there's only one way (that I know of) to get to the streak page. Can we also link to the streak page from the stats streak section as well. It's currently Home>Streak If you can link the Streak section it could be Stats>Streak OR Profile>Stats>Streak as well. I'm helping my friends find it all the time because their apps are defaulting to open on their profile page so it's buried for them.

posts.title: Edit edition without scrapping history
posts.description: I’d like to be able to edit the edition of a book but it still retains the history, rather than becoming a whole other entry.

posts.title: Hide 'books read' counter for the year/month
posts.description: It would be great if we had the option to hide total books read in the period we are viewing for graphs. It would be great for those of us who are trying to take the self-inflicted pressure off reading. Even though I've not set myself a goal this year, I can still see how many books I've read when I open the graphs and can't help but compare to last year. I know we could count up the numbers on the graphs, but it would be nice to have the option to hide it anyway 😊 (P.S. thanks for all your hard work)

posts.title: Overview and tools for adding old reading data.
posts.description: I would like a more intuitive way to add or correct older data in my reading history. Currently, my reading journal is a mix of books with daily/weekly updates, books with start and end dates only or other books with only end dates. This is mainly due to transferring my data from outside Storygraph so older data is not as good as newer data added to Storygraph. I’ve tried going back through my data and manually fixing start and end dates, but I stopped because I don’t feel like I have good visibility on what effect my changes are having. In particular, on reading stats (yearly/monthly) and streaks. I can of course go check my stats and recalculate streaks after each change to see but I feel like there could be a better way. If I had a few tools like: - Ability to see/edit reading journal entries across selected dates. - Access to a graph that show pages/books read on selected dates. - Ability to add journal entries for books read a decade ago. - If we know our reading pace this could allow users to smooth out their streaks (daily/weekly etc.) - Allowing data points on the graph to be clicked to see the book/page data underneath. - Allow easy refreshing of these tools so as not to lose “place” or context. - Add some documentation on what counts as pages read (100% vs page count vs page number and how they interact). - And documentation on how to manage/curate your reading history using these tools. Hopefully, this makes sense on what I’d like to see. Let me know if I can add clarification.

posts.title: Better support for importing Norwegian books
posts.description: Currently the app doesn't do well at importing Norwegian books by ISBN. This could be solved by integrating with something like Bokbasen (https://www.bokbasen.no/en) which provides the required metadata.

posts.title: Books not added to challenges
posts.description: I'd love to be able to sort my books in order to see which ones I forgot to add to challenges.
