I know that I can go through my read books manually to see, but so far this year, that's 238 books and a lot of times that list is so long that the page won't load. The other option would be to load only 10 or 20 books at a time and then go to a new page if I haven't found it yet.

posts.title: Accidental taps when aiming for first pub date.
posts.description: On a book’s page when tapping on the first pub date to expand the info, sometimes the author’s name is accidentally tapped, sending you to the author’s page. Even when trying to carefully tap the first pub date it can be difficult to not tap the author instead. This is notice on iOS version of TSG.

posts.title: Move star ratings to below a book cover in wrap-up graphics
posts.description: The star ratings on the wrap up graphics often cover titling or author. I would love to see the ratings presented in a bar either above or below the book cover so that all titles and author is visible.

posts.title: Have series name populate When you type series ID into the new edition form
posts.description: Use series ID number in a series field when importing a new edition to make it easier to identify the correct series. For users like myself who know how to get the series ID, it would be great if once you’ve typed in the series ID the name of the series populate. right now you can type in the series name, which could be complicated when there are multiple series with the same and you have to cross check the series ID. It would be so much easier if we could just paste in the series ID and have quickly pop up in the list.

posts.title: Allow audiobook users to use HH:MM in their buddy reaad comments
posts.description: I have a few friends who are new to Storygraph joining me for a buddy read. One is reading on Audible and, since she's not using Storygraph to track her reads yet, she is only given the option of adding page or % in her buddy read comments. Can we add the option of HH:MM to this dropdown like it is in currently reading.

posts.title: List view of all your challenge prompt books
posts.description: A list showing prompt books across all of your challenges. Maybe as a selection under to-read.

posts.title: Feature polls in app in addition to your social media
posts.description: I love how we can go on polls on social media for new features, but can we add a poll option to the app or in the roadmap and not just on social media? There are times that I miss a chance to participate in the polls when the stories expire.

posts.title: Toggle for Default Ascending or Descending for buddy read comments
posts.description: Add Buddy Read discussion points begin to increase it can take a while to get to the newest comments. There is a sort option but that takes several seconds to load and places you at the bottom of the page. Some users may prefer to see the newest comments by default

posts.title: Share link to annual wrapup
posts.description: I want to be able to share my annual reading wrapup to people who don't have The StoryGraph (yet.. I'm prosletyzing). I know our default is to consider privacy, but I'd like to opt into a public sharing of my own data. Since the stats and graphs are such a huge feature for TSG, I'd love to showcase tehm.

posts.title: Library of Congress Call Numbers
posts.description: I don't know if this is even possible, but I'd love if the LOC call numbers were included in the data on the books, like ISBNs. Or even a label where we can add them for our own tracking, outside of tags (because I'd have one tag per book and I don't really think that's how they are meant to be used.)

posts.title: Revert to old personalized preview
posts.description: I was a HUGE fan of the personalized previews offered in the prior updates, but I noticed a dramatic change to their format with the newest update. This new format feels a little more cumbersome to read and offers possibly too much information with all the book titles and ratings. If possible I would love to have the former paragraph summary still available, since the current analysis paragraph seems to be a simple repetition of the information included in the “Aspect you might like” / “Aspects you might not like”

posts.title: Search Challenge for a specific book
posts.description: When I have a specific book I would like to search a challenge to see what prompts that people have put that book in.

posts.title: Exclude some tags from selection dropdown
posts.description: I would like to be able to mark some of my tags to be excluded in the list that appears when I'm adding tags to a book. An example of what I mean is that I have a set of tags recording what year I acquired a book, and when I'm adding the 'acquired-2024' tag to a new acquisition I have to navigate past 'acquired-2001', 'acquired-2002', etc. Since I'm unlikely ever to want to add 'acquired-2001' to another book, it's just cluttering up the list, so it would be nice to be able to mark it not to appear. Ideally, this would be sensitive to the context in which the dropdown is appearing: I wouldn't want 'acquired-2001' to appear when I was adding tags, but I would still want it as an option if I was filtering by tags or creating a custom tag chart. (I'm trying to think if there's a tag where the opposite situation would apply, that I'd want to have it as an option for adding but not for searching, but nothing's coming to mind.) This is not a high priority request, just an idea for something that might make the interface a tiny bit nicer to work with.

posts.title: Enter pause date data retrospectively
posts.description: I have books I have paused reading but was not able to mark as "paused" here before the function was available. Now, it looks like the only way to add the pause is to first move it to "currently reading", then add the pause, and then delete the "currently reading" journal entry you made just a couple minutes ago. It would be great to add pause start and end dates in a much easier way even after a read is finished (and of course while still reading) if possible.

posts.title: Adding books to reading challenge
posts.description: Can the feature be added that to add a book to a reading challenge, rather than having to go into the book you can select the three dots next to a book and have the option there. Perhaps it could sit under "add to up next" or in the drop down options

posts.title: Book status to indicate moved to a different edition
posts.description: I'm not sure what exactly the best way to frame this request is, and am open to alternative solutions than what I am describing. I will sometimes begin a book with one edition (e.g. ebook), and then decide I want to read it in another (e.g. audio). In these instances, I usually end up with two different editions in my Currently Reading, and I end up marking only one edition as Finished. I want to remove the initial edition from my Currently Reading without marking it as DNF, Paused, or Finished, since none of those statuses is accurate. Between ebook and physical book I will often just Switch Editions, as I feel like the pages are comparable enough between the two. I don't feel the same way about ebook/physical and audio, as I separately track pages and minutes listened, and won't Switch Editions but instead start tracking on another edition. I don't want this to impact how editions are handled, as I know many people, myself included, will re-read or tandem read different editions of a book, so I wouldn't want finishing one edition to mark the book as read across all editions. I want some sort of Status that will mark an edition as Dropped/Inactive or something along those lines, where the implication is not that you will necessarily continue, but it also doesn't have the connotations that come from a DNF. I wonder if it could be some sort of Tag or Checkbox on the DNF option? Thank you!

posts.title: Add reason for rejecting a buddy read invite
posts.description: I was just invited to join a buddy read and I’m not interested in the book, but I want to add a message to the creator explaining why! I’ve never rejected a buddy read before, so hopefully I’m not missing anything.

posts.title: Change Year Start Month
posts.description: Sounds mental but would it be possible to change when your reading year starts... instead of it being January 1st it could be whenever?

posts.title: Remove/hide suggestions
posts.description: There are some books I am nearly certain I will never read, but they are popular, so they regularly show up as recommendations. I would love to be able to hide books, and just in case someone changes their mind, they can see a list of books they have hidden and "unhide" them.

posts.title: AI suggestions based on a subset of books
posts.description: my tbr is about 1300 books long (ik im sry im like this) and so using the suggestions feature for up next is very helpful. however, i would love to be able to have the suggestion be based on a subset of my tbr; for example suggest books only from certain genres/pages/pub years/etc from the current filtering options, or even suggest books only from a certain tag(s). ty ily for making the book tracking app of my dreams <3

posts.title: Merge author in different languages
posts.description: Hi! Currently some books in different languages have the author name in the edition language, which is ok. But when we check Most read authors chart, the author can be duplicated because of the language. Is it possible to treat author name in any language as the same person for this chart? Example (not the best one) of the book that has the author in English and Russian: https://app.thestorygraph.com/books/193bce15-5f6a-484b-aec1-ba1564c6e8e7

posts.title: Change format of Buddy Read Suggestions page
posts.description: Apologies if this overlaps with any other posts, but I have tried to set up a buddy read with my friend and wanted to use the buddy read suggestions tool. Whilst it was good, I was hoping for something more like the normal recommendations page (which is excellent), and I'd like something like; >Books from both of your tbrs >Books from one tbr that we think both will enjoy >Wildcard suggestions that neither of you own of have on a tbr >Suggestions by genre, or some way to filter the suggestions (I'd like to search for non-fiction or sci-fi specifically, and preferably limit the page count)

posts.title: Quick Remove Books from Challenge
posts.description: Several of my challenges have multiple books attached to a single prompt. Because I'm not sure which one I'll read to complete the prompt. I've tried to go back in and remove the extra books, to reflect which one I actually read, but it is a painstakingly slow process. And after removing the book, I can't just return to the challenge page. I have to start from scratch and find my way back to the challenge all over again. I'd love to see a feature that simplifies this process, perhaps letting you quickly remove multiple books at once from a challenge. Or even a back button that can return me to the challenge page.

posts.title: Time-based reading challenges
posts.description: I'd love to see a way to track time-based reading challenges such as the 24 readathons, screen time reading challenge, etc. that are popular on YouTube.

posts.title: Google Lens/Live Text into journal entries
posts.description: Right now I do a lot of - open Google Lens - snap a picture of the text of a physical book - copy the text of the lines I want to quote - paste into journal entry and clean up any errors It would be really neat if I could do that directly within StoryGraph!!

posts.title: In-app book ticket status section
posts.description: In addition to in-app notifications for close book tickets, can you add a section where users can keep track of their open book tickets?

posts.title: Allow book number over 2000 in book-type reading challenge
posts.description: Such that we can use the year of a prize as the sort order, without hiding it behind the click for information. e.g. https://app.thestorygraph.com/reading_challenges/24dd8d74-56e9-47b3-a060-5992a7af599a

posts.title: Embeddable reading challenge
posts.description: Related to the embeddable currently reading request I've seen, I'd love to have an embeddable reading challenge widget. I use Notion to track my reading, and being able to embed Storygraph elements into that would be an absolute gamechanger.

posts.title: Adding colons to tags
posts.description: This is a small idea, but with the ability to make custom charts based on tags I’ve been making more tags and have found it difficult to keep them organized. If I had the ability to add a colon so that I knew what chart or category a tag might belong to it would help with the organization! For example, one could have “representation: bisexual” and “author identity: bisexual” and be able to keep those two tags separate but organized. Hope this makes sense!

posts.title: Owning and reading different editions (or multiple) of the book
posts.description: Sometimes I like to get an ebook of a book I own because it's either too heavy or it's a special edition I don't want to ruin. I would love an option where we can own different editions of a book or the ability to own a copy but also reading another (by utilizing the library for example).

posts.title: Sharing Public Profile Information
posts.description: I'd love to have more options to post things publicly to my profile. For example, I just tried to share my Owned Books section with a family member so that she could see what she could borrow. The link doesn't work on a device that isn't already logged into my account.

posts.title: Filter star ratings by similar readers
posts.description: We all know that the star rating system is controversial because of how it impacts authors, while readers still grasp for some way to easily communicate how they feel about a book. But I think the biggest issue with it is that while it’s helpful for marketing purposes, it’s not very helpful for readers who are trying to decide what to read next. **I propose that there be an option to see the average rating readers with similar reading histories and tastes gave the book.** It does no good to see a 4 star average (or a 2 star average) if 90% of the readers who wrote ratings like something radically different from me. What one person hates about a book might be the thing that another reader loves about it. By allowing users to filter for the ratings submitted by users like themselves, it helps the books and authors find the right audience, no matter how much buzz their marketing team can or can’t afford to buy.

posts.title: Bulk add chapters for readalongs
posts.description: I just created a readalong and it was pretty tedious to create a locked forum for each chapter. Would be great to be able to bulk add by the number of chapters and then just have to fill in pages/percentages for each. Thanks for your consideration!

posts.title: Add more filters/searching in Editions chooser
posts.description: I recently read a new translation of Ovid's Metamorphoses. I realized that I had recorded it as a hardcover edition instead of a digital edition. However, when I went to make this change, it was virtually impossible for me to find other formats/editions for the particular book I had read. ALL translations of this book are lumped together under one book (which does seem like the correct behavior), but they are not sorted/grouped in any meaningful way. This makes it pretty difficult to do a very common workflow of changing the edition of a book.

posts.title: Add 'Clear' Option Next to Date Fields In Challenges
posts.description: Add a 'Clear' option next to the two date lines in the challenges. This allows for quicker setup; 'Clear' is particularly useful when setting up an open challenge, reducing the process to just two clicks instead of changing six different drop-downs. The attached picture also displays a 'set to today' option. Initially, I added this, thinking it could be convenient for a quick reset if you clear or change the dates. Maybe not necessary, but could consider including both for added flexibility? *Also to be noted for clarification that my picture shows the date fields cleared but when you setup a challenge those a filled in with that days date.

posts.title: Challenge creator x participant interactions
posts.description: I just created my first challenge and it's great to see that people have joined already. I think it would be great to have some way of communicating with everyone in the challenge, without needing to become friends and with some checks in place to prevent spam (definitely allow participants to opt in/out). But I'm thinking some automated updates on the challenge page depending on the runtime of a challenge (e.g. monthly stats about how many people have joined, how many prompts have been completed etc.), but maybe also some kind of chat / discussion where people could post encouragement or share some thoughts about the experience? I see some creators link to a Discord for specific challenges, but that's a bit too much for me. Though it would be nice to occasionally just check in with everyone participating, directly in the StoryGraph.

posts.title: Graphs/data filtered by tag(s)
posts.description: I’d love to be able to see a dashboard for all of the stats for any given tag I have.

posts.title: Retroactively Apply Reading Goals
posts.description: Not sure if I just haven't found it yet, but I would love to be able to retroactively apply my reading goals from past years. I just switched from Goodreads and I'd like to maintain that data on TSG without having to look back at my Goodreads profile.

posts.title: share a recommended reading list
posts.description: I recommend a lot of books to friends, and lot being able to link them to storygraph for details/content warnings/etc. I'd love to be able to create a recommended reading list (even using tags) that I could share as a list with others.

posts.title: Fable integration
posts.description: Integration with the fable app to keep your book club progress up to date.

posts.title: Books to Challenge Prompt Visibiltiy
posts.description: Right now, when I click on a book, it tells me that other people have added it to a challenge. But it doesn't show ms which prompt. I would be nice if that was also a filter when looking at the challenge page from a specific book page (Prompts this books has been added to). Or even an (*) by the prompt(s) the book has been added to, because there are sometimes a hundred prompts, this might be less user friendly, but it would still give visibility if the filter wasn't an option. I love love the new filters on challenges and I think this would also be useful.

posts.title: Recommendations by pub date
posts.description: When selecting recommendations it would be nice to filter or sort by publication date.

posts.title: Machine Selected Nontypical Books
posts.description: I know that if you hit the "suggestions" button near the "Up Next " it gives you some machine learned suggestions for books to read and the rationale behind the suggestions. I think that's great. What I would love is for one of the outputs to be a book that is extremely different (but still "good") from everything else I read. It should be able to do his by parsing that same data that it uses to select books based on what you have been reading, and what fits with your current reading trends and all that. This time though, it just finds the under represented/less logged moods, pace, type and genre from your data. I feel like this would allow for more visibility into the corners and blindspots of our reading selections and allow us to broaden our reading horizons more easily.

posts.title: Quick add for books
posts.description: I beta read books for authors, and I’d like to be able to track this books in Story Graph, so it would be nice if I could quickly add the book with minimal details, and have it ONLY available to me, not addd to the global database.

posts.title: Add kindle books
posts.description: Is there an easy way to add all Amazon books and or audiobooks? Would be nice to have everything listed at one place.

posts.title: Input authors or contributors in batches
posts.description: When inputting a new book, or edition, can there be a way to input either authors or contributors all in at once in bulk/batches. This would helpful for books with multiple authors or contributors. I attached an example of a book with multiple narrators. It would be nice to be able to copy them on ones and paste them into the contributor section.

posts.title: Customise Tag stats panel shown in Owned Book Stats
posts.description: I’d like to be able to customise the tag stats panel shown within Owned Book Stats. The Tag Stats page goes into two-tag compare mode, for Plus at least, which isn’t what I’m after. Instead I visit my Owned Books page and then into Stats. This gives me a Tags panel showing a decent chunk of my tags, ordered by number of books from most tagged to least tagged. I love to be able to choose which tags are included - effectively filtering tags out of the display. And then I want to control the ordering with options for Ascending, Descending and, crucially, None - i.e. sort by tag name irrespective of the number of tagged books. For example, I have been tagging my books with the year I bought them: shelved-1996 … shelved-2023, so I have a good 25+ of these tags now. When I’m reviewing my tag stats I may want to see just the shelved-* tags, without any others interfering. I then want the chart effectively sorted by year i.e. using the tag name as the sort order, so I can see the length of tag bar vary by year, and thus review overall trends across contiguous time. So a bit more control over what appears in Owned Book Stats, or perhaps a more configurable Tag Stats page.

posts.title: Ability to require both pages and minutes in an interval before streak is extended
posts.description: The streak feature is amazing! I would love to see an and/or option made explicit between pages/minutes. For example, users might want to challenge themselves to read both pages and minutes every interval. The way it's currently built has the flexibility to allow either without forcing both, if that makes sense?

posts.title: Sans serif font for book page
posts.description: I like a lot about the new design, but could you please switch the font of the book's title on the book page back to sans serif font, to make it match the rest of the page? I find sans serif much more accessible, and it's jarring to have the book title be so different. Thank you for considering!

posts.title: Group Series Together
posts.description: Currently reading a tv tie-in series that has multiple authors and noticed that there's no method of accessing a series page with all of those novels in a list. Is there a way to add one?

posts.title: Bulk edit tags to be public
posts.description: add a toggle button to make all your tags public if you would like at once

posts.title: Star ratings click and drag instead of numerical drop down menu
posts.description: Being able to rate books using click and drag stars (keeping the .25 increments) instead of having to go into pull down menus

posts.title: Count audiobooks separately
posts.description: I would love if it was possible to count audio books apart from the books I've read. I want the possibility for them not to be a part of my "Read Books"

posts.title: Way to archive/dismiss buttons to create StoryGraph reading goals
posts.description: I don’t intend to do the StoryGraph 2023 challenges, but there’s no button to archive them. I’d like to go to my reading challenges page and just see the ones I am participating in without having to scroll past the ones I’m not doing first! Ty :)

posts.title: Curated Recommendations
posts.description: As an addition to the current system of deriving recommendations from my own past reading, I would like to see explicit recommendations by people (including authors) I follow. I envision a future StoryGraph where recommendation tools allow me to toggle which kind of recommendations I want to see at the moment. This could be developed in a few different ways: - Easy way 1 - just use the ratings. Blah. - Easy way 2 - a simple checkbox to "recommend this book". - Cooler but more complex way: a dialog to recommend a book that includes tagging, so I could recommend a book with [tag1], [tag2]... When I follow someone, I would see these recommendations with the tags and the person's name - "Recommended by Joe Johnson for [tag1], [tag2]". I think people would love to be able to recommend certain books, beyond just rating them. I may rate many books highly but would probably have a shorter curated list of books I think other people should read and would want to tag them to show why. I love The StoryGraph, but I have to admit that I was turned off at first glance by the idea of categorizing and books by 'mood', and by deriving recommendations from books I've already read. I'm sure you've heard objections to this before (filter bubbles, etc.). For my part, I value the chance to discover random things in a library (or a record store) just by walking past them and taking interest, and to find out what people I find interesting think others should read.

posts.title: Connect with authors
posts.description: I recently stumbled upon a service that allows book clubs to connect with authors in the service's network, free for 30 min or a pre-defined fee for an hour or more, with some kind of mechanism for the author to set available times and book clubs to sign up for slots. Authors also pay to be part of this service. I didn't register yet because I'm not sure if my book club wants to give their emails to this company, but most of us have StoryGraph accounts already... 😉 My book club recently met with an author after winning a silent auction at a book convention where time with the author was up for bid. It was so fun to hear about the process and development of the book of hers that we read, so we're looking for more ways to connect with authors! I know you've developed relationships with authors, and that you've considered features to support book clubs for a while, so I thought I'd mention this!

posts.title: Add error text for buddy read invite
posts.description: As the initiator of a buddy read, when a user exists but hasn't changed the preference to allow buddy reads, it would be great if there was error text. When the suggested users list shows zero users, error text could be something like "user not found or user hasn't enabled buddy read search yet" Eek, I know that error is really clumsy, but I think you get my point. In my current use case, I have coworkers who agreed to make StoryGraph accounts for the work erg book club. Given that this is the first time I've started a buddy read and the first time they've ever been on StoryGraph, it could be helpful to have some helpful text. Oh! Or I guess there could just be more helper test that says something similar

posts.title: No total numer of Currently Reading books
posts.description: I have been in that reading phase that I start many books and don't finish them. It would be great if I could hide the currently reading number at the top of the page, so I don't keep being reminded of how many books I'm already reading. It sort of stresses me out haha.

posts.title: Choice to type in publication date
posts.description: Give users the choice to either use the calendar or type in the publication date when inputting a book or adding a missing information.

posts.title: Ability to sync with my book buddy
posts.description: For those of us that maintain a library with the my book buddy app, it would be great to have an option to important books I own from that app or others

posts.title: category of suggestions that other people read after the book you’re currently reading/last finished
posts.description: kinda like on amazon when you are looking at a product, there is similar items category and also recommended products that other people also bought.

posts.title: Sort option for TBR on landing page
posts.description: Would it be possible to change how the TBR is sorted in the landing page display? Currently it seems to only be random, with no option to change.

posts.title: Can Western Frisian be added as a language?
posts.description: Basically the title. Frisian, or to be more exact, Western Frisian is not in the list of languages. Would love it if you could add it to the list. Thanks in advance!

posts.title: Option to remove/hide reading format or editions
posts.description: It would be great if I could hide certain features, namely the format or edition for a book, from my stats pages. I've set default to print, but every now and then I find another format has been recorded (my error). Others have suggested making it easier to switch editions, which I upvoted and think would be great, but really the extra stat being there is very annoying. Also the button underneath the stat-"Set default format to print"-I find confusing. It makes me think the format is incorrect. Maybe the button instead should read "Default format is print" or something with the format bolded as a link to the settings for ease of interface. Thanks for considering!

posts.title: Way to record short stories published in academic journals
posts.description: When I read short stories from the English world, a lot of them have been published individually at one point or another so I can include them in the record of books I have read, but when it comes to short stories translated from other languages these translations are often only found in academic journals, yet I would love a way to be able to record these as well (afterall, they're just as much a complete work as any of the short stories that have been published individually in English)! I don't know whether it would be okay to add one of these without an ISBN using the current manual import system or not.

posts.title: Page Equivalent Graph
posts.description: I would love to see a graph that creates/displays a page equivalent for audiobook listeners - i.e. 6 hour audiobook = 250 pages and then the graph would display the 250 pages. I like knowing the page equivalent, and in my total month, it says zero pages because I've only listened to audio so far. Thanks!

posts.title: Factoring Ratings Per Book Type and Read History into New Recommendations
posts.description: The Recommendations feature is pretty good at finding books based on the info I provide in the questionnaire. But it's also hard to really pinpoint what I love and am looking for sometimes; I don't always know the vocabulary that would work best in the free text section. I'm not sure if it does this already, but it would be so helpful if it also factored in data from "Ratings per book type" and read history to learn more about what I like. Although, one thing that may not be helpful about this is that in my "Ratings per book type" data, there may be a category that averages a 5.0 rating at the top of the chart, but when I click to view it, it's because I only read one or two books in that category and they happened to have a 5 star rating. It might be more helpful if it averaged in amount of books read rather than a simple average of star ratings.

posts.title: Hide the Recommendations on the homepage?
posts.description: Having discovered that the new recommendations algorithm is recommending books in genres I've excluded and languages I don't read, is there any way to remove the Recommendations from the homepage?

posts.title: Non-fiction articles
posts.description: It would be really useful if it were possible to add individual academic articles with doi, if only to help motivate those of us who otherwise seem to read endlessly into the void...

posts.title: Edit book editions
posts.description: I would like to be able to edit existing editions just like a librarian user can in Goodreads. Often I run across an edition that has the correct ISBN but book information is lacking e.g. no page numbers/listening time and no cover picture.

posts.title: Mute/Hide "not following anyone" message
posts.description: I gave in and followed a couple of users, but only because I was utterly sick of the nag screen. I tended to actively avoid the Community tab because I hated seeing that censorious admonition. Had the option existed to turn it off or hide it, I would not have felt compelled to follow users just for peace and quiet.

posts.title: Mark as Owned
posts.description: It used to be very easy to "Mark as Owned" from the results page. Now it seems you have to go into the book to mark it? Or am I missing something? Will that feature be reinstated? I find myself buying several books at a time and like to update my lists before I shelve them.

posts.title: Optimise use of screen space on mobile screens - Book Reading Journal
posts.description: On the book specific reading journals the notes don't take the full width of the screen. I assume it's like this because it uses the same layout as the regular reading journal where there is a book cover that takes up space next to the note. However, on small screen sizes especially, the notes can become very long, very quickly when they only take op 3/4 of the width. It would be nice (and look neater) to have the notes take up the full width when the space is available.

posts.title: Show group of multiple editions marked by user
posts.description: This might be an edge case and not that important, but I have a some cases where I have read or want to read different editions of a book (e.g.: want to reread it in another language) and there's only a link to one of the editions. So it would be nice to see them grouped somewhere, for example as the top editions in the browse editions list. It might also be nice to see the editions you have tagged or marked as owned (but not marked read or to-read yet) at the top of the list.

posts.title: Possibility to select genres
posts.description: it will be good to be able to select the genres of the books I read. I don't always agree with the genres that appear for the books I read

posts.title: Integration with WorldCat
posts.description: integrate with the WorldCat API so users can easily find copies of books they come across in their local libraries.

posts.title: End of Year 3D Network Visualization
posts.description: At the end of the year, can we have a 3D network visualization that maps all the books everyone has read? Colour coded by genre? Stretch goals: With the ability to show the books I read? And maybe zoom in and see the data for other books that were read by people who read the same books as me (if privacy concerns are ok)?

posts.title: Ability to read with others in a community
posts.description: What if we had the ability to choose to join a community, for example, a geographical region, and then we could vote on what genre we in the community were going to read in the next year/month, and then all read different books that fit the criteria. It would act like an extension of the challenges, as we can currently choose to join those, but can't upvote. Also, we could have a widget on our Your Storygraph page that would scroll through the books people are reading in the community that they are 'releasing' to the community (have to think about privacy settings there...). I was also thinking we could have stats from it... :)

posts.title: Challenge wrap-ups
posts.description: It would be great to be able have reading challenge wrap ups, graphics with which books you read for which prompts, and when you read it (like which month you finished or something)!

posts.title: warning if aleady on owned list
posts.description: I have just added all my books to my owned list, but I found I had duplicated some (note sure how). Having a warning when adding a book with something like 'you already have another edition of this book marked as owned would you like to -cancel adding this edition, -replace the edition on your list for this one or -add this edition anyway.' With each hyphen being a button. This could help prevent accidental re-adds while still allowing it to happen (i have multiple copies of the same book, so I know some people will need that)

posts.title: Sort own/profile reviews by read date
posts.description: Sometimes I edit my reviews and the last edited date is changed. I would love it if we could sort the reviews we wrote (or on someone else's profile) by read date.

posts.title: Tier list Rating for books
posts.description: I don't really like just rating my books, mainly because even if I love two books, i can't give them both 5, or 4 stars, they need relationship to each other at the 5 or 4 star mark, but decimal point a are garbage as you may have hundreds of 4 star books. This is wher I think a tier list supported rating system would be interesting, allow users to create a tier list of their books, 5, 4, 3, 2, 1, DNF; this would also create a very interesting system for recommendations. For example, my 5 star books could make a hash, all similar hashes that fall in the same bucket within a expected range, probably have a book that i would be interested in.

posts.title: Check all edition in family for missing or multiple series
posts.description: A suggestion for some data clean up. Check all edition in family for missing or multiple series. I have found a lot of these so seems like an easy way to fix data that could run in off hours.

posts.title: Turn tag into tier list
posts.description: Tier lists are popular lately would be cool to turn a tag into a tier list.

posts.title: Wrap-up summary graphic without ratings
posts.description: Rating labels on the monthly wrap-up summary graphic often obscure the author and the title of the book. It would be nice to have an option to generate this graphic without the ratings, just like there is a separate "cover collage" and a "ratings collage".

posts.title: filter Stats by tag and book format
posts.description: I'd love to see a way to combine tags with book format in the Stats section. What I'm hoping for: the ability to filter or break down my read books by tag and format (hardcover, paperback, ebook, audiobook, etc.) at the same time. Example use case: I use a "library" tag for books I borrow from my library. I'd like to see how many of those library books I read as paperbacks, ebooks, audiobooks, and so on. Right now I can see format stats and I can see tagged books, but I can't see the two together. Why it would help: it would show how readers actually use their libraries. For example, whether someone borrows mostly ebooks and audiobooks through Libby (the library's free borrowing app) or checks out print copies. It would work for any custom tag too, such as "gifted," "bought secondhand," or "review copy."

posts.title: ThriftBooks Wishlist Integration
posts.description: I'd love it if I could sync my StoryGraph To-Read Pile into my ThriftBooks wishlist.

posts.title: Weighted Rating
posts.description: I propose a weighted star rating system. Specifically, I don't think a DNF 1 star rating should be given the same weight in a rating. Many literary classics are rated much lower than "crowd pleasers" and perusing the ratings, it seems like some of this may be due to people marking DNF and citing everything from form to content to issues with characters not being likable to give a poor rating. I think a "% DNF" would be a good metric to still give those people a voice, but rating a book after reading 1/4 of it is silly.

posts.title: Book equivalent for goal setting
posts.description: When setting your yearly reading goals, I would love to see an indication for the hours and pages goals that says "this is approximately x number of books on average" so people who read 50 books a year, but read more audio than text can adjust their goals accordingly. otherwise the goals can be misaligned.

posts.title: AT Protocol Integration
posts.description: Hi! Huge fan! One feature that would be awesome (and plays into the request for an API) is integrating with the AT protocol, which underlies bluesky. https://atproto.com/ it was designed originally to billionaire-proof twitter, which fits with your goals as an alternative to goodreads. there are even already some examples to learn from and integrate with, like popfeed.social. the fun part is that i’d be able to use storygraph, and with the right syncing behavior users on popfeed could see and follow my reviews. this would also satisfy requests for an API, since users could query their personal data server (PDS, where atproto data lives) directly. for example, here’s a record on my PDS: https://pdsls.dev/at://did:plc:s7xw6pqvc72ha73bogjqp4m3/social.popfeed.book.progress/3mjbgmq4mv42p in the long term, this would provide network effects, reduce hosting costs, and create resiliency for users and their data. atproto is designed to be “the last social account you need” since data is portable across applications. this could be done in a few stages/pieces: - connecting an atproto account (oauth) - exporting data to atproto (onetime export on demand) - mirror data to atproto (as data is created, records are updated and stored to the PDS) - listen to firehose of atproto data to import from across the network (allows me to see popfeed data in storygraph) - shifting to atproto as source of truth for data anyways, let me know if this sounds interesting or if you have any questions! i’m not affiliated w bluesky, but i am a dev and a fan!

posts.title: Notification or redirect when a user changes their profile name
posts.description: Background: I keep a note on my computer of bookish folks I follow on Storygraph because they have similar tastes, where I link to their profile and include a short list of books we've both loved. This helps give context to their updates in my Storygraph feed so I know if they loved a book whether it might also be a good fit for me. However, here's the problem: If a person changes their profile name, the link is broken, and there's no way for me to figure out what their new profile name is without manually looking at every person I've followed or friended to figure out what the new name might be. A related issue crops up when a person changes their profile name: There's no notification to their followers, and so I just start seeing a new name in my Storygraph updates, and I have no idea who it is. Redirecting from the old profile name to the new would help in the first use case, or alternatively, notifying followers/friends of a profile name change would address both use cases (some other social media platforms do this when there's a name change for someone you follow/friend).

posts.title: Replying to a comment in buddy reads
posts.description: At the moment if you reply to a comment on the buddy read it shows which top-level comment you're replying to. However, if you reply to somebody else's reply, it doesn't show which reply you're replying to (just which person) which can make these threads become confusing. It would be great if replies to replies quoted the original reply or otherwise indicated what they were in response to!

posts.title: UI request: numeric popover (iPad app)
posts.description: In order to save space and not have the keyboard take up half of the screen in the iPad app, can you please change the UI to number pad pop over when someone taps on the percentage and the pages dialogue box? I attached an example of what it looks like in Goodreads on an iPad in landscape mode.

posts.title: Option to "hide" following/friend reviews on book page
posts.description: Would it be possible to hide the star-reviews my friends have given a book on the book page under the "people you follow" section? I would really like for it only to be visible when you click "see all". Sometimes I don't want to be biased from the get-go by what the people I follow think of a book before I read it or consider it even. Thanks! :)

posts.title: move reading history between editions
posts.description: I mostly read digital editions. Every so often, I accidentally select the incorrect edition for the book I am reading, twice now I only noticed after the fact. Once I manually moved all the reading journal entries to the correct edition but it would be nice, if that could be done automatically somehow.

posts.title: Custom chart and tag features
posts.description: A few ideas for custom charts & tags 1. Segment by the lack of a tag 2 Support for multiple tags in one section of a pie chart 3. The ability to apply a tag to multiple books at once, like a book selection when creating a new tag

posts.title: Edit history for tags
posts.description: I am going through my read books right now adding tags so that my custom charts will be up to date for my end of year reading write-up. Multiple times now, in trying to add tags (on desktop if it matters), I have accidentally deleted a tag instead. I'll have the box open like this, and I don't know exactly how I'm clicking wrong, but a tag will disappear unexpectedly. There's some UI lagginess on my end that may be contributing (I am not sure if this is an actual issue or just my own computer being slow, I did try it on two browsers with the same behavior but it could just be a problem with my wifi or something) but once the tag has disappeared, I have no way of knowing what I accidentally got rid of. I'd love for there to be a way for me to look at an edit history to recover these tags because for some of them like "rec-from-XXXX" there isn't a way for me to recover that info if I lose it.

posts.title: Notification Setting for Question Bank
posts.description: Yay, I just saw the Question Bank is in Beta! Thank you ❤️ Once we're able to answer book Questions, I would love to be able to get a notification when a question is asked about a book I've read. Alternatively, a book I own? Not sure about specifics, but I'd love to be part of the crowdsourcing. Maybe we could also get an opportunity to answer questions immediately upon finishing a book!

posts.title: export csv - challenges
posts.description: I think it could be helpful - especially for longer challenges or ones with multiple prompts, to be able to pull a CSV of the challenge. When on the go, I find it easier to scan a list, versus going into each individual prompt to when trying to decide which to do next.

posts.title: Exclude recommendation if it doesn't include a specific genre
posts.description: Option to stop recommendations from showing books if their genre list does not include one or more preferred genres For example, if I want to see more MM Romance, there should be a way to simply tell the algorithm to exclude books if they are not marked as LGBTQIA+ Currently the only workaround is to go into Advanced filters, but that feels like I need to put in extra work while my Recommendations list remains mostly irrelevant

posts.title: Make it easier to add different version of book to prompt
posts.description: When adding books to challenge prompts, I can't seem to figure out how to choose the right language version. It always prefers the English-language version of a book, even for books originally written in another language. Now that I studied it more it is possible on the desktop version, but I would really love for this to be possible a bit more easily.

posts.title: Ability to reorder the info on a book's page
posts.description: It would be nice if we could reorder the layout/listing of the info page for books. The ability to collapse/uncollapse the review section would also be nice since it's kinda huge. Like if I wanted content warnings to be the first thing on the list before getting to the recommendations, etc.

posts.title: Alternate Rating System
posts.description: Would like to have an optional alternative to the star ratings since I, personally speaking, don't really quantify my reading numerically but rather by how much I felt I enjoyed it. Something like a binary rating system with at least three options (like/dislike/ambivalent) or the traffic light rating system which is similar to the former but uses colors instead (green = like, red = dislike, yellow = ambivalent). Star ratings just leaves me trying to guess which number(s) best correlates to how I feel about a book which just ends up with me not rating them at all.

posts.title: Mark a book as read without noting all its pages as read
posts.description: I'd love to be able to mark a book as "read" without counting all its pages as in my "pages read" statistic. A number of the books I read have pages I use as reference when needed (think maps, glossary pages, multiple pages of contributor bios in anthologies, several pages of endnotes and citations in academic books) but don't actually read front-to-end. When I finish these books and mark them as "read", those pages I didn't read get included in my pages read stats. Could you please introduce a way to mark say a 300-page book as "read" without counting all 300 pages as read?

posts.title: No Limit to Buddy Read
posts.description: I am currently in a Book Club and start Buddy Reads using the JOIN MEETING approach. There 18 members in the book club so 3 of us are left out of the Buddy Read. Is there any way to extend how many people can join a Buddy Read to reflect who is all in the Book Club group?

posts.title: Formatting Content Warnings Free-response
posts.description: I would love to be able to format my extra text about content warnings in the same way I can format my review. Right now, I have to insert to separate my notes with newlines!

posts.title: Edit Meeting Titles - Book Club
posts.description: It would be amazing to have the option to edit meeting titles for book clubs. Context: My book club is an introvert/antisocial book club that never hosts meetings. I would love to be able to edit "#2 - No Date" to "February 2025"

posts.title: Most Pages Read/Minutes Listened Option
posts.description: In the monthly wrap-up calendar, it would be nice to be able to choose whether the day that gets the trophy counts minutes listened. This would be helpful to those who track their physical reading separately from audiobooks, as pages and minutes are not necessarily equivalent.

posts.title: User choice for percentage display
posts.description: It would be great if users could have an option to choose how their progress percentage is displayed either bar or button. I personally prefer the previous button version vs the progress bar.

posts.title: Make percentage number more visible in progress bar
posts.description: At the moment when a user has only read a little bit of a book at the beginning, there are a situations where the Green progress bar cut through/makes the percentage number very difficult to read. Basically the green progress bar splits up the percentage number, which can sometimes make it very difficult to read. i’m taking an example of a book. I just started today. That is at 10% and it’s pretty difficult to see the one next to the zero because of the green progress bar.

posts.title: Audiobook tracks
posts.description: I'm still using a old school iPod to listen to audiobooks and unlike Libby or Audible, the books are broken into tracks, which makes it virtually impossible to use to track progress here on storygraph, as each track has a different HH:MM and I have no idea what percentage of the book overall I've listened to. I would love to see a similar sort of thing as to goodreads where each track is listed as a "page." Even better would be to have each track as a "chapter" and you could specify how far you're into that chapter.

posts.title: Custom (Horizontal) Chart Size Options
posts.description: Some of my horizontal custom charts employ a lot of tags, and tend to get smushed together. It might be nice to have an option to make the chart run longer down the page as the number of tags being included increased.

posts.title: lgbtqia
posts.description: Is there an option to turn off this tag? I don’t care what the sexuality of the people in my books is, it even spoils part of the story for me sometimes. Which I hate, I don’t want to be spoiled, it’s not a genre, I honestly don’t know why it’s such a huge thing on this site about books. Who you love is not a genre, it’s just life, it’s part of the story, not the whole story. And if you take it this far, then I think you should add more cultural relevant tags, not just this one.

posts.title: Special “6 stars” option
posts.description: Sometimes a book is just sooo good I want to show that in my rating by giving it a special star or some other recognition. I think it would be cool if you had a limited number of annual bonus stars to give to books you found truly outstanding.

posts.title: New barcode scanner or scanning audiobook covers and information
posts.description: I love that we’re going to have an option to scan. The book covers to input information. I hope this system includes the ability to put in information for audiobooks from different platforms, like audible and others. I have attached a screenshot of the type of scan that I would like to be able to use.

posts.title: Challenge Recommendation based on book reading
posts.description: When I look at a book, I'd like to see the challenges it has been added to so I can read those books and join those as well. Also, AI does book recommendations it could also do challenge recommendations.

posts.title: Missing Challenge Icon on Bottom of Vertical Desktop
posts.description: Hello! I love the new view on mobile (I have iOS for reference) and I noticed that my vertical screen at work has a similar layout on the bottom as mobile. I'm just curious why it's four of the same icons as on mobile but missing challenges?

posts.title: overview of currend & upcoming club books
posts.description: Members of our book club are wishing for an easier way to see all club readalongs/buddy reads, specifically the current and upcoming ones, regardless of whether they joined them or not. For myself, I participate in several clubs and still keep a google sheet with the following information: - book being read - by which club - during which timeframe to plan my reading. Ideally, I would like to have this overview automatically created in the app. On the "readalongs" page we can only see those we have joined, and no upcoming readalongs. Clicking through to the club meetings is quite a few clicks, and then we can only see one club's meetings. What I envision is an overview of: - which club is reading what - which club will be reading what in the (near?) future - start & end dates/meeting times - which of these have I joined This could be included in the readalongs and buddy reads tabs, or the book club tab could be changed, or it could be a new tab, calendar etc.

posts.title: "Missing Pub Info" date but date listed in edition's stats?
posts.description: When sorting my TBR by publication date, I noticed that a lot of books with undefined pub date info are listed at the top, when sorting Earliest First. However, when I click "Missing pub info," on one of those books, within the stats that drop down, there is more often than not an accurate publication date listed? I've included a screenshot here. Not sure if this is a bug or not. Thanks!

posts.title: Challenge prompt fulfillment unique to user
posts.description: Could a setting be added to the Challenge set up that restricts prompt completion to books users added themselves? I've set up a challenge and User 1 read a book for Prompt A, but that same book was added by User 2 to Prompt B. The challenge marked both prompts completed for User 1 even though she planned to read something else for Prompt B. I hope that makes sense!

posts.title: Project Consolidation
posts.description: I feel that these project ideas and updates should be consolidated into the StoryGraph website itself. Going to a different website for progress updates, and then finding out there is a third website over at https://thestorygraph.freshdesk.com for tips and an option to become a volunteer librarian is...cumbersome from a user perspective

posts.title: About us page
posts.description: I would like the StoryGraph people to add an about us page and a mission statement. There's a lot of tree ideas without giving us a picture of the forest, and as a Shelfari vet, I need some reassurance ;A;

posts.title: Audiobook tracking keyboard
posts.description: It would be good to show a number keyboard popup when entering hour/minute tracking for audiobooks, as opposed to a full keyboard.

posts.title: Want to read Specific Tags
posts.description: I like to have a priority tbr or seasonal tbr tags. I would love to have the option to automatically have a book removed from the tag if I have read it or another version of the book.

posts.title: Align progress bars in new layout?
posts.description: I read a lot of audiobooks (square covers) and print books (vert rectangle covers) and when they all show up in the new layout together, the progress bars are really out of alignment. It's such a silly little thing but it makes me do a double take whenever I'm trying to update the progress. Otherwise really loving the layout, the covers look SO nice!! Can't wait to see the rest of the new upcoming updates!

posts.title: DNF Books Counting for Book Specific Challenge Should Be Optional
posts.description: Right now, DNFing a book marks it off the book-specific challenges and makes it look like I have completed more than I actually have. When you look to view more details, it marks the prompt as "complete (DNF)" and adds the DNFed book to the total of "read" books in the progress bar. I would love if this were an optional thing you could set up while making the challenge. I love the book-specific challenges but I DNF a lot of books because it's the right book, wrong time kind of deal.

posts.title: Simple table option for pages read/minutes read
posts.description: I love both the streaks graph and the new monthly calendar wrap up. But I would also love a simple table with just the date and pages/minutes. The graph is difficult to see actual numbers on mobile, and the monthly graph takes a second to generate each time. I like to pull the pages/minutes I read for other tracking and having it more accessible would be great!

posts.title: Ability to make different To-Read Piles
posts.description: Be able to make different to-read piles. I like to have different lists for finished/unfinished series. It makes it easier to keep track before I start a new book

posts.title: Journal Audiobook Chapter Entry
posts.description: I have had a few occasions where I am listening to an audio book that doesn't list the total minutes/percentage but instead will list the minutes for each chapter. It would be great if I could enter in the audiobook chapter details, and if those could then sync to the total completion journal entries for hh:mm/%age

posts.title: Setting read & start date to same date
posts.description: It would be nice if we had the option when setting or editing date read, to set the start date to be the same as end date, and vice versa.

posts.title: Color-coded Journal Entries
posts.description: When I read books on Kindle and highlight lines of text, I will often use colors to signify different things. I'd love to be able to do something similar on StoryGraph! Right now I'm reading Murderbot Diaries and it would be so neat to be able to quickly distinguish between a quote that I'm adding that is plot relevant vs a quote that is just Murderbot being snarky 😂

posts.title: Only show me books not added to a reading challenge
posts.description: When filtering books read, have the option in "Only show me books..." for books not added to a reading challenge. This would make it easier to add books to challenges retroactively instead of going book by book to look for the ones not added to a challenge.

posts.title: Tertulia Integration
posts.description: Integrate TBR and owned shelves with Tertulia so I can more easily find and order new books

posts.title: DNF stat
posts.description: It would be cool if in addition to "books with no rating" we had a section of books we DNF'd. I think there's a huge difference between books we read but didn't rate and books we didn't finish/got a chance to rate for that reason. I don't like how my stats look like I don't rate books because my DNFs take over.

posts.title: Wrap up in horizontal/banner format
posts.description: I'd like to use my wrap-up as a banner for a blog post (or social media cover image) and need to create it manually from the vertically generated one. It would be great to have an option to squareify or horizontalize the wrap up!

posts.title: Content warning for demons/exorcisms
posts.description: I would really like some sort of content warning for demons, possession, exorcism, or something that denotes spiritual warfare. My Christian friends are extremely sensitive to this kind of content and it’s hard for me to remember which thrillers/horror books I read that feature these elements. I’m struggling to think of one word to encompass this, but maybe “demonic possession.” Maybe evil spirits? This literally does “trigger” my mother so I’d like to see it added somehow as a content warning. I get that this isn’t a thing for most non-religious people but would still find it useful as a content warning.

posts.title: Excluding "Not-a-book" titles in annual stats summary
posts.description: Is it possible to exclude titles that have been marked "Not-A-Book" titles from the Read books Stats view?

posts.title: Filter similar book suggestions
posts.description: Hi, An idea I had would be to allow for a filter when looking up similar books to something your reading. For example, filtering by page number, highest to lowest, that kind of thing.

posts.title: Ebooks/Audio/Physical
posts.description: It would be nice to have a record of what format we read a book in. Sometimes we may have it in more than one format.

posts.title: Notification if unsaved text will be lost
posts.description: I somehow have done this multiple times in various contexts over the past two days, but with an increasing number of places in the app where you can write long-form content, I would LOVE a notification that you're about to lose your text if you navigate away. I hit this yesterday while writing up a multi-paragraph review and just now while writing thankfully only a couple sentences in a readalong post. I don't know why my thumb decided to tap the home button in both cases, but I groaned out loud at having to rewrite what I had lost. If there were a buffer in there to say "You have unsaved text, are you sure you want to leave?" it would have saved me so many times. 🙏

posts.title: Finishing a previously DNFed book doesn't show up in Community Feed
posts.description: I very triumphantly just finished a 700+ page book that I had previously DNFed years ago that I had been reading in bursts since last June. I marked it as finished and was a little surprised not to see the usual "Add review" indicator. I figured out that because I had previously DNFed and written an explanation, I had to edit my existing review, not *add* a review. No matter, I went in and added my review. But now, I am not seeing anything in my Community Feed about this. Usually I see my own activity for finishing and adding a review, but for this book, there's nothing. I'd really like for this to show up in the Feed because I'd love to get some ❤️s for finally finishing 😄

posts.title: Add Name of Users Using Book on Reading Challenges
posts.description: Add the name of the user who submitted the book to a reading challenge prompt and/or the names of those who are using/planning to use the book to finish a prompt. Could make it visible only to the person who created the challenge if there's a privacy concern, but it would be nice to see who is reading what and maybe coordinate buddy reads if there's a bunch of people all using the same book for a prompt especially when the challenge is hosted by a bookish community.

posts.title: Reading challenges with specific books and their editions
posts.description: Hi! I was looking through the challenges and came across an improvement. When somebody has made a list of books to read for a challenge, it doesn't show as read if you have read another edition (for example the creator has but hardback and I have read paperback). But I still have read the book and I don't want to mark another editions as read when I haven't. So is it possible to make so that if you have read one edition when tackling reading challenges. You have read the book regardless of which edition the creator has put in the challenge.

posts.title: Highlight/surface books already read in a challenge prompt
posts.description: If I have read a book that would complete a prompt, it would be nice to have that at the top of the list of in some way indicated. I may disagree that it meets the prompt but an indication that I may have could be useful

posts.title: Sort Books in Challenges
posts.description: This may have been requested, but I can't see a post matching this so I thought I'd make one myself. Following the recent addition of book prompts in challenges, instead of manually listing and adding books, it would be great if we could sort them in editing, such as by author name, title name, pages, pub. date etc. like you can for your to-read pile and when you add new books, you can easily sort them to follow the rest of the order of the books.

posts.title: Catalogue books into Tags/Owned/Shelf immediately when scanning
posts.description: Is there a way to develop the barcode scanner further to be able to go into a view like Tags, Owned or any of the shelves (ideally a combination to make cataloguing that much more efficient!) via filters or some other means and use the barcode scanner to automatically add the books you scan to those categories? For example, I catalogue the books I own with an additional tag by country they're in. Over the past few years, I've gotten quite lax with cataloguing physical books (a mix of frequent travelling and moves, as well as being between platforms following Storygraph's launch on a wider scale) and my goal for this year is to have each book I own accounted for. Most of them I have not yet read, so the default shelf could be To-Read, but maybe there could be an option to switch to reading or read. I would really appreciate your help on this and this is just an extra feature I'm looking for, because the barcode scanner itself works great! Thank you for all the hard work!

posts.title: filter 'add to reading challenge' view
posts.description: As someone who partakes in a lot long-time of reading challenges, I would like to filter the 'add to reading challenge' view to find the challenge I want to add my book to faster. I'd be happy with a simple text box where I can just start typing and have the list be filtered in real-time.

posts.title: New reading challenge prompt type: format-limited
posts.description: I recently joined a reading challenge related to listening to books with specific audiobook narrators. I started adding some books in my TBR that matched the narrators listed. In one case, there's a book I've read in print whose narrator is listed, so I added the audio version to the challenge, hoping to listen to it someday. This immediately marked the prompt as complete. I naturally understand why this happened and it's generally very welcome behaviour! However, given the type of challenge here, a print/digital edition should not complete this prompt. This is true of many other audiobook-related challenges on TSG. It would be nice if it were possible to restrict some prompts to audio editions someday in the future!

posts.title: Update Edition From Stats Page
posts.description: Update edition from stats page or a easier way to do it without having to go into the books page

posts.title: Ability to print
posts.description: It would be great to be able to print out my TBR not owned list (either to paper (gasp) or a pdf) to help when visiting the used book stores. would love for it to be just the titles and authors, or options to select which details we want to print. (I am sure there are other printing options that would be helpful as well)

posts.title: Tracking Tandem Reads
posts.description: I'd love to be able to create a tandem read to track how far I am in completing both books overall. For example, in this tandem read I am 27% done with one book and 31% done with the other, but what percent am I done when they are combined? (Clearly I was an accelerated reading student and not math student haha)

posts.title: Add “Scared” to Moods
posts.description: Would be great in addition to “tense” to also have an option for “scared” or something equivalent to let readers know how spooked a book made them feel.

posts.title: Reading Challenge description or link.
posts.description: I'd love it if the 'add to reading challenge' page either showed me the description of the challenge OR had a link on it to the main challenge page. (The link could be the name of the challenge.) I have two similar 'around the world' challenges with similar names. One is for authors-from-countries and the other is for books-set-in-countries, but that difference is only obvious from the descriptions so when I'm actually on the page to add the latest book I've read, I have to open a new window to open my reading challenges and remind myself which is which.

posts.title: Easily update kindle Vella episode/page count
posts.description: Have an easy way to update the page/episode count that is still in progress and not marked as complete by the author. I would just like an easier way to add new episodes to the overall page count of a Kindle Vella story, rather than having to submit a librarian update request frequently. Also be able to mark whether I kind of a story is complete or if the author is still adding episodes. Kindle Vella displays the frequency of episode uploads and when a story or series is complete.

posts.title: show friends' books in english if possible
posts.description: Lots of my friends/people I follow read books in languages other than english. Right now, if it's in a language I don't speak, it's hard for me to find out if I'm interested in the book. I have to go to editions and see if it has been translated into english or one of my other languages. I'd love for this to be easier, I can think of several options: - If an edition is not in one of my languages, show me an english edition instead. If there's no english edition, show me one in another of my languages. If there is none, show me the edition my friend read. - Indicate (via icon or something similar) if there is an edition in one of my languages so I know if it's worth my time to go search for it or if I should just scroll over the entry. - Place a direct link to an english edition somewhere in the entry of the community tab or on the book page.

posts.title: Have a 'Don't show this user' option for Similar Users
posts.description: Would be very useful for inactive users

posts.title: Add fiction/nonfiction checkbox to recommendations preferences pane
posts.description: I'd really love an "only show me fiction" or "only show me nonfiction" option in the Recommendations preferences. I'm mostly looking for fantasy recommendations and I'm getting a lot of TTRPG guides and art books after the last update. They're correctly marked as nonfiction, so that would be an easy way to filter them out. (Also, I'm not sure if I should file this as a bug, but I have put Dungeons & Dragons and TTRPG in the "topics you don't like" box and they're still showing up in my recommendations.)

posts.title: toggle read/dnf in stats page
posts.description: this is my first year tracking DNF with regularity, and I see those books get added to my stats, which is cool, but also I'd love to be able to see stats on only the books I actually finished. Could this be a toggle option?

posts.title: Add "Mark book as finished?" verification to "Mark as 'finished'" button on action menu
posts.description: Add the “finished book“ verification message to the iPad app. Admin update: The verification didn't exist on the action menu, only in the progress update menu. I'm now going to add it to the action menu (across all platforms) now! - Nadia

posts.title: Home and community tabs merge?
posts.description: What if we had the home and community tab merge so our friends' updates are the first things we see when we sign in? The community tab could also be turned into a page where you can see all of your book lists in one section, like a "my books" page? I'm not suggesting this so it'd be like Goodreads, but rather to make the website a little more cohesive. The more newbies get lost clicking around, the more likely they are to leave.

posts.title: I asked a GR user friend what's stopping them from switching over;
posts.description: I'm not sure if the devs would find this useful but no harm in trying. I'm sure you guys have internal UX people but I was trying to convince a friend to make the leap and they mentioned some ideas I thought I would copy and paste into here. Honestly they gave a lot of really interesting thoughts that I hadnt really thought of because I use SG for the personal stats but now that they mentioned it it's really genius! A lot of their thoughts were about feeling a bit of a disconnect between themselves and the book community. They said, "I think a big thing for me is that it starts of with info about myself. What am I reading my to-read pile and stuff is what covers so much of the first impression. right now, it feels like nothing more than a database, reflecting back info I already know. Doesn’t entice me to stick around on the app, I have to actively go out of my way to get new info." They continued to say; "It’s also so big, 75% of the the page when I open the app is telling me what I’m currently reading. Like, I know, the books are literally right next to me. In fact, of all the things the app could tell me about me, I think that’s the least interesting thing it could say. If I open up goodreads at any given time, chances are that it’s giving me new info. Even if you want to focus on being more of a personal tracker, lean into that. Let me open up the page to some interesting info about my stats “You’re currently reading 24% more than last week” or something. Or like a FB/Insta thing “on this day last year, you were reading…”. Something fresh and interesting about the stats"

posts.title: Add the colon to the numbers pad for hours and minutes
posts.description: I don’t know if this is possible considering Apple or android keyboard formatting requirements, but can you add the colon key to the numbers pad/keyboard for adding hours and minutes in a progress update? It'scenes unnecessary (cluttered) to show the entire keyboard when the only extra key you need is the colon. Again, I understand UI Coding constraints may not permit this. Another option would be to have the colon automatically appear once the hours are input or have the colon already in the dialogue box. The cursor could jump to the other side once two numbers are put in for hours (i.e., 06:30). I prefer using percentages whenever I can, but I'm still desperately waiting for audible to include percentage in its app. If I could, I would use other audiobook platforms, but I already have thousands of audiobooks in their ecosystem, and I like how the Kindle app incorporates immersion reading seamlessly. I’ve emailed them hundreds of times about adding percentage to the app and maybe one day incorporating immersion reading into their E-readers (not just the tablets). The frustrating thing is I have to rely on audiobooks and other adaptive reading software due to a physical/cognitive disability that impedes reading physical or digital books alone.

posts.title: Desktop View
posts.description: I would love to see different interface options on Desktop. While it's really nice to scroll through all the books one by one on a phone. It's really annoying to me to do that on a PC. Especially when you wanna take screenshots real quick of a list of books, for example your current reading list. You can barely ever show more than 2 1/2 books. would be nice to be able to switch between "listed below" and a "windows" view like shown on the added pic. There you see the problem in real life. I could not really quickly make a prettier version, cuz with one screenshot i cant fit 3 full books on one side. Like this easily 4 or even 6 would fit.

posts.title: Allow for magazine and newspaper formats
posts.description: (1) When reading an item that isn't classified as a book, it doesn't show up in books read. It's misleading. Add a feature for short stories, magazine specially for smaller/novella works. (2) More format options: magazine, & newspapers.

posts.title: Archive challenges but keep record on book page
posts.description: This feels a little bit hard to describe but I will try my best! I joined several reading challenges last year (and have joined several new ones this year!) Throughout last year, as I filled out the challenges with books I intended to read, I had tagged those aspirational books with "2022-challenges" so that I could quickly access the entire list of books to choose from for my Up Next. Many of these books remained aspirational, as I did not read many of them the way I had hoped. I have now started archiving the 2022 challenges themselves from the Challenge page, since the dates have passed and even if I read the books, it will no longer complete the challenge. But now if I click on my "2022-challenges" tag, I have lost the link to which challenge and prompt I had added the book to. When I click on the "Add to Reading Challenges" button, the archived challenge that I had added it to no longer shows up. Whether I ended up completing the challenge or not, I would love for the record to remain visible of which challenge(s) I added the book to, regardless of archive status. Was it something from my TBR that I added to a Reading Randomizer challenge? Or was it something that I picked to try to complete last year’s Read The World challenge? I’m trying to clean up my TBR to get rid of things I don’t actually plan on reading and something in the latter category has a higher “sticking power” than something in the former.

posts.title: Add ability to sort/filter "Reading Challenges I've Created" section
posts.description: Under the "Challenges I've Created" section, create tabs or allow filtering by the tags that already show up there: Live, Public, Ended, etc. It would be cool to be able to change the sort order too (like earliest or last created, most/least participants, etc), but that's less important to me than just being able to see all public/current challenges quickly.

posts.title: Increase number of prompts allowed in a reading challenge
posts.description: Right now you can't label any books over #999 on reading challenges. I was trying to add the 1001 books to read before you die list (which is actually almost 1400 books) and it would not allow me to number the challenges because of the limit. Is there any way this can be expanded?

posts.title: Series differences in editions because of language
posts.description: Sometimes the number of books within a series is different in the translations. For example, in Germany a lot of fantatsy ans science fiction books get cut into 2 books. Like...
