"A Game of Thrones" is "Die Herren von Winterfell" and "Das Erbe von Winterfell". Currently the series shows "A Song of Ice and Fire #1a and #1b" here. But if a mostly German reader would click on the series name, they get * A Song of Ice and Fire #1 (English) * A Song of Ice and Fire #2 (English) * A Song of Ice and Fire #3 (English) * A Song of Ice and Fire #4 (English) * A Song of Ice and Fire #5 (English) * A Song of Ice and Fire #6 (English) * A Song of Ice and Fire #7 (English) * A Song of Ice and Fire #2a (German) * A Song of Ice and Fire #4a (German) * etc. This makes it pretty confusing to find the next book in reading order. Also the more language editions are added, the more chaotic the series overview becomes. (I stumbled into some Manga series pages where I couldn't make any sense out of the information because I only know German and English, but not Japanese. And sometimes with Manga the German edition is not shown on the series page but "hidden" in the editions of the Japanese issue.) I think it would be cleaner to have a separate series page per language. Someone here already suggested that books can be added to more then one series so that order of publishing and chronologically order can be portrayed. That would help with the language too, I think. But it could be cleaner on the long term if books and series get a language sub category as this would make it possible for users to get the site filtered only for books in languages they speak?

posts.title: Beanstack
posts.description: It would be nice to be able to have my beanstack updated whenever I read a book.

posts.title: Merge Editions
posts.description: I'm trying to be much more careful about adding the correct edition of the book I'm reading (number of pages, physical/digital etc) than I did on Goodreads. but I've had at least one instance where the edition I'm not reading has information I want to track but the edition I'm reading doesn't but has different information I also want to track. In this case it's an anthology where the edition I'm reading lists only the editor but has the correct media type and page count while the other edition in Storygraph lists all the authors but contains almost no other information (no page number, no media type, but does have the year of publication). I'm a little frustrated by the suggestion to search other editions to see if they have the information I want before putting in a request to fix missing information because it means I have to prioritize which stat(s) I want to be accurately tracked. FWIW, I really appreciate it when all the authors in an anthology are listed. It makes the authors read tracking more useful and can also alert me to anthologies I didn't know a favored author contributed to.

posts.title: Recommendations in TBR
posts.description: I would like the recommendation to have the option a « Only show me books... » option. My TBR is extensive and having this option to filter would be very helpful instead of just the automated up next suggestions in the TBR.

posts.title: Audiobook Stats - Minutes vs Hours
posts.description: I noticed the chart for the stats around audiobook minutes listened is labeled in hours at the top of the chart and the axis is labeled in minutes. It confused me at first and might be easier/less confusing to read if they matched. Hours seems like it would be simpler to understand when quickly glancing at it.

posts.title: Change Invitation/Request Wording for "Reject" Button
posts.description: Just a thought, but when I receive a buddy read invitation, "Reject" sounds a bit harsh haha. Maybe changing it to a softer language would feel nicer? Something like "Decline" possibly? It's also worded this way for friend requests as well, but I hadn't noticed it as much because I usually just accept those haha.

posts.title: Browser agnostic website
posts.description: As someone who only ever reads ebooks and finds buddy reads & audiobooks about as appealing as DIY dentistry, I know I'm not in the target demo for the big enhancements at TSG. The tiny and INCREDIBLY hard-working team has dome a truly fantastic job of maximising the user exerience for the greatest possible number of users, and I applaud in awe. Adding to my list of things that I fully understand are VERY low priority enhancements (comprehensive DNF stats & sorting, seamless & painless ebook adds) here's another: a browser-agnostic website experience One of the VERY best things about TSG is that it's not owned by a data-sucking megacorp as GR is. Sadly, for those of us who access TSG primarily by the web browser (90% for me), the site is VERY heavily optimised for a browser whose data suckage is infinitely worse than Amazon's. I avoid Chrome as much as possible, but that means putting up with a markedly suboptimal experience on the website that I use more than any other, multiple times a day. Adding hundreds of ebooks has been and continues to be a frustrating hit-and-miss "will it work this time?" kind of game, as the support team and librarians can testify. I am grateful for their tireless efforts and apologise for adding so often to their workload. Dark mode also works properly only in Chrome. The percentages are blurred in Firefox (even on my 34-inch 4K monitor) and in my secondary browser, Pale Moon, the graphs won't load at all. I fully grok, and support, the wisdom of "the greatest good for the greatest number" when it comes to the wonderful leaps forward TSG has made, but I hope that enhancements like this one can be kept in mind for some future attention.

posts.title: "# books added" counter in reading challenge prompts doesn't reflect "books added" list
posts.description: When browsing a reading challenge, it is confusing to see, for example, "(4 books added)", click through, and see only one book (because all books are editions in the same book family). This is particularly relevant for reading challenge owners trying to make sure that books added to their challenges are actually relevant to participants. Could the count please reflect the number of book families added, and not editions? Thank you!

posts.title: Live text feature for inputting new books
posts.description: Add the IOS Live text function to the new book edition form to make it easier/faster to fill out the text fields.

posts.title: Not a priority ticket, but this is.
posts.description: I obviously don't know how things are handled behind the scenes at TheStoryGraph, but I'm a subscriber currently and have added some data to a few books. However, I really don't feel it's important that these tickets should be fast-tracked (assuming they are), taking up time which could be spent on people having more urgent problems. So, would it be possible to add a little box to tick before we submit a new ticket stating this is not a priority? I've no idea if this would help you now, but since this app is going to explode in popularity in 2022, it might be of some value 😃

posts.title: Review Section on Book Page
posts.description: It would be lovely to have an entire section dedicated to user reviews on a book's page. Aside from content warnings, tags, etc, it would be really beneficial to know exactly how readers feel about a book.

posts.title: Change interface on desktop
posts.description: Whilst the interface is suitable for mobile, a function to change from the box-version to a list-version of the homepage for desktop is needed. It feels very clunky.

posts.title: Use previously read books to complete prompts
posts.description: Sometimes I do not wish to re-read books that are part of a reading challenge and I've already read before. If a book is marked as "read", we should be able to use it to complete a prompt (maybe manually, so that the people who wish to re-read can still do so).

posts.title: Better site navigation
posts.description: I don't understand why the site has so few navigational links. The only way I know to get to "Browse," for instance, is by Googling it or manually altering the URL in the address bar. Same with getting to this feedback page. Why aren't there links to these things, or why are they so hard to find? I understand the minimalist aesthetic, but when it seriously compromises functionality, it defeats its own "simplicity."

posts.title: Filter book by availability in certain countries
posts.description: I've run into a problem recently where a few books that are recommended to me aren't available in my country, in this case the US. They just haven't been published through a US publisher, meaning I can't recommend them to the library or get them from a non-Amazon bookstore. I've got one that was published in the UK a while back, but won't be published in the US until next year. It would be nice if there was a way to filter that so I'm not getting recommendations for books I can't actually get my hands on.

posts.title: Link Amazon and Audible Accounts
posts.description: I don't know if this is possible given the constraints of Amazon, But if there is a way you could enable users to link their Amazon or other bookseller accounts tO SG as a way to easily identify which books a user has/need as well as which ones they are currently reading. In my head, this would also be an easy way to input Book data into the database. Of course, I understand this may be impossible right now but I just wanted to suggest it in case it is possible in the future.

posts.title: App Rotation Lock
posts.description: Include a setting where people can choose whether they want to lock screen rotation for the app in landscape or portrait mode regardless of the position of their device? This would be especially helpful given the menu on the phone app disappears when it rotates into landscape mode

posts.title: Tags
posts.description: Would it be possible to add a few more spaces on the Favorite Genre section of our profiles? It's always a struggle to pick one genre over the other! I always have to redo my tags because sometimes I want to see books from the genre I didn't have space to choose.

posts.title: Connectivity/Import to GoodNotes
posts.description: I don't have a specific idea mapped out for this suggestion but wanted to toss something out for consideration. I'm getting into digital journaling and see an opportunity to combine that with GoodNotes some how. Perhaps I could export my Storygraph data visualizations (as PDFs?) so I can insert them into my digital reading journal.

posts.title: Separate stats for books in bundle editions
posts.description: Not sure how feasable that would be, but I would love to be able to count books and see their stats separately when it's an edition with several novels in one book. For example, I've read an edition that had The Iron Dragon's Daughter and the Dragons of Babel in one book, so the SG counted them as one, while I counted them as two in my physical reading journal.

posts.title: Progress Update/Add Notes - Placeholder
posts.description: On the homepage and the book page, the page/% input has been changed to be a placeholder. I love it! Would it be possible to change the progress update page to have this as well?

posts.title: Filter 5-star book lists of other users
posts.description: If I'm looking at another user's 5-star book list, I would like the ability to filter the books by the types I'm most interested in.

posts.title: Siri/Alexa integration
posts.description: I would love to be able to say “Siri, add ‘book title’ to my storygraph” when an interesting recommendation comes up in a podcast or audiobook that I’m listening to. Mostly I want to add things to my TBR, but also “Siri I finished reading X” might be great too!

posts.title: Algorithm Transparency
posts.description: It might be interesting to see a general overview of how the algorithm that recommends books is picking them. I realize that you would not be able to go into great detail, as then someone could steal your work, but a high level overview would be useful. Partly because I think we (the users of Storygraph) might want to be aware of changes to the algorithm.

posts.title: Weighted Voting
posts.description: Here in the Feedback/Roadmap section, might it be possible to give users a set number of votes for a given period (say a month)? Users could then indicate the strength of their preference for an idea by the number of votes they give it

posts.title: Don't always auto-rotate the screen
posts.description: Have the app follow the setting for allow/disallow rotation. I find the app always rotates, even when I'm in landscape/portrait mode.

posts.title: Clearer upvote icon
posts.description: That. The upvote icon on roadmap item pages could be a bit clearer.

posts.title: Apple shortcuts integration
posts.description: I'm using Habits First as a screen blocking app to motivate me to read, exercise, etc. The app can use data reported from an Apple shortcut and I'd love if Storygraph could report my pages read to a shortcut so I can use reading as motivation to unlock my phone more effectively. This would be immensely helpful for other screen blocking apps with similar features as well! And unlock a lot of cool data-forward shortcuts for reading that everybody could use. I would be okay with this as a Plus only feature if necessary!

posts.title: Easily integrate my TBR and Read list into ai chat bot.
posts.description: I am working on a personal reading challenge where I added a bunch of tropes that I’d like to read an example of this year. Rather than add new books to my tbr, I’d love to be able to ask an ai bot to look through my list and, avoiding excessive spoilers, suggest books with specific tropes. If no books on my list work, use my history and preferences to suggest books i will like, rather than just the most popular examples. I have tried to use the trope search function in explore, but I’m not sure if it understands my plain text properly (do I need a - in “fated mates” for it to work?) I also can’t easily search for tbr books that have not been added to a reading challenge yet, but that would be a helpful way to use the tbr search bar.

posts.title: Update broken streak to 0 or 1 faster
posts.description: I casually like to maintain a streak but am not too worried when I lose it. It is frustrating however to have to wait a full extra day after a missed day for it to acknowledge that I’m at 0 or 1. I understand folks who miss entering in data don’t want to be shocked by a 0, but I would prefer the streak count on the homepage be accurate to the data it has at the time. There can still be that big box for “Previous period incomplete” on the streak page. But having to wait a full extra day to see my streak decrease makes it feel like a bigger deal than it is.

posts.title: Syncing with MyAnimeList and Anilist for manga
posts.description: Most avid manga readers like myself use a platform like MAL or Anilist to track their manga alongside their anime, but tracking it both in those platforms and where I do the rest of my reading (Storygraph) is a hassle. Being able to sync them would be GREAT!

posts.title: Tag Dispute
posts.description: I see many books tagged as, for example, 'literary' when I would heavily dispute that. I would love the ability to question or vote a tag out or in. Could get messy, but there are many books tagged in a way that I think warrants a "flagging" or challenge system.

posts.title: Reading Challenges
posts.description: I’d love to be able to choose my books in advance for a reading challenge and see the cover of all the reading challenge books. I like how you can see books you’ve added for a challenge, but I’d love to have a book selected for a challenge to see my plan outlined. Kind of like when you’ve added a book you can see the books you’ve added to a challenge.

posts.title: Readest integration
posts.description: Readest is a pretty great cross-platform reader. Would love to connect it with StoryGraph.

posts.title: toggle value expression on book length graph
posts.description: I love the book length graph but I also think it would be cool to see the pie graph with a toggle to change the expression. For example currently one 600pg book = 1 value, and one 50pg book = 1 value, but it would be cool to have the option to see it expressed where the 600pg book = 600 value, and the 50pg book = 50 value etc. so even sorted into the current page count categories you could see the specific "amount" of reading you've done in that way. Hope I explained that well enough.

posts.title: 'Hide from Challenge' Option
posts.description: The option to hide a completed book for a reading challenge prompt is available if you're the creator of the challenge, but not if you're participating in someone else's challenge. Make that option available to anyone?

posts.title: Have data points dots always show up on streak chart
posts.description: Hi there! If this has been discussed before, I'm sorry for wasting your time. I really love the streak feature and can't wait to see whether or not some of the cool Ideas suggested here get implemented. I've been wondering if there was a possibility to always show the dots per date on the line. I've always been confused why I don't see them and some friends do. I thought it might be a setting I messed up, or something to do with the operating system, but after googling I found out it's due to the screen sizes. Have you thought of a way to give smaller screens the ability to also show the dots? I am always messing up seeing the amount of pages I've read on a day, and I see friends (with the dots) doing so with ease. I also think it just looks way more fun, personally! I know rotating my screen shows the dots, but that way the graph doesn't fit completely. Which I understand, of course, given the amount of different sizes of screens!

posts.title: Be able to track audiobook progress to align with Audible
posts.description: Audible doesn’t show the % progress, it only shows how much you have left. Instead of me having to do spreadsheet math to do the tracking, have a progress option for time left instead of how much listened to or %

posts.title: publication year vs read date: See Edition Pub Date
posts.description: I know you just shipped an update to the scatter plot. Sorry for adding more! This came up as I was clicking around on the new chart. Would it be possible to see the edition pub date on the chart and not just the first pub date? Maybe a way to toggle between the two? I read translations and it's helpful to see when a book was published in the language I read it in against the read year because that's when it became accessible to me.

posts.title: filter past meetings (book club)
posts.description: I would love to be able to filter past meetings by book title, author name and date, so I can easily check if the club has read a specific book or something by a specific author before, or check what we read in a certain time frame.

posts.title: Blurb preview on hover
posts.description: One thing I miss from GR is the preview of the blurb of a book when you hover over the title/cover. You can see the first 100 or so characters of the description when hovering the mouse. (I've recently moved over from GoodReads - love it here!) So you can get an idea of a book without having to click through to it, which given that SG sometimes loses my place if I click through and then use the back button to return to the results list would be really handy.

posts.title: Reactions and replies in forum/buddyread
posts.description: When you reply to a reaction in a forum or buddyread, it shows the user you're replying to, but clicking on that doesn't bring you to the reaction the reply is for. This sometimes can confuse the discussion. Can a reply to a reaction be connected to that reaction? Also, a third layer of reactions would be soooo nice (coming from a platform with three layer-discussions).

posts.title: Daily stats
posts.description: I know this might be unique to someone like me, but I often read 4 to 6 different books a day and would like to be able to see to my pages read or minute listen stats for an individual day and not a range or total over time. perhaps it can be next to the daily streak and users can decide whether they want to see it or not?

posts.title: Edit buddy read comments & page numbers
posts.description: I’d love it if we could edit the page number after posting a comment under a buddy read. Sometimes I forget to update the page number and it’s a pain to have to delete the comment and repost it rather than being able to just edit the comment and/or page number. I’d also love it if we could update the reading tracker for that book via the buddy read instead of having to click out of that, go to the home page or my profile and do it there.

posts.title: Library Workers: Reader's Advisory
posts.description: So this app is an AMAZING start for reader's advisory. I'm hoping at some point you will add a feature for those who work in libraries to create/save readers advisory searches/lists for patrons that are totally separate from their personal stats

posts.title: Hide Genre In Lists
posts.description: I was just realizing when I’m looking at lists, I’m not caring about genre. I just want all my results. Either in tags on searching for a book. I could get a lot more results per page. Maybe a filter option?

posts.title: Get home from roadmap
posts.description: I currently don't see a way to get back to the StoryGraph home page from the roadmap page without editing the URL in my browser. If there truly isn't a way to get back home, there should be! And if there is a way already, can we make it more prominent?

posts.title: Reading challenge aggregate progress
posts.description: I've been thinking it might be fun for the participants page of a reading challenge to have an indicator of how complete the challenge is, as in the collective effort of all the participants. I picture it maybe having three indicators: one showing how many prompts have been completed by the participant who's made the most progress, one showing how many prompts have been completed by the participant who's made the least progress, and one showing some kind of average of everybody's progress.

posts.title: Easier switch between book versions/formats
posts.description: I struggle to find audiobook versions of the books I’m reading, which throws off my charts. I’d like an easy way to accomplish this. Maybe there’s already a way to do this that just isn’t obvious to me, and in that case, I think it should be made more obvious.

posts.title: Scan books with book spine
posts.description: Hello! Love the work you've done with the barcode scanner and being able to scan covers now! I wanted to ask how difficult it would be to tweak it so that users can add their books using the book spine? Totally understandable if it is too complex or technically infeasible, but it would be amazingly helpful to add owned books by just scanning the spines of books on the shelf instead of having to pull each of them out manually!

posts.title: Display no. of books required to complete challenge at top of page
posts.description: Currently for numerical and prompt challenges, the number of books added by participants is displayed at the top of the page. Instead, this should be the number of books/prompts required to complete the challenge. Many times for numerical challenges, the host does not include the no. of books required in the title or description, so I have to join the challenge to see the number in the progress circle. Or for prompt challenges the host has opted not to number the prompts, so I have to count them or join the challenge to see the number. For numerical challenges, it makes more sense to show the no. of books added by participants under the CHALLENGE BOOKS section like this: **Books you've added (10)** and **All books added (50)**.

posts.title: Tab buttons behaviour when composing comments in buddy read
posts.description: I am currently doing a buddy read, having a fun time. However, when I am writing a comment on mobile, I sometimes accidentally click one of the bottom "tab" buttons (usually the "Challenges" one, as it's in the middle) and as a result, I lose the partially drafted comment, as pressing the "back" button does not return you to the buddy read page. Perhaps there IS way to retrieve that comment, but I haven't found it yet. I don't really have a great solution (besides stop pressing buttons accidentally). Perhaps disabling those buttons while composing a comment - though this could be confusing. Removing them entirely then? Luckily not my job to figure this out xD. I suppose the issue also applies for Readalongs.

posts.title: Buddy read comments remain open for a reread
posts.description: When you’ve finished a book in a buddy read and start a reread all the comments lock again. Can it be changed to keep them open if you’ve already finished the book once, even if it was in a different format?

posts.title: allow standard shortcut to start quote formatting
posts.description: I'm very used to starting a quote by beginning a line with the greater than symbol then a space "> " As long as > is the first character on the line, as soon as I type the space, the formatting changes to quote formatting in the other apps that I use regularly (discord, slack, jira). So I tend to do the same thing by default when I want to add a quote in storygraph, and then I have to go back and delete the extra characters and manually click the quote button. It would be amazing to honor this standard formatting shortcut.

posts.title: Identify which book satisfied challenge prompt
posts.description: Can the book that was read to meet a challenge prompt be marked in some way? I have often listed multiple books there, and I like seeing the options but it would be nice to have the one that I read identified.

posts.title: Journaling Goal
posts.description: As I’m thinking about my 2025 reading goals, I’m wishing we had the ability to set a yearly # of words journaled goal. I am wanting to engage more with my reading, and it would be nice to have the app automatically track this for the year just like pages, books, or minutes. It should definitely count the private reading journal for books, but probably also readalong forum comments and book reviews as well. I just want to think and write about my books more and have some kind of metric for this!

posts.title: Sort for Novellas
posts.description: Finding short reads made easier with the ability to distinguish novellas from normal books. Even if I try the Low to High pages route, it doesn't help since a lot of books on my tbr are missing page info

posts.title: Numerical book property input like a tag but with simple calculations?
posts.description: May be a long shot, but I have data about how long in hours it took me to read each book, and the thickness of the book as well, and I want to plot this data in various ways. But because of the continuous nature of these things, I'd end up with essentially thousands of 'categories' on plots if I used tags. For example, I want to add up how tall the books I've read are in a certain time period, or how long I read for in a certain time period. I am currently using excel and bookly for these two things, respectively, but it would be cool to have it natively here!

posts.title: "Profile Privacy" setting is hard to find!
posts.description: I was trying to set my profile to "public" so that my local bookstore could look at it for my personalized book subscription without needing an account themselves. I looked at the Preferences where the rest of the privacy settings are multiple times, and I think I did look at "Manage Account" once but didn't see it at first. I was all set to write up a feature request for this to be an option, but I saw a few suggested posts that made it seem like this was already a feature, so I gave it one more closer look. I'm all set now 🙌 but I definitely was expecting that setting to be co-located with the other privacy settings.

posts.title: Import/export books read to/from Fable app?
posts.description: hello, i love The StoryGraph for tracking my personal date, but i got sucked in to a bookclub on Fable (i know i know 😅). would be cool to import/export books between platforms- maybe just a few times a year.

posts.title: Book counts are off
posts.description: Book count is off by one, and percentage is incorrect. Showing 249 books read, but Ive only read 248. My goal for this year is 250 books, and showing that as 100% complete.

posts.title: Steam-style Book Discovery Queue
posts.description: Similar to the recommendations, but a bit more dynamically on-demand. In the gaming app Steam, it's possible to go through a suggested list of Games, based on previous preferences and some adjustments such as popularity of a game and maybe its release date. It's interesting because when unsure if to go for something from the to-read list, or something from standard recommendations, the possibility to just browse through a randomized list of suggestions that might match the interests of the reader. It would also help with discovering more new authors and new books, since the most popular books (while super cool as a feature) don't necessarily show the latest releases, and the recommendations don't seem to refresh on a regular basis to take into account newly read books and rating trends for them.

posts.title: Track Fan Fiction
posts.description: Okay. Before people get mad hear me out. I don't think it should include the authors name, story name, etc. But it would be cool to track that reading with your books. I envision a static fan fiction book you can to your currently reading list. All you do is add to your page number to this item. Edit: This would be different from "not a book" because you wouldn't have to type out all the details for each fic

posts.title: Tag Updates
posts.description: Apologies as this is a post mostly about the overall tag capability and several aspects relating to it. Hoping in future we can see: - ability to tag specific editions - I use tags to indicate where I procured the book (home collection, library, gift, libro.fm, audible) as well as format (graphic audio, audiobook, magazine, physical, ebook). This is really only a problem when I do a reread. I might have read a physical copy i owned the first time, then took out the graphic audio version from the library next time. - ability to edit existing tags. ex. i mark books by author gender and want to change all my "woman" tags to "femme", and all my "man" tags to "masc". - ability to delete tag options, i misspelt something once and that tag lives forever in my list gumming up my drop down 😅 - ability to have tag groups. I saw this one in another post, but the ability to have be able to have Canada as two separate tags, one for setting and one for author location. - mass editing. I think i've seen this one too, but I'd love to be able to apply the same tag to a large swath of books. ex books i own, or took from the library.

posts.title: Restore avatar image to upper navbar in Landscape orientation
posts.description: Since the upper menu bar was changed to include Explore I’ve noticed that I’ve lost my avatar image in the top right corner when changing between Landscape and Portrait mode on my iPad. It now gets replaced by the Hamburger icon in Portrait mode, which has the menu options plus my profile menu combined into one. When I work in TSG I use my iPad in Landscape mode. But when I take screenshots for the socials I turn my iPad into Portrait mode to make better use of screenshot real estate. I no longer get my avatar in the Portrait mode screen shots to visually demonstrate that this is *my* screenshot, *my* data. I’m actually surprisingly bothered by this! Because it’s something I’m used to having that has been removed. Is there any way to work the avatar image back into both Portrait and Landscape modes? Here are examples of how Portrait mode used to look - from a screenshot I actively took and used on the socials - and how it now looks. The loss of ‘identity’ in the screenshot is unfortunate to me. Update: in fact, here is a request from two full years ago where I stated my preference for including my avatar in screenshots! So I’ve got long standing form for this 🤓 https://roadmap.thestorygraph.com/requests-ideas/posts/include-plus-status-icon-on-in-app-avatar-image-like-notificatio

posts.title: Streak import
posts.description: One time manual import of reading streak from different app. I have a 1200+ Kindle reading streak that is probably the only thing keeping me chained to Kindle at this point

posts.title: Easy way to find read books without dates
posts.description: Is there already or Can we get some way to filter so it is easy to find books, that you have read but havent got specific dates? They dont Seem to be on The read books stat… and I would like to clean them up and use The read without a date solely for owned books, Where i have read a different version.

posts.title: Average rating by publication month stat
posts.description: I'd love to have, or be able to create in the Plus options, a stat that can show me my average rating for books published "April 2024" or "all Junes" to discover if there's a publication month/season most successful in my reading.

posts.title: Mass-Deleting Tags / Possibly Custom Charts WITHOUT Deleting Books & Reviews ?
posts.description: I saw there is a feature to Mass-Delete Tags, Books and Reviews all at once, what if I want to Mass-Delete my Tags but not the Books & Reviews? And/or Mass-Delete my Custom Charts? Is there any way to make it so that when you delete your chart the tags in that chart delete with it?

posts.title: Select book type while rating book
posts.description: I would like to be able to save whether or not I have read a book physically, digitally, or via audio when I select the book I am reading. Currently it defaults me to whatever type the book was created in which is not necessarily correct for the way I have read the book which is showing skewed results on the stats page

posts.title: Connect multiple kindle books to audiobook collection
posts.description: This is mainly for immersion reading, but can we have a way to link multiple Kindle books series to an audiobook collection? Example linking the first two books in the Rachel Scott adventure series to the audiobook collection. StoryGraph book pages down below: https://app.thestorygraph.com/books/15c666e8-4099-4362-9ce3-212212306730 https://app.thestorygraph.com/books/733d9caa-469a-4df5-b133-2557c8a75318 https://app.thestorygraph.com/series-collections/383455

posts.title: Have an easy way to search for and identify Kindle Vella  series
posts.description: Can we have an easy way to search for and identify Kindle Vella series? I know that you can mark the publisher as Kindle Vella, but can we have some other type of identification marker in the visible book information on the book page? Also, can there be a way to indicate whether a vella is ongoing or complete? finally, can we have a search category within the database to find Kindle Vellas?

posts.title: Show your most recent edition in Personalized Similar Books
posts.description: Hello! I've been loving the Personalized Similar Books feature and I noticed something that has gotten me a bit frustrated but I'm not sure how much of an easy fix this is. I would absolutely love it if in the recommendations it showed books I've already read, owned or TBR'd as the editions I've marked. Currently, I see books I've read in the recommendations with the label "You've read another edition". Secondly, if there was an option to exclude previously read books from the recommendations list, as a toggle button or something, that would be amazing!

posts.title: Add Explore Button to Menu Bar/Hammbuger Menu
posts.description: Maybe this is just a me thing, but whenever I'm trying to get to the recommendation search, I always default to looking for it everywhere else besides right next to the recommendation pile. It's usually worse in the app. Adding a shortcut to the menus could also be nice if you're on a book page so you don't have to jump back to the main page.

posts.title: AI Recommendations
posts.description: Pango books has a bot that recommends books based on pretty much anything you put in. It's given me some pretty good recommendations and is fun to use. I think it would be a great feature to have here

posts.title: Easier date accessibility for vintage books
posts.description: I buy/collect a fair amount of vintage books from secondhand shops, and scrolling back to put in a date from 1983 or 1969 takes a really long time. Could the date add be an easier dropdown? Also, books only have the pub year, is a day and month always necessary?

posts.title: A read before option
posts.description: I've been tracking the books I read since 2019. I absolutely will go back to the books I've enjoyed in the past, and I'd like a simple option to be able to tag a book as 'read before' even if it's not logged in my Storygraph history. On Letterboxd for films they have an option you can tap that says 'I've seen this film before' when you log it; I'd appreciate something similar to that

posts.title: Export Data in filtered view
posts.description: I like to double track books I've read so I export the data and put into a spreadsheet. It would be nice to be able to set what data to export instead of all of the books. Example: export only books read this year/month.

posts.title: Add seconds to audiobook progress updates/duration
posts.description: Add seconds to progress updates and total time duration for audiobook to make time and reading challenges more accurate.

posts.title: Ability to clone other user’s lists
posts.description: On the Letterbxd movie app, they allow the ability to clone other people’s lists in their pro subscription. Ex: I have a book 1001 movies to see before you die and another member has already added all the movies to a list I was able to clone. Now when I log that movie in my watched list, I can see how much of the list is finished with just a glance. I know I am not the person to add 1001 books to StoryGraph for my own use so would love this feature.

posts.title: Private editions
posts.description: Users have Ability to input, certain additions of a book that are private and not available to the rest of the community. This teacher would be helpful for people like myself that need to authorize the format or page numbers to accommodate Accessibility software. Basically, these Additions of a book or not available to anyone else, but I’m particular reader, and should be able to be hidden from the community database. Jimmy absolutely clear, These additions do not change an authors work at all! It would just change the page, count and format for an individual person to be able to use it with Accessibility text to speech software that cannot read it in its usual format. The reason that I want to be able to put these private additions in my Word account, rather than just adding the extra pages at the end, like I do for bonus scenes, and extra content from authors, Is that I want to be able to track my progress accurately with the page numbers generated from my text to speech software .

posts.title: Track streak from journal entries
posts.description: Right now streak is counting the days you log in and add your progress on a book. I would like it to count my journal updates. So I get a better view of days I haven't read.

posts.title: URL scheme
posts.description: Is there a URL scheme for the iOS app that I could reference when building an iOS Shortcut? I only half know what I’m asking here lol. But I’ve been teaching myself more and there are a number of automations I’d like to set up involving SG. For instance, get a book’s ISBN from a web page and pass it into Storygraph so I can go directly into a query/result instead of pausing to copy/paste the ISBN in the search box. Thanks for any info!

posts.title: Yearly Reading Wrap-up — Pie charts set by reader (Plus stat) is not clickable to see books in that data point
posts.description: In the pie charts for the Plus-only stats, the "pie slice" is not clickable so I can't see the list of books that make up the datapoint.

posts.title: Option to display book format on currently reading list
posts.description: Give users the option to display a book’s format on the currently reading list. This option would be useful for users reading multiple formats simultaneously (Immersion reading). Having visible format indicators on the list would help prevent potential mix ups when inputting progress updates. I have attached a mock up of how the formats could be displayed.

posts.title: Make included/exclude genres tick boxes
posts.description: The genres list is a bit hard to navigate especially on the phone. Might also make saving the filters easier (a separate suggestion I made).

posts.title: Profile Button Top Bar
posts.description: The Profile button is now pretty hidden, but I use that one the most. Would be nice to have that next to Community, in the top bar.

posts.title: Include Plus status icon on in-app avatar image, like notifications
posts.description: When I take screenshots for the twitters I like to include my avatar image in the top-right corner of the app, to show that they’re from my StoryGraph account. Would it be helpful/nice/useful to add a little + icon to the image for Plus accounts, much like the ‘you have new notifications’ lozenge that intermittently shows up. Otherwise the only indication that I’ve noticed of being Plus is on the Profile page.

posts.title: Review Questions for Short Stories
posts.description: When adding a review, some of the questions, like whether the work is more plot or character driven, simply don't apply to most short story collections (or anthologies, now that I think about it). It would be nice to have a way to opt out of answering those questions for short story collections.

posts.title: Exclude books with no page count from Up Next Suggestions "short book" pick
posts.description: In my suggestions, for the "shortest" book I was suggested an unpublished book with no page count added. This is misleading because not being updated with the page count doesn't mean it's short. (Also, it's not out/available yet, so I'm not sure it's useful to have it in suggestions in the first place.)

posts.title: Import data from existing edition format when adding a new one
posts.description: I would like it if there was a faster way to create pages for the same edition of a book in different formats (e.g. adding the e-book or audiobook versions to an existing paperbook edition). If I'm not mistaken, the only way to do so now is to create a new page and copy everything manually.

posts.title: Streamline editions/ read
posts.description: In recommendations, I’ve had to get rid of several editions of books I have already read because they are present in anthologies/ rereleased. This is especially true with novellas and short stories. Every variation of the yellow wallpaper has been recommended to me but I have already read it.

posts.title: Minor - remove pace for “daily’s”
posts.description: I read 3 books daily that have a different entry for each day (part of my morning routine). They are all listed as “fast paced” which is kind of nonsensical for a book intended to be read one entry per day over a year. I suspect this is because people enter their reading of these books once and the system calculates that they read the entire book in a single day. Might be hard to figure this out, but I suspect there is a power law curve for these daily readers - like the top 50 of them account for 99% of the daily entry type books that readers here consume. As a side note, could also auto-increment daily readers by around .28% points per day since they are intended to be read over a year.

posts.title: Reading challenge bonus prompts
posts.description: It would be great to be able to also see for example "Bonus prompts: 0%" in the description box of a prompt before opening the page itself so I know that there are bonus prompts as it can get overwhelming

posts.title: Manual lists of tags within TBR pile
posts.description: I love being able to sort and filter my TBR pile, but I would really like to be able to create my own lists via a manual tag. Having self-made tags will make it much easier to find books within my TBR that I had previously tagged when I first added them, such as a certain subject matter, recommended by a certain person, has to do with a certain experience we’re going through, etc. Thanks for all that you do!

posts.title: Personalized Recommendations
posts.description: Would it be possible to turn off personalized recs? It'd be nice just to see what is recommended without being catered to my history so I can find something I (or Storygraphy, for that matter) didn't think I'd like.

posts.title: Sync with goodreads
posts.description: I never had a goodreads account, but the friends I've enticed over do and don't like maintaining two lists.

posts.title: Reading Challenge - Add Public Tag Next To Live
posts.description: In the Challenges you've created, there is a green, “Live” indicator above each challenge. It would be great if an additional tag called “Public” could be added to Public challenges so they’re easier to spot in the list.

posts.title: Clicking "(It took 'x' days)" prompts you to edit the date finished
posts.description: Steps to replicate 1. Log in 2. Click Your Storygraph 3. Go to a book in Read recently 4. Click View/edit read history 5. Click (Took x days) Only the remove icon should prompt for removal

posts.title: Share book's link in app
posts.description: Being able to share a link to a book's storygraph page while using the app. It happens often I want to mention a book in a group chat with friends, but to do so I have to either screenshot the app or open the web browser and find the link manualy
